知识点／记忆点：异步失败处理发生在重试策略耗尽之后；目标可直接接收失败调用记录，无需为了调用另一函数再加消息中转层。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：SQS 加轮询函数可实现，但比直接失败目的地增加队列配置。

C：重构为状态机并改变 S3 事件路由，开发工作更多。

D：SNS 加订阅也可实现，但额外主题不是最少组件方案。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-retain-records.html

options.text: Set the image resize Lambda function as a destination of the avatar generator Lambda function for the events that fail processing.

Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Set the SQS queue as a destination with an on failure condition for the avatar generator Lambda function. Configure the image resize Lambda function to poll from the SQS queue.

Create an AWS Step Functions state machine that invokes the avatar generator Lambda function and uses the image resize Lambda function as a fallback. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches events from the S3 bucket to invoke the state machine.

Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Set the SNS topic as a destination with an on failure condition for the avatar generator Lambda function. Subscribe the image resize Lambda function to the SNS topic.

question_text_original: A developer is using an AWS Lambda function to generate avatars for profile pictures that are uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket. The Lambda function is automatically invoked for profile pictures that are saved under the /original/ S3 prefix. The developer notices that some pictures cause the Lambda function to time out. The developer wants to implement a fallback mechanism by using another Lambda function that resizes the profile picture. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员需要将在线零售应用迁移到 AWS，以应对预期增长的流量。目前应用运行在两台服务器上：Web 服务器渲染网页并在内存中管理会话状态，数据库服务器托管保存订单详情的 MySQL 数据库。流量较大时，Web 服务器内存使用率接近 100%，应用明显变慢。开发人员发现，内存增长和性能下降主要源于管理更多用户会话的负载。迁移 Web 服务器时，将使用位于 Application Load Balancer 后方、由 Auto Scaling 组管理的 Amazon EC2 实例。还应对应用做哪些改动以提高性能？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：B。会话状态应从 Web EC2 内存移到 ElastiCache，业务订单放 RDS，才可水平扩展。

知识点／记忆点：无状态 Web 节点把共享会话放在外部低延迟存储；会话可丢失性和订单持久性要求不同，不能把交易数据一起放入可逐出缓存。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：把所有会话压力转移到自管数据库增加连接和数据库负载，并需维护 MySQL。

C：Memcached 非持久缓存，不能作为订单业务数据的唯一存储。

D：实例存储随实例生命周期丢失且不跨节点共享，无法支撑可靠横向扩容。

options.text: Use an EC2 instance to host the MySQL database. Store the session data and the application data in the MySQL database.
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to store and manage the session data. Use an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store the application data.
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to store and manage the session data and the application data.
Use the EC2 instance store to manage the session data. Use an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store the application data.

question_text_original: A developer needs to migrate an online retail application to AWS to handle an anticipated increase in traffic. The application currently runs on two servers: one server for the web application and another server for the database. The web server renders webpages and manages session state in memory. The database server hosts a MySQL database that contains order details. When traffic to the application is heavy, the memory usage for the web server approaches 100% and the application slows down considerably. The developer has found that most of the memory increase and performance decrease is related to the load of managing additional user sessions. For the web server migration, the developer will use Amazon EC2 instances with an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Which additional set of changes should the developer make to the application to improve the application's performance?

question_text: 一个应用使用 Lambda 函数提取上传到 S3 存储桶的文件元数据，并将元数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。应用开始出现异常，开发人员希望检查 Lambda 函数代码的日志以查找错误。根据此配置，应在哪里查找日志？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。CloudWatch 可统一监控 Lambda 处理过程和相关告警。

知识点／记忆点：应用运行日志记录代码输出和异常，审计日志记录谁调用了 AWS API；排查函数代码报错要找运行日志而不是数据存储。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：输入文件位于 S3 不意味着函数日志也自动写入 S3。

B：CloudTrail 主要记录 API 审计，不等同于函数内部异常日志。

D：DynamoDB 保存业务元数据，不会自动保存 Lambda 运行日志。

options.text: Amazon S3
AWS CloudTrail
Amazon CloudWatch
Amazon DynamoDB

question_text_original: An application uses Lambda functions to extract metadata from files uploaded to an S3 bucket; the metadata is stored in Amazon DynamoDB. The application starts behaving unexpectedly, and the developer wants to examine the logs of the Lambda function code for errors. Based on this system configuration, where would the developer find the logs?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理 Amazon Kinesis 数据流中的记录。最近记录处理变慢，开发人员发现函数的迭代器年龄指标不断增大，而且 Lambda 运行时长持续高于正常水平。应采取哪些措施加快处理？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AC。Kinesis 消费落后时可增加 shard 并提高 Lambda memory/CPU。

知识点／记忆点：迭代器年龄增长表示消费赶不上生产；扩分片提高可并行处理的分区数，提升单次处理能力则减少每批耗时，两者作用层级不同。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：缩短超时会让更多批次失败重试，不能加快处理。

D：减少分片降低流并行度，可能进一步增加积压。

E：延长超时只允许慢任务运行更久，并不提升处理速度。

options.text: Increase the number of shards of the Kinesis data stream.
Decrease the timeout of the Lambda function.
Increase the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
Decrease the number of shards of the Kinesis data stream.
Increase the timeout of the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A company is using an AWS Lambda function to process records from an Amazon Kinesis data stream. The company recently observed slow processing of the records. A developer notices that the iterator age metric for the function is increasing and that the Lambda run duration is constantly above normal. Which actions should the developer take to increase the processing speed? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司需要在容器映像运行之前进行安全加固。应用使用 Amazon Elastic Container Registry（Amazon ECR）作为映像仓库、Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）提供计算能力，并通过 AWS CodePipeline 编排 CI/CD 工作流。流水线最后阶段会在新映像部署到 EKS 集群的开发命名空间后，执行动态应用安全测试。开发人员需要在该部署之前增加分析阶段，以便在 CI/CD 流水线更早阶段分析容器映像。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：B。要在部署前加入独立镜像分析阶段；ECR 扫描结果可由 Lambda action 检查并阻止流水线。

适用前提与时效：“有任意 finding 就失败”是题设策略，实际可按严重性设门槛；D 是否排除依赖对独立阶段要求的解释。

知识点／记忆点：静态源码检查、镜像依赖扫描和运行时动态测试覆盖不同风险；镜像必须先构建才能扫描，流水线门禁要等待扫描完成后再决定是否部署。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：依赖开发者本地钩子容易被绕过，也不能形成统一流水线镜像门禁。

C：源码扫描不能替代对最终镜像操作系统及打包依赖的扫描。

D：若使用不同 runOrder，部署阶段前置动作技术上也能拦截，因此不是能力错误；但题干明确要求在部署前增加独立分析阶段，B 更贴合。

options.text: Build the container image and run the docker scan command locally. Mitigate any findings before pushing changes to the source code repository. Write a pre-commit hook that enforces the use of this workflow before commit.

Create a new CodePipeline stage that occurs after the container image is built. Configure ECR basic image scanning to scan on image push. Use an AWS Lambda function as the action provider. Configure the Lambda function to check the scan results and to fail the pipeline if there are findings.

Create a new CodePipeline stage that occurs after source code has been retrieved from its repository. Run a security scanner on the latest revision of the source code. Fail the pipeline if there are findings.

Add an action to the deployment stage of the pipeline so that the action occurs before the deployment to the EKS cluster. Configure ECR basic image scanning to scan on image push. Use an AWS Lambda function as the action provider. Configure the Lambda function to check the scan results and to fail the pipeline if there are findings.

question_text_original: A company needs to harden its container images before the images are in a running state. The company's application uses Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as an image registry. Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) for compute, and an AWS CodePipeline pipeline that orchestrates a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflow. Dynamic application security testing occurs in the final stage of the pipeline after a new image is deployed to a development namespace in the EKS cluster. A developer needs to place an analysis stage before this deployment to analyze the container image earlier in the CI/CD pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational eficiency?

question_text: 开发人员正在测试一个文件存储应用，通过 Amazon CloudFront 分配提供 Amazon S3 存储桶中的内容。分配使用源访问身份（OAI）访问存储桶，桶权限明确拒绝其他所有用户。应用要求用户在登录页进行身份验证，再使用签名 Cookie 允许用户访问个人存储目录。开发人员为分配设置了限制查看器访问的默认缓存行为，并将源指向该 S3 存储桶。但访问登录页时收到 403 Forbidden 错误。需要允许未经身份验证的用户访问登录页，同时保持全部私有内容安全。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudFront cache behavior 可按路径为特定对象设置不同缓存策略。

知识点／记忆点：登录入口必须先于身份验证可达；CloudFront 按路径选择缓存行为，查看器授权和到私有源站的授权是两层独立控制。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：默认缓存行为的路径模式固定为 *，不能改成登录页专用模式。

C：源站故障转移处理源站错误，不提供按源配置查看器路径授权的功能。

D：公开 S3 登录页并绕过 CloudFront 增加入口，还与桶现有拒绝策略冲突，无需这样暴露源站。

options.text: Add a second cache behavior to the distribution with the same origin as the default cache behavior. Set the path pattern for the second cache behavior to the path of the login page, and make viewer access unrestricted. Keep the default cache behavior's settings unchanged.

Add a second cache behavior to the distribution with the same origin as the default cache behavior. Set the path pattern for the second cache behavior to *, and make viewer access restricted. Change the default cache behavior's path pattern to the path of the login page, and make viewer access unrestricted.

Add a second origin as a failover origin to the default cache behavior. Point the failover origin to the S3 bucket. Set the path pattern for the primary origin to *, and make viewer access restricted. Set the path pattern for the failover origin to the path of the login page, and make viewer access unrestricted.

Add a bucket policy to the S3 bucket to allow read access. Set the resource on the policy to the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the login page object in the S3 bucket. Add a CloudFront function to the default cache behavior to redirect unauthorized requests to the login page's S3 URL.

question_text_original: A developer is testing a new file storage application that uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve content from an Amazon S3 bucket. The distribution accesses the S3 bucket by using an origin access identity (OAI). The S3 bucket's permissions explicitly deny access to all other users. The application prompts users to authenticate on a login page and then uses signed cookies to allow users to access their personal storage directories. The developer has configured the distribution to use its default cache behavior with restricted viewer access and has set the origin to point to the S3 bucket. However, when the developer tries to navigate to the login page, the developer receives a 403 Forbidden error. The developer needs to implement a solution to allow unauthenticated access to the login page. The solution also must keep all private content secure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS Amplify Hosting 构建和部署应用，收到的用户缺陷报告越来越多。开发人员希望增加端到端测试，在缺陷进入生产环境前尽可能消除它们。应实现哪种方案？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Amplify Hosting 的 amplify.yml test phase 可在部署流程中运行测试。

知识点／记忆点：自动测试属于构建流水线阶段，不是应用运行时配置；端到端测试失败应阻止后续发布，而不只是把测试代码部署出去。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Amplify CLI 没有该选项所述的 add test 类别命令。

B：单元测试不等同端到端测试，amplify push 也不是执行托管构建测试的配置方式。

D：aws-exports.js 保存客户端服务配置，不定义构建测试阶段。

options.text: Run the amplify add test command in the Amplify CLI.
Create unit tests in the application. Deploy the unit tests by using the amplify push command in the Amplify CLI.
Add a test phase to the amplify.yml build settings for the application.
Add a test phase to the aws-exports.js file for the application.

question_text_original: A developer is using AWS Amplify Hosting to build and deploy an application. The developer is receiving an increased number of bug reports from users. The developer wants to add end-to-end testing to the application to eliminate as many bugs as possible before the bugs reach production. Which solution should the developer implement to meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家电商公司使用位于 Amazon API Gateway 后方的 AWS Lambda 函数作为应用层。结账处理订单时，前端调用 POST API，由该 API 异步调用 Lambda 函数。极少数情况下，应用未能处理订单，但 Lambda 应用日志中没有错误或失败记录。开发人员应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。异步 Lambda 的失败事件应进入 DLQ 或 on-failure destination，以便排查和重放。

知识点／记忆点：异步接收成功不表示业务已处理成功；失败事件需要持久化出口，才能在没有完整应用日志时保留原输入并安排幂等重放。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：前端只看到异步接收结果，手工重发也无法系统性覆盖后续失败。

C：题干已说明运行日志未体现错误，仅重复检查不能补获未成功处理事件。

D：关闭 API 缓存不处理 Lambda 异步执行链路中的失败或重试耗尽。

options.text: Inspect the frontend logs for API failures. Call the POST API manually by using the requests from the log file.
Create and inspect the Lambda dead-letter queue. Troubleshoot the failed functions. Reprocess the events.
Inspect the Lambda logs in Amazon CloudWatch for possible errors. Fix the errors.
Make sure that caching is disabled for the POST API in API Gateway.

question_text_original: An ecommerce company is using an AWS Lambda function behind Amazon API Gateway as its application tier. To process orders during checkout, the application calls a POST API from the frontend. The POST API invokes the Lambda function asynchronously. In rare situations, the application has not processed orders. The Lambda application logs show no errors or failures. What should a developer do to solve this problem?

question_text: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建 Web 应用。客户发出请求后，应用生成报告，并在一小时内供客户获取。报告应允许客户访问 8 小时，部分报告大于 1 MB，每份报告都专属于对应客户。应用应删除所有超过 2 天的报告。哪种方案能够以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。大于 1 MB 的报告应存 S3，短期访问用 presigned URL，过期清理由 Lifecycle rule 处理。

适用前提与时效：S3 Lifecycle 删除是异步的，不保证恰好第48小时执行；若要求精确删除时点，需额外机制。

知识点／记忆点：访问到期与数据删除是两个时钟：预签名 URL 限定访问窗口，生命周期规则回收对象；URL 提前失效也可能由签名凭证到期导致。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：大于 1 MB 的报告超过 DynamoDB 单项目大小限制。

B：SNS 邮件不是任意大文件附件投递服务，且无法收回已发出附件的访问。

D：RDS 加自建清理任务能做但增加数据库和定时删除维护。

options.text: Generate the reports and then store the reports as Amazon DynamoDB items that have a specified TTL. Generate a URL that retrieves the reports from DynamoDB. Provide the URL to customers through the web application.

Generate the reports and then store the reports in an Amazon S3 bucket that uses server-side encryption. Attach the reports to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) message. Subscribe the customer to email notifications from Amazon SNS.

Generate the reports and then store the reports in an Amazon S3 bucket that uses server-side encryption. Generate a presigned URL that contains an expiration date Provide the URL to customers through the web application. Add S3 Lifecycle configuration rules to the S3 bucket to delete old reports.

Generate the reports and then store the reports in an Amazon RDS database with a date stamp. Generate an URL that retrieves the reports from the RDS database. Provide the URL to customers through the web application. Schedule an hourly AWS Lambda function to delete database records that have expired date stamps.

question_text_original: A company is building a web application on AWS. When a customer sends a request, the application will generate reports and then make the reports available to the customer within one hour. Reports should be accessible to the customer for 8 hours. Some reports are larger than 1 MB. Each report is unique to the customer. The application should delete all reports that are older than 2 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 一家公司已在 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 上部署应用，并将相关 Auto Scaling 组配置为包含五个 Amazon EC2 实例。部署期间，如果容量低于四个实例，应用性能就会下降。目前使用一次性全部部署策略。解决此部署问题最具成本效益的方法是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Elastic Beanstalk rolling with additional batch 能更新实例时保持容量。

知识点／记忆点：滚动批次会减少可服务容量，额外批次先补容量再替换；计算批次时用原实例数减去同时下线数核对最低容量。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：全部同时部署仍可能使所有实例不可用，增加一台不修复部署策略。

B：流量拆分通常要额外建立完整新环境并保持评估期，相比单实例额外批次成本更高。

D：五台中一次更新两台只剩三台，低于四台要求。

options.text: Change the Auto Scaling group to six desired instances.
Change the deployment policy to traffic splitting. Specify an evaluation time of 1 hour.
Change the deployment policy to rolling with additional batch. Specify a batch size of 1.
Change the deployment policy to rolling. Specify a batch size of 2.

question_text_original: A company has deployed an application on AWS Elastic Beanstalk. The company has configured the Auto Scaling group that is associated with the Elastic Beanstalk environment to have five Amazon EC2 instances. If the capacity is fewer than four EC2 instances during the deployment, application performance degrades. The company is using the all-at-once deployment policy. What is the MOST cost-effective way to solve the deployment issue?

question_text: 开发人员正在将 AWS X-Ray 集成到一个处理个人身份信息（PII）的应用中。应用托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上，跟踪消息包含加密的 PII，并发送至 Amazon CloudWatch。开发人员需要确保任何 PII 都不会离开 EC2 实例。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。手动 instrumentation 可以控制 X-Ray segment 字段，避免把 PII 发出 EC2；自动采集不适合这一约束。

适用前提与时效：A 也必须实际编写字段筛选；使用正确配置的 OpenTelemetry 同样可满足目标，不能把工具本身等同于安全保证。

知识点／记忆点：敏感数据即使加密仍然属于敏感数据；要求不出主机时，必须在遥测生成或导出前删除敏感字段，不能以传输加密代替数据最小化。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：自动插桩可能收集请求属性，未提供主动排除 PII 的保证。

C：Macie 主要分析 S3 数据，不能自动在 EC2 发出每条跟踪前脱敏。

D：仅选用 OpenTelemetry 并不自动过滤 PII，仍需显式插桩或处理器配置。

options.text: Manually instrument the X-Ray SDK in the application code.
Use the X-Ray auto-instrumentation agent.
Use Amazon Macie to detect and hide PII. Call the X-Ray API from AWS Lambda.
Use AWS Distro for Open Telemetry.

question_text_original: A developer is incorporating AWS X-Ray into an application that handles personal identifiable information (PII). The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The application trace messages include encrypted PII and go to Amazon CloudWatch. The developer needs to ensure that no PII goes outside of the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在将旧有单体应用的部分功能迁移到 AWS Lambda 函数。目前数据存储在 Amazon Aurora 数据库集群中，该集群位于 VPC 的私有子网。AWS 账户中只部署了一个 VPC。Lambda 函数和数据库集群位于同一 AWS 账户、同一区域。开发人员需要确保函数能够安全访问数据库集群，且流量不经过公共互联网。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Lambda 连私有 Aurora 应配置同一 VPC 的 subnet 与 security group。

知识点／记忆点：私有数据库连接的前提是网络接入，连接池和 IAM 权限都不能凭空创造路由；VPC 配置与安全组需与数据库连通性一起检查。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：开启数据库公网访问违背不经过公共互联网的要求。

B：RDS Proxy 的私有端点仍需网络可达，单独创建代理不让未接入VPC的函数连通。

C：NAT 提供出站互联网访问，不是访问私有 Aurora 的必要路径。

options.text: Configure the DB cluster's public access setting to Yes.
Configure an Amazon RDS database proxy for he Lambda functions.
Configure a NAT gateway and a security group for the Lambda functions.
Configure the VPC, subnets, and a security group for the Lambda functions.

question_text_original: A developer is migrating some features from a legacy monolithic application to use AWS Lambda functions instead. The application currently stores data in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster that runs in private subnets in a VPC. The AWS account has one VPC deployed. The Lambda functions and the DB cluster are deployed in the same AWS Region in the same AWS account. The developer needs to ensure that the Lambda functions can securely access the DB cluster without crossing the public internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在 AWS 上构建新应用，使用 AWS Lambda 函数从 Amazon DynamoDB 表获取信息。表名被硬编码在函数代码中，但以后可能会改变。开发人员不希望在表名改变时修改 Lambda 代码。哪种方案最有效？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。Lambda environment variable 把表名从代码移到函数配置，更换表名无需改代码。

知识点／记忆点：把会变化的资源名称放在配置层，程序读取配置而不是把值编译进代码；全局变量的位置改变不了硬编码本质。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：/tmp 是临时执行环境存储，不是可靠的预置配置来源。

C：更新 Layer 文件仍要发布 Layer 版本和更新函数引用，过于复杂。

D：处理程序外的全局变量仍属于代码，改表名仍需改代码。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html

options.text: Create a Lambda environment variable to store the table name. Use the standard method for the programming language to retrieve the variable.
Store the table name in a file. Store the file in the /tmp folder. Use the SDK for the programming language to retrieve the table name.
Create a file to store the table name. Zip the file and upload the file to the Lambda layer. Use the SDK for the programming language to retrieve the table name.
Create a global variable that is outside the handler in the Lambda function to store the table name.

question_text_original: A developer is building a new application on AWS. The application uses an AWS Lambda function that retrieves information from an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer hard coded the DynamoDB table name into the Lambda function code. The table name might change over time. The developer does not want to modify the Lambda code if the table name changes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST efficiently?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行关键应用，通过 Amazon API Gateway 暴露 HTTP API，并集成 AWS Lambda 函数。数据存储在具有 2 个 vCPU 和 64 GB 内存的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例中。客户反映部分 API 调用返回 HTTP 500 Internal Server Error，Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中显示“too many connections”错误。这些错误出现在不可预测的使用高峰期。公司需要提高应用的弹性，且数据库不能在计划维护时间之外停机。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。RDS Proxy 复用数据库连接，缓解 Lambda 峰值并发导致的 too many connections。

知识点／记忆点：数据库连接数与 CPU 利用率不是同一瓶颈；突发无服务器并发可能耗尽连接，即使计算还有余量，池化复用比盲目放大连接上限更稳妥。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：减少 vCPU 不解决连接风暴，提高连接上限还可能增加内存压力。

C：实例规格变更可能引入重启，且不能快速匹配不可预测的短峰值。

D：CPU 阈值不能可靠检测连接耗尽，增大连接上限也没有池化效果。

options.text: Decrease the number of vCPUs for the DB instance. Increase the max_connections setting.
Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy that connects to the DB instance. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy.
Add a CloudWatch alarm that changes the DB instance class when the number of connections increases to more than 1,000.
Add an Amazon EventBridge rule that increases the max_connections setting of the DB instance when CPU utilization is above 75%.

question_text_original: A company has a critical application on AWS. The application exposes an HTTP API by using Amazon API Gateway. The API is integrated with an AWS Lambda function. The application stores data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with 2 virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 64 GB of RAM. Customers have reported that some of the API calls return HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses. Amazon CloudWatch Logs shows errors for “too many connections.” The errors occur during peak usage times that are unpredictable. The company needs to make the application resilient. The database cannot be down outside of scheduled maintenance hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司在所有客户所在地安装了智能电表。电表每分钟测量一次用电量，并将读数发送到远程端点。公司需要创建一个端点接收读数并存入数据库，同时保存位置 ID 和时间戳。客户需要能够按需、低延迟地访问当前和历史用电量。预计需求将显著增长，扩展时不能影响性能或造成停机。哪种方案最具成本效益？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。DynamoDB 用 location ID 作 partition key、timestamp 作 sort key，支持按设备查询时间序列。

知识点／记忆点：时间序列常以实体标识分区、时间排序，既能定位某设备又能做时间范围查询；冷分析查询与用户交互式低延迟查询应分开选型。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：RDS 可以存储，但在大幅增长下通常要额外规划实例、索引和读取扩展。

C：Redis 缓存不能在此题中直接替代长期历史记录的可靠主数据存储。

D：S3/Athena 适合分析扫描，不适合按需查询最新读数所需的稳定低延迟。

options.text: Store the smart meter readings in an Amazon RDS database. Create an index on the location ID and timestamp columns. Use the columns to filter on the customers' data.
Store the smart meter readings in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create a composite key by using the location ID and timestamp columns. Use the columns to filter on the customers' data.
Store the smart meter readings in Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Create a SortedSet key by using the location ID and timestamp columns. Use the columns to filter on the customers' data.
Store the smart meter readings in Amazon S3. Partition the data by using the location ID and timestamp columns. Use Amazon Athena to filter on the customers' data.

question_text_original: A company has installed smart meters in all its customer locations. The smart meters measure power usage at 1-minute intervals and send the usage readings to a remote endpoint for collection. The company needs to create an endpoint that will receive the smart meter readings and store the readings in a database. The company wants to store the location ID and timestamp information. The company wants to give its customers low-latency access to their current usage and historical usage on demand. The company expects demand to increase significantly. The solution must not impact performance or include downtime while scaling. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 一家公司正在构建使用 AWS Lambda 函数的无服务器应用，需要创建一组测试事件，在开发环境中测试这些函数。测试事件只创建一次，然后由 IAM 开发人员组中的所有开发人员共用，而且该组中的任何 IAM 用户都必须能够编辑它们。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。Lambda shareable test events 可供同账户有权限的开发人员复用。

知识点／记忆点：测试数据的共享范围和函数执行权限分别授权；可共享测试事件让团队复用同一输入，而私有事件只属于创建者。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：S3 JSON 是自建测试数据管理方案，且允许全部 IAM 用户访问比开发组需要更宽。

C：DynamoDB 存事件需要额外读取和编辑流程，不是现成的函数测试共享机制。

D：私有测试事件不能满足组内成员共同编辑复用。

options.text: Create and store the test events in Amazon S3 as JSON objects. Allow S3 bucket access to all IAM users.
Create the test events. Configure the event sharing settings to make the test events shareable.
Create and store the test events in Amazon DynamoDB. Allow access to DynamoDB by using IAM roles.
Create the test events. Configure the event sharing settings to make the test events private.

question_text_original: A company is building a serverless application that uses AWS Lambda functions. The company needs to create a set of test events to test Lambda functions in a development environment. The test events will be created once and then will be used by all the developers in an IAM developer group. The test events must be editable by any of the IAM users in the IAM developer group. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在 AWS CodePipeline 中配置应用部署环境。应用代码保存在 GitHub 仓库中，开发人员希望在新部署环境中运行仓库软件包的单元测试。目前已将流水线源提供商设置为 GitHub，并指定部署使用的仓库和分支。接下来应执行哪些步骤，以最少的开销满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：BD；修正答案：BE。CodeBuild 执行 buildspec 单元测试，需在 source stage 后新增 stage 并传入 source artifact。

知识点／记忆点：流水线制品有先后依赖：源码阶段输出源码制品，构建阶段消费它并运行 buildspec；测试结果要进入后续发布门禁。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CodeCommit 托管源码，不运行 buildspec 构建测试。

C：CodeDeploy 部署制品，不以 buildspec 执行编译和单元测试。

D：应消费已经产生的源码制品，而不是在源阶段引用尚未产生的构建制品。

options.text: Create an AWS CodeCommit project. Add the repository package's build and test commands to the project's buildspec.
Create an AWS CodeBuild project. Add the repository package's build and test commands to the project's buildspec.
Create an AWS CodeDeploy project. Add the repository package's build and test commands to the project's buildspec.
Add an action to the source stage. Specify the newly created project as the action provider. Specify the build artifact as the action's input artifact.

Add a new stage to the pipeline after the source stage. Add an action to the new stage. Specify the newly created project as the action provider. Specify the source artifact as the action's input artifact.

question_text_original: A developer is configuring an application's deployment environment in AWS CodePipeline. The application code is stored in a GitHub repository. The developer wants to ensure that the repository package's unit tests run in the new deployment environment. The developer has already set the pipeline's source provider to GitHub and has specified the repository and branch to use in the deployment. Which combination of steps should the developer take next to meet these requirements with the LEAST overhead? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一名工程师在 Amazon CloudWatch Evidently 项目中为新功能创建了 A/B 测试，配置了变体 A 和变体 B。工程师希望自己只使用变体 A，需要进行设置，使其访问应用端点时只出现变体 A。哪种方案能够满足此要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：题目过时；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。历史上针对某个用户的 variation override 应以用户 ID 为 identifier；CloudWatch Evidently 已于 2025 年停止服务，现应用 AppConfig feature flags。

适用前提与时效：本题沿用已停用的 Evidently 历史行为，仅学习定向覆盖原理，不据此新建生产方案。

知识点／记忆点：个体定向覆盖与全量流量比例不同：稳定用户标识锁定指定变体，实验比例只描述总体分配，不能保证某个人始终命中。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：把变体名称当用户标识且把百分比当变体值，字段含义均错误。

C：新增实验并把另一变体设为零并非针对该工程师的个体覆盖。

D：AWS 账户ID不是应用中该工程师的用户ID，无法精确锁定其请求。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/full_shutdown_services.html

options.text: Add an override to the feature. Set the identifier of the override to the engineer's user ID. Set the variation to Variation A.
Add an override to the feature. Set the identifier of the override to Variation A. Set the variation to 100%.
Add an experiment to the project. Set the identifier of the experiment to Variation B. Set the variation to 0%.
Add an experiment to the project. Set the identifier of the experiment to the AWS account's account ISet the variation to Variation A.

audit_label: 题目过时；原答案已修正
question_text_original: An engineer created an A/B test of a new feature on an Amazon CloudWatch Evidently project. The engineer configured two variations of the feature (Variation A and Variation B) for the test. The engineer wants to work exclusively with Variation A. The engineer needs to make updates so that Variation A is the only variation that appears when the engineer hits the application's endpoint. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 开发人员正在维护一个使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储数据的现有应用。表包含 partNumber（分区键）、vendor（排序键）、description、productFamily 和 productType 属性。分析使用模式后发现，一些应用模块经常根据 productFamily 和 productType 查找产品列表。开发人员希望修改应用，提高查询操作性能。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。查询非主键属性组合时可建立匹配访问模式的 DynamoDB GSI。

知识点／记忆点：LSI 必须保留主表分区键，GSI 可以改变分区键；新增访问模式按新的等值键和排序条件设计索引，不靠 Scan 后过滤伪装查询。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：LSI 不允许把原 partNumber 分区键替换为 productFamily。

C：即使重建表，LSI 仍必须与主表共享分区键。

D：Scan 读取全表再筛选，不因称属性为分区键就获得索引查询效率。

options.text: Create a global secondary index (GSI) with productFamily as the partition key and productType as the sort key.
Create a local secondary index (LSI) with productFamily as the partition key and productType as the sort key.

Recreate the table. Add partNumber as the partition key and vendor as the sort key. During table creation, add a local secondary index (LSI) with productFamily as the partition key and productType as the sort key.
Update the queries to use Scan operations with productFamily as the partition key and productType as the sort key.

question_text_original: A developer is working on an existing application that uses Amazon DynamoDB as its data store. The DynamoDB table has the following attributes: partNumber (partition key), vendor (sort key), description, productFamily, and productType. When the developer analyzes the usage patterns, the developer notices that there are application modules that frequently look for a list of products based on the productFamily and productType attributes. The developer wants to make changes to the application to improve performance of the query operations. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员创建了名为 VPC-A 的 VPC，其中包含公有和私有子网，并在私有子网中创建了 Amazon RDS 数据库。为了执行查询，开发人员在默认 VPC 中创建了一个 AWS Lambda 函数，函数代码会访问该 RDS 数据库。运行时却提示无法连接数据库。开发人员应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：B。默认 VPC 的 Lambda 无法直接访问另一 VPC 的私有 RDS；部署到数据库 VPC 并放通 security group 可解决。

适用前提与时效：不必与 RDS 同一子网；同 VPC 的可达子网即可，B 给出的同子网方案是足够条件而非必要条件。

知识点／记忆点：安全组放通只解决过滤，不解决不同 VPC 间的网络路径；把函数接入数据库可达网络后，再只开放数据库所需端口。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：开放所有端口既不安全，也不能建立两个 VPC 间缺失的路由。

C：新增安全组规则不能单独连通默认 VPC 与 VPC-A。

D：IAM 数据库权限不替代私有网络连通配置。

options.text: Modify the RDS security group. Add a rule to allow traffic from all the ports from the VPC CIDR block.
Redeploy the Lambda function in the same subnet as the RDS instance. Ensure that the RDS security group allows traffic from the Lambda function.
Create a security group for the Lambda function. Add a new rule in the RDS security group to allow traffic from the new Lambda security group.
Create an IAM role. Attach a policy that allows access to the RDS database. Attach the role to the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A developer creates a VPC named VPC-A that has public and private subnets. The developer also creates an Amazon RDS database inside the private subnet of VPC-A. To perform some queries, the developer creates an AWS Lambda function in the default VPC. The Lambda function has code to access the RDS database. When the Lambda function runs, an error message indicates that the function cannot connect to the RDS database. How can the developer solve this problem?

question_text: 一家公司将应用部署在 AWS 的 Amazon EC2 实例上，并在 Amazon Aurora 中存储数据。最近，应用向 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 写入了多条应用自定义的 DECRYP_ERROR 错误，但直到每 30 分钟运行一次的自动测试失败，公司才发现问题。开发人员需要监控这些自定义错误，并在生产环境出现错误时实时通知开发团队。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。CloudWatch Logs metric filter 可把指定错误日志转为指标并设置 alarm。

知识点／记忆点：已有日志可通过指标筛选器变成可告警的数值，不必修改应用再上报；日志匹配、指标阈值和通知目标分别配置。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudTrail 不是设置指标告警的服务，所述 CloudTrail alarm 不成立。

B：五分钟扫描需要自建轮询，延迟也高于直接日志指标告警。

D：采集代理负责上传数据，不直接代替 CloudWatch alarm 向 SNS 告警。

options.text: Configure the application to create a custom metric and to push the metric to CloudWatch. Create an AWS CloudTrail alarm. Configure the CloudTrail alarm to use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send notifications.

Create an AWS Lambda function to run every 5 minutes to scan the CloudWatch logs for the keyword DECRYP_ERROR. Configure the Lambda function to use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send a notification.

Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to create a metric filter that has a filter pattern for DECRYP_ERROR. Create a CloudWatch alarm on this metric for a threshold >=1. Configure the alarm to send Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notifications.

Install the CloudWatch unified agent on the EC2 instance. Configure the application to generate a metric for the keyword DECRYP_ERROR errors. Configure the agent to send Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notifications.

question_text_original: A company runs an application on AWS. The company deployed the application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application stores data on Amazon Aurora. The application recently logged multiple application-specific custom DECRYP_ERROR errors to Amazon CloudWatch logs. The company did not detect the issue until the automated tests that run every 30 minutes failed. A developer must implement a solution that will monitor for the custom errors and alert a development team in real time when these errors occur in the production environment. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 开发人员创建了一个访问 VPC 资源的 AWS Lambda 函数。函数通过 VPC 端点轮询 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列的新消息，然后计算消息中数值的滚动平均值。初步测试发现，函数返回的滚动平均值不准确。开发人员如何确保计算结果准确？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。reserved concurrency=1 限制并发，滚动平均值需存于共享持久状态而非 Lambda 内存。

适用前提与时效：A 并不独自保证数学准确：滚动窗口还需保存窗口数据或计数/总和，并对 SQS 重复消息幂等处理；ElastiCache 也非天然持久保证。

知识点／记忆点：预留并发是执行上限，预置并发只是预热容量；跨调用聚合必须外置状态，并处理并发更新和重复消息，不能只缓存一个进程内值。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：只在初始化时读取旧值，后续暖调用和其他执行环境仍可能使用过期状态。

C：预置并发为1不限制总并发为1，仍可能同时更新共享平均值。

D：Layer 是只读版本化代码依赖，不是可写共享状态仓库。

options.text: Set the function's reserved concurrency to 1. Calculate the rolling average in the function. Store the calculated rolling average in Amazon ElastiCache.
Modify the function to store the values in Amazon ElastiCache. When the function initializes, use the previous values from the cache to calculate the rolling average.
Set the function's provisioned concurrency to 1. Calculate the rolling average in the function. Store the calculated rolling average in Amazon ElastiCache.
Modify the function to store the values in the function's layers. When the function initializes, use the previously stored values to calculate the rolling average.

question_text_original: A developer created an AWS Lambda function that accesses resources in a VPC. The Lambda function polls an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for new messages through a VPC endpoint. Then the function calculates a rolling average of the numeric values that are contained in the messages. After initial tests of the Lambda function, the developer found that the value of the rolling average that the function returned was not accurate. How can the developer ensure that the function calculates an accurate rolling average?

question_text: 开发人员正在为将部署到 AWS 的新应用编写单元测试，希望验证每个拉取请求，且仅在全部测试通过后才将代码合并到主分支。代码保存在 AWS CodeCommit 中，单元测试由 AWS CodeBuild 运行。开发人员创建了一个启动 CodeBuild 任务的 AWS Lambda 函数，需要识别 Amazon EventBridge 事件中的 CodeCommit 事件，以便在拉取请求创建或更新时调用该函数。哪种 CodeCommit 事件能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。CodeCommit pull request 创建和更新事件需在 EventBridge pattern 中同时匹配。

知识点／记忆点：事件筛选要匹配真实的事件类型与 detail 字段值；PR 创建和源分支更新是不同事件，都匹配才能在新增提交后重新测试。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：图示匹配 pullRequestMergeStatusUpdated，属于合并状态变更，不是创建或源分支更新。

B：图示匹配 pullRequestApprovalRuleCreated，只表示审批规则创建，不能覆盖新建PR和新提交。

D：图示的 pullRequestUpdated 和 pullRequestSourceBranchCreated 不是所需的真实创建及源分支更新事件名。

options.text: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D

question_text_original: A developer is writing unit tests for a new application that will be deployed on AWS. The developer wants to validate all pull requests with unit tests and merge the code with the main branch only when all tests pass. The developer stores the code in AWS CodeCommit and sets up AWS CodeBuild to run the unit tests. The developer creates an AWS Lambda function to start the CodeBuild task. The developer needs to identify the CodeCommit events in an Amazon EventBridge event that can invoke the Lambda function when a pull request is created or updated. Which CodeCommit event will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员将应用部署到 Amazon EC2 实例。应用需要知道该实例的公有 IPv4 地址。应如何获取此信息？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：A。EC2 instance metadata 可提供公网 IPv4；实际调用还须遵循当前 IMDSv2 token 流程。

适用前提与时效：实际读取 public-ipv4 路径，并按实例设置使用 IMDSv2 token。

知识点／记忆点：实例元数据描述当前运行实例，用户数据是启动配置；IMDS 应使用令牌流程，并且只有实例实际拥有公有地址时相应字段才存在。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：user-data 是用户提供的启动脚本或配置，不是平台分配的地址信息。

C：AMI 描述映像，不能反映当前实例分配的公网地址。

D：hosts 文件用于本地名称解析，不可靠地保存云平台分配的公网IP。

options.text: Query the instance metadata from http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/.
Query the instance user data from http://169.254.169.254/latest/user-data/.
Query the Amazon Machine Image (AMI) information from http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ami/.
Check the hosts file of the operating system.

question_text_original: A developer deployed an application to an Amazon EC2 instance. The application needs to know the public IPv4 address of the instance. How can the application find this information?

question_text: 一个正在开发的应用需要存储数百个视频文件。数据必须在存储前由应用进行加密，每个视频文件使用唯一的密钥。开发人员应如何编写应用？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。客户端加密大文件可用 KMS GenerateDataKey，并随密文保存加密后的 data key。

知识点／记忆点：信封加密用每文件数据密钥加密大正文，再用 KMS 保护数据密钥；持久化密文数据密钥，销毁明文副本，解密时才能恢复文件密钥。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：KMS Encrypt 不适合直接加密视频等大文件，且没有所述自动返回数据密钥过程。

B：应用共用一把密钥不满足每文件唯一密钥，也未描述可恢复的安全密钥保存。

D：服务器端加密发生在上传后服务端，不满足应用内先加密。

options.text: Use the KMS Encrypt API to encrypt the data. Store the encrypted data key and data.
Use a cryptography library to generate an encryption key for the application. Use the encryption key to encrypt the data. Store the encrypted data.
Use the KMS GenerateDataKey API to get a data key. Encrypt the data with the data key. Store the encrypted data key and data.
Upload the data to an S3 bucket using server side-encryption with an AWS KMS key.

question_text_original: An application under development is required to store hundreds of video files. The data must be encrypted within the application prior to storage, with a unique key for each video file. How should the developer code the application?

question_text: 一家公司计划在 AWS 上将应用部署到 Elastic Load Balancer 后方。应用使用 HTTP/HTTPS 侦听器，并且必须能够获取客户端 IP 地址。哪种负载均衡方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。ALB 的 X-Forwarded-For 可向后端传递原始客户端 IP。

知识点／记忆点：七层代理终止客户端连接后，通过转发头保留原请求信息；后端看到的 TCP 对端地址与原始浏览器地址不是同一个概念。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：NLB 的代理协议适用于四层连接，不提供题目要求的 HTTP/HTTPS 侦听器。

C：按实例ID注册目标不自动使后端 TCP 来源变成客户端IP，仍需读取转发头。

D：NLB 不像 ALB 那样插入 HTTP X-Forwarded-For 头。

options.text: Use an Application Load Balancer and the X-Forwarded-For headers.
Use a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Enable proxy protocol support on the NLB and the target application.
Use an Application Load Balancer. Register the targets by the instance ID.
Use a Network Load Balancer and the X-Forwarded-For headers.

question_text_original: A company is planning to deploy an application on AWS behind an Elastic Load Balancer. The application uses an HTTP/HTTPS listener and must access the client IP addresses. Which load-balancing solution meets these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员希望通过搜索和筛选日志数据来调试应用。应用日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中。开发人员创建了一个新的指标筛选器，统计日志中的异常，但日志未返回任何结果。没有返回筛选结果的原因是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。CloudWatch Logs metric filter 不会回填创建之前的日志指标。

知识点／记忆点：日志查询可以分析历史，指标筛选器则从配置后新摄取的匹配日志产生指标；创建筛选器不会自动回填此前的指标。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：是否使用 VPC 端点与历史日志是否回填指标无关。

C：日志指标筛选不依赖 OpenSearch 中转。

D：导出到 S3 不是 CloudWatch Logs 产生指标的前提。

options.text: A setup of the Amazon CloudWatch interface VPC endpoint is required for filtering the CloudWatch Logs in the VPC.
CloudWatch Logs only publishes metric data for events that happen after the filter is created.
The log group for CloudWatch Logs should be first streamed to Amazon OpenSearch Service before metric filtering returns the results.
Metric data points for logs groups can be filtered only after they are exported to an Amazon S3 bucket.

question_text_original: A developer wants to debug an application by searching and filtering log data. The application logs are stored in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The developer creates a new metric filter to count exceptions in the application logs. However, no results are returned from the logs. What is the reason that no filtered results are being returned?

question_text: 一家公司计划使用 AWS CodeDeploy 将应用部署到 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）。部署新版本时，首先只能将 10% 的实时流量导向新版本；15 分钟后，必须将全部剩余实时流量切换到新版本。哪种 CodeDeploy 预定义配置能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CodeDeploy ECS canary 配置可先转 10% 流量，等待后再全量发布。

知识点／记忆点：Canary 是先小比例观察再一次全量，Linear 是按固定步长多次递增；部署配置名称还绑定 ECS 或 Lambda 平台，不能混用。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：这是 Lambda 平台配置且等待仅5分钟。

C：这是 Lambda 配置，不能用于 ECS 部署，名称还含拼写异常。

D：每分钟线性增加10%不等于等待15分钟后将剩余90%一次切换。

options.text: CodeDeployDefault.ECSCanary10Percent15Minutes
CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percentl15Minutes
CodeDeployDefault.ECSLinear10PercentEvery1Minutes

question_text_original: A company is planning to use AWS CodeDeploy to deploy an application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). During the deployment of a new version of the application, the company initially must expose only 10% of live traffic to the new version of the deployed application. Then, after 15 minutes elapse, the company must route all the remaining live traffic to the new version of the deployed application. Which CodeDeploy predefined configuration will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 上托管批处理应用，实例运行最新版本的 Amazon Linux。应用用于排序和处理大型数据集。最近几周，流量高峰期间应用性能显著下降。开发人员怀疑与内存使用有关，但检查 Elastic Beanstalk 控制台后发现并未跟踪内存使用率。应如何收集更多信息以排查性能问题？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。EC2 memory 不是默认 CloudWatch 指标，需安装 CloudWatch agent 采集。

知识点／记忆点：看不到指标时先检查是否采集，而不是先画图；EC2 默认指标来自基础设施层，操作系统内存使用量需要代理从实例内部读取。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：上传日志不等于采集内存使用率指标。

B：.ebextensions 可以安装和配置代理，但仅声明目录不能自动生成内存指标，选项缺少实际采集机制。

D：仪表板只展示已有指标，不会产生缺失的内存数据。

options.text: Configure the Amazon CloudWatch agent to push logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs by using port 443.
Configure the Elastic Beanstalk .ebextensions directory to track the memory usage of the instances.
Configure the Amazon CloudWatch agent to track the memory usage of the instances.
Configure an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard to track the memory usage of the instances.

question_text_original: A company hosts a batch processing application on AWS Elastic Beanstalk with instances that run the most recent version of Amazon Linux. The application sorts and processes large datasets. In recent weeks, the application's performance has decreased significantly during a peak period for traffic. A developer suspects that the application issues are related to the memory usage. The developer checks the Elastic Beanstalk console and notices that memory usage is not being tracked. How should the developer gather more information about the application performance issues?

question_text: 开发人员正在使用无服务器组件构建一个高度安全的医疗应用。该应用需要向 AWS Lambda 函数的 /tmp 存储写入临时数据。开发人员应如何加密这些数据？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。要自行加密 /tmp 敏感数据，可用 KMS data key 做应用层 envelope encryption。

适用前提与时效：当前 Lambda /tmp 已由 AWS 托管密钥默认静态加密；仅题干所述“加密”并不强制额外应用层加密，B 是需要自主密钥控制时的增强方案，C 并非密码学上错误。

知识点／记忆点：平台默认静态加密与应用层加密是两层控制；需要独立密钥授权和审计时，用信封加密保护内容，并避免持久保存明文数据密钥。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：普通 Lambda 没有为 /tmp 选择并配置 EBS 卷加密的开关。

C：本地生成密钥也能加密临时数据，但选项未提供集中授权、密钥生命周期或跨执行环境恢复管理。

D：每次请求依赖本地 HSM 增加网络可达性、延迟和运维复杂度。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html

options.text: Enable Amazon EBS volume encryption with an AWS KMS key in the Lambda function configuration so that all storage attached to the Lambda function is encrypted.
Set up the Lambda function with a role and key policy to access an AWS KMS key. Use the key to generate a data key used to encrypt all data prior to writing to /tmp storage.
Use OpenSSL to generate a symmetric encryption key on Lambda startup. Use this key to encrypt the data prior to writing to /tmp.
Use an on-premises hardware security module (HSM) to generate keys, where the Lambda function requests a data key from the HSM and uses that to encrypt data on all requests to the function.

question_text_original: A developer is building a highly secure healthcare application using serverless components. This application requires writing temporary data to /tmp storage on an AWS Lambda function. How should the developer encrypt this data?

question_text: 开发人员创建了一个 AWS Lambda 函数，当超过 50 MB 的文件上传到 Amazon S3 时，通过 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）发送通知。开发人员已使用 CLI 部署并测试该函数。但向存储桶添加事件通知后，上传一个 3,000 MB 的文件却未能启动函数。以下哪项可能是函数无法启动的原因？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。S3 触发 Lambda 需要 Lambda resource-based policy 授予 s3.amazonaws.com 调用权限。

知识点／记忆点：事件通知传递对象元数据而不是整个大文件；调用方权限和函数执行权限分别设置，CLI 手工调用成功不能证明 S3 服务具有调用权。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：S3 通知没有此处声称的大于1000 MB就不触发的限制。

C：S3 对象创建事件可以直接触发 Lambda。

D：将桶公开不会授予 S3 调用函数的权限，还暴露数据。

options.text: The S3 event notification does not activate for files that are larger than 1,000 MB.
The resource-based policy for the Lambda function does not have the required permissions to be invoked by Amazon S3.
Lambda functions cannot be invoked directly from an S3 event.
The S3 bucket needs to be made public.

question_text_original: A developer has created an AWS Lambda function to provide notification through Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) whenever a file is uploaded to Amazon S3 that is larger than 50 MB. The developer has deployed and tested the Lambda function by using the CLI. However, when the event notification is added to the S3 bucket and a 3,000 MB file is uploaded, the Lambda function does not launch. Which of the following is a possible reason for the Lambda function's inability to launch?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个 Ruby 应用，希望在不需要了解底层基础设施的情况下，自动完成环境部署、扩展和管理。哪项服务最适合？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Elastic Beanstalk 负责 Ruby 应用部署、环境伸缩与基础设施管理。

知识点／记忆点：平台服务负责预置与运行环境，部署工具只负责发布动作；题目强调不管理基础设施时，应选择能够管理应用环境生命周期的抽象层。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CodeDeploy 负责向已有目标部署代码，不替代完整环境的创建和伸缩管理。

B：CloudFormation 要显式描述基础设施资源，不能免去底层配置知识。

C：OpsWorks 需要配置管理与实例层面知识，不是本题最少基础设施管理的应用平台。

options.text: AWS CodeDeploy
AWS CloudFormation
AWS OpsWorks
AWS Elastic Beanstalk

question_text_original: A developer is creating a Ruby application and needs to automate the deployment, scaling, and management of an environment without requiring knowledge of the underlying infrastructure. Which service would best accomplish this task?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 上部署了一个 Web 应用，其后端使用 Amazon API Gateway API 和 AWS Lambda 函数。最近应用出现异常，开发人员检查函数代码、发现错误并进行了修复。在将修复部署到生产环境前，必须通过测试验证应用正常运行。目前只有生产环境，因此需要创建新的开发环境来测试代码变更，并防止其他开发人员在测试期间覆盖这些变更。哪组步骤需要的开发工作最少？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BD。给修复后的 Lambda 发布版本并创建 hotfix alias，再用独立 API stage 测试，避免覆盖生产版本。

知识点／记忆点：测试隔离需要两道保护：不可变的函数版本锁住代码，独立阶段隔开请求入口；别名可移动而版本内容不可被其他开发者覆盖。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：重新部署当前生产阶段会修改生产 API，不符合测试隔离。

C：$LATEST 可被后续代码更新覆盖，且 Lambda 别名应指向已发布版本。

E：另建完整 API 可以隔离，但比复用现有 API 的新阶段配置更多。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html

options.text: Create a new resource in the current stage. Create a new method with Lambda proxy integration. Select the Lambda function. Add the hotfix alias. Redeploy the current stage. Test the backend.
Update the Lambda function in the API Gateway API integration request to use the hotfix alias. Deploy the API Gateway API to a new stage named hotfix. Test the backend.
Modify the Lambda function by fixing the code. Test the Lambda function. Create the alias hotfix. Point the alias to the $LATEST version.

Modify the Lambda function by fixing the code. Test the Lambda function. When the Lambda function is working as expected, publish the Lambda function as a new version. Create the alias hotfix. Point the alias to the new version.

Create a new API Gateway API for the development environment. Add a resource and method with Lambda integration. Choose the Lambda function and the hotfix alias. Deploy to a new stage. Test the backend.

question_text_original: A company has a web application that is deployed on AWS. The application uses an Amazon API Gateway API and an AWS Lambda function as its backend. The application recently demonstrated unexpected behavior. A developer examines the Lambda function code, finds an error, and modifies the code to resolve the problem. Before deploying the change to production, the developer needs to run tests to validate that the application operates properly. The application has only a production environment available. The developer must create a new development environment to test the code changes. The developer must also prevent other developers from overwriting these changes during the test cycle. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员正在使用 AWS Cloud Development Kit（AWS CDK）实现一个无服务器应用，在创建 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈时预置多个 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon API Gateway API。开发人员的工作站已在本地安装 AWS Serverless Application Model（AWS SAM）和 AWS CDK。如何在本地测试指定的 Lambda 函数？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。CDK synth 生成模板后，可用 SAM CLI 的 sam local invoke 在本地测试指定 Lambda。

知识点／记忆点：CDK synth 只生成模板，deploy 才创建云资源；本地单次函数测试使用 invoke，启动本地 Lambda 端点则是供 SDK 进行后续调用。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：package/deploy 加控制台测试是在云端部署运行，不是本地测试。

B：cdk deploy 后控制台调用仍是云端执行。

D：start-lambda 启动本地服务端点，并不按该写法直接执行一个指定函数。

options.text: Run the sam package and sam deploy commands. Create a Lambda test event from the AWS Management Console. Test the Lambda function.
Run the cdk synth and cdk deploy commands. Create a Lambda test event from the AWS Management Console. Test the Lambda function.
Run the cdk synth and sam local invoke commands with the function construct identifier and the path to the synthesized CloudFormation template.
Run the cdk synth and sam local start-lambda commands with the function construct identifier and the path to the synthesized CloudFormation template.

question_text_original: A developer is implementing an AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) serverless application. The developer will provision several AWS Lambda functions and Amazon API Gateway APIs during AWS CloudFormation stack creation. The developer's workstation has the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) and the AWS CDK installed locally. How can the developer test a specific Lambda function locally?

question_text: 一家公司的新移动应用使用 Amazon API Gateway。开发团队完成新版 API 后，开发人员必须安全且透明地推出变更。通过 API Gateway 向有限数量的用户推出新版 API，最简单的方案是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。API Gateway canary deployment 可逐步将一部分流量导向新版 API。

知识点／记忆点：金丝雀发布在同一稳定入口按比例试运行新部署，便于观测和撤回；流量隔离机制与故障告警机制不能相互替代。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：另建 API 再配置 DNS 分流增加资源与路由管理，非最简单方案。

B：低峰全量发布仍影响全部用户，没有小范围验证。

C：告警回滚有助于止损，但本身不实现先向有限用户推出新版。

options.text: Create a new API in API Gateway. Direct a portion of the traffic to the new API using an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy.
Validate the new API version and promote it to production during the window of lowest expected utilization.
Implement an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to trigger a rollback if the observed HTTP 500 status code rate exceeds a predetermined threshold.
Use the canary release deployment option in API Gateway. Direct a percentage of the API traffic using the canarySettings setting.

question_text_original: A company's new mobile app uses Amazon API Gateway. As the development team completes a new release of its APIs, a developer must safely and transparently roll out the API change. What is the SIMPLEST solution for the developer to use for rolling out the new API version to a limited number of users through API Gateway?

question_text: 一家公司将 Web 应用的会话信息缓存在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中，希望自动删除表内的旧项目。最简单的做法是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。DynamoDB TTL 使用过期时间戳异步删除不再需要的会话项。

知识点／记忆点：TTL 是服务端异步清理机制，过期时间用数值型 Unix 秒时间戳；过期到实际删除之间仍可能读到项目，应用应自行过滤过期会话。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：定时EC2清理需要服务器、扫描与调度维护。

C：每日换表破坏跨天会话并增加表管理工作。

D：属性名称本身不会启用TTL，必须在表设置中指定TTL属性。

options.text: Write a script that deletes old records; schedule the script as a cron job on an Amazon EC2 instance.
Add an attribute with the expiration time; enable the Time To Live feature based on that attribute.
Each day, create a new table to hold session data; delete the previous day's table.
Add an attribute with the expiration time; name the attribute ItemExpiration.

question_text_original: A company caches session information for a web application in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company wants an automated way to delete old items from the table. What is the simplest way to do this?

question_text: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway REST API 端点作为 webhook，将本地源代码管理（SCM）系统的事件发布到 Amazon EventBridge。公司配置了 EventBridge 规则来侦听事件，并控制中央 AWS 账户中的应用部署。现在需要在多个接收方 AWS 账户中获取相同事件。开发人员如何在不修改 SCM 系统配置的情况下实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。EventBridge 跨账户分发需要目标 event bus 授权及发送端 rule。

知识点／记忆点：事件发布入口可以保持不变，通过中央总线扇出到接收账户；跨账户投递既需要目标接收授权，也要有发送端规则和相应执行权限。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：同一域名并不会使一个请求自动复制到多个API端点。

B：增加SCM webhook会修改现有SCM配置，违背约束。

D：REST改HTTP API不会自动产生跨账户事件分发。

options.text: Deploy the API Gateway REST API to all the required AWS accounts. Use the same custom domain name for all the gateway endpoints so that a single SCM webhook can be used for all events from all accounts.
Deploy the API Gateway REST API to all the receiver AWS accounts. Create as many SCM webhooks as the number of AWS accounts.

Grant permission to the central AWS account for EventBridge to access the receiver AWS accounts. Add an EventBridge event bus on the receiver AWS accounts as the targets to the existing EventBridge rule.
Convert the API Gateway type from REST API to HTTP API.

question_text_original: A company is using an Amazon API Gateway REST API endpoint as a webhook to publish events from an on-premises source control management (SCM) system to Amazon EventBridge. The company has configured an EventBridge rule to listen for the events and to control application deployment in a central AWS account. The company needs to receive the same events across multiple receiver AWS accounts. How can a developer meet these requirements without changing the configuration of the SCM system?

question_text: 一家公司将部分受保护文件移入一个不允许公有访问的私有 Amazon S3 存储桶。公司希望开发无服务器应用，让员工登录并与其他用户安全地共享文件。应使用哪项 AWS 功能来安全共享和访问文件？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：B。S3 presigned URL 可让已认证用户在有限时间内访问私有对象，无需公开 bucket。

知识点／记忆点：预签名URL是带时效的持有者凭证，服务端应先验证用户是否有权共享目标对象，再签发有限范围链接；私有桶不必因此公开。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：用户池负责登录身份，不直接授予另一个用户下载特定私有文件的临时链接。

C：桶策略提供资源级授权规则，不能独自完成面向每次分享的短时链接流程。

D：身份池可提供AWS临时凭证，但不等同于按文件生成可分享的限时下载URL。

options.text: Amazon Cognito user pool
S3 presigned URLs
S3 bucket policy
Amazon Cognito identity pool

question_text_original: A company moved some of its secure files to a private Amazon S3 bucket that has no public access. The company wants to develop a serverless application that gives its employees the ability to log in and securely share the files with other users. Which AWS feature should the company use to share and access the files securely?

question_text: 一家公司需要为 Web 服务应用开发概念验证。应用展示公司某个办公地点的天气预报，并提供客户端可调用的 REST 端点。应尽可能使用 AWS 的缓存功能，减少对后端服务的请求。应用后端只会在测试期间接收少量流量。开发人员应采用哪种方式，以最具成本效益的方式提供 REST 端点？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。低流量概念验证用 Lambda 和 API Gateway 比常驻容器成本更低。

适用前提与时效：API Gateway REST API缓存需另外配置并计费；B本身没有自动保证启用缓存。

知识点／记忆点：低频、短时计算优先避免持续空闲的计算资源；缓存能减少重复天气查询，但缓存本身有费用，应按命中率和成本评估是否启用。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：为少量概念验证流量维护EKS集群增加固定成本和复杂度。

C：ECS容器服务通常需要持续或计划中的计算资源管理，低流量下不如按调用执行直接。

D：Beanstalk加ALB构成常驻环境，且选项混入Lambda并未简化方案。

options.text: Create a container image. Deploy the container image by using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Expose the functionality by using Amazon API Gateway.
Create an AWS Lambda function by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). Expose the Lambda functionality by using Amazon API Gateway.
Create a container image. Deploy the container image by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Expose the functionality by using Amazon API Gateway.
Create a microservices application. Deploy the application to AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Expose the AWS Lambda functionality by using an Application Load Balancer.

question_text_original: A company needs to develop a proof of concept for a web service application. The application will show the weather forecast for one of the company's office locations. The application will provide a REST endpoint that clients can call. Where possible, the application should use caching features provided by AWS to limit the number of requests to the backend service. The application backend will receive a small amount of traffic only during testing. Which approach should the developer take to provide the REST endpoint MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 一个在本地共享会话状态的电商 Web 应用正在迁移到 AWS。应用必须容错、原生支持高度扩展，而且任何服务中断都不应影响用户体验。存储会话状态的最佳选择是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。将 session state 放在 ElastiCache，避免实例故障造成会话丢失。

适用前提与时效：ElastiCache必须按所需故障模型配置复制和高可用；不能认为任意单节点缓存都保证无会话丢失。

知识点／记忆点：会话从Web实例外置后，任意健康节点都可继续处理用户请求；会话粘滞只绑定节点，不能在节点故障时恢复其本地状态。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：CloudFront缓存分发内容，不是可读写的用户会话状态数据库。

C：S3可以持久保存对象，但对象API通常不适合高频低延迟会话更新。

D：粘滞会话不复制本地状态，原实例故障仍会丢失会话。

options.text: Store the session state in Amazon ElastiCache.
Store the session state in Amazon CloudFront.
Store the session state in Amazon S3.
Enable session stickiness using elastic load balancers.

question_text_original: An e-commerce web application that shares session state on-premises is being migrated to AWS. The application must be fault tolerant, natively highly scalable, and any service interruption should not affect the user experience. What is the best option to store the session state?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建使用 Amazon DynamoDB 的应用，希望通过一次 API 调用获取多个指定项目。哪个 DynamoDB API 调用能够满足要求，并对数据库造成最小影响？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。已知多个主键时用 DynamoDB BatchGetItem，一次获取指定 item；Query 不适合跨分区精确取多项。

知识点／记忆点：已知完整主键时直接点查，多个点查可以批量组合；Query按同一分区键检索，Scan遍历数据，三者访问成本不同。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：GetItem一次仅获取一个指定项目，不能满足一次调用多个项目。

C：Scan会读取大量无关项目，数据库影响更大。

D：Query要求分区键条件，不能任意一次获取多个不同分区的指定主键。

options.text: BatchGetItem
GetItem
Scan
Query

question_text_original: A developer is building an application that uses Amazon DynamoDB. The developer wants to retrieve multiple specific items from the database with a single API call. Which DynamoDB API call will meet these requirements with the MINIMUM impact on the database?

question_text: 开发人员编写了一个运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用，现在要增加向 Amazon S3 存储桶写入对象的功能。必须修改哪种策略，才能允许实例写入这些对象？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。EC2 写 S3 应检查 instance profile role 的 IAM policy，而非实例本身的资源策略。

知识点／记忆点：EC2应用通过实例角色取得临时凭证；给应用增加权限应修改其实际身份策略，网络端点策略只能进一步约束而不能凭空补齐身份授权。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：实例角色会话不是题目中可随意附加和编辑会话策略的权限来源。

C：KMS密钥策略附着于密钥而非实例角色，且不代替S3写入权限。

D：VPC端点策略不负责为实例角色授予原本没有的S3对象写权限。

options.text: The IAM policy that is attached to the EC2 instance profile role
The session policy that is applied to the EC2 instance role session
The AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key policy that is attached to the EC2 instance profile role
The Amazon VPC endpoint policy

question_text_original: A developer has written an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The developer is adding functionality for the application to write objects to an Amazon S3 bucket. Which policy must the developer modify to allow the instances to write these objects?

question_text: 开发人员通过基于边界网关协议（BGP）的 AWS VPN 连接，从本地访问其账户中的 Amazon EC2 实例。开发人员能够访问子网 A 中的实例，却不能访问同一 VPC 中子网 B 的实例。可以使用哪些日志确认流量是否到达子网 B？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。VPC Flow Logs 可排查 VPN 到 EC2 网络流量是否被拒绝。

知识点／记忆点：逐层定位网络问题：隧道日志看VPN连接，路由协议看路由通告，流日志看接口流量及接受/拒绝，API审计不记录数据包路径。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：VPN日志能排查隧道状态，但不能直接证明流量已到达指定子网接口。

B：BGP日志体现路由交换，不是子网内实际流量记录。

D：CloudTrail记录API操作，不用于跟踪EC2连接数据包。

options.text: VPN logs
BGP logs
VPC Flow Logs
AWS CloudTrail logs

question_text_original: A developer is leveraging a Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)-based AWS VPN connection to connect from on-premises to Amazon EC2 instances in the developer's account. The developer is able to access an EC2 instance in subnet A, but is unable to access an EC2 instance in subnet B in the same VPC. Which logs can the developer use to verify whether the traffic is reaching subnet B?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个图片上传服务，使用 Amazon S3 存储桶存储图片，并通过 AWS Lambda 函数为每张图片生成缩略图。每次上传图片后，都需要发送电子邮件通知并生成缩略图。开发人员需要配置图片处理和邮件通知流程。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。S3 event 发往 SNS，可同时订阅 Lambda 生成缩略图和 email 通知。

知识点／记忆点：一个事件需要被多个不同消费者各收一份时使用扇出；队列的竞争消费与主题的广播订阅不是同一种分发模型。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：SQS没有可直接订阅队列的电子邮件通知协议。

C：队列不能直接接受email订阅，无法实现所述邮件通知。

D：即使EventBridge路由成功，最后的SQS邮件订阅仍不存在。

options.text: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure S3 event notifications with a destination of the SNS topic. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Create an email notification subscription to the SNS topic.

Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure S3 event notifications with a destination of the SNS topic. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Subscribe the SQS queue to the SNS topic. Create an email notification subscription to the SQS queue.

Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure S3 event notifications with a destination of the SQS queue. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SQS queue. Create an email notification subscription to the SQS queue.

Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Send S3 event notifications to Amazon EventBridge. Create an EventBridge rule that runs the Lambda function when images are uploaded to the S3 bucket. Create an EventBridge rule that sends notifications to the SQS queue. Create an email notification subscription to the SQS queue.

question_text_original: A developer is creating a service that uses an Amazon S3 bucket for image uploads. The service will use an AWS Lambda function to create a thumbnail of each image. Each time an image is uploaded, the service needs to send an email notification and create the thumbnail. The developer needs to configure the image processing and email notifications setup. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员设计了一个应用，将传入数据作为 JSON 文件存储在 Amazon S3 对象中，再由 AWS Lambda 函数中的自定义业务逻辑转换对象，并将数据加载到 Amazon DynamoDB 表。最近流量出现突然而显著的变化，写入 DynamoDB 表的数据流开始受到限流。开发人员需要消除限流，使数据更平稳地加载到表中。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。在写入 DynamoDB 前用 SQS 缓冲流量，可削平突发并降低 throttling。

知识点／记忆点：缓冲把瞬时峰值转换为可控消费速率，但队列本身不会自动限制数据库负载；消费者并发、批大小和重试也需匹配下游容量。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：自动伸缩反应有滞后，不能保证骤增流量立刻被吸收，也没有排队缓冲。

C：预置并发提高函数就绪能力，反而可能更快压向受限数据库。

D：先写表再处理仍使所有峰值写入直接命中数据库，没有前置削峰。

options.text: Refactor the Lambda function into two functions. Configure one function to transform the data and one function to load the data into the DynamoDB table. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue in between the functions to hold the items as messages and to invoke the second function.
Turn on auto scaling for the DynamoDB table. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the table's read and write capacity metrics and to track consumed capacity.
Create an alias for the Lambda function. Configure provisioned concurrency for the application to use.

Refactor the Lambda function into two functions. Configure one function to store the data in the DynamoDB table. Configure the second function to process the data and update the items after the data is stored in DynamoDB. Create a DynamoDB stream to invoke the second function after the data is stored.

question_text_original: A developer has designed an application to store incoming data as JSON files in Amazon S3 objects. Custom business logic in an AWS Lambda function then transforms the objects, and the Lambda function loads the data into an Amazon DynamoDB table. Recently, the workload has experienced sudden and significant changes in traffic. The flow of data to the DynamoDB table is becoming throttled. The developer needs to implement a solution to eliminate the throttling and load the data into the DynamoDB table more consistently. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个在 VPC 模式下运行的 AWS Lambda 函数。对象上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶时，由 S3 事件调用该函数。函数处理对象后，将分析结果写入文件，并为每个已处理对象生成日志条目。其他 Lambda 函数、AWS 服务和本地资源都必须能够访问结果文件和日志文件。每条日志还必须追加到同一个共享日志文件。开发人员需要能够共享文件并向已有文件追加结果的方案。应使用哪种方案？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。EFS 可被多个 VPC Lambda 和本地系统共享，并支持追加同一日志文件。

知识点／记忆点：共享追加写需要文件系统语义，实例本地暂存仅属于单个执行环境；多写者还应设计文件锁或原子写策略避免日志交错。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Lambda不能直接附加EBS Multi-Attach卷。

C：/tmp不跨执行环境共享，也不能供本地系统直接访问。

D：/opt存放Layer等部署内容，通常为只读目录，不是共享可写文件系统。

options.text: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in Lambda. Store the result files and log file in the mount point. Append the log entries to the log file.

Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach enabled volume. Attach the EBS volume to all Lambda functions. Update the Lambda function code to download the log file, append the log entries, and upload the modified log file to Amazon EBS.
Create a reference to the /tmp local directory. Store the result files and log file by using the directory reference. Append the log entry to the log file.
Create a reference to the /opt storage directory. Store the result files and log file by using the directory reference. Append the log entry to the log file.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function in VPC mode. An Amazon S3 event will invoke the Lambda function when an object is uploaded into an S3 bucket. The Lambda function will process the object and produce some analytic results that will be recorded into a file. Each processed object will also generate a log entry that will be recorded into a file. Other Lambda functions, AWS services, and on-premises resources must have access to the result files and log file. Each log entry must also be appended to the same shared log file. The developer needs a solution that can share files and append results into an existing file. Which solution should the developer use to meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理 Amazon API Gateway API 传入的请求，API 通过 Lambda 别名调用函数。开发人员已更新代码，以处理请求中的更多细节，希望部署新版函数供其他开发人员继续测试，同时不影响使用 API 的客户。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。新建 Lambda version 与独立 API Gateway stage，测试流量不会进入生产别名。

知识点／记忆点：开发者测试与生产金丝雀不同：前者要独立入口、零客户流量，后者故意让少量客户使用新版；函数版本保证测试代码稳定。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：加权生产别名会让部分真实客户进入新版，违反不影响客户。

C：额外编写请求分流函数增加代码和新的故障点。

D：新建完整API可实现隔离，但比新增阶段维护更多重复资源。

options.text: Create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a new stage on API Gateway with integration to the new Lambda version. Use the new API Gateway stage to test the Lambda function.

Update the existing Lambda alias used by API Gateway to a weighted alias. Add the new Lambda version as an additional Lambda function with a weight of 10%. Use the existing API Gateway stage for testing.

Create a new version of the Lambda function. Create and deploy a second Lambda function to filter incoming requests from API Gateway. If the filtering Lambda function detects a test request, the filtering Lambda function will invoke the new Lambda version of the code. For other requests, the filtering Lambda function will invoke the old Lambda version. Update the API Gateway API to use the filtering Lambda function.
Create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a new API Gateway API for testing purposes. Update the integration of the new API with the new Lambda version. Use the new API for testing.

question_text_original: A company has an AWS Lambda function that processes incoming requests from an Amazon API Gateway API. The API calls the Lambda function by using a Lambda alias. A developer updated the Lambda function code to handle more details related to the incoming requests. The developer wants to deploy the new Lambda function for more testing by other developers with no impact to customers that use the API. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon S3 触发器处理 S3 存储桶中的图片。开发团队在同一个 AWS 账户内设置了多个环境。最近一次生产部署后，团队发现开发环境的 S3 存储桶调用了生产环境的 Lambda 函数，导致开发环境文件被生产函数意外处理。团队必须遵循安全最佳实践，阻止这些调用。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：C。Lambda resource policy 可按 S3 bucket SourceArn 限制调用；若要求更强环境隔离，仍应分账户。

适用前提与时效：题干未明确最少改动时，B同样符合安全最佳实践；C是保持现有单账户结构的直接修复，需移除或收紧已有宽泛Allow。

知识点／记忆点：执行角色控制函数出去访问什么，资源策略控制谁能调用函数；按SourceArn限制调用源，不能仅靠函数读取权限防止被触发。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：限制执行角色读桶只能使错误调用后的读取失败，不能阻止调用本身。

B：分账户加资源策略是有效且更强隔离，但重构范围更大，并非技术错误。

D：分账户仍需限制调用授权，单独修改执行角色不能阻止跨环境触发。

options.text: Update the Lambda execution role for the production Lambda function to add a policy that allows the execution role to read from only the production environment S3 bucket.

Move the development and production environments into separate AWS accounts. Add a resource policy to each Lambda function to allow only S3 buckets that are within the same account to invoke the function.
Add a resource policy to the production Lambda function to allow only the production environment S3 bucket to invoke the function.

Move the development and production environments into separate AWS accounts. Update the Lambda execution role for each function to add a policy that allows the execution role to read from the S3 bucket that is within the same account.

question_text_original: A company uses AWS Lambda functions and an Amazon S3 trigger to process images into an S3 bucket. A development team set up multiple environments in a single AWS account. After a recent production deployment, the development team observed that the development S3 buckets invoked the production environment Lambda functions. These invocations caused unwanted execution of development S3 files by using production Lambda functions. The development team must prevent these invocations. The team must follow security best practices. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个应用程序。新用户必须能够使用自己的社交媒体账户创建账户并注册。开发人员应使用哪项 AWS 服务或资源来满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Cognito user pool 可托管用户注册及社交身份提供商登录。

知识点／记忆点：用户目录负责注册与登录，身份池把已认证或访客身份换成AWS临时权限；应用账户和AWS资源访问凭证是不同层次。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：IAM角色授予AWS权限，不提供面向用户的注册和社交登录流程。

B：身份池主要换取临时AWS凭证，不是托管应用用户注册目录。

D：Directory Service面向目录服务集成，不是本题社交账号注册的直接方案。

options.text: IAM role
Amazon Cognito identity pools
Amazon Cognito user pools
AWS Directory Service

question_text_original: A developer is creating an application. New users of the application must be able to create an account and register by using their own social media accounts. Which AWS service or resource should the developer use to meet these requirements?

question_text: 一个社交媒体应用在前端使用 AWS SDK for JavaScript，从 AWS Security Token Service（AWS STS）获取用户凭证。应用资源存放在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，并通过以该桶为源的 Amazon CloudFront 分配提供内容。应用进行 SDK 调用时所代入角色的凭证，以明文形式保存在应用代码中的 JSON 文件内。开发人员需要改进方案，使应用能够获取用户凭证，而无需在代码中硬编码任何凭证。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：A。可把需要 AWS 凭证的后端调用移入有 IAM role 的 Lambda@Edge；前端不应携带长期凭证。

适用前提与时效：A适用于把相关操作代理到边缘函数的架构；仍须验证用户身份与授权，不能把执行角色凭证直接泄露给前端。

知识点／记忆点：浏览器中的任何秘密都应视为可被用户读取；把AWS调用移到可信执行环境后，凭证应来自角色而不是从一个代码文件搬到另一个。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：CloudFront Functions不能任意发起STS网络请求，也没有所述Lambda执行角色机制。

C：把静态凭证搬入函数仍保留硬编码和轮换问题。

D：既继续硬编码凭证，又依赖CloudFront Functions不支持的STS调用。

options.text: Add a Lambda@Edge function to the distribution. Invoke the function on viewer request. Add permissions to the function's execution role to allow the function to access AWS STS. Move all SDK calls from the frontend into the function.

Add a CloudFront function to the distribution. Invoke the function on viewer request. Add permissions to the function's execution role to allow the function to access AWS STS. Move all SDK calls from the frontend into the function.

Add a Lambda@Edge function to the distribution. Invoke the function on viewer request. Move the credentials from the JSON file into the function. Move all SDK calls from the frontend into the function.

Add a CloudFront function to the distribution. Invoke the function on viewer request. Move the credentials from the JSON file into the function. Move all SDK calls from the frontend into the function.

question_text_original: A social media application uses the AWS SDK for JavaScript on the frontend to get user credentials from AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS). The application stores its assets in an Amazon S3 bucket. The application serves its content by using an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the origin set to the S3 bucket. The credentials for the role that the application assumes to make the SDK calls are stored in plaintext in a JSON file within the application code. The developer needs to implement a solution that will allow the application to get user credentials without having any credentials hardcoded in the application code. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一个电商网站使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库提供订单履行服务，必须立即返回订单确认。在一次导致订单量增长的营销活动中，运维团队发现 Amazon RDS 返回“too many connections”错误，但数据库集群的指标正常，CPU 和内存仍有余量。开发人员应如何解决这些错误？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：B。RDS Proxy 建立连接池，缓解 Lambda 并发导致的 too many connections，而无需盲目调大数据库参数。

知识点／记忆点：数据库连接数耗尽不等于CPU耗尽；短生命周期计算应复用客户端连接，并通过连接池把大量客户端会话与有限数据库连接解耦。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：调高连接上限和重启会引入风险，且未解决突发并发连接管理。

C：队列改为异步处理，不能直接保证订单入库后即时确认。

D：降低并发加队列虽能削峰，但改变了题目要求的即时确认流程。

options.text: Initialize the database connection outside the handler function. Increase the max_user_connections value on the parameter group of the DB cluster. Restart the DB cluster.
Initialize the database connection outside the handler function. Use RDS Proxy instead of connecting directly to the DB cluster.

Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues to queue the orders. Ingest the orders into the database. Set the Lambda function's concurrency to a value that equals the number of available database connections.

Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues to queue the orders. Ingest the orders into the database. Set the Lambda function's concurrency to a value that is less than the number of available database connections.

question_text_original: An ecommerce website uses an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon RDS for MySQL database for an order fulfillment service. The service needs to return order confirmation immediately. During a marketing campaign that caused an increase in the number of orders, the website's operations team noticed errors for “too many connections” from Amazon RDS. However, the RDS DB cluster metrics are healthy. CPU and memory capacity are still available. What should a developer do to resolve the errors?

question_text: 一家公司将数据以数据表的形式存储在一系列 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司收到警报，提示某个公开应用的数据表可能泄露了客户信用卡信息。开发人员需要识别应用环境内所有潜在泄露。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：B。Macie 可扫描 S3 中的敏感财务数据，信用卡暴露属于 Financial finding。

知识点／记忆点：敏感数据发现与SQL查询不是同一种能力；选择发现类型时按数据含义分类，支付卡号属于财务信息而不是泛指个人身份信息。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Athena不自动产出Macie的敏感数据发现，且类别不对应信用卡。

C：Personal发现针对个人信息类别，信用卡应检查Financial。

D：Financial是Macie发现类型，Athena查询任务不会自动产生该发现。

options.text: Use Amazon Athena to run a job on the S3 buckets that contain the affected data. Filter the findings by using the SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal finding type.
Use Amazon Macie to run a job on the S3 buckets that contain the affected data. Filter the findings by using the SensitiveData:S3Object/Financial finding type.
Use Amazon Macie to run a job on the S3 buckets that contain the affected data. Filter the findings by using the SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal finding type.
Use Amazon Athena to run a job on the S3 buckets that contain the affected data. Filter the findings by using the SensitiveData:S3Object/Financial finding type.

question_text_original: A company stores its data in data tables in a series of Amazon S3 buckets. The company received an alert that customer credit card information might have been exposed in a data table on one of the company's public applications. A developer needs to identify all potential exposures within the application environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家软件公司即将推出多媒体应用，允许访客先访问示例内容，再决定是否创建账户以获得完整访问权限。公司希望实现一个身份验证流程，识别已创建账户的用户，并跟踪最终创建账户的访客数量。哪组步骤能够满足这些要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：BE；修正答案：BD。Cognito identity pool 支持 guest identity，并用 authenticated 与 unauthenticated IAM role 分配不同内容权限。

知识点／记忆点：访客也是可跟踪的身份：先给最低权限，登录后提升到已认证角色；转化统计还需把访客标识与注册事件关联。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：用户池不提供身份池式未认证身份与AWS凭证交换。

C：CloudFront是内容分发服务，不承担所述身份交换功能。

E：默认开放样例没有明确的访客角色边界，也不足以实现题述身份关联。

options.text: Create an Amazon Cognito user pool. Configure the user pool to allow unauthenticated users. Exchange user tokens for temporary credentials that allow authenticated users to assume a role.
Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool. Configure the identity pool to allow unauthenticated users. Exchange unique identity for temporary credentials that allow all users to assume a role.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the distribution to allow unauthenticated users. Exchange user tokens for temporary credentials that allow all users to assume a role.
Create a role for authenticated users that allows access to all content. Create a role for unauthenticated users that allows access to only the sample content.
Allow all users to access the sample content by default. Create a role for authenticated users that allows access to the other content.

question_text_original: A software company is launching a multimedia application. The application will allow guest users to access sample content before the users decide if they want to create an account to gain full access. The company wants to implement an authentication process that can identify users who have already created an account. The company also needs to keep track of the number of guest users who eventually create an account. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司正在更新应用，将后端从 Amazon EC2 实例迁移到无服务器架构。应用使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例，并运行于 AWS 上的单个 VPC 中。应用和数据库实例都部署在该 VPC 的私有子网。公司需要将 AWS Lambda 函数连接到数据库实例。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。VPC 内 Lambda 访问私有资源需配置 VPC/subnet 与网络接口相关执行角色权限。

知识点／记忆点：私有数据库连通性同时依赖函数的VPC接入权限和数据库安全组；调用Lambda的私有API端点不等于函数进入VPC访问资源。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：BasicExecutionRole主要允许日志写入，缺少创建VPC网络接口所需权限。

C：Lambda接口端点用于私下调用Lambda API，不建立函数到RDS的网络路径。

D：仅添加VPC访问策略和Lambda接口端点仍未配置函数的子网及安全组。

options.text: Create Lambda functions inside the VPC with the AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole policy attached to the Lambda execution role. Modify the RDS security group to allow inbound access from the Lambda security group.

Create Lambda functions inside the VPC with the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole policy attached to the Lambda execution role. Modify the RDS security group to allow inbound access from the Lambda security group.

Create Lambda functions with the AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole policy attached to the Lambda execution role. Create an interface VPC endpoint for the Lambda functions. Configure the interface endpoint policy to allow the lambda:InvokeFunclion action for each Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

Create Lambda functions with the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole policy attached to the Lambda execution role. Create an interface VPC endpoint for the Lambda functions.
