Configure the interface endpoint policy to allow the lambda:InvokeFunction action for each Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

question_text_original: A company is updating an application to move the backend of the application from Amazon EC2 instances to a serverless model. The application uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance and runs in a single VPC on AWS. The application and the DB instance are deployed in a private subnet in the VPC. The company needs to connect AWS Lambda functions to the DB instance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的 Web 应用使用自定义 Amazon 系统映像（AMI），运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并通过 AWS CloudFormation 预置。应用目前运行于 us-east-1 区域，需要部署到 us-west-1 区域。但在 us-west-1 创建堆栈时失败，错误提示 AMI ID 不存在。开发人员应采用哪种方案，以最少的运维开销解决问题？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。AMI 属于 Region 资源，跨 Region 部署前需复制 AMI 并在模板中使用目标 Region 的 AMI ID。

知识点／记忆点：AMI标识具有区域范围；跨区复制后得到新的标识，基础设施模板应使用部署区域对应的镜像映射。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：换为通用AWS镜像会丢失自定义内容，还无谓重部署已有区域。

C：重建镜像及模板比复制现有镜像增加维护和一致性风险。

D：手工部署绕过既有基础设施代码，增加运维工作。

options.text: Change the AWS CloudFormation templates for us-east-1 and us-west-1 to use an AWS AMI. Relaunch the stack for both Regions.
Copy the custom AMI from us-east-1 to us-west-1. Update the AWS CloudFormation template for us-west-1 to refer to AMI ID for the copied AMI. Relaunch the stack.
Build the custom AMI in us-west-1. Create a new AWS CloudFormation template to launch the stack in us-west-1 with the new AMI ID.
Manually deploy the application outside AWS CloudFormation in us-west-1.

question_text_original: A company has a web application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances with a custom Amazon Machine Image (AMI). The company uses AWS CloudFormation to provision the application. The application runs in the us-east-1 Region, and the company needs to deploy the application to the us-west-1 Region. An attempt to create the AWS CloudFormation stack in us-west-1 fails. An error message states that the AMI ID does not exist. A developer must resolve this error with a solution that uses the least amount of operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员在更新多个 AWS Lambda 函数时发现，它们使用相同的自定义库。开发人员希望集中管理所有库，方便更新，并保留版本。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。Lambda layer 能集中版本化共享 dependency，多个函数可引用同一 layer version。

知识点／记忆点：共享依赖应锁定版本以保持可重现部署；发布新Layer版本不会自动升级所有函数，需要明确更新引用。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CodeArtifact管理包仓库，仍需额外构建和分发到各函数。

B：容器可共享基础镜像，但迁移镜像打包比现有函数引入Layer工作更多。

D：EFS共享文件不原生提供不可变依赖版本，且需要网络和文件系统配置。

options.text: Create an AWS CodeArtifact repository that contains all the custom libraries.
Create a custom container image for the Lambda functions to save all the custom libraries.
Create a Lambda layer that contains all the custom libraries.
Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to store all the custom libraries.

question_text_original: A developer is updating several AWS Lambda functions and notices that all the Lambda functions share the same custom libraries. The developer wants to centralize all the libraries, update the libraries in a convenient way, and keep the libraries versioned. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员希望使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk，在测试环境中测试新版应用。哪种部署方法速度最快？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Elastic Beanstalk all-at-once 部署最快，但会导致短暂可用性风险。

知识点／记忆点：部署速度与可用性是取舍：一次更新全部实例省去批次等待，却会让所有实例同时进入更新窗口。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：不可变部署需创建新实例组并等待健康检查。

B：滚动部署逐批更新，等待时间累积。

C：额外批次要先创建容量，之后仍逐批推进。

options.text: Immutable
Rolling
Rolling with additional batch
All at once

question_text_original: A developer wants to use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to test a new version of an application in a test environment. Which deployment method offers the FASTEST deployment?

question_text: 一家公司向不同客户提供 Amazon S3 存储桶对象的读取权限，并通过 IAM 权限限制客户只能访问自己的文件。由于法规要求，公司必须强制对与 Amazon S3 的交互进行传输加密。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。S3 强制 TLS 应在 bucket policy 中 Deny aws:SecureTransport=false。

知识点／记忆点：强制安全条件应拒绝不安全请求，避免其他Allow绕过；对象访问范围、对象静态加密和HTTPS传输是独立控制。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：对象ACL是否公开与请求是否使用TLS无直接关系。

C：SDK是客户端工具，使用SDK本身不是IAM可强制的TLS条件。

D：ACL条件既不验证HTTPS，也不能通过一条Allow阻止其他授权放行HTTP。

options.text: Add a bucket policy to the S3 bucket to deny S3 actions when the aws:SecureTransport condition is equal to false.
Add a bucket policy to the S3 bucket to deny S3 actions when the s3:x-amz-acl condition is equal to public-read.
Add an IAM policy to the IAM users to enforce the usage of the AWS SDK.
Add an IAM policy to the IAM users that allows S3 actions when the s3:x-amz-acl condition is equal to bucket-owner-read.

question_text_original: A company is providing read access to objects in an Amazon S3 bucket for different customers. The company uses IAM permissions to restrict access to the S3 bucket. The customers can access only their own files. Due to a regulation requirement, the company needs to enforce encryption in transit for interactions with Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行图片存储 Web 应用。应用托管在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上，该组作为 Application Load Balancer（ALB）的目标组，并使用 Amazon S3 存储桶保存待售图片。公司希望开发一项测试系统请求的功能，将请求导向另一个托管新版测试应用的目标组。哪种方案需要的工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。ALB listener rule 可按请求 cookie 分流测试用户，无需新建 ALB 或 Lambda@Edge。

适用前提与时效：ALB没有独立cookie条件类型，应通过http-header条件匹配Cookie头中的version=beta，注意匹配边界。

知识点／记忆点：测试分流可以依据请求携带的标记复用现有入口；标记只是路由条件，不能替代对测试环境的访问授权。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：新建ALB和DNS记录能实现隔离，但资源和配置多于增加监听规则。

C：增加CloudFront、边缘代码及第二个ALB明显增加工作。

D：测试客户端本可直接加Cookie，无需额外边缘函数代写。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-condition-types.html

options.text: Create a new Auto Scaling group and target group for the beta version of the application. Update the ALB routing rule with a condition that looks for a cookie named version that has a value of beta. Update the test system code to use this cookie to test the beta version of the application.

Create a new ALB, Auto Scaling group, and target group for the beta version of the application. Configure an alternate Amazon Route 53 record for the new ALB endpoint. Use the alternate Route 53 endpoint in the test system requests to test the beta version of the application.

Create a new ALB, Auto Scaling group, and target group for the beta version of the application. Use Amazon CloudFront with Lambda@Edge to determine which specific request will go to the new ALB. Use the CloudFront endpoint to send the test system requests to test the beta version of the application.

Create a new Auto Scaling group and target group for the beta version of the application. Update the ALB routing rule with a condition that looks for a cookie named version that has a value of beta. Use Amazon CloudFront with Lambda@Edge to update the test system requests to add the required cookie when the requests go to the ALB.

question_text_original: A company has an image storage web application that runs on AWS. The company hosts the application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The Auto Scaling group acts as the target group for an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and uses an Amazon S3 bucket to store the images for sale. The company wants to develop a feature to test system requests. The feature will direct requests to a separate target group that hosts a new beta version of the application. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST effort?

question_text: 一个团队正在开发部署于 Amazon EC2 实例的应用。测试中发生错误，实例无法访问 Amazon S3 存储桶。团队应采取哪些步骤排查？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：DE；修正答案：AB。EC2 访问 S3 被拒应核查 instance profile role 的 IAM policy 和 bucket policy，而非 S3 Lifecycle。

适用前提与时效：题干没有给出AccessDenied等错误细节；如果是超时，应同时检查安全组出站、路由和端点，不能绝对排除E。

知识点／记忆点：排查访问失败先区分授权拒绝与网络超时；实例角色身份策略与桶资源策略共同决定S3授权，显式拒绝优先。

其他选项为什么不选：

C：EC2实例通过实例配置文件关联角色，不是附加IAM用户。

D：Lifecycle管理对象保留和存储类别，不负责访问授权。

E：安全组确实可能因出站规则造成连接失败，但没有显式Deny规则，题目预期检查的是IAM和桶授权。

options.text: Check whether the policy that is assigned to the IAM role that is attached to the EC2 instances grants access to Amazon S3.
Check the S3 bucket policy to validate the access permissions for the S3 bucket.
Check whether the policy that is assigned to the IAM user that is attached to the EC2 instances grants access to Amazon S3.
Check the S3 Lifecycle policy to validate the permissions that are assigned to the S3 bucket.
Check the security groups that are assigned to the EC2 instances. Make sure that a rule is not blocking the access to Amazon S3.

question_text_original: A team is developing an application that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances. During testing, the team receives an error. The EC2 instances are unable to access an Amazon S3 bucket. Which steps should the team take to troubleshoot this issue? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员正在维护一个电商网站，希望不逐台登录应用服务器就能查看服务器日志。网站使用 Python 编写，运行于多个 Amazon EC2 实例上，并且需要高可用性。如何以最少的改动满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。CloudWatch agent 可集中采集 EC2 应用日志，避免逐台登录。

知识点／记忆点：集中可观测性不要求重写业务应用；代理可从各节点采集已有日志，实例伸缩后日志仍留在集中服务。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：迁移Lambda需要重构部署和运行方式，远超最少改动。

B：自建采集与搜索管线增加组件配置和运维。

C：缩成单实例破坏高可用要求。

options.text: Rewrite the application to be cloud native and to run on AWS Lambda, where the logs can be reviewed in Amazon CloudWatch.
Set up centralized logging by using Amazon OpenSearch Service, Logstash, and OpenSearch Dashboards.
Scale down the application to one larger EC2 instance where only one instance is recording logs.
Install the unified Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances. Configure the agent to push the application logs to CloudWatch.

question_text_original: A developer is working on an ecommerce website. The developer wants to review server logs without logging in to each of the application servers individually. The website runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances, is written in Python, and needs to be highly available. How can the developer update the application to meet these requirements with MINIMUM changes?

question_text: 一家公司正在创建一个处理 Amazon S3 中 .csv 文件的应用。开发人员已创建 S3 存储桶，以及用于处理其中 .csv 文件的 AWS Lambda 函数。哪组步骤能够在上传 .csv 文件到 S3 时调用该函数？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：BD；修正答案：AC。S3 ObjectCreated 事件可以走 EventBridge rule 触发既有 Lambda；须先启用 bucket 向 EventBridge 发送事件。

适用前提与时效：需要启用桶的EventBridge通知并配置Lambda调用权限；仅处理CSV时还应按对象键的.csv后缀过滤。

知识点／记忆点：事件驱动处理必须接通事件源、路由和目标授权三段；只创建规则并不自动让S3开始向事件总线发事件。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：定时扫描存在延迟且引入额外函数，不能等同上传事件触发。

D：仅创建扫描函数没有调用机制，还需要自行管理增量和重复。

E：生命周期规则用于转换或过期对象，不直接调用业务Lambda。

options.text: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule. Configure the rule with a pattern to match the S3 object created event.
Schedule an Amazon EventBridge rule to run a new Lambda function to scan the S3 bucket.
Add a trigger to the existing Lambda function. Set the trigger type to EventBridge. Select the Amazon EventBridge rule.
Create a new Lambda function to scan the S3 bucket for recently added S3 objects.
Add S3 Lifecycle rules to invoke the existing Lambda function.

audit_label: 有条件成立；原答案已修正
question_text_original: A company is creating an application that processes .csv files from Amazon S3. A developer has created an S3 bucket. The developer has also created an AWS Lambda function to process the .csv files from the S3 bucket. Which combination of steps will invoke the Lambda function when a .csv file is uploaded to Amazon S3? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员需要构建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，使其自动填充表示部署所在 AWS 区域的变量。确定模板部署区域时，运维效率最高的方法是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudFormation 的 AWS::Region pseudo parameter 自动取得部署 Region。

知识点／记忆点：模板内置上下文应优先使用伪参数，减少人工输入与外部状态；区域是部署上下文，而不是需要再维护一份的业务配置。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：手动传入区域容易与实际部署区域不一致。

C：解析StackId可行但脆弱且多余，已有直接返回区域的伪参数。

D：维护Parameter Store区域值增加外部依赖和读取配置。

options.text: Use the AWS::Region pseudo parameter.
Require the Region as a CloudFormation parameter.
Find the Region from the AWS::StackId pseudo parameter by using the Fn::Split intrinsic function.
Dynamically import the Region by referencing the relevant parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.

question_text_original: A developer needs to build an AWS CloudFormation template that self-populates the AWS Region variable that deploys the CloudFormation template. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to determine the Region in which the template is being deployed?

question_text: 一家公司拥有数百个 AWS Lambda 函数，QA 团队需要通过 Lambda 函数 URL 进行测试。开发人员需要配置函数身份验证，允许 QA IAM 组通过这些公开 URL 调用函数。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。Lambda function URL 使用 AWS_IAM auth，并给 QA group 身份策略授予 lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl。

适用前提与时效：A是原题最佳方向，但当前新建Function URL从2025年10月起需同时授予lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl与lambda:InvokeFunction；选项仅前者已不完整。

知识点／记忆点：公开可达的URL仍可要求IAM签名认证；组承载身份策略而不是成为资源策略Principal，调用者须按SigV4签名。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：NONE不验证QA成员身份，资源策略也不能附加到IAM组。

C：身份策略应附加给组并列函数资源，不能把组ARN当允许来源Principal。

D：NONE不限制为QA身份，IAM组也不能用作资源策略Principal。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/urls-auth.html

options.text: Create a CLI script that loops on the Lambda functions to add a Lambda function URL with the AWS_IAM auth type. Run another script to create an IAM identity-based policy that allows the lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl action to all the Lambda function Amazon Resource Names (ARNs). Attach the policy to the QA IAM group.

Create a CLI script that loops on the Lambda functions to add a Lambda function URL with the NONE auth type. Run another script to create an IAM resource-based policy that allows the lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl action to all the Lambda function Amazon Resource Names (ARNs). Attach the policy to the QA IAM group.

Create a CLI script that loops on the Lambda functions to add a Lambda function URL with the AWS_IAM auth type. Run another script to loop on the Lambda functions to create an IAM identity-based policy that allows the lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl action from the QA IAM group's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

Create a CLI script that loops on the Lambda functions to add a Lambda function URL with the NONE auth type. Run another script to loop on the Lambda functions to create an IAM resource-based policy that allows the lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl action from the QA IAM group's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

question_text_original: A company has hundreds of AWS Lambda functions that the company's QA team needs to test by using the Lambda function URLs. A developer needs to configure the authentication of the Lambda functions to allow access so that the QA IAM group can invoke the Lambda functions by using the public URLs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员维护一个以 Amazon DynamoDB 为主要数据存储的关键业务应用。表中包含数百万份文档，每分钟接收 30 到 60 个请求。文档添加到表中或更新时，需要进行近实时处理。如何以最少的现有代码改动实现此功能？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。DynamoDB Streams 可驱动 Lambda 异步处理新写入的文档。

知识点／记忆点：数据库变更流把副作用从写入路径移出，无需每个写入者重复发事件；消费者应按至少一次处理设计幂等逻辑。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：每小时轮询不满足近实时，且需要维护服务器和变更识别。

C：应用发事件需要修改写入代码，还要处理写库与发事件的一致性。

D：同步附加处理增大写请求延迟并需要修改现有业务。

options.text: Set up a cron job on an Amazon EC2 instance. Run a script every hour to query the table for changes and process the documents.
Enable a DynamoDB stream on the table. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the documents.
Update the application to send a PutEvents request to Amazon EventBridge. Create an EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the documents.
Update the application to synchronously process the documents directly after the DynamoDB write.

question_text_original: A developer maintains a critical business application that uses Amazon DynamoDB as the primary data store. The DynamoDB table contains millions of documents and receives 30-60 requests each minute. The developer needs to perform processing in near-real time on the documents when they are added or updated in the DynamoDB table. How can the developer implement this feature with the LEAST amount of change to the existing application code?

question_text: 开发人员正在为公司编写一个部署到 Amazon EC2 的应用，使用 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server 数据库。安全团队要求至少每周轮换一次数据库凭证。开发人员应如何配置应用的数据库凭证？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。RDS 凭证放 Secrets Manager 并设置轮换，EC2 应按需检索而非硬编码。

知识点／记忆点：轮换加密密钥不会轮换数据库密码；凭证轮换必须同时更新数据库身份与秘密值，应用也要能刷新缓存凭证。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：KMS轮换只改变加密材料，不改变数据库登录密码。

B：RDS SQL Server不支持此处所述IAM数据库认证模式。

D：启动脚本和环境变量没有持续自动轮换机制。

options.text: Create a database user. Store the user name and password in an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store secure string parameter. Enable rotation of the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is used to encrypt the parameter.
Enable IAM authentication for the database. Create a database user for use with IAM authentication. Enable password rotation.
Create a database user. Store the user name and password in an AWS Secrets Manager secret that has daily rotation enabled.
Use the EC2 user data to create a database user. Provide the user name and password in environment variables to the application.

question_text_original: A developer is writing an application for a company. The application will be deployed on Amazon EC2 and will use an Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server database. The company's security team requires that database credentials are rotated at least weekly. How should the developer configure the database credentials for this application?

question_text: 一个实时消息应用使用 Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API，并连接后端 HTTP 服务。开发人员需要增加功能，识别不断连接和断开 WebSocket 的客户端，并能够移除该客户端。应进行哪些改动？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：CD；修正答案：CE。WebSocket 的 $connect/$disconnect routes 可跟踪连接，管理 API 能按 connection ID 断开客户端。

适用前提与时效：$disconnect属于尽力投递，需处理失联残留状态；主动断连使用管理API的DELETE @connections/{connectionId}。

知识点／记忆点：连接生命周期路由用于观测连接，管理API用于主动断连；必须记录连接ID，且断连事件不能当作绝对可靠的在线状态来源。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：HTTP API不提供本题所需WebSocket连接生命周期。

B：换REST API不能跟踪持久WebSocket连接。

D：缓存可辅助存状态，但单独存状态不能接收连接与断开事件。

options.text: Switch to HTTP APIs in the backend service.
Switch to REST APIs in the backend service.
Use the callback URL to disconnect the client from the backend service.
Add code to track the client status in Amazon ElastiCache in the backend service.
Implement $connect and $disconnect routes in the backend service.

question_text_original: A real-time messaging application uses Amazon API Gateway WebSocket APIs with backend HTTP service. A developer needs to build a feature in the application to identify a client that keeps connecting to and disconnecting from the WebSocket connection. The developer also needs the ability to remove the client. Which combination of changes should the developer make to the application to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员已编写应用代码，希望与团队其他开发人员共享以获取反馈。共享代码需要长期存储，支持多个版本以及批量变更跟踪。应使用哪项 AWS 服务？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。CodeCommit 可让团队共享并审查版本控制中的源代码。

知识点／记忆点：源代码协作需要提交历史、分支及差异比较；对象版本与Git提交不是同一种粒度，开发环境也不等于代码托管。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CodeBuild执行构建和测试，不是团队Git版本库。

B：S3对象版本不提供跨文件原子提交及代码分支评审工作流。

D：Cloud9是开发环境，本身不能替代长期Git代码托管。

options.text: AWS CodeBuild
Amazon S3
AWS CodeCommit
AWS Cloud9

question_text_original: A developer has written code for an application and wants to share it with other developers on the team to receive feedback. The shared application code needs to be stored long-term with multiple versions and batch change tracking. Which AWS service should the developer use?

question_text: 公司的开发人员正在构建一个静态网站，将部署到 Amazon S3 的生产环境。网站通过 AWS Lambda 函数集成 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库，并使用指向指定函数版本的 Lambda 别名。公司必须每两周轮换一次数据库凭证，之前部署的 Lambda 函数也必须能使用最新凭证。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。Secrets Manager rotation 使旧 Lambda version 仍可在运行时取得最新数据库凭证。

知识点／记忆点：不可变代码版本与可变运行配置应解耦；运行时读取秘密，让旧函数版本也能适应密码轮换。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：重新发布代码不能修改既有不可变版本中的密码。

C：已发布版本的环境变量不能原地修改。

D：Parameter Store没有内置的数据库密码自动轮换开关。

options.text: Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation. Write code in the Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from Secrets Manager.
Include the database credentials as part of the Lambda function code. Update the credentials periodically and deploy the new Lambda function.
Use Lambda environment variables. Update the environment variables when new credentials are available.
Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation. Write code in the Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from Systems Manager Parameter Store.

question_text_original: A company's developer is building a static website to be deployed in Amazon S3 for a production environment. The website integrates with an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database by using an AWS Lambda function. The website that is deployed to production will use a Lambda alias that points to a specific version of the Lambda function. The company must rotate the database credentials every 2 weeks. Lambda functions that the company deployed previously must be able to use the most recent credentials. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在开发一个通过签名请求（Signature Version 4）调用其他 AWS 服务的应用，已经创建规范请求、待签名字符串，并计算了签名信息。可以通过哪些方法完成签名请求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AD。SigV4 签名可放 Authorization header，预签名请求则通过 X-Amz-Signature query parameter 传递。

知识点／记忆点：SigV4绑定请求内容，签名位置必须遵守协议；临时凭证还需安全令牌，签名后修改请求可能使验证失败。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：普通会话Cookie不是AWS服务接受的SigV4签名入口。

C：规定的头名是Authorization而非Authentication。

E：WWW-Authenticate是服务端认证挑战响应头，不是提交签名的请求头。

options.text: Add the signature to an HTTP header that is named Authorization.
Add the signature to a session cookie.
Add the signature to an HTTP header that is named Authentication.
Add the signature to a query string parameter that is named X-Amz-Signature.
Add the signature to an HTTP header that is named WWW-Authenticate.

question_text_original: A developer is developing an application that uses signed requests (Signature Version 4) to call other AWS services. The developer has created a canonical request, has created the string to sign, and has calculated signing information. Which methods could the developer use to complete a signed request? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司必须通过 AWS CloudFormation 模板部署所有 Amazon RDS 数据库实例，作为 AWS CodePipeline CI/CD 自动化的一部分。数据库实例的主密码必须在部署过程中自动生成。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：D。CloudFormation 可创建 Secrets Manager secret 并自动生成密码，再用 dynamic reference 设置 RDS 凭证。

知识点／记忆点：部署时引用秘密而非把值复制进模板和构建日志；原生资源能生成随机密码，动态引用在需要时解析。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：自定义资源生成密码增加代码维护与秘密暴露面。

B：构建脚本生成并传参增加步骤，NoEcho不能防止其他日志泄露。

C：原生Secret已有生成能力，再写Lambda重复实现。

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda-backed CloudFormation custom resource. Write Lambda code that generates a secure string. Return the value of the secure string as a data field of the custom resource response object. Use the CloudFormation Fn::GetAtt intrinsic function to get the value of the secure string. Use the value to create the DB instance.

Use the AWS CodeBuild action of CodePipeline to generate a secure string by using the following AWS CLI command: aws secretsmanager get-random-password. Pass the generated secure string as a CloudFormation parameter with the NoEcho attribute set to true. Use the parameter reference to create the DB instance.

Create an AWS Lambda-backed CloudFormation custom resource. Write Lambda code that generates a secure string. Return the value of the secure string as a data field of the custom resource response object. Use the CloudFormation Fn::GetAtt intrinsic function to get a value of the secure string. Create secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Use the secretsmanager dynamic reference to use the value stored in the secret to create the DB instance.

Use the AWS::SecretsManager::Secret resource to generate a secure string. Store the secure string as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Use the secretsmanager dynamic reference to use the value stored in the secret to create the DB instance.

question_text_original: A company must deploy all its Amazon RDS DB instances by using AWS CloudFormation templates as part of AWS CodePipeline continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) automation. The primary password for the DB instance must be automatically generated as part of the deployment process. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 一个组织在 Amazon S3 中存储大型文件，正在编写 Web 应用向终端用户展示文件元数据。用户根据元数据选择要下载的对象。该组织需要一种机制，为文件建立索引，并以个位数毫秒延迟获取元数据。应使用哪项 AWS 服务？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。S3 存大文件，DynamoDB 存可检索的文件 metadata。

适用前提与时效：RDS并非不能实现毫秒延迟，本题是选最匹配的托管服务特征。

知识点／记忆点：大对象和检索索引分离：对象存储放内容，键值数据库放小型元数据；按访问模式设计主键与索引。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：EC2仅提供计算，需自行搭建和维护索引数据库。

C：Lambda不是持久化元数据存储。

D：RDS能保存元数据，但本题键值访问不需要关系查询，DynamoDB更直接。

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB
Amazon EC2
AWS Lambda
Amazon RDS

question_text_original: An organization is storing large files in Amazon S3, and is writing a web application to display meta-data about the files to end-users. Based on the metadata a user selects an object to download. The organization needs a mechanism to index the files and provide single-digit millisecond latency retrieval for the metadata. What AWS service should be used to accomplish this?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个 AWS Serverless Application Model（AWS SAM）模板，定义了多个 AWS Lambda 函数、一个 Amazon S3 存储桶和一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。其中一个函数在该分配的 Lambda@Edge 上运行，S3 存储桶作为分配的源。在 eu-west-1 区域部署模板时，堆栈创建失败。以下哪项可能是原因？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：B。Lambda@Edge 函数版本必须在 us-east-1 创建；仅在 eu-west-1 部署会失败。

适用前提与时效：Lambda@Edge必须关联us-east-1已发布版本，不能使用$LATEST或别名。

知识点／记忆点：全球服务和依赖的区域资源可能有不同约束；边缘代码的发布区域不等于最终执行位置。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudFront是全球服务，不要求创建分发的栈只能在us-east-1。

C：SAM模板允许多个函数。

D：S3源和CloudFront分发没有必须位于不同区域的限制。

options.text: CloudFront distributions can be created only in the us-east-1 Region.
Lambda@Edge functions can be created only in the us-east-1 Region.
A single AWS SAM template cannot contain multiple Lambda functions.
The CloudFront distribution and the S3 bucket cannot be created in the same Region.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template. The AWS SAM template contains the definition of multiple AWS Lambda functions, an Amazon S3 bucket, and an Amazon CloudFront distribution. One of the Lambda functions runs on Lambda@Edge in the CloudFront distribution. The S3 bucket is configured as an origin for the CloudFront distribution. When the developer deploys the AWS SAM template in the eu-west-1 Region, the creation of the stack fails. Which of the following could be the reason for this issue?

question_text: 开发人员正在将 Amazon ElastiCache 集成到应用中，用于缓存数据库中的数据。这些缓存数据必须供实时仪表板使用。哪种缓存策略能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。write-through cache 在数据库写入时同步更新缓存，降低读取陈旧值的概率。

适用前提与时效：Write-through要求所有写入遵守策略，仍需处理数据库和缓存双写失败。

知识点／记忆点：缓存新鲜度取决于数据库写入时是否同步更新或失效；只处理读未命中不能防止读到已缓存旧值。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Read-through处理未命中加载，不自动刷新已缓存旧数据。

B：Write-behind延迟写数据库，增加持久化滞后与恢复复杂度。

C：Lazy loading可能一直命中旧值直到缓存失效。

options.text: A read-through cache
A write-behind cache
A lazy-loading cache
A write-through cache

question_text_original: A developer is integrating Amazon ElastiCache in an application. The cache will store data from a database. The cached data must populate real-time dashboards. Which caching strategy will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，需要使用外部库连接第三方解决方案。该库由总计 100 MB 的文件组成。开发人员需要让 Lambda 执行环境能够使用此库，同时减小 Lambda 部署包的占用空间。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。100 MB 的共享库可放 Lambda layer，减少每个函数部署包的重复内容；须遵守总解压大小限制。

知识点／记忆点：Layer减少各函数包的依赖重复，但仍计入函数与全部Layer的总解压大小；共享库还须兼容运行时和架构。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Lambda不提供直接将S3桶作为本地目录挂载的普通配置。

C：部署时不能预填未来每个执行环境的临时/tmp目录。

D：EFS可加载库，但需要文件系统、网络及挂载权限，运维更多。

options.text: Create a Lambda layer to store the external library. Configure the Lambda function to use the layer.
Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Upload the external library into the S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket folder in the Lambda function. Import the library by using the proper folder in the mount point.
Load the external library to the Lambda function's /tmp directory during deployment of the Lambda package. Import the library from the /tmp directory.

Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Upload the external library to the EFS volume. Mount the EFS volume in the Lambda function. Import the library by using the proper folder in the mount point.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function needs an external library to connect to a third-party solution. The external library is a collection of files with a total size of 100 MB. The developer needs to make the external library available to the Lambda execution environment and reduce the Lambda package space. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 一家公司的前端应用运行在由 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 预置的生产环境中，使用 Elastic Load Balancer（ELB）后方的四个 Amazon EC2 实例。开发人员需要部署和测试新代码，同时将 Elastic Beanstalk 平台从当前版本更新到较新的 Node.js 版本。整个过程必须实现零停机。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。Elastic Beanstalk 蓝绿部署可先克隆环境、升级平台并测试，再交换 URL 以避免停机。

适用前提与时效：URL交换仍需考虑DNS缓存、长连接及数据库兼容。

知识点／记忆点：同时升级应用与平台时，独立新环境可完整验证并保留旧环境回切；新旧版本还须兼容数据和会话。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：全量原地部署可能同时中断所有实例服务。

C：不可变代码更新未完整描述跨平台版本的独立测试和切换。

D：滚动更新会把未充分验证的代码送入生产，也未解决平台升级隔离。

options.text: Clone the production environment to a different platform version. Deploy the new application code, and test it. Swap the environment URLs upon verification.
Deploy the new application code in an all-at-once deployment to the existing EC2 instances. Test the code. Redeploy the previous code if verification fails.
Perform an immutable update to deploy the new application code to new EC2 instances. Serve traffic to the new instances after they pass health checks.
Use a rolling deployment for the new application code. Apply the code to a subset of EC2 instances until the tests pass. Redeploy the previous code if the tests fail.

question_text_original: A company has a front-end application that runs on four Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB) in a production environment that is provisioned by AWS Elastic Beanstalk. A developer needs to deploy and test new application code while updating the Elastic Beanstalk platform from the current version to a newer version of Node.js. The solution must result in zero downtime for the application. Which solution meets these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个消费 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列消息的 AWS Lambda 函数，希望将单元测试纳入该函数的 CI/CD 流程。如何对该函数进行单元测试？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：信息不足】
参考答案：D。aws lambda invoke 调用已部署函数属于集成测试；题目没有给出真正隔离 handler 的 unit test 选项。

适用前提与时效：D同样不是严格的单元测试；原题没有完全符合定义的选项，仅保留参考答案，不强行认定D正确。

知识点／记忆点：单元测试隔离业务函数与外部依赖；调用部署在云端的函数即使使用测试事件，也属于集成测试。

选项核查与缺失信息：

A：实际创建队列并部署函数验证的是服务集成。

B：消费真实SQS消息引入外部依赖，不是纯单元测试。

C：真实测试队列仍需要云资源，不能隔离业务单元。

options.text: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that creates an SQS queue and deploys the Lambda function. Create a stack from the template during the CI/CD process. Invoke the deployed function. Verify the output.
Create an SQS event for tests. Use a test that consumes messages from the SQS queue during the function's Cl/CD process.
Create an SQS queue for tests. Use this SQS queue in the application's unit test. Run the unit tests during the CI/CD process.
Use the aws lambda invoke command with a test event during the CIICD process.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function will consume messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The developer wants to integrate unit testing as part of the function's continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) process. How can the developer unit test the function?

question_text: 开发人员正在维护一个以 Amazon DynamoDB 为数据存储的 Web 应用。应用包含 artists 和 songs 两张表：artists 的分区键为 artistName；songs 的分区键为 songName，排序键为 artistName。网页需要通过一次数据库操作获取多个歌曲和艺术家的信息。如何以最小网络流量获得最佳应用性能？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。DynamoDB BatchGetItem 可按已知主键从多个表批量取记录。

知识点／记忆点：BatchGetItem可一次请求多张表的完整主键；结果无顺序保证，未处理键需要重试。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：LSI不能改变原表分区键，逐个查询还增加请求数。

C：分两次批量读取可用，但跨表一次读取网络往返更少。

D：Scan先读再过滤，读取大量无关数据。

options.text: Perform a BatchGetltem operation that returns items from the two tables. Use the list of songName/artistName keys for the songs table and the list of artistName key for the artists table.

Create a local secondary index (LSI) on the songs table that uses artistName as the partition key. Perform a query operation for each artistName on the songs table that filters by the list of songName. Perform a query operation for each artistName on the artists table.
Perform a BatchGetitem operation on the songs table that uses the songName/artistName keys. Perform a BatchGetltem operation on the artists table that uses artistName as the key.
Perform a Scan operation on each table that filters by the list of songName/artistName for the songs table and the list of artistName in the artists table.

question_text_original: A developer is working on a web application that uses Amazon DynamoDB as its data store. The application has two DynamoDB tables: one table that is named artists and one table that is named songs. The artists table has artistName as the partition key. The songs table has songName as the partition key and artistName as the sort key. The table usage patterns include the retrieval of multiple songs and artists in a single database operation from the webpage. The developer needs a way to retrieve this information with minimal network traffic and optimal application performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司正在开发一个电商应用，使用 Amazon API Gateway API 和 AWS Lambda 后端。发布到生产环境前，公司需要在专用且受监控的测试环境中测试代码。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。API Gateway stages 和 stage variables 可将不同环境路由到对应 Lambda。

知识点／记忆点：环境隔离应同时覆盖入口、代码和监控；阶段变量只做路由，目标函数仍须授权API调用。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：单阶段依赖客户端参数，没有独立阶段配置和监控边界。

B：函数环境变量不是按请求阶段变化的配置，单函数代码仍相互耦合。

D：同一函数根据客户端参数分环境，不能提供独立测试后端。

options.text: Use a single stage in API Gateway. Create a Lambda function for each environment. Configure API clients to send a query parameter that indicates the environment and the specific Lambda function.

Use multiple stages in API Gateway. Create a single Lambda function for all environments. Add different code blocks for different environments in the Lambda function based on Lambda environment variables.
Use multiple stages in API Gateway. Create a Lambda function for each environment. Configure API Gateway stage variables to route traffic to the Lambda function in different environments.

Use a single stage in API Gateway. Configure API clients to send a query parameter that indicates the environment. Add different code blocks for different environments in the Lambda function to match the value of the query parameter.

question_text_original: A company is developing an ecommerce application that uses Amazon API Gateway APIs. The application uses AWS Lambda as a backend. The company needs to test the code in a dedicated, monitored test environment before the company releases the code to the production environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员创建了一个 AWS Lambda 函数，从多个公共 API 端点获取并汇总数据。函数更新后被配置为连接 VPC 的私有子网。该 VPC 已附加互联网网关，并采用默认网络 ACL 和安全组配置。开发人员发现函数无法再访问公共 API，虽然已确认 API 本身正常可用。如何修复此连接问题？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：C。私有 subnet 中的 Lambda 出公网 API 需经 public NAT gateway；仅有 internet gateway 不够。

适用前提与时效：公有NAT所在子网也须能经IGW出网。

知识点／记忆点：Lambda连入VPC后由子网路由决定公网出口；函数接口没有自动公网IP，单有IGW不能完成IPv4出网。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：题设默认ACL已允许流量，缺失的是出口路径。

B：默认安全组允许出站，不是此处主要问题。

D：直接指向IGW不能为无公网IP的函数接口做地址转换。

options.text: Ensure that the network ACL allows outbound traffic to the public internet.
Ensure that the security group allows outbound traffic to the public internet.
Ensure that outbound traffic from the private subnet is routed to a public NAT gateway.
Ensure that outbound traffic from the private subnet is routed to a new internet gateway.

question_text_original: A developer creates an AWS Lambda function that retrieves and groups data from several public API endpoints. The Lambda function has been updated and configured to connect to the private subnet of a VPC. An internet gateway is attached to the VPC. The VPC uses the default network ACL and security group configurations. The developer finds that the Lambda function can no longer access the public API. The developer has ensured that the public API is accessible, but the Lambda function cannot connect to the API How should the developer fix the connection issue?

question_text: 开发人员需要存储应用配置变量，为配置设置到期日期和时间，并在到期前收到通知。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。Parameter Store Expiration 与 ExpirationNotification policies 需要 advanced parameter。

适用前提与时效：ExpirationNotification产生EventBridge事件，邮件通知仍需规则和目标。

知识点／记忆点：配置值与生命周期分开管理；到期删除和提前提醒是不同策略，提醒事件还需接到通知目标。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：标准参数不支持高级参数策略。

B：手写删除与通知Lambda比内置策略维护更多。

D：维护EC2和cron增加不必要运维。

options.text: Create a standard parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set Expiration and ExpirationNotification policy types.

Create a standard parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an AWS Lambda function to expire the configuration and to send Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notifications.
Create an advanced parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set Expiration and ExpirationNotification policy types.
Create an advanced parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an Amazon EC2 instance with a cron job to expire the configuration and to send notifications.

question_text_original: A developer needs to store configuration variables for an application. The developer needs to set an expiration date and time for the configuration. The developer wants to receive notifications before the configuration expires. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 一家公司正在开发无服务器应用，由位于 Amazon API Gateway API 后方的多个 AWS Lambda 函数组成。开发人员需要自动部署函数代码，并通过 AWS CodeDeploy 发布更新。部署必须尽量减少潜在错误对终端用户的影响，且生产应用在指定维护窗口之外不能停机。哪种部署配置能够满足要求且部署时间最短？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：D。Lambda CodeDeploy canary 先转少量流量再于 5 分钟后全量切换，比线性 10% 分批更快。

知识点／记忆点：金丝雀先验证小流量再整体扩大，线性部署则重复多次增加；健康指标和回滚机制决定是否能及时止损。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Lambda不是EC2式原地部署，立即全量也不限制错误暴露。

B：每分钟增10%比5分钟后全量的金丝雀需更多等待。

C：全量切换让全部用户立即暴露给新版本错误。

options.text: Use the AWS CodeDeploy in-place deployment configuration for the Lambda functions. Shift all traffic immediately after deployment.
Use the AWS CodeDeploy linear deployment configuration to shift 10% of the traffic every minute.
Use the AWS CodeDeploy all-at-once deployment configuration to shift all traffic to the updated versions immediately.
Use the AWS CodeDeploy predefined canary deployment configuration to shift 10% of the traffic immediately and shift the remaining traffic after 5 minutes.

question_text_original: A company is developing a serverless application that consists of various AWS Lambda functions behind Amazon API Gateway APIs. A developer needs to automate the deployment of Lambda function code. The developer will deploy updated Lambda functions with AWS CodeDeploy. The deployment must minimize the exposure of potential errors to end users. When the application is in production, the application cannot experience downtime outside the specified maintenance window. Which deployment configuration will meet these requirements with the LEAST deployment time?

question_text: 一家公司创建了四个 AWS Lambda 函数，连接运行在 Amazon RDS 实例上的关系数据库服务器。安全团队要求每 30 天自动更改一次数据库密码。哪种方案最安全？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：B。Secrets Manager 可托管数据库凭证并按 30 天周期自动 rotation。

知识点／记忆点：凭证集中管理可避免多个函数副本不一致；轮换必须修改数据库密码并让客户端刷新缓存。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：周期性重发代码不是托管自动轮换，并复制了秘密。

C：SecureString加密存储没有原生数据库密码轮换周期配置。

D：轮换SSE-C密钥只影响加密材料，不改变数据库密码。

options.text: Store the database credentials in the environment variables of the Lambda function. Deploy the Lambda function with the new credentials every 30 days.
Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure a 30-day rotation schedule for the credentials.
Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store secure strings. Configure a 30-day schedule for the secure strings.
Store the database credentials in an Amazon S3 bucket that uses server-side encryption with customer-provided encryption keys (SSE-C). Configure a 30-day key rotation schedule for the customer key.

question_text_original: A company created four AWS Lambda functions that connect to a relational database server that runs on an Amazon RDS instance. A security team requires the company to automatically change the database password every 30 days. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

question_text: 开发人员正在设置部署流水线，其中的 AWS CodeBuild 构建阶段需要访问数据库以运行集成测试。开发人员使用 buildspec.yml 文件配置数据库连接。公司政策要求自动轮换所有数据库凭证。哪种方案能够最安全地处理这些凭证？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：C。CodeBuild 可从 Secrets Manager 环境变量取得自动轮换的数据库凭证。

知识点／记忆点：构建时按身份读取当前秘密，版本库只保留引用；不要让密码出现在构建脚本、普通变量或日志中。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：buildspec硬编码会把密码留在版本历史。

B：Parameter Store没有选项所述内置数据库凭证自动轮换。

D：明文变量增加暴露面，EventBridge事件本身也不执行密码更新。

options.text: Retrieve the credentials from variables that are hardcoded in the buildspec.yml file. Configure an AWS Lambda function to rotate the credentials.
Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that is linked to a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure Parameter Store for automatic rotation.
Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that is linked to an AWS Secrets Manager secret. Configure Secrets Manager for automatic rotation.
Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that contains the connection string in plaintext. Configure an Amazon EventBridge event to rotate the credentials.

question_text_original: A developer is setting up a deployment pipeline. The pipeline includes an AWS CodeBuild build stage that requires access to a database to run integration tests. The developer is using a buildspec.yml file to configure the database connection. Company policy requires automatic rotation of all database credentials. Which solution will handle the database credentials MOST securely?

question_text: 一家公司正在 AWS 上开发无服务器多层应用，将使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 构建逻辑层。在逻辑层开发期间，负责前端的开发人员需要编写集成测试，覆盖依据成功和错误 HTTP 状态码区分的正向及负向场景。哪种方案需要的工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。API Gateway MOCK integration 可通过 request/response mapping template 模拟不同 HTTP 状态。

知识点／记忆点：接口Mock可让前后端并行开发，通过输入选择成功或失败响应，先验证契约而不依赖真实业务后端。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：为成功和失败各建资源增加重复配置，不如同一接口分支真实。

C：编写Lambda桩比原生Mock多出代码和部署。

D：Mock不选择调用Lambda，选项混淆两种集成类型。

options.text: Set up a mock integration for API methods in API Gateway. In the integration request from Method Execution, add simple logic to return either a success or error based on HTTP status code. In the integration response, add messages that correspond to the HTTP status codes.

Create two mock integration resources for API methods in API Gateway. In the integration request, return a success HTTP status code for one resource and an error HTTP status code for the other resource. In the integration response, add messages that correspond to the HTTP status codes.

Create Lambda functions to perform tests. Add simple logic to return either success or error, based on the HTTP status codes. Build an API Gateway Lambda integration. Select appropriate Lambda functions that correspond to the HTTP status codes.

Create a Lambda function to perform tests. Add simple logic to return either success or error-based HTTP status codes. Create a mock integration in API Gateway. Select the Lambda function that corresponds to the HTTP status codes.

question_text_original: A company is developing a serverless multi-tier application on AWS. The company will build the serverless logic tier by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. While the company builds the logic tier, a developer who works on the frontend of the application must develop integration tests. The tests must cover both positive and negative scenarios, depending on success and error HTTP status codes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

question_text: 用户报告应用发生错误。应用由多个微服务组成，使用 AWS Fargate 部署在 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）上。开发人员应采取哪些步骤修复错误？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：AD。原 PDF 只给 A，但题干要求选两项；旧式 Fargate tracing 需 X-Ray sidecar 与 SDK 对接，SDK/daemon 已进入维护模式。

适用前提与时效：追踪帮助定位而非自动修复；X-Ray SDK和daemon自2026-02-25进入维护模式，新实现应评估OpenTelemetry。

知识点／记忆点：追踪需要应用产生跨度及采集器转发，日志输出不能替代调用链；Fargate的sidecar随任务运行并使用任务权限。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：DaemonSet属于Kubernetes，不能用于ECS Fargate部署。

C：不存在PutXrayTrace这个API，旧式SDK把段发送给daemon。

E：stdout和stderr是日志而非链路数据，cloudwatch:PullLogs也不是有效写日志权限。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-daemon-timeline.html

options.text: Deploy AWS X-Ray as a sidecar container to the microservices. Update the task role policy to allow access to the X-Ray API.
Deploy AWS X-Ray as a daemonset to the Fargate cluster. Update the service role policy to allow access to the X-Ray API.
Instrument the application by using the AWS X-Ray SDK. Update the application to use the PutXrayTrace API call to communicate with the X-Ray API.
Instrument the application by using the AWS X-Ray SDK. Update the application to communicate with the X-Ray daemon.
Instrument the ECS task to send the stdout and stderr output to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Update the task role policy to allow the cloudwatch:PullLogs action.

audit_label: 有条件成立；原答案已修正
question_text_original: Users are reporting errors in an application. The application consists of several microservices that are deployed on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate. Which combination of steps should a developer take to fix the errors? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员正在为公司创建一个应用，需要读取名为 DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET 的 Amazon S3 存储桶根目录中的 doc.txt 文件。安全团队要求应用的 IAM 策略遵循最小权限原则。哪个 IAM 策略语句能够满足这些安全要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。图中 A 只允许读取 doc.txt 这个对象 ARN，符合 S3 最小权限；原 D 权限范围不对。

知识点／记忆点：最小权限同时限制动作与资源；读取已知对象不需要列桶、写入或其他对象权限，对象ARN必须包含完整键路径。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：s3:*与Resource *同时放开全部S3动作和资源。

C：GetObject正确，但桶下/*允许读取所有对象。

D：虽然限制到doc.txt，s3:*仍额外授予该对象的写入和删除等权限。

options.text: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D

question_text_original: A developer is creating an application for a company. The application needs to read the file doc.txt that is placed in the root folder of an Amazon S3 bucket that is named DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET. The company’s security team requires the principle of least privilege to be applied to the application’s IAM policy. Which IAM policy statement will meet these security requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的应用使用 AWS CodePipeline 自动执行 CI/CD 工作流，并使用 AWS CodeCommit 进行版本控制。一名开发人员处理任务时未拉取主分支的最新变更，一周后发现合并冲突。如何以最少的开发工作解决其分支中的合并冲突？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：D。用 rebase 把 main 更新带入 feature branch 后仍可能需要手动解决冲突；题目省略了冲突解决步骤。

适用前提与时效：D须先中止未完成合并，再rebase并解决冲突；不能认为rebase保证无冲突，merge也可能合理。

知识点／记忆点：Rebase把自己的提交重新应用到新基线，可能重写提交ID且仍需解决冲突；共享分支应协调历史改写。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：重克隆和新建分支增加迁移工作，不消除内容冲突。

B：搬运修改到新分支仍可能遇到原有冲突。

C：提交可视化辅助理解历史，不直接完成主线整合。

options.text: Clone the repository. Create a new branch. Update the branch with the changes.
Create a new branch. Apply the changes from the previous branch.
Use the Commit Visualizer view to compare the commits when a feature was added. Fix the merge conflicts.
Stop the pull from the main branch to the feature branch. Rebase the feature branch from the main branch.

question_text_original: A company has an application that uses AWS CodePipeline to automate its continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflow. The application uses AWS CodeCommit for version control. A developer who was working on one of the tasks did not pull the most recent changes from the main branch. A week later, the developer noticed merge conflicts. How can the developer resolve the merge conflicts in the developer's branch with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员希望为生产环境中的 Amazon API Gateway API 添加请求验证，并在部署到生产环境之前测试变更。测试时将通过测试工具向 API 发送请求。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。API Gateway 的新 request validation 可先部署到独立 stage，再发布生产。

知识点／记忆点：API配置修改和阶段发布是不同步骤；独立阶段绑定新部署，可先验证同一API快照，再把验证过的部署用于生产。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：导出再导入创建第二套API，增加复制与同步步骤。

C：手工重建资源和方法重复劳动，容易遗漏配置。

D：克隆API仍需把变更同步回原API，维护多于新增阶段。

options.text: Export the existing API to an OpenAPI file. Create a new API. Import the OpenAPI file. Modify the new API to add request validation. Perform the tests. Modify the existing API to add request validation. Deploy the existing API to production.
Modify the existing API to add request validation. Deploy the updated API to a new API Gateway stage. Perform the tests. Deploy the updated API to the API Gateway production stage.

Create a new API. Add the necessary resources and methods, including new request validation. Perform the tests. Modify the existing API to add request validation. Deploy the existing API to production
Clone the existing API. Modify the new API to add request validation. Perform the tests. Modify the existing API to add request validation. Deploy the existing API to production.

question_text_original: A developer wants to add request validation to a production environment Amazon API Gateway API. The developer needs to test the changes before the API is deployed to the production environment. For the test, the developer will send test requests to the API through a testing tool. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 一家在线食品公司通过 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 接收合作伙伴订单。API 集成 AWS Lambda 函数，将订单存入 Amazon DynamoDB 表。公司预计会接入更多合作伙伴，其中部分合作伙伴需要额外的 Lambda 函数接收订单。公司已创建 Amazon S3 存储桶，需要将所有订单及更新保存在其中，以供未来分析。开发人员如何以最少的开发工作确保所有订单和更新都存入 S3？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。DynamoDB Streams 可把订单表变更交给独立 Lambda 后续处理。

适用前提与时效：应配置合适的StreamViewType，若需保存更新前后内容，应包含相应镜像；需在流记录保留期内可靠消费。

知识点／记忆点：在数据存储的变更边界统一捕获事件，可以覆盖多个写入入口；存档消费者应幂等并处理重试，避免双写遗漏和重复。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：每个写入函数都要额外调用新API，新增伙伴仍需重复改造。

B：既要修改生产者，Kinesis Data Streams本身也不直接把记录写入S3。

D：每个生产者显式发SNS事件仍有业务代码修改与双写一致性问题。

options.text: Create a new Lambda function and a new API Gateway API endpoint. Configure the new Lambda function to write to the S3 bucket. Modify the original Lambda function to post updates to the new API endpoint.
Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to create a new data stream. Modify the Lambda function to publish orders to the data stream. Configure the data stream to write to the S3 bucket.

Enable DynamoDB Streams on the DynamoDB table. Create a new Lambda function. Associate the stream’s Amazon Resource Name (ARN) with the Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to write to the S3 bucket as records appear in the table's stream.

Modify the Lambda function to publish to a new Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the Lambda function receives orders. Subscribe a new Lambda function to the topic. Configure the new Lambda function to write to the S3 bucket as updates come through the topic.

question_text_original: An online food company provides an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to receive orders for partners. The API is integrated with an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function stores the orders in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company expects to onboard additional partners. Some of the partners require additional Lambda functions to receive orders. The company has created an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to store all orders and updates in the S3 bucket for future analysis. How can the developer ensure that all orders and updates are stored to Amazon S3 with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 一家公司的站点运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并通过 Auto Scaling 在高峰期扩展环境。由于静态内容存放在 EC2 实例上，全球用户即使在非高峰期也遇到高延迟。哪些步骤可以解决此问题？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：DE。S3 承载静态文件，CloudFront 缓存并分发全球用户访问的静态内容。

知识点／记忆点：全球静态内容延迟主要受用户与源站距离影响；边缘缓存减少远程往返，扩服务器只缓解源站容量问题。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：提高最大实例数不保证实际扩容，也不缩短全球用户网络距离。

B：迁移计算到Lambda不会自动把静态内容缓存到全球边缘。

C：更大实例不解决远距离传输延迟。

options.text: Double the Auto Scaling group’s maximum number of servers.
Host the application code on AWS Lambda.
Scale vertically by resizing the EC2 instances.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to cache the static content.
Store the application’s static content in Amazon S3.

question_text_original: A company’s website runs on an Amazon EC2 instance and uses Auto Scaling to scale the environment during peak times. Website users across the world are experiencing high latency due to static content on the EC2 instance, even during non-peak hours. Which combination of steps will resolve the latency issue? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司在 Amazon S3 存储桶中保存高级内容，只打算向网站付费订阅者开放。目前桶内所有对象均采用私有的默认权限，以防意外向非付费访客公开。如何将下载桶内高级内容文件的权限限制为仅付费订阅者可用？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。S3 presigned URL 可临时授权付费用户下载私有对象。

适用前提与时效：预签名URL是持有者凭证，可被转发；不能保证只有原订阅者使用，应缩短有效期并避免泄露。

知识点／记忆点：预签名URL把签发者部分权限临时交给持有者；先验证订阅资格，再签发单对象短期链接，桶仍保持私有。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：匿名读取直接向未付费用户开放内容。

C：MFA证明额外认证因素，不证明网站付费资格。

D：静态加密不替代对象访问授权。

options.text: Apply a bucket policy that allows anonymous users to download the content from the S3 bucket.
Generate a pre-signed object URL for the premier content file when a paid subscriber requests a download.
Add a bucket policy that requires multi-factor authentication for requests to access the S3 bucket objects.
Enable server-side encryption on the S3 bucket for data protection against the non-paying website visitors.

question_text_original: A company has an Amazon S3 bucket containing premier content that it intends to make available to only paid subscribers of its website. The S3 bucket currently has default permissions of all objects being private to prevent inadvertent exposure of the premier content to non-paying website visitors. How can the company limit the ability to download a premier content file in the S3 bucket to paid subscribers only?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，从保存客户联系信息的 Amazon DynamoDB 表中搜索项目。表以客户 email_address 为分区键，另含 customer_type、name 和 job_title 等属性。每当用户在 customer_type 文本输入框中输入新字符时，函数都会运行。开发人员希望搜索返回指定 customer_type 下所有 email_address 属性的部分匹配结果，但不想重新创建表。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。DynamoDB GSI 可新增 customer_type partition key 与 email_address sort key；begins_with 适用于 sort key。

适用前提与时效：A仅支持已知完整customer_type并按email_address前缀查询；题干称输入customer_type每个字符触发且笼统说partial match，若要求类型前缀或任意子串，A不完全满足。

知识点／记忆点：DynamoDB Query要求分区键精确相等，前缀条件用于排序键；GSI可后加并改变访问键，LSI不能后加或改变分区键。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：email_address作分区键不能使用begins_with进行分区键查询。

C：LSI必须沿用原分区键且不能在现有表上新增。

D：LSI不能把分区键改为job_title，也不匹配所需customer_type访问模式。

options.text: Add a global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table with customer_type as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the GSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

Add a global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table with email_address as the partition key and customer_type as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the GSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

Add a local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table with customer_type as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the LSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

Add a local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table with job_title as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the LSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that searches for items from an Amazon DynamoDB table that contains customer contact information. The DynamoDB table items have the customer’s email_address as the partition key and additional properties such as customer_type, name and job_title. The Lambda function runs whenever a user types a new character into the customer_type text input. The developer wants the search to return partial matches of all the email_address property of a particular customer_type. The developer does not want to recreate the DynamoDB table. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建使用 Amazon API Gateway API、AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon DynamoDB 表的应用，通过 AWS Serverless Application Model（AWS SAM）构建并运行。即使只推送 Lambda 函数的变更，应用的所有制品也会重新构建。开发人员希望使用 AWS SAM Accelerate 命令，只重新部署发生变化的函数。应使用哪个命令？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。SAM Accelerate 使用 sam sync --watch 增量同步变更的 Lambda，而非重打包全部资源。

适用前提与时效：sam sync --watch适用于开发迭代；基础设施变化仍可能触发CloudFormation更新，不能理解为永远只操作Lambda。

知识点／记忆点：快速开发反馈可直接同步变更代码，避免每次完整基础设施发布；代码变更与资源结构变更仍可能走不同更新路径。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：force-upload强制上传已有构件，不提供增量监视同步。

B：no-execute-changeset只创建变更集，不执行部署。

C：package打包上传构件，不持续监视并更新运行函数。

options.text: sam deploy --force-upload
sam deploy --no-execute-changeset
sam package
sam sync --watch

question_text_original: A developer is building an application that uses AWS API Gateway APIs, AWS Lambda functions, and AWS DynamoDB tables. The developer uses the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to build and run serverless applications on AWS. Each time the developer pushes changes for only to the Lambda functions, all the artifacts in the application are rebuilt. The developer wants to implement AWS SAM Accelerate by running a command to only redeploy the Lambda functions that have changed. Which command will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建一个应用，让用户在同一仪表板中查看多个来源的银行账户。开发人员已自动化获取这些来源 API 凭证的过程，该过程调用与 AWS CloudFormation 自定义资源关联的 AWS Lambda 函数。开发人员希望以最少的运维开销存储 API 凭证。哪种方案能够最安全地满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：B。既有 custom-resource Lambda 可调用 ssm:PutParameter 写入 SecureString；NoEcho 不是 PutParameter 参数。

知识点／记忆点：秘密值的加密存储与界面隐藏是两回事；已有自定义资源可直接写安全参数，避免把凭证经过CloudFormation返回值传播。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：GenerateSecretString用于生成新随机秘密，不是存入已取回的第三方凭证的独立资源。

C：NoEcho并不把普通参数变成KMS加密的SecureString，且资源定义混淆了NoEcho位置。

D：PutParameter没有NoEcho参数，必须指定SecureString实现加密存储。

options.text: Add an AWS Secrets Manager GenerateSecretString resource to the CloudFormation template. Set the value to reference new credentials for the CloudFormation resource.

Use the AWS SDK ssm:PutParameter operation in the Lambda function from the existing custom resource to store the credentials as a parameter. Set the parameter value to reference the new credentials. Set the parameter type to SecureString.
Add an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store resource to the CloudFormation template. Set the CloudFormation resource value to reference the new credentials. Set the resource NoEcho attribute to true.

Use the AWS SDK ssm:PutParameter operation in the Lambda function from the existing custom resource to store the credentials as a parameter. Set the parameter value to reference the new credentials. Set the parameter NoEcho attribute to true.

question_text_original: A developer is building an application that gives users the ability to view bank accounts from multiple sources in a single dashboard. The developer has automated the process to retrieve API credentials for these sources. The process invokes an AWS Lambda function that is associated with an AWS CloudFormation custom resource. The developer wants a solution that will store the API credentials with minimal operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

question_text: 开发人员尝试从名为 demoman-table 的 Amazon DynamoDB 表获取数据。AWS CLI 已配置为使用某个 IAM 用户的凭证，随后执行命令：aws dynamodb get-item --table-name demoman-table --key '{"id": {"N":"1993"}}'。命令返回错误，未返回任何行。最可能的原因是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：D。DynamoDB GetItem 命令语法可用；AccessDenied 时核查调用者对目标 table 的 IAM read 权限。

适用前提与时效：未给错误码与表键结构，缺权限只是选项中最合理解释；若表有排序键或id类型非数字，该请求也会失败。

知识点／记忆点：有效API语法不等于拥有资源权限；点查还须提供与表主键类型一致的完整键，排障应结合具体错误码。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：PutItem用于写入，不应替换读取操作。

B：正常DynamoDB授权由IAM策略控制，不需Support为单表开通访问。

C：AWS CLI支持DynamoDB GetItem。

options.text: The command is incorrect; it should be rewritten to use put-item with a string argument.
The developer needs to log a ticket with AWS Support to enable access to the demoman-table.
Amazon DynamoDB cannot be accessed from the AWS CLI and needs to be called via the REST API.
The IAM user needs an associated policy with read access to demoman-table.

question_text_original: A developer is trying to get data from an Amazon DynamoDB table called demoman-table. The developer configured the AWS CLI to use a specific IAM user’s credentials and ran the following command: aws dynamodb get-item --table-name demoman-table --key '{"id": {"N":"1993"}}' The command returned errors and no rows were returned. What is the MOST likely cause of these issues?

question_text: 一个组织使用 Amazon CloudFront，为用户提供低延迟的 Web 应用访问。现在需要加密用户与 CloudFront 之间的全部流量，以及 CloudFront 与 Web 应用之间的全部流量。如何满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BD。CloudFront viewer 与 origin 两段连接都要限制为 HTTPS，才能实现端到端传输加密。

适用前提与时效：重定向模式的首次HTTP请求仍是明文；若合规要求绝不接受HTTP业务请求，应选择HTTPS Only，源站也需支持HTTPS。

知识点／记忆点：CDN有查看者到边缘、边缘到源站两段独立连接，必须分别约束TLS；端口数字与访问签名不能替代协议加密。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：KMS用于密钥与加密操作，不负责把CloudFront源站连接改为TLS。

C：将HTTP端口写成443不使HTTP自动成为HTTPS。

E：Restrict Viewer Access要求签名URL或Cookie，控制授权而非传输协议。

options.text: Use AWS KMS to encrypt traffic between CloudFront and the web application.
Set the Origin Protocol Policy to “HTTPS Only”.
Set the Origin’s HTTP Port to 443.
Set the Viewer Protocol Policy to “HTTPS Only” or “Redirect HTTP to HTTPS”.
Enable the CloudFront option Restrict Viewer Access.

question_text_original: An organization is using Amazon CloudFront to ensure that its users experience low-latency access to its web application. The organization has identified a need to encrypt all traffic between users and CloudFront, and all traffic between CloudFront and the web application. How can these requirements be met? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员计划将公司本地数据迁移到 Amazon S3。数据必须加密，加密密钥必须支持每年自动轮换，并且公司必须使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）加密数据。应使用哪种类型的密钥？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：B。KMS 自动轮换适用于 AWS 生成密钥材料的 symmetric customer managed key；imported key material 不能自动轮换。

知识点／记忆点：KMS轮换更新密钥材料而保持密钥标识，并保留旧材料解密历史数据；自动定期轮换、按需轮换与手动换钥是不同机制。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：S3托管密钥属于SSE-S3，不满足必须使用KMS的要求。

C：非对称密钥不支持此处要求的自动定期轮换，也不是S3 SSE-KMS所用类型。

D：导入材料的对称密钥可支持按需轮换，但不支持要求的自动年度轮换。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/importing-keys-considerations.html

options.text: Amazon S3 managed keys
Symmetric customer managed keys with key material that is generated by AWS
Asymmetric customer managed keys with key material that is generated by AWS
Symmetric customer managed keys with imported key material

question_text_original: A developer is planning to migrate on-premises company data to Amazon S3. The data must be encrypted, and the encryption keys must support automatic annual rotation. The company must use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the data. Which type of keys should the developer use to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发团队使用 AWS CodePipeline 流水线作为 Web 应用的 CI/CD 机制。开发人员已编写单元测试，以编程方式验证代码功能，并生成显示每项检查结果的测试报告。现在希望在 CI/CD 过程中自动运行这些测试。哪种方案需要的运维工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。CodeBuild 单元测试阶段应位于部署测试环境之前，且可输出 test report。

知识点／记忆点：单元测试应成为部署前的自动门禁，失败退出码阻断流水线；测试报告提供逐项结果，不能代替失败状态传播。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：本地hook容易缺装或绕过，不是统一自动流水线步骤。

B：部署后再跑单元测试能发现问题，但在可提前发现失败时浪费部署步骤。

D：Jenkins可实现测试，但要维护额外服务和插件，运维更多。

options.text: Write a Git pre-commit hook that runs the tests before every commit. Ensure that each developer who is working on the project has the pre-commit hook installed locally. Review the test report and resolve any issues before pushing changes to AWS CodeCommit.

Add a new stage to the pipeline. Use AWS CodeBuild as the provider. Add the new stage after the stage that deploys code revisions to the test environment. Write a buildspec that fails the CodeBuild stage if any test does not pass. Use the test reports feature of CodeBuild to integrate the report with the CodeBuild console. View the test results in CodeBuild. Resolve any issues.

Add a new stage to the pipeline. Use AWS CodeBuild as the provider. Add the new stage before the stage that deploys code revisions to the test environment. Write a buildspec that fails the CodeBuild stage if any test does not pass. Use the test reports feature of CodeBuild to integrate the report with the CodeBuild console. View the test results in CodeBuild. Resolve any issues.

Add a new stage to the pipeline. Use Jenkins as the provider. Configure CodePipeline to use Jenkins to run the unit tests. Write a Jenkinsfile that fails the stage if any test does not pass. Use the test report plugin for Jenkins to integrate the report with the Jenkins dashboard. View the test results in Jenkins. Resolve any issues.

question_text_original: A team of developers is using an AWS CodePipeline pipeline as a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) mechanism for a web application. A developer has written unit tests to programmatically test the functionality of the application code. The unit tests produce a test report that shows the results of each individual check. The developer now wants to run these tests automatically during the CI/CD process. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

question_text: 一家公司在同一个 VPC 中具有多个 Amazon VPC 端点。开发人员需要配置 Amazon S3 存储桶策略，只允许用户通过这些端点访问存储桶。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。S3 bucket policy 可用 aws:SourceVpce 列表限定多个 VPC endpoint，StringNotEquals 用于拒绝列表外请求。

适用前提与时效：若题意是允许该VPC全部端点，B同样合理，官方也明确推荐此用法；D适用于严格的端点ID清单，原题存在范围歧义。

知识点／记忆点：按网络路径限制访问要区分允许整个VPC还是指定端点；Deny加StringNotEquals列表可排除清单外来源，条件本身不授予权限。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：一个桶只有一个桶策略文档；分别Deny非某端点还可能互相拒绝合法端点。

B：SourceVpc允许该VPC的所有适用端点，不能严格限定为列举的指定端点。

C：StringNotEquals不把vpce*作为通配模式，也未限定具体授权端点。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html

options.text: Create multiple S3 bucket polices by using each VPC endpoint ID that have the aws:SourceVpce value in the StringNotEquals condition.
Create a single S3 bucket policy that has the aws:SourceVpc value and in the StringNotEquals condition to use VPC ID.
Create a single S3 bucket policy that has the aws:SourceVpce value and in the StringNotEquals condition to use vpce*.
Create a single S3 bucket policy that has multiple aws:sourceVpce value in the StringNotEquals condition. Repeat for all the VPC endpoint IDs.

question_text_original: A company has multiple Amazon VPC endpoints in the same VPC. A developer needs to configure an Amazon S3 bucket policy so users can access an S3 bucket only by using these VPC endpoints. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司使用大小为 10 KB 的自定义根证书颁发机构证书链（Root CA Cert），为本地 HTTPS 端点生成 SSL 证书。一个云端应用包含数百个 AWS Lambda 函数，会从这些端点获取数据。开发人员将根证书作为文本文件打包进 Lambda 部署包，并在执行环境初始化时更新信任存储以使用该证书。开发三个月后，根证书失效，必须更新。开发人员需要更高效的更新方案，不能重新构建或更新所有使用该证书的函数，并且必须适用于分别由不同 AWS 账户管理的开发、测试和生产环境。哪组步骤最具成本效益？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：CE。Root CA certificate 本身不是秘密，S3 跨账户共享更经济；Lambda 初始化时从 S3 加载可避免重新打包函数。

适用前提与时效：初始化加载的暖执行环境不会自动看到S3更新；需设计定期刷新、版本检查或环境回收，才能保证证书及时更新。

知识点／记忆点：信任根证书不是私钥，通常不需秘密存储，但完整性与写权限必须保护；初始化阶段加载可复用缓存，减少每次调用的读取成本。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Secrets Manager能存证书但费用较高，给IAM用户授权也未准确覆盖Lambda执行角色。

B：10KB超过Parameter Store高级参数8KB上限，不能原样存入单个参数。

D：每次handler调用加载和修改信任库会重复产生读取成本与处理开销。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/parameter-store-advanced-parameters.html

options.text: Store the Root CA Cert as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Create a resource-based policy. Add IAM users to allow access to the secret.
Store the Root CA Cert as a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create a resource-based policy. Add IAM users to allow access to the policy.
Store the Root CA Cert in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create a resource-based policy to allow access to the bucket.
Refactor the Lambda code to load the Root CA Cert from the Root CA Cert’s location. Modify the runtime trust store inside the Lambda function handler.
Refactor the Lambda code to load the Root CA Cert from the Root CA Cert’s location. Modify the runtime trust store outside the Lambda function handler.

question_text_original: A company uses a custom root certificate authority certificate chain (Root CA Cert) that is 10 KB in size to generate SSL certificates for its on-premises HTTPS endpoints. One of the company’s cloud-based applications has hundreds of AWS Lambda functions that pull data from these endpoints. A developer updated the trust store of the Lambda execution environment to use the Root CA Cert when the Lambda execution environment is initialized. The developer bundled the Root CA Cert as a text file in the Lambda deployment bundle. After 3 months of development, the Root CA Cert is no longer valid and must be updated. The developer needs a more efficient solution to update the Root CA Cert for all deployed Lambda functions. The solution must not include rebuilding or updating all Lambda functions that use the Root CA Cert. The solution must also work for all development, testing, and production environments. Each environment is managed in a separate AWS account. Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员维护的应用在 AWS Secrets Manager 中保存了多个密钥，这些密钥随时间有所变化。开发人员需要识别仍在使用且必需的密钥，同时不能导致应用停机。应如何操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：B。AWS Config 的 secretsmanager-secret-unused 规则可识别长期未使用的 secret，不需停用应用。

适用前提与时效：Config规则按设定期限评估未使用秘密；告警应订阅相应不合规状态，删除前还需确认周期任务和缓存用途。

知识点／记忆点：通过使用记录判断闲置比停用试错安全；一段时间未读取不等于永远无用，低频任务和应用缓存会影响判断。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudTrail送S3不会自动形成CloudWatch可告警的API调用指标，方案缺少处理链路。

C：停用秘密会导致仍依赖它的应用故障，违反无停机。

D：X-Ray抽样追踪不能完整证明哪些秘密长期没有访问。

options.text: Configure an AWS CloudTrail log file delivery to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the GetSecretValue Secrets Manager API operation requests.
Create a secretsmanager-secret-unused AWS Config managed rule. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to initiate notifications when the AWS Config managed rule is met.
Deactivate the applications secrets and monitor the applications error logs temporarily.
Configure AWS X-Ray for the applications. Create a sampling rule to match the GetSecretValue Secrets Manager API operation requests.

question_text_original: A developer maintains applications that store several secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. The applications use secrets that have changed over time. The developer needs to identify required secrets that are still in use. The developer does not want to cause any application downtime. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在编写一个无服务器应用，需要每 10 分钟调用一次 AWS Lambda 函数。哪种自动化、无服务器方式可以调用该函数？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。EventBridge schedule 可按固定间隔无服务器地触发 Lambda。

知识点／记忆点：定时触发器属于函数外部调度机制，函数配置不会自行唤醒执行；目标调用权限和失败重试也应配置。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：EC2 cron需要维护服务器，不满足无服务器要求。

B：PERIOD不是Lambda内置调度变量，设置它不会产生调用。

D：SNS订阅没有所述600秒周期计时器。

options.text: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance based on Linux, and edit its /etc/crontab file by adding a command to periodically invoke the Lambda function.
Configure an environment variable named PERIOD for the Lambda function. Set the value to 600.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs on a regular schedule to invoke the Lambda function.
Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that has a subscription to the Lambda function with a 600-second timer.

question_text_original: A developer is writing a serverless application that requires an AWS Lambda function to be invoked every 10 minutes. What is an automated and serverless way to invoke the function?

question_text: 一家公司使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 实现审计监控系统。开发人员需要创建与 AWS Lambda 函数关联的 AWS CloudFormation 自定义资源，用于配置 OpenSearch Service 域。函数必须使用 OpenSearch Service 内部主用户凭证访问该域。将凭证传给 Lambda 函数最安全的方式是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。CloudFormation 从 Secrets Manager 动态引用密码配置 OpenSearch，Lambda 在运行时凭 IAM role 读取 secret。

知识点／记忆点：模板和函数配置只保留秘密引用，把实际值在使用时解析；隐藏输出不等于秘密加密或完善的访问控制。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：NoEcho只隐藏部分CloudFormation输出，密码仍复制进函数配置。

B：未明确SecureString且CloudFormation原生参数资源并不因此加密，NoEcho不能弥补。

C：自行加密后还要设计解密权限及调用路径，直接把密文用于MasterUserOptions也不能作为正常密码。

options.text: Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain’s MasterUserOptions and the Lambda function’s environment variable. Set the NoEcho attribute to true.

Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain’s MasterUserOptions and to create a parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set the NoEcho attribute to true. Create an IAM role that has the ssm:GetParameter permission. Assign the role to the Lambda function. Store the parameter name as the Lambda function’s environment variable. Resolve the parameter’s value at runtime.

Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain’s MasterUserOptions and the Lambda function’s environment variable. Encrypt the parameter’s value by using the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypt command.

Use CloudFormation to create an AWS Secrets Manager secret. Use a CloudFormation dynamic reference to retrieve the secret’s value for the OpenSearch Service domain’s MasterUserOptions. Create an IAM role that has the secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permission. Assign the role to the Lambda function. Store the secret’s name as the Lambda function’s environment variable. Resolve the secret’s value at runtime.

question_text_original: A company is using Amazon OpenSearch Service to implement an audit monitoring system. A developer needs to create an AWS CloudFormation custom resource that is associated with an AWS Lambda function to configure the OpenSearch Service domain. The Lambda function must access the OpenSearch Service domain by using OpenSearch Service internal master user credentials. What is the MOST secure way to pass these credentials to the Lambda function?

question_text: 一个应用运行在 ELB 后方的多个 EC2 实例上。为了在多个请求间可靠地提供会话数据，最好将数据写入哪里？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。会话状态应放 ElastiCache 这类共享存储，而不是单台 EC2 本地内存。

适用前提与时效：单节点ElastiCache同样有故障风险，应按可用性与持久性需求配置，不能无条件保证零丢失。

知识点／记忆点：负载均衡会把连续请求分到不同实例，外置会话使计算节点可替换；共享缓存还需复制和高可用配置。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：普通EBS卷不是所有Web节点可直接共享的会话服务。

C：Instance Store随宿主机和实例生命周期变化，其他节点无法可靠读取。

D：根文件系统属于单实例，跨实例请求不能可靠获取同一状态。

options.text: Write data to Amazon ElastiCache.
Write data to Amazon Elastic Block Store.
Write data to Amazon EC2 Instance Store.
Write data to the root filesystem.

question_text_original: An application runs on multiple EC2 instances behind an ELB. Where is the session data best written so that it can be served reliably across multiple requests?

question_text: 一个电商应用运行在 Application Load Balancer 后方。开发人员观察到非高峰时段出现了意外负载，希望分析使用该应用的客户端 IP 地址模式。应使用哪个 HTTP 标头进行分析？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：C。ALB 的 X-Forwarded-For header 保存原始客户端 IP，可用于访问分析。

适用前提与时效：ALB默认追加X-Forwarded-For，头可能含多个地址；不能盲信最左侧值，应结合受信代理拓扑。

知识点／记忆点：反向代理改变后端看到的TCP来源，转发头承载原始请求信息；分析客户端地址时应按受信代理链处理，避免信任用户伪造值。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：X-Forwarded-Proto描述客户端使用HTTP还是HTTPS。

B：X-Forwarded-Host表示请求主机信息，不是客户端IP。

D：X-Forwarded-Port表示客户端连接端口，不是来源地址。

options.text: The X-Forwarded-Proto header
The X-Forwarded-Host header
The X-Forwarded-For header
The X-Forwarded-Port header

question_text_original: An ecommerce application is running behind an Application Load Balancer. A developer observes some unexpected load on the application during non-peak hours. The developer wants to analyze patterns for the client IP addresses that use the application. Which HTTP header should the developer use for this analysis?

question_text: 开发人员将旧应用迁移到 AWS Lambda 函数。函数每月末通过一系列 API 调用从第三方服务获取数据，再处理数据生成月报，此前一直正常运行。最近第三方服务限制了每分钟和每天的 API 调用次数，超过任一限额就返回错误，并在响应标头中提供分钟和每日限额。由于处理所需调用次数超过可用限额，这项限制可能使整个流程持续多天。如何以最高的运维效率重构无服务器应用，以适应此变化？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。Step Functions Standard workflow 可跨多天等待第三方 API 配额恢复，再调用 Lambda。

适用前提与时效：跨多天应使用Standard workflow；不仅重试错误，还应保存分页与处理进度并根据配额提前等待。

知识点／记忆点：跨天流程应把进度与等待外置到持久化编排，避免函数长时间睡眠；分钟和日配额应分别记录并按响应头计算恢复时间。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：队列可缓冲任务，但仅配置轮询不能自动同时满足分钟和日配额，需额外状态与限流逻辑。

C：日志指标存在延迟，告警也不能直接终止正在执行的某次Lambda调用。

D：Firehose用于数据交付，不是第三方API配额感知的请求调度器。

options.text: Use an AWS Step Functions state machine to monitor API failures. Use the Wait state to delay calling the Lambda function.
Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to hold the API calls. Configure the Lambda function to poll the queue within the API threshold limits.

Use an Amazon CloudWatch Logs metric to count the number of API calls. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that stops the currently running instance of the Lambda function when the metric exceeds the API threshold limits.
Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to batch the API calls and deliver them to an Amazon S3 bucket with an event notification to invoke the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A developer migrated a legacy application to an AWS Lambda function. The function uses a third-party service to pull data with a series of API calls at the end of each month. The function then processes the data to generate the monthly reports. The function has been working with no issues so far. The third-party service recently issued a restriction to allow a fixed number of API calls each minute and each day. If the API calls exceed the limit for each minute or each day, then the service will produce errors. The API also provides the minute limit and daily limit in the response header. This restriction might extend the overall process to multiple days because the process is consuming more API calls than the available limit. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to refactor the serverless application to accommodate this change?

question_text: 开发人员必须分析生产环境中以 AWS Lambda 函数编写的分布式应用的性能问题。这些 Lambda 应用还会调用其他应用组件。应如何识别并排查生产环境性能问题的根因？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。X-Ray traces 与 service map 可分析分布式 Lambda 调用中的延迟与错误。

知识点／记忆点：分布式延迟定位要沿请求链路比较各段耗时，区分函数自身处理与下游等待；追踪上下文必须跨组件传播。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：普通日志有帮助，但手工关联多组件请求比链路追踪困难。

B：CloudTrail审计AWS API操作，不提供完整业务调用链的耗时分解。

D：Inspector检查漏洞和暴露风险，不是分布式请求性能剖析工具。

options.text: Add logging statements to the Lambda functions, then use Amazon CloudWatch to view the logs.
Use AWS CloudTrail and then examine the logs.
Use AWS X-Ray, then examine the segments and errors.
Run Amazon Inspector agents and then analyze performance.

question_text_original: A developer must analyze performance issues with production-distributed applications written as AWS Lambda functions. These distributed Lambda applications invoke other components that make up the applications. How should the developer identify and troubleshoot the root cause of the performance issues in production?

question_text: 开发人员希望部署新版 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 应用。部署期间，应用必须保持完整容量，避免服务中断，并尽量降低支持部署的额外资源成本。应使用哪种部署方法？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。Elastic Beanstalk rolling with additional batch 在部署时维持原有服务容量。

知识点／记忆点：部署策略的取舍看三件事：旧容量是否减少、额外实例是一个批次还是整套环境、失败时如何回退。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：一次更新全部实例会中断服务，不能保持完整容量。

C：蓝绿保留两套环境，额外资源成本通常高于增加一个批次。

D：不可变部署新建整套实例，满足可用性但额外资源成本高于增加一个批次。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.rolling-version-deploy.html

options.text: All at once
Rolling with additional batch
Blue/green
Immutable

question_text_original: A developer wants to deploy a new version of an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application. During deployment, the application must maintain full capacity and avoid service interruption. Additionally, the developer must minimize the cost of additional resources that support the deployment. Which deployment method should the developer use to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员发现，团队在 Node.js 应用中部署的 AWS Lambda 函数缺陷增多。为减少缺陷，希望在高度模拟 Lambda 环境的环境中实施自动化测试，让其他开发人员可在本地运行，并将测试集成到团队 CI/CD 流水线中，在 AWS Cloud Development Kit（AWS CDK）部署之前执行。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。SAM local generate-event 与 sam local invoke 可在本地容器环境模拟 Lambda 调用并纳入 CI。

知识点／记忆点：单元测试直接验证函数逻辑，运行时仿真还要模拟事件格式、处理程序入口和运行环境；本地测试不能证明真实 IAM 与网络集成正确。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：cdk local invoke 不是题述的本地 Lambda 调用命令。

B：普通单元测试框架不能仅凭安装就重现 Lambda 执行环境。
