D：通用 Node.js 容器不自动模拟 Lambda 运行时协议，需要额外搭建。

options.text: Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Create automated test scripts that use the cdk local invoke command to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document the test scripts for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the test scripts.

Install a unit testing framework that reproduces the Lambda execution environment. Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Invoke the handler function by using a unit testing framework. Check the response. Document how to run the unit testing framework for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the unit testing framework.

Install the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI tool. Use the sam local generate-event command to generate sample events for the automated tests. Create automated test scripts that use the sam local invoke command to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document the test scripts for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the test scripts.

Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Create a Docker container from the Node.js base image to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document how to run the Docker container for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the Docker container.

question_text_original: A developer has observed an increase in bugs in the AWS Lambda functions that a development team has deployed in its Node.js application. To minimize these bugs, the developer wants to implement automated testing of Lambda functions in an environment that closely simulates the Lambda environment. The developer needs to give other developers the ability to run the tests locally. The developer also needs to integrate the tests into the team’s continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline before the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) deployment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在排查一个使用 us-west-2 区域 Amazon DynamoDB 的应用。应用部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上，需要对名为 Cars 的表具有只读权限。实例附加的 IAM 角色包含下图所示策略。应用尝试读取 Cars 表时出现 Access Denied 错误。应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。图示 DynamoDB IAM policy 已含读操作与表 ARN；若 EC2 role 无法被服务承担，需补 ec2.amazonaws.com trust principal。

适用前提与时效：C 只在 EC2 信任关系缺失时成立；图中的身份权限已允许读取，题目没有提供实际拒绝原因，仍可能存在显式拒绝或凭证来源问题。

知识点／记忆点：权限策略规定角色能做什么，信任策略规定谁能代入角色；修复 AccessDenied 应确认凭证来源，不能先扩大资源和操作范围。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：图中已指定 Cars 表，扩大到所有表不会修复角色无法代入的问题。

B：图中已包含常用读取操作，授予全部 DynamoDB 操作超出只读要求。

D：代入 EC2 实例角色的是 EC2 服务，不是被访问的 DynamoDB 服务。

options.text: Modify the IAM policy resource to be “arn:aws:dynamodb:us-west-2:account-id:table/*”.
Modify the IAM policy to include the dynamodb:* action.
Create a trust policy that specifies the EC2 service principal. Associate the role with the policy.
Create a trust relationship between the role and dynamodb.amazonaws.com.

audit_label: 有条件成立；原答案已修正
question_text_original: A developer is troubleshooting an application that uses Amazon DynamoDB in the us-west-2 Region. The application is deployed to an Amazon EC2 instance. The application requires read-only permissions to a table that is named Cars. The EC2 instance has an attached IAM role that contains the following IAM policy: When the application tries to read from the Cars table, an Access Denied error occurs. How can the developer resolve this error?

question_text: 使用 AWS Encryption SDK 时，开发人员如何跟踪用于加密数据的数据加密密钥？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：B。AWS Encryption SDK 把加密后的 data key 随 ciphertext 保存，无需开发者自行维护密钥映射。

知识点／记忆点：信封加密将大数据加密与数据密钥保护分离；密文数据密钥可随数据保存，明文数据密钥不应持久化。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：SDK 的加密消息格式已携带加密数据密钥，不要求应用另建手工映射。

C：SDK 不会自动把数据密钥另存到 S3。

D：EC2 UserData 不是数据密钥的安全存储位置，也不是 SDK 的密文格式。

options.text: The developer must manually keep track of the data encryption keys used for each data object.
The SDK encrypts the data encryption key and stores it (encrypted) as part of the returned ciphertext.
The SDK stores the data encryption keys automatically in Amazon S3.
The data encryption key is stored in the Userdata for the EC2 instance.

question_text_original: When using the AWS Encryption SDK, how does the developer keep track of the data encryption keys used to encrypt data?

question_text: 一个在 AWS Lambda 上运行的应用需要访问 Amazon S3 存储桶中的特定高度机密对象。公司遵循最小权限原则，只使用临时凭证授予访问权限。开发人员如何以最安全的方式配置对存储桶的访问？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。Lambda execution role 提供临时凭证，可按对象 ARN 授权 S3，不应创建长期 access key。

知识点／记忆点：临时凭证解决凭证生命周期，精确对象 ARN 解决权限范围；把长期密钥换一个存放位置，并不会使它变成临时凭证。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：硬编码凭证可能泄露，且不满足仅使用临时凭证的要求。

B：Secrets Manager 可安全存储访问密钥，但这里创建的长期密钥仍不满足要求。

D：环境变量中的访问密钥仍是长期凭证，还需自行管理轮换。

options.text: Hardcode the credentials that are required to access the S3 objects in the application code. Use the credentials to access the required S3 objects.

Create a secret access key and access key ID with permission to access the S3 bucket. Store the key and key ID in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to retrieve the Secrets Manager secret and use the credentials to access the S3 objects.
Create a Lambda function execution role. Attach a policy to the role that grants access to specific objects in the S3 bucket.

Create a secret access key and access key ID with permission to access the S3 bucket. Store the key and key ID as environment variables in Lambda. Use the environment variables to access the required S3 objects.

question_text_original: An application that runs on AWS Lambda requires access to specific highly confidential objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. In accordance with the principle of least privilege, a company grants access to the S3 bucket by using only temporary credentials. How can a developer configure access to the S3 bucket in the MOST secure way?

question_text: 开发人员将代码存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，需要在与该桶相同区域的多个 AWS 账户内，将代码部署为 AWS Lambda 函数。每个账户都会运行 AWS CloudFormation 模板进行部署。允许 CloudFormation 访问桶内 Lambda 代码的最安全方式是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。跨账户 CloudFormation 读取源码 S3 bucket 时需要 service role 权限与 bucket policy 同时允许。

适用前提与时效：A 是给定选项中最接近要求的方案，实际部署应将桶策略进一步限定到具体部署角色和代码对象前缀。

知识点／记忆点：部署阶段读取代码的身份与函数运行身份不同；跨账户访问还需要资源所有者授权，单方 IAM Allow 不够。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：桶策略的通配 Principal 向所有主体开放，违反最安全访问要求。

C：所谓服务链接没有完成 CloudFormation 部署身份与跨账户桶的双向授权。

D：给函数授予通配资源权限不能替代部署时读取代码的跨账户授权。

options.text: Grant the CloudFormation service role the S3 ListBucket and GetObject permissions. Add a bucket policy to Amazon S3 with the principal of “AWS”: [account numbers].
Grant the CloudFormation service role the S3 GetObject permission. Add a bucket policy to Amazon S3 with the principal of “*”.
Use a service-based link to grant the Lambda function the S3 ListBucket and GetObject permissions by explicitly adding the S3 bucket’s account number in the resource.
Use a service-based link to grant the Lambda function the S3 GetObject permission. Add a resource of “*” to allow access to the S3 bucket.

question_text_original: A developer has code that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The code must be deployed as an AWS Lambda function across multiple accounts in the same AWS Region as the S3 bucket. An AWS CloudFormation template that runs for each account will deploy the Lambda function. What is the MOST secure way to allow CloudFormation to access the Lambda code in the S3 bucket?

question_text: 公司的开发人员需要创建一个小型应用，每天在指定时间执行一次相同的 API 调用。公司尚未在 AWS 云中部署基础设施，但希望使用 AWS 实现此功能。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。EventBridge schedule 触发 Lambda 能实现每日定时 API 调用而无需服务器。

知识点／记忆点：稀疏定时任务应分离调度与执行：托管调度器负责时间，按次运行的计算负责工作，无需维护空闲服务器。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：为每天一次调用维护 Kubernetes 集群增加明显管理负担。

B：EC2 定时任务需要维护主机、补丁和可用性。

D：仅向 Batch 队列提交作业未提供每日定时触发，而且该任务不需要批处理调度体系。

options.text: Use a Kubernetes cron job that runs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS).
Use an Amazon Linux crontab scheduled job that runs on Amazon EC2.
Use an AWS Lambda function that is invoked by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.
Use an AWS Batch job that is submitted to an AWS Batch job queue.

question_text_original: A developer at a company needs to create a small application that makes the same API call once each day at a designated time. The company does not have infrastructure in the AWS Cloud yet, but the company wants to implement this functionality on AWS. Which solution meets these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient manner?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建基于 AWS Lambda 的无服务器应用，并在 Lambda 处理程序函数之外初始化 AWS SDK。这样做的主要好处是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。把 SDK client 初始化放在 Lambda handler 外，可复用 execution environment 中的连接。

知识点／记忆点：一次执行环境可以承载多次调用；连接和 SDK 客户端适合复用，用户专属敏感状态不应依赖全局变量跨调用保留。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：可读性可能改善，但不是减少重复初始化的主要收益。

C：初始化位置不自动增加异常处理能力。

D：放在处理程序外正是为了复用，而不是每次创建新实例。

options.text: Improves legibility and stylistic convention
Takes advantage of runtime environment reuse
Provides better error handling
Creates a new SDK instance for each invocation

question_text_original: A developer is building a serverless application that is based on AWS Lambda. The developer initializes the AWS software development kit (SDK) outside of the Lambda handler function. What is the PRIMARY benefit of this action?

question_text: 一家公司使用 Amazon RDS 作为应用后端数据库。最近的营销活动使读取请求激增，增加了数据获取延迟。公司决定在数据库前增加缓存层，要求缓存内容加密且具有高可用性。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Redis cluster mode 可扩展热读缓存并降低 RDS 读负载。

适用前提与时效：C 还需配置副本、多可用区自动故障转移及加密；cluster mode 本身不等于高可用。

知识点／记忆点：缓存高可用依赖副本和故障转移，数据保护依赖静态与传输加密；只选择缓存产品或开启分片，不代表这些配置已全部完成。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudFront 主要缓存 HTTP 内容，不是通用 RDS 查询结果缓存。

B：题目所指传统 Memcached 方案不具备 Redis 副本式高可用能力，不能只靠分片满足要求。

D：DAX 专用于 DynamoDB，不能作为 RDS 的透明读取缓存。

options.text: Amazon CloudFront
Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached
Amazon ElastiCache for Redis in cluster mode
Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)

question_text_original: A company is using Amazon RDS as the backend database for its application. After a recent marketing campaign, a surge of read requests to the database increased the latency of data retrieval from the database. The company has decided to implement a caching layer in front of the database. The cached content must be encrypted and must be highly available. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 公司的开发人员最近创建了一个无服务器应用，用于处理和展示业务报告数据。用户通过界面选择文件并启动处理，结果可查看时界面显示提示。应用使用 AWS Step Functions 和 AWS Lambda 处理文件，并通过 Amazon API Gateway 与 Lambda 创建支持界面的 API。界面团队反映，由于文件大小或复杂度，处理文件的请求经常超时。团队希望 API 立即响应，以便处理期间显示提示，同时要求 API 触发的后端流程在报告处理完成后发送电子邮件。开发人员应如何配置 API？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。API Gateway 对 Lambda integration 设置 X-Amz-Invocation-Type: Event 可异步调用，先返回请求已接收。

适用前提与时效：A 解决请求立即返回，完成后的邮件仍需由既有工作流显式发送；需使用支持配置该集成请求标头的集成方式。

知识点／记忆点：异步接口的即时响应表示任务已受理，不表示任务已完成；最终结果应通过通知或查询状态交付。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：事件最大存留时间影响异步事件处理策略，不会把同步 API 调用改为异步。

C：延长等待时间仍让前端阻塞，且不能保证适配任意长的文件处理。

D：X-Amz-Target: Async 不是 Lambda Invoke 的异步调用控制标头。

options.text: Change the API Gateway route to add an X-Amz-Invocation-Type header with a static value of ‘Event’ in the integration request. Deploy the API Gateway stage to apply the changes.
Change the configuration of the Lambda function that implements the request to process a file. Configure the maximum age of the event so that the Lambda function will run asynchronously.
Change the API Gateway timeout value to match the Lambda function timeout value. Deploy the API Gateway stage to apply the changes.
Change the API Gateway route to add an X-Amz-Target header with a static value of ‘Async’ in the integration request. Deploy the API Gateway stage to apply the changes.

question_text_original: A developer at a company recently created a serverless application to process and show data from business reports. The application’s user interface (UI) allows users to select and start processing the files. The UI displays a message when the result is available to view. The application uses AWS Step Functions with AWS Lambda functions to process the files. The developer used Amazon API Gateway and Lambda functions to create an API to support the UI. The company’s UI team reports that the request to process a file is often returning timeout errors because of the size or complexity of the files. The UI team wants the API to provide an immediate response so that the UI can display a message while the files are being processed. The backend process that is invoked by the API needs to send an email message when the report processing is complete. What should the developer do to configure the API to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员的应用由许多 AWS Lambda 函数组成，这些函数共用部分依赖。为了避免安全问题，开发人员需要持续更新所有函数的依赖，导致重复劳动。如何以最少的额外复杂度保持依赖最新？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Lambda layer 可集中共享依赖并独立版本化。

知识点／记忆点：共享依赖要集中构建并显式版本化；Lambda layer 版本不可变，发布新层不会自动更新函数所引用的旧版本。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：设维护窗口不会自动分发或更新依赖。

B：升级运行时不等于升级应用自带的第三方库。

D：集中保存源码不等于把依赖交付到各函数执行环境。

options.text: Define a maintenance window for the Lambda functions to ensure that the functions get updated copies of the dependencies.
Upgrade the Lambda functions to the most recent runtime version.
Define a Lambda layer that contains all of the shared dependencies.
Use an AWS CodeCommit repository to host the dependencies in a centralized location.

question_text_original: A developer has an application that is composed of many different AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda functions all use some of the same dependencies. To avoid security issues, the developer is constantly updating the dependencies of all of the Lambda functions. The result is duplicated effort for each function. How can the developer keep the dependencies of the Lambda functions up to date with the LEAST additional complexity?

question_text: 一个移动应用将博客文章存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中，每天新增数百万篇，每篇对应一个项目。应用只需要近期文章，超过 48 小时的文章可以删除。最具成本效益的删除方式是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：D。DynamoDB TTL 属性必须是 Number 类型的 Unix epoch 秒，服务会异步清理过期帖子。

知识点／记忆点：TTL 是异步后台过期清理，不是精确计时删除；过期时间保存为 Unix 秒数，读取端如要求严格不展示过期数据还需过滤。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：定时全表扫描及删除消耗读取、写入和实例资源。

B：换成 Fargate 仍有扫描、删除和调度成本，不如原生 TTL。

C：DynamoDB 没有 Date 属性类型，而且自建清理仍增加代码与容量消耗。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html

options.text: For each item, add a new attribute of type String that has a timestamp that is set to the blog post creation time. Create a script to find old posts with a table scan and remove posts that are older than 48 hours by using the BatchWriteItem API operation. Schedule a cron job on an Amazon EC2 instance once an hour to start the script.

For each item, add a new attribute of type String that has a timestamp that is set to the blog post creation time. Create a script to find old posts with a table scan and remove posts that are older than 48 hours by using the BatchWriteItem API operation. Place the script in a container image. Schedule an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task on AWS Fargate that invokes the container every 5 minutes.

For each item, add a new attribute of type Date that has a timestamp that is set to 48 hours after the blog post creation time. Create a global secondary index (GSI) that uses the new attribute as a sort key. Create an AWS Lambda function that references the GSI and removes expired items by using the BatchWriteItem API operation. Schedule the function with an Amazon CloudWatch event every minute.

For each item, add a new attribute of type Number that has a timestamp that is set to 48 hours after the blog post creation time. Configure the DynamoDB table with a TTL that references the new attribute.

question_text_original: A mobile app stores blog posts in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Millions of posts are added every day, and each post represents a single item in the table. The mobile app requires only recent posts. Any post that is older than 48 hours can be removed. What is the MOST cost-effective way to delete posts that are older than 48 hours?

question_text: 开发人员修改现有 AWS Lambda 函数时，发现代码硬编码了 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 的用户名、密码、数据库、主机和端口，以及 Amazon DynamoDB 表、Amazon S3 存储桶和 Amazon SNS 主题等参数。开发人员希望将参数以加密形式安全存储在代码之外，启用凭证轮换，让其他应用复用参数，并且无需修改代码就能更新参数。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。数据库连接配置和密码应从硬编码转为 Secrets Manager secret。

知识点／记忆点：跨应用配置集中管理，凭证轮换由专门服务承担；加密存储不等于自动轮换，函数环境变量也不是共享配置中心。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：环境变量绑定单个函数，其他应用复用及统一更新较不方便。

C：自建凭证轮换函数与计划任务增加维护工作。

D：S3 配置文件加自建轮换流程需要更多读取、更新和轮换逻辑。

options.text: Create an RDS database secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Set the user name, password, database, host, and port. Turn on secret rotation. Create encrypted Lambda environment variables for the DynamoDB table, S3 bucket, and SNS topic.

Create an RDS database secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Set the user name, password, database, host, and port. Turn on secret rotation. Create SecureString parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for the DynamoDB table, S3 bucket, and SNS topic.

Create RDS database parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for the user name, password, database, host, and port. Create encrypted Lambda environment variables for the DynamoDB table, S3 bucket, and SNS topic. Create a Lambda function and set the logic for the credentials rotation task. Schedule the credentials rotation task in Amazon EventBridge.

Create RDS database parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for the user name, password, database, host, and port. Store the DynamoDB table, S3 bucket, and SNS topic in Amazon S3. Create a Lambda function and set the logic for the credentials rotation. Invoke the Lambda function on a schedule.

question_text_original: A developer is modifying an existing AWS Lambda function. While checking the code, the developer notices hardcoded parameter values for an Amazon RDS for SQL Server user name, password, database, host, and port. There are also hardcoded parameter values for an Amazon DynamoDB table, an Amazon S3 bucket, and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The developer wants to securely store the parameter values outside the code in an encrypted format and wants to turn on rotation for the credentials. The developer also wants to be able to reuse the parameter values from other applications and to update the parameter values without modifying code. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 开发人员通过 SSH 访问 AWS CodeCommit。用于访问的 SSH 密钥关联到一个具有下图所示权限的用户。开发人员需要创建和删除分支。按照最小权限原则，应增加哪些具体 IAM 权限？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。CodeCommit branch 的最小权限是 codecommit:CreateBranch 与 codecommit:DeleteBranch。

适用前提与时效：A 仅适用于分支 API/CLI 操作；如果按题干 SSH 的含义使用 git push 创建或删除远端分支，则需要 GitPush，选项中没有精确的最小权限答案。

知识点／记忆点：CodeCommit 的 Git 协议权限与分支 API 权限分开：GitPush 控制推送，CreateBranch/DeleteBranch 控制对应 API，不要按操作名称混用。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Put* 不包含 CreateBranch 或 DeleteBranch，也不等价于 GitPush。

C：Update* 不包含创建及删除分支的 API 权限。

D：授予所有 CodeCommit 操作远超最小权限。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/auth-and-access-control-permissions-reference.html

options.text: "codecommit:CreateBranch" "codecommit:DeleteBranch"
"codecommit:Put*"
"codecommit:Update*"
"codecommit:*"

question_text_original: A developer accesses AWS CodeCommit over SSH. The SSH keys configured to access AWS CodeCommit are tied to a user with the following permissions: The developer needs to create/delete branches. Which specific IAM permissions need to be added, based on the principle of least privilege?

question_text: 一个部署在 Amazon EC2 上的应用通过 DynamoDB REST API 使用 Amazon DynamoDB。向表写入时，应用周期性收到 ProvisionedThroughputExceededException 错误。哪些方案能够以最具成本效益的方式缓解此错误？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AB。DynamoDB throttling 应指数退避；SDK 内置重试机制可降低手写代码。

知识点／记忆点：短时限流先做指数退避与抖动，持续容量不足再调整容量或分区设计；读取缓存不能凭空增加写入吞吐量。

其他选项为什么不选：

C：增加容量可能有效，但同时增加读写吞吐量带来额外成本，不是偶发写限流下最经济的首选。

D：DAX 主要加速读取，写入仍需落到 DynamoDB，不能替代写入容量。

E：拆成两个表要求自行分片和查询汇总，增加复杂度且没有消除根本容量问题。

options.text: Modify the application code to perform exponential backoff when the error is received.
Modify the application to use the AWS SDKs for DynamoDB.
Increase the read and write throughput of the DynamoDB table.
Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster for the DynamoDB table.
Create a second DynamoDB table. Distribute the reads and writes between the two tables.

question_text_original: An application that is deployed to Amazon EC2 is using Amazon DynamoDB. The application calls the DynamoDB REST API. Periodically, the application receives a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error when the application writes to a DynamoDB table. Which solutions will mitigate this error MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员尝试运行 AWS CodeBuild 项目时发生错误，原因是所有环境变量的总字符数超过上限。推荐的解决方案是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。CodeBuild 大量配置值可存 Parameter Store，再以引用方式注入构建环境。

知识点／记忆点：构建配置可用引用代替直接嵌入长文本；外置参数减少项目定义中的值长度，但不会取消运行环境自身的大小限制。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：设置 locale 不会增加环境变量配置容量。

B：Cognito 是身份服务，不是构建参数仓库。

C：CodeBuild 不会仅通过一个 S3 桶设置就原生自动注入大量环境变量，需要自行实现获取逻辑。

options.text: Add the export LC_ALL="en_US.utf8" command to the pre_build section to ensure POSIX localization.
Use Amazon Cognito to store key-value pairs for large numbers of environment variables.
Update the settings for the build project to use an Amazon S3 bucket for large numbers of environment variables.
Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store large numbers of environment variables.

question_text_original: When a developer tries to run an AWS CodeBuild project, it raises an error because the length of all environment variables exceeds the limit for the combined maximum of characters. What is the recommended solution?

question_text: 一家公司正在扩展照片分享移动应用的兼容性，以支持数百种屏幕尺寸和分辨率各异的新设备。照片以原始格式和分辨率存储在 Amazon S3 中，并由 Amazon CloudFront 分配提供。应用每次请求都会将显示尺寸和分辨率作为 GET 参数发送。开发人员需要针对每种设备优化照片，降低加载时间并提高画质。哪种方案最具成本效益？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：D。按设备需求动态生成图片并存 S3 供后续复用；Lambda@Edge 直接返回图片仍受响应大小限制。

适用前提与时效：D 需要满足 Lambda@Edge 响应体大小限制，并正确设计变体对象键和缓存键；它不是无条件适用于任意图片大小的完整实现。

知识点／记忆点：图片衍生版本应以源对象加尺寸参数唯一标识，按需生成后复用；缓存键若遗漏尺寸，会把同一尺寸图片错误地返回给其他设备。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：预先生成所有设备变体增加存储和计算，且 CloudFront 没有题述自动映射全部设备变体的动态源功能。

B：预生成数百种规格工作量大，且请求条件在查询参数中而非选项指定的请求标头中。

C：缓存最大 TTL 不能保证缓存永不驱逐，也没有持久保存变体，且可能导致内容更新长期不可见。

options.text: Use S3 Batch Operations to invoke an AWS Lambda function to create new variants of the photos with the required dimensions and resolutions. Create a dynamic CloudFront origin that automatically maps the request of each device to the corresponding photo variant.

Use S3 Batch Operations to invoke an AWS Lambda function to create new variants of the photos with the required dimensions and resolutions. Create a Lambda@Edge function to route requests to the corresponding photo variant by using request headers.
Create a Lambda@Edge function that optimizes the photos upon request and returns the photos as a response. Change the CloudFront TTL cache policy to the maximum value possible.

Create a Lambda@Edge function that optimizes the photos upon request and returns the photos as a response. In the same function, store a copy of the processed photos on Amazon S3 for subsequent requests.

question_text_original: A company is expanding the compatibility of its photo-sharing mobile app to hundreds of additional devices with unique screen dimensions and resolutions. Photos are stored in Amazon S3 in their original format and resolution. The company uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve the photos. The app includes the dimension and resolution of the display as GET parameters with every request. A developer needs to implement a solution that optimizes the photos that are served to each device to reduce load time and increase photo quality. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 一家公司正在构建股票交易应用，处理交易请求需要亚毫秒级延迟。处理每个请求所需的交易数据都存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。负载测试发现，数据获取时间比预期更长。开发团队需要以尽可能少的工作缩短获取时间。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。DAX 在 DynamoDB 前提供低延迟读取缓存；写入一致性要求需另行评估。

知识点／记忆点：微秒级热点读取适合缓存，但速度不等于最新性；要求强一致的数据必须评估缓存绕过与失效策略。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：LSI 优化访问模式，但不保证把所有读取降到微秒级，且不能直接为已有表补建。

B：S3 Transfer Acceleration 优化远距离对象传输，不是交易数据的微秒级查询方案。

C：退避重试处理限流，通常会增加等待而非降低正常读取延迟。

options.text: Add local secondary indexes (LSIs) for the trading data.
Store the trading data in Amazon S3, and use S3 Transfer Acceleration.
Add retries with exponential backoff for DynamoDB queries.
Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache the trading data.

question_text_original: A company is building an application for stock trading. The application needs sub-millisecond latency for processing trade requests. The company uses Amazon DynamoDB to store all the trading data that is used to process each trading request. A development team performs load testing on the application and finds that the data retrieval time is higher than expected. The development team needs a solution that reduces the data retrieval time with the least possible effort. Which solution meets these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在维护一个运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Python 应用，希望启用应用请求跟踪，以调试代码中的性能问题。应采取哪些措施？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：CE；修正答案：BE。旧式 X-Ray tracing 需 Python SDK 与实例上的 daemon；两者已进入维护模式，新部署宜用 OpenTelemetry。

适用前提与时效：按题目传统 SDK/daemon 组合选 BE；两者已进入维护模式，新方案应评估 OpenTelemetry。

知识点／记忆点：链路跟踪需要应用产生跟踪片段并由采集器传送；普通文本日志即使改成 JSON，也不会自动成为可关联的分布式追踪。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：只安装 CloudWatch agent 不等于完成跟踪配置；现代代理可以配置采集 trace，但本选项未说明，不能将它概括为永远不支持跟踪。

C：写 JSON 日志不会自动完成 X-Ray 插桩、上下文传播及片段上传。

D：写入本地路径不会自动被 X-Ray 当作 trace 上报。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-daemon-timeline.html

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-daemon.html

options.text: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances.
Install the AWS X-Ray daemon on the EC2 instances.
Configure the application to write JSON-formatted logs to /var/log/cloudwatch.
Configure the application to write trace data to /var/log/xray.
Install and configure the AWS X-Ray SDK for Python in the application.

audit_label: 有条件成立；原答案已修正
question_text_original: A developer is working on a Python application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The developer wants to enable tracing of application requests to debug performance issues in the code. Which combination of actions should the developer take to achieve this goal? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司的应用由多个 AWS Lambda 函数组成。每个函数从 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题接收数据，再将数据写入 Amazon Aurora 数据库实例。为遵守信息安全政策，公司必须确保所有函数使用同一个安全加密的数据库连接字符串访问 Aurora。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。多函数共享的数据库连接字符串可放 Parameter Store SecureString，集中管理并加密。

知识点／记忆点：共享配置需要单一权威来源；相同加密密钥只能统一加密机制，不能让多份配置值自动保持一致。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：IAM 数据库认证改变认证方式，没有提供题目要求的共享加密连接字符串。

B：为获取数据库凭证再访问一个数据库，需要先解决另一个数据库的引导凭证问题。

D：多个函数各存一份环境变量，即使共用 KMS 密钥，更新时仍可能不一致。

options.text: Use IAM database authentication for Aurora to enable secure database connections for all the Lambda functions.
Store the credentials and read the credentials from an encrypted Amazon RDS DB instance.
Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a secure string parameter.
Use Lambda environment variables with a shared AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for encryption.

question_text_original: A company has an application that runs as a series of AWS Lambda functions. Each Lambda function receives data from an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and writes the data to an Amazon Aurora DB instance. To comply with an information security policy, the company must ensure that the Lambda functions all use a single securely encrypted database connection string to access Aurora. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在排查一个 Amazon API Gateway API。客户端访问其中一个端点时收到 HTTP 400 响应错误。开发人员如何确定错误原因？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：D。API Gateway execution/access logs 能定位客户端 400 错误及请求上下文。

知识点／记忆点：区分访问日志、执行日志与审计日志：请求上下文及网关处理失败原因应在 API 阶段日志中查找，管理操作审计不能替代它们。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudWatch Logs 不是题述 Firehose 原生投递目的地，此链路并非启用网关执行日志的方法。

B：CloudTrail Insights 分析管理 API 异常活动，不用 trail ARN 配置 API Gateway 客户端执行日志。

C：X-Ray 可辅助追踪，但仅启用追踪并指定日志组不能替代执行与访问日志配置。

options.text: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to receive API call logs from API Gateway. Configure Amazon CloudWatch Logs as the delivery stream’s destination.
Turn on AWS CloudTrail Insights and create a trail. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the trail for the stage of the API.
Turn on AWS X-Ray for the API stage. Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the log group for the API stage.

Turn on execution logging and access logging in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the API stage. Create a CloudWatch Logs log group. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the log group for the API stage.

question_text_original: A developer is troubleshooting an Amazon API Gateway API. Clients are receiving HTTP 400 response errors when the clients try to access an endpoint of the API. How can the developer determine the cause of these errors?

question_text: 一家公司使用 Amazon CloudFront、Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 在 AWS 上开发了 API 应用。API 每秒至少接收四个请求。开发人员发现许多用户使用 POST 方法执行相同查询，希望缓存 POST 请求以优化 API 资源使用。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：B。API Gateway REST API 可覆盖 POST method 的 stage cache 设置，但必须确认 cache key 包含区分查询的输入。

适用前提与时效：B 针对 REST API 阶段缓存，必须显式配置能区分输入的缓存键；仅启用 POST 缓存并不保证结果正确。

知识点／记忆点：缓存必须区分语义不同的查询；POST 请求体变化若未反映到缓存键，可能把其他查询结果错误复用。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudFront 不缓存 POST 响应，修改默认请求标头不能开启这种缓存。

C：/tmp 仅属于单个执行环境，多个并发实例无法共享这份缓存。

D：Parameter Store 不是高频响应缓存，保存“最新请求”也不能区分多个查询。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorCustomOrigin.html

options.text: Configure the CloudFront cache. Update the application to return cached content based upon the default request headers.
Override the cache method in the selected stage of API Gateway. Select the POST method.
Save the latest request response in Lambda /tmp directory. Update the Lambda function to check the /tmp directory.
Save the latest request in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Modify the Lambda function to take the latest request response from Parameter Store.

question_text_original: A company developed an API application on AWS by using Amazon CloudFront, Amazon API Gateway, and AWS Lambda. The API has a minimum of four requests every second. A developer notices that many API users run the same query by using the POST method. The developer wants to cache the POST request to optimize the API resources. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司正在构建由多个 AWS Lambda 函数组成的微服务应用。开发团队希望通过 AWS Serverless Application Model（AWS SAM）模板自动测试函数，并在完整部署前，先将少量流量导向新更新进行测试。哪组步骤的运维效率最高？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：BD；修正答案：CD。SAM DeploymentPreference 启用渐进发布，Canary10Percent30Minutes 配合 hooks 验证后再全量切换。

知识点／记忆点：金丝雀是先给少量流量、观察后一次切全量；线性部署则持续分批增加，两者的风险暴露节奏不同。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CodeDeploy 的验证钩子不是执行 SAM 本地 CLI 命令的运行环境。

B：EventInvokeConfig 配置异步调用去向与重试，不决定发布流量切换。

E：线性策略会每十分钟增加流量，不符合先小流量验证再切全量的金丝雀模式。

options.text: Use AWS SAM CLI commands in AWS CodeDeploy to invoke the Lambda functions to test the deployment.
Declare the EventInvokeConfig on the Lambda functions in the AWS SAM templates with OnSuccess and OnFailure configurations.
Enable gradual deployments through AWS SAM templates.
Set the deployment preference type to Canary10Percent30Minutes. Use hooks to test the deployment.
Set the deployment preference type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Use hooks to test the deployment.

question_text_original: A company is building a microservices application that consists of many AWS Lambda functions. The development team wants to use AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) templates to automatically test the Lambda functions. The development team plans to test a small percentage of traffic that is directed to new updates before the team commits to a full deployment of the application. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署双层应用，并以 Amazon RDS 为后端数据库。公司希望部署期间随机生成数据库密码，之后自动轮换密码，且无需修改应用。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。CloudFormation 可创建 Secrets Manager secret，自动生成并定期轮换 RDS 密码。

适用前提与时效：应用必须已经支持动态取用 secret；如果它硬编码旧密码，创建轮换资源不能让应用无需任何改造就自动适配。

知识点／记忆点：生成密码、修改数据库密码和让应用读取新密码必须形成完整闭环；密钥存储加密并不等于凭证轮换。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：自定义资源可实现，但要自己维护生成和轮换逻辑。

B：Parameter Store SecureString 不提供自动生成及轮换数据库密码的内置能力。

C：主机 cron 需要维护执行环境及轮换失败处理，运维开销更大。

options.text: Use an AWS Lambda function as a CloudFormation custom resource to generate and rotate the password.
Use an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store resource with the SecureString data type to generate and rotate the password.
Use a cron daemon on the application’s host to generate and rotate the password.
Use an AWS Secrets Manager resource to generate and rotate the password.

question_text_original: A company is using AWS CloudFormation to deploy a two-tier application. The application will use Amazon RDS as its backend database. The company wants a solution that will randomly generate the database password during deployment. The solution also must automatically rotate the database password without requiring changes to the application. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员需要创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每当 Amazon DynamoDB 表中的项目更新时调用该函数。函数已经创建，执行角色也已添加适当权限，表的 DynamoDB Streams 已启用，但函数仍未被调用。哪个选项能够让表更新触发该函数？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。DynamoDB Streams 到 Lambda 需要 event source mapping。

知识点／记忆点：启用流只创建变更数据源，事件源映射才建立轮询消费者；StreamViewType 决定事件内容，不负责连接消费者。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES 改变流记录包含的镜像，不会自动绑定函数。

C：SNS 主题不能替代 Lambda 的 DynamoDB Streams 事件源映射。

D：尚未触发函数时，增加超时不会建立触发链路。

options.text: Change the StreamViewType parameter value to NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES for the DynamoDB table.
Configure event source mapping for the Lambda function.
Map an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to the DynamoDB streams.
Increase the maximum runtime (timeout) setting of the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A developer has been asked to create an AWS Lambda function that is invoked any time updates are made to items in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The function has been created, and appropriate permissions have been added to the Lambda execution role. Amazon DynamoDB streams have been enabled for the table, but the function is still not being invoked. Which option would enable DynamoDB table updates to invoke the Lambda function?

question_text: 开发人员需要使用 Amazon ECS 部署一个在 AWS Fargate 上运行的应用。应用初始化时需要向容器传递环境变量。应如何传递？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：B。ECS Fargate container 的 environment 数组应写在 task definition 的 container definition 中。

知识点／记忆点：任务定义描述如何启动容器，服务描述如何维持任务运行；环境变量属于容器运行配置，entryPoint 则是启动命令入口。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：服务定义不承载题述容器 environment 数组。

C：entryPoint 传入入口程序及参数，不是环境变量键值数组。

D：同时混淆服务定义与入口命令，不能注入所需环境变量。

options.text: Define an array that includes the environment variables under the environment parameter within the service definition.
Define an array that includes the environment variables under the environment parameter within the task definition.
Define an array that includes the environment variables under the entryPoint parameter within the task definition.
Define an array that includes the environment variables under the entryPoint parameter within the service definition.

question_text_original: A developer needs to deploy an application running on AWS Fargate using Amazon ECS. The application has environment variables that must be passed to a container for the application to initialize. How should the environment variables be passed to the container?

question_text: 开发团队使用一个模板维护 Web 应用，原文将其称为 AWS RDS 模板。模板定义了 Web 服务器和 Amazon RDS 数据库，并通过 CloudFormation 向不同环境部署堆栈。最近一次部署中，开发人员误将主要开发数据库删除并重新创建，造成数据丢失。团队需要避免今后意外删除数据库。哪些方案能够满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AB。DeletionPolicy Retain 防误删数据库，stack policy 保护其免受更新替换。

适用前提与时效：Retain 不能单独覆盖所有更新替换场景；部署前还应审查更改集及替换策略。

知识点／记忆点：删除保护与更新保护不同：DeletionPolicy 控制移除资源时的行为，Stack Policy 可限制更新；替换旧资源还需理解 UpdateReplacePolicy。

其他选项为什么不选：

C：Multi-AZ 提高可用性，不防止 IaC 更新主动删除或替换数据库。

D：StackSets 负责跨账户或区域部署，不提供数据库防误删语义。

E：DeletionPolicy 应定义在具体资源上，不是对整个堆栈设置该资源属性。

options.text: Add a CloudFormation DeletionPolicy attribute with the Retain value to the database resource.
Update the CloudFormation stack policy to prevent updates to the database.
Modify the database to use a Multi-AZ deployment.
Create a CloudFormation stack set for the web application and database deployments.
Add a CloudFormation DeletionPolicy attribute with the Retain value to the stack.

question_text_original: A development team maintains a web application by using a single AWS RDS, template. The template defines web servers and an Amazon RDS database. The team uses the CloudFormation template to deploy the CloudFormation stack to different environments. During a recent application deployment, a developer caused the primary development database to be dropped and recreated. The result of this incident was a loss of data. The team needs to avoid accidental database deletion in the future. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员将应用生成的敏感数据存储在 Amazon S3 中，希望对静态数据加密。公司政策要求记录 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）密钥何时被谁使用的审计轨迹。哪种加密选项能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。SSE-KMS 用 AWS KMS key 对 S3 对象做服务端静态加密。

适用前提与时效：使用 S3 Bucket Key 等机制时，KMS 请求可能被复用，不能将 KMS 调用次数直接当作对象访问次数。

知识点／记忆点：需要审计密钥使用时，关注 KMS API 的 CloudTrail 记录；对象加密只解决数据保护，无法自动提供任意粒度的逐对象密钥调用记录。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：SSE-S3 使用 S3 管理的密钥，没有所要求的 KMS 密钥使用轨迹。

C：SSE-C 由调用方提供密钥，不会因对象加密而产生 KMS 使用审计。

D：自行管理密钥不是题述 KMS 审计的内置服务器端加密选项。

options.text: Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)
Server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (SSE-KMS)
Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)
Server-side encryption with self-managed keys

question_text_original: A developer is storing sensitive data generated by an application in Amazon S3. The developer wants to encrypt the data at rest. A company policy requires an audit trail of when the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key was used and by whom. Which encryption option will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的电商应用使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表跟踪产品评价。每条记录包含：16 位通用唯一标识符（UUID）形式的 Review ID；引用其他表的 16 位 UUID Product ID 和 User ID；1 到 5 分的 Product Rating；以及可选的用户评论。表的分区键为 Review ID。最常见的查询是查找指定产品评分最高的 10 条评价。哪种索引能最快响应此查询？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。按 Product ID 查评分前十，应建 Product ID partition key 与 Rating sort key 的 GSI。

知识点／记忆点：Top-N 查询需要先按分区键圈定集合，再按排序键逆序并限制条数；LSI 不能更换主表分区键，GSI 可以。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：按 Review ID 排序不能直接得到评分最高的十条评价。

C：LSI 必须沿用 Review ID 分区键，不能改为 Product ID。

D：沿用 Review ID 会按单条评价分组，不能高效取得某产品的评分排行榜。

options.text: A global secondary index (GSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Product Rating as the sort key
A global secondary index (GSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Review ID as the sort key
A local secondary index (LSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Product Rating as the sort key
A local secondary index (LSI) with Review ID as the partition key and Product ID as the sort key

question_text_original: A company has an ecommerce application. To track product reviews, the company’s development team uses an Amazon DynamoDB table. Every record includes the following: • A Review ID, a 16-digit universally unique identifier (UUID) • A Product ID and User ID, 16-digit UUIDs that reference other tables • A Product Rating on a scale of 1-5 • An optional comment from the user The table partition key is the Review ID. The most performed query against the table is to find the 10 reviews with the highest rating for a given product. Which index will provide the FASTEST response for this query?

question_text: 一家公司需要向全球客户分发固件更新。哪项服务能以最低成本，方便且安全地控制下载访问？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudFront signed URL 可控制全球固件下载权限与有效期。

知识点／记忆点：签名 URL 是带有效期的持有者访问授权；限制下载还要阻止绕过 CDN 直接访问公开源站。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：每个客户创建分配导致大量管理工作，并未自行解决授权。

C：Lambda@Edge 可自定义鉴权，但本题已有签名 URL 能力，无需增加边缘代码。

D：API Gateway 加 Lambda 的下载控制增加调用与执行成本，也不能替代全球边缘内容缓存。

options.text: Use Amazon CloudFront with signed URLs for Amazon S3.
Create a dedicated Amazon CloudFront Distribution for each customer.
Use Amazon CloudFront with AWS Lambda@Edge.
Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to control access to an S3 bucket.

question_text_original: A company needs to distribute firmware updates to its customers around the world. Which service will allow easy and secure control of the access to the downloads at the lowest cost?

question_text: 开发人员正在测试一个异步调用 AWS Lambda 函数的应用。测试期间，函数在重试两次后仍未能成功处理。开发人员如何排查失败原因？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。异步 Lambda 失败事件可进 SQS DLQ 供调查。

知识点／记忆点：异步失败的调查要同时保留原始事件与执行日志；DLQ 保存失败载荷便于重放，但不会自动修复业务逻辑。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudTrail 侧重 API 审计，不能替代捕获函数处理失败的事件载荷。

C：SWF 不会自动接收 Lambda 重试耗尽的事件。

D：AWS Config 检查资源配置，不负责接收函数失败事件并处理。

options.text: Configure AWS CloudTrail logging to investigate the invocation failures.
Configure Dead Letter Queues by sending events to Amazon SQS for investigation.
Configure Amazon Simple Workflow Service to process any direct unprocessed events.
Configure AWS Config to process any direct unprocessed events.

question_text_original: A developer is testing an application that invokes an AWS Lambda function asynchronously. During the testing phase, the Lambda function fails to process after two retries. How can the developer troubleshoot the failure?

question_text: 一家公司正在将 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 AWS 云。公司希望采用能够保护数据库凭证并定期轮换凭证的数据库方案，且不增加编程工作。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：B。Aurora PostgreSQL 搭配 Secrets Manager 自动轮换数据库凭证，不必自写轮换逻辑。

知识点／记忆点：关系型数据库迁移与凭证生命周期是两条独立决策；参数加密存储不代表具备数据库密码自动轮换。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Parameter Store 没有直接“开启数据库凭证轮换”的对应内置功能。

C：DynamoDB 不是 PostgreSQL 的直接替代，且 Parameter Store 仍未提供轮换。

D：将关系型库改成 DynamoDB 需要数据模型和应用改造，不符合无额外编程开销。

options.text: Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation.
Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation.
Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation.
Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation.

question_text_original: A company is migrating its PostgreSQL database into the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use a database that will secure and regularly rotate database credentials. The company wants a solution that does not require additional programming overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个无需用户登录的移动应用。授予用户 AWS 资源访问权限的最高效方法是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Cognito identity pool 的 unauthenticated identity 可给未登录手机用户有限 IAM 权限。

知识点／记忆点：匿名不等于无限权限：访客可获得短期、低权限身份；用户池负责登录，身份池负责将身份换成 AWS 凭证。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：强制通过身份提供商登录违反无需登录的要求。

B：为每个访客创建 IAM 用户会积累长期身份并增加管理工作。

C：KMS 生成和管理加密密钥，不签发访问 AWS 的用户凭证。

options.text: Use an identity provider to securely authenticate with the application.
Create an AWS Lambda function to create an IAM user when a user accesses the application.
Create credentials using AWS KMS and apply these credentials to users when using the application.
Use Amazon Cognito to associate unauthenticated users with an IAM role that has limited access to resources.

question_text_original: A developer is creating a mobile application that will not require users to log in. What is the MOST efficient method to grant users access to AWS resources?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数开发了新的无服务器应用，准备通过 AWS Serverless Application Model（AWS SAM）CLI 部署。部署前，开发人员应完成哪个步骤？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：题目过时；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。旧流程单独运行 sam package；当前 SAM CLI 的 sam deploy 可自动打包上传，题目把它当必需前置步骤已过时。

适用前提与时效：C 是旧式分步流程答案；现代 sam deploy 可自动完成打包上传，单独 sam package 并非总是必需。

知识点／记忆点：区分构建、打包上传与部署：构建准备运行制品，打包替换本地路径，部署由 CloudFormation 管理资源；新工具可合并步骤但职责仍不同。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：手工直接上传 Lambda 绕过 SAM 应用部署，不是必要前置步骤。

B：X-Ray 是运行期追踪，部署前不必先以它测试函数。

D：eb create 创建 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，与 SAM Lambda 部署无关。

options.text: Compress the application to a .zip file and upload it into AWS Lambda.
Test the new AWS Lambda function by first tracing it in AWS X-Ray.
Bundle the serverless application using a SAM package.
Create the application environment using the eb create my-env command.

audit_label: 题目过时；原答案已修正
question_text_original: A company has developed a new serverless application using AWS Lambda functions that will be deployed using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI. Which step should the developer complete prior to deploying the application?

question_text: 一家公司希望自动化部分部署流程。开发人员需要自动检查并删除曾支持旧部署堆栈、但现已不再使用的资源。公司通过一个中央应用，使用 AWS Cloud Development Kit（AWS CDK）管理分布在多个账户中的所有部署堆栈。方案必须尽可能无缝地集成现有流程。哪种方案所需配置最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。现有 CDK 应用中直接定义 Lambda-backed custom resource，可在 stack 生命周期清理资源，配置最少。

知识点／记忆点：IaC 自定义资源将额外逻辑接入创建、更新、删除生命周期；清理必须幂等并限制资源范围，不能把“未使用”简单等同于“可删除”。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：另外维护 JSON 模板和绑定逻辑，比已有 CDK 中直接定义自定义资源配置更多。

C：Amplify API 不会自然接入当前堆栈生命周期，还需额外调用与配置。

D：控制台手工维护函数使代码和部署分离，跨账户复现与更新开销更大。

options.text: In the central AWS CDK application, write a handler function in the code that uses AWS SDK calls to check for and delete unused resources. Create an AWS CloudFormation template from a JSON file. Use the template to attach the function code to an AWS Lambda function and to invoke the Lambda function when the deployment stack runs.

In the central AWS CDK application, write a handler function in the code that uses AWS SDK calls to check for and delete unused resources. Create an AWS CDK custom resource. Use the custom resource to attach the function code to an AWS Lambda function and to invoke the Lambda function when the deployment stack runs.

In the central AWS CDK, write a handler function in the code that uses AWS SDK calls to check for and delete unused resources. Create an API in AWS Amplify. Use the API to attach the function code to an AWS Lambda function and to invoke the Lambda function when the deployment stack runs.

In the AWS Lambda console, write a handler function in the code that uses AWS SDK calls to check for and delete unused resources. Create an AWS CDK custom resource. Use the custom resource to import the Lambda function into the stack and to invoke the Lambda function when the deployment stack runs.

question_text_original: A company wants to automate part of its deployment process. A developer needs to automate the process of checking for and deleting unused resources that supported previously deployed stacks but that are no longer used. The company has a central application that uses the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to manage all deployment stacks. The stacks are spread out across multiple accounts. The developer’s solution must integrate as seamlessly as possible within the current deployment process. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of configuration?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 云中构建了新应用，使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板及 Auto Scaling 组自动完成新资源的引导初始化。引导脚本包含敏感数据。公司需要一个与 CloudFormation 集成的方案来管理这些数据。哪种方案最安全？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：信息不足；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。CloudFormation dynamic references 不支持 EC2 UserData 或 AWS::CloudFormation::Init；原选项 C 无法直接安全注入 bootstrap script。

适用前提与时效：原题已标信息不足；C 的动态引用不能直接放在 EC2 UserData 或 CloudFormation::Init 中，因此不是完整可执行答案。

知识点／记忆点：模板的动态引用有支持位置限制；引导脚本应让实例通过最小权限角色在运行时取密，而不是把解密后的秘密留在 UserData 中。

选项核查与缺失信息：

A：把敏感值放入模板参数不能因“加密模板”就消除其在部署与引导路径的暴露。

B：仅写从 S3 下载没有说明加密及最小权限控制，不能据此认定为最安全。

D：EFS 加密不能在现有未加密文件系统上直接开启，且挂载文件系统并不解决引导密钥安全。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references.html

options.text: Put the sensitive data into a CloudFormation parameter. Encrypt the CloudFormation templates by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key.
Put the sensitive data into an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the CloudFormation templates to download the object from Amazon S3 during bootstrap.
Put the sensitive data into AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a secure string parameter. Update the CloudFormation templates to use dynamic references to specify template values.
Put the sensitive data into Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Enforce EFS encryption after file system creation. Update the CloudFormation templates to retrieve data from Amazon EFS.

audit_label: 信息不足；原答案已修正
question_text_original: A company built a new application in the AWS Cloud. The company automated the bootstrapping of new resources with an Auto Scaling group by using AWS CloudFormation templates. The bootstrap scripts contain sensitive data. The company needs a solution that is integrated with CloudFormation to manage the sensitive data in the bootstrap scripts. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

question_text: 一家公司需要为所有 AWS 云资源设置安全的数据库凭证，资源包括 Amazon RDS 数据库实例、Amazon DocumentDB 集群和 Amazon Aurora 数据库实例。安全政策要求凭证静态加密并定期轮换。哪种方案最安全？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。Secrets Manager 支持加密存储并按计划轮换 RDS、Aurora、DocumentDB 凭证。

知识点／记忆点：轮换加密密钥与轮换数据库密码不是同一件事：前者保护存储材料，后者必须实际修改数据库认证凭证并验证新值。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：IAM 数据库认证不等同于对所有列出的数据库提供统一密码轮换。

B：SecureString 提供加密参数存储，不提供该描述中的原生数据库自动轮换开关。

C：S3 加密密钥轮换不会更改数据库的登录密码。

options.text: Set up IAM database authentication for token-based access. Generate user tokens to provide centralized access to RDS DB instances, Amazon DocumentDB clusters, and Aurora DB instances.
Create parameters for the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set the Type parameter to SecureString. Set up automatic rotation on the parameters.

Store the database access credentials as an encrypted Amazon S3 object in an S3 bucket. Block all public access on the S3 bucket. Use S3 server-side encryption to set up automatic rotation on the encryption key.

Create an AWS Lambda function by using the SecretsManagerRotationTemplate template in the AWS Secrets Manager console. Create secrets for the database credentials in Secrets Manager. Set up secrets rotation on a schedule.

question_text_original: A company needs to set up secure database credentials for all its AWS Cloud resources. The company’s resources include Amazon RDS DB instances, Amazon DocumentDB clusters, and Amazon Aurora DB instances. The company’s security policy mandates that database credentials be encrypted at rest and rotated at a regular interval. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

question_text: 开发人员创建了一个查询 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库实例的 AWS Lambda 函数。测试时，数据库实例报告连接数过多。哪种方案能够以最少的运维工作解决问题？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。RDS Proxy 复用连接，缓解 Lambda 查询导致的数据库连接压力。

知识点／记忆点：数据库 CPU 有余量仍可能耗尽连接数；函数并发扩展会放大连接，连接代理通过池化与复用控制后端连接压力。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：只读副本分担查询，但应用仍可能对副本建立过多连接。

B：迁移到 DynamoDB 需要重构数据模型和访问逻辑，运维与开发工作远大于连接代理。

C：Multi-AZ 面向可用性，不会自动对突发客户端连接进行池化。

options.text: Create a read replica for the DB instance. Query the replica DB instance instead of the primary DB instance.
Migrate the data to an Amazon DynamoDB database.
Configure the Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
Create a proxy in Amazon RDS Proxy. Query the proxy instead of the DB instance.

question_text_original: A developer has created an AWS Lambda function that makes queries to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. When the developer performs a test, the DB instance shows an error for too many connections. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

question_text: 开发人员正在使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 创建新的 REST API。团队会在部署到生产环境前，针对已知用例测试 API 并验证响应。开发人员希望通过本地 API Gateway 提供 REST API 供测试使用。哪个 AWS SAM CLI 子命令能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。sam local start-api 在本地模拟 API Gateway + Lambda HTTP API 供测试。

知识点／记忆点：本地 HTTP 路由仿真与直接函数调用是不同测试层次：前者检验请求到函数事件的映射，后者只触发指定函数。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：sam local invoke 用单次事件调用函数，不启动 API HTTP 路由服务。

B：sam local generate-event 生成示例事件，不运行 API。

C：sam local start-lambda 暴露 Lambda 调用端点，不等于按 API Gateway 路由启动 REST API。

options.text: Sam local invoke
Sam local generate-event
Sam local start-lambda
Sam local start-api

question_text_original: A developer is creating a new REST API by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The development team tests the API and validates responses for the known use cases before deploying the API to the production environment. The developer wants to make the REST API available for testing by using API Gateway locally. Which AWS Serverless Application Model Command Line Interface (AWS SAM CLI) subcommand will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行无服务器应用，使用一组带别名的 AWS Lambda 函数，并定期通过内部部署方案发布新函数版本。公司希望改进发布流程，采用流量切换，使新发布版本最初只对固定比例的生产用户开放。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。已有自建发布系统可在 Lambda alias 配置 weighted routing，把固定比例导向新版。

适用前提与时效：若“固定比例用户”意味着按用户身份稳定分组，单纯加权别名不够，还需上游按身份路由。

知识点／记忆点：版本不可变、别名可加权；权重按调用概率分流，不保证某一固定用户群始终落在同一版本。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：CodeDeploy 金丝雀也能实现逐步发布，但需接入额外发布编排；对已有自建发布系统，直接加权别名更直接。

C：环境变量不负责在两个已发布版本间分配调用流量。

D：线性部署逐步增加比例，不是保持题目所说的初始固定比例机制本身。

options.text: Configure routing on the alias of the new function by using a weighted alias.
Configure a canary deployment type for Lambda.
Configure routing on the new versions by using environment variables.
Configure a linear deployment type for Lambda.

question_text_original: A company has a serverless application on AWS that uses a fleet of AWS Lambda functions that have aliases. The company regularly publishes new Lambda function by using an in-house deployment solution. The company wants to improve the release process and to use traffic shifting. A newly published function version should initially make available only to a fixed percentage of production users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的应用将数据存储在 Amazon RDS 实例中。应用周期性遇到流量激增，引起性能问题；高峰期间所有数据库查询都变慢。技术负责人决定采用多线程、可扩展的缓存方案，卸载繁重的读取流量以提高性能。哪种方案复杂度最低？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。Memcached 支持多线程和横向扩展，可卸载 RDS 读压力；Multi-AZ standby 不能直接读。

适用前提与时效：Redis/Valkey 的 I/O 线程及新版本能力与命令执行线程须区分，不能笼统说 Redis 完全没有多线程。

知识点／记忆点：缓存选型先看访问模式与执行模型；数据库高可用副本不等同于可供查询的只读副本。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：需要迁移并同步关系数据到 DynamoDB，远比添加缓存复杂。

C：传统 Multi-AZ DB 实例的备用实例不提供读取服务。

D：按本题传统引擎执行模型，Redis 的命令处理不符合题干强调的多线程缓存要求。

options.text: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to offload read requests from the main database.
Replicate the data to Amazon DynamoDSet up a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster.
Configure the Amazon RDS instances to use Multi-AZ deployment with one standby instance. Ofioad read requests from the main database to the standby instance.
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to offload read requests from the main database.

question_text_original: A company has an application that stores data in Amazon RDS instances. The application periodically experiences surges of high traffic that cause performance problems. During periods of peak traffic, a developer notices a reduction in query speed in all database queries. The team’s technical lead determines that a multi-threaded and scalable caching solution should be used to offload the heavy read traffic. The solution needs to improve performance. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST complexity?

question_text: 开发人员必须向定时运行的 AWS Lambda 函数提供 API 密钥，以向第三方系统进行身份验证，并确保密钥在静态存储时加密。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。API key 不应硬编码；Lambda 环境变量可用 KMS 加密，生产中优先考虑 Secrets Manager。

知识点／记忆点：传输加密和静态加密保护不同阶段；定时函数不能依赖人工输入密钥，密钥也应与代码版本解耦。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：无人值守的定时调用无法等待用户首次输入。

C：硬编码会使密钥进入源码及部署包，不能满足安全存储目的。

D：HTTPS 保护网络传输，不能解决 API 密钥的静态存储加密。

options.text: Store the API key as a Lambda environment variable by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.
Configure the application to prompt the user to provide the password to the Lambda function on the first run.
Store the API key as a value in the application code.
Use Lambda@Edge and only communicate over the HTTPS protocol.

question_text_original: A developer must provide an API key to an AWS Lambda function to authenticate with a third-party system. The Lambda function will run on a schedule. The developer needs to ensure that the API key remains encrypted at rest. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: IT 部门使用 Amazon S3 保存敏感图片。超过一年后，公司会将图片移至归档存储。公司很少访问图片，但希望最大程度提高存储韧性，同时 IT 部门必须能在 24 小时内访问归档图片。哪种方案最具成本效益？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。S3 Glacier Deep Archive 标准取回通常 12 小时内；One Zone-IA 不满足最高韧性。

适用前提与时效：A 与 C 的总成本仍取决于对象大小、访问分布和计费；C 在功能上可行，不应说它无法满足取回时限。

知识点／记忆点：归档题同时比较取回时限、存储成本和可用区冗余；最低存储价格不代表取回模式也符合时限。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Deep Archive 批量取回可能需 48 小时，不符合 24 小时要求。

C：已知长期低访问时，自动分层并非必需，且有对象监控成本，不能直接优于固定低频层。

D：单可用区存储降低故障韧性，且批量归档取回也可能超时。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html

options.text: Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with standard retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with bulk retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with standard retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
Use S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with bulk retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.

question_text_original: An IT department uses Amazon S3 to store sensitive images. After more than 1 year, the company moves the images into archival storage. The company rarely accesses the images, but the company wants a storage solution that maximizes resiliency. The IT department needs access to the images that have been moved to archival storage within 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS Serverless Application Model（AWS SAM）构建无服务器应用，目前在开发环境中测试。应用接近完成时，需要为 QA 团队增加测试和预发布环境。开发人员希望使用 AWS SAM 的功能配置多环境部署。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。samconfig.toml 可为多个环境配置独立 config-env，复用同一 SAM 模板。

知识点／记忆点：多环境部署宜复用模板、分离参数；环境命名配置让相同部署命令能够重复执行且不依赖操作者记住参数。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：复制模板和自建脚本增加维护及环境漂移风险。

C：每次手动覆盖参数更易遗漏，未充分利用环境配置分组。

D：只有模板参数而无环境配置，不能简化各环境参数和部署选项的持续管理。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/serverless-sam-cli-config.html

options.text: Add a configuration file in TOML format to group configuration entries to every environment. Add a table for each testing and staging environment. Deploy updates to the environments by using the sam deploy command and the --config-env flag that corresponds to each environment.

Create additional AWS SAM templates for each testing and staging environment. Write a custom shell script that uses the sam deploy command and the --template-file flag to deploy updates to the environments.

Create one AWS SAM configuration file that has default parameters. Perform updates to the testing and staging environments by using the --parameter-overrides flag in the AWS SAM CLI and the parameters that the updates will override.

Use the existing AWS SAM template. Add additional parameters to configure specific attributes for the serverless function and database table resources that are in each environment. Deploy updates to the testing and staging environments by using the sam deploy command.

question_text_original: A developer is building a serverless application by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). The developer is currently testing the application in a development environment. When the application is nearly finished, the developer will need to set up additional testing and staging environments for a quality assurance team. The developer wants to use a feature of the AWS SAM to set up deployments to multiple environments. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员正在开发一个处理 IoT 设备运行数据的应用。每台设备每小时向 Amazon S3 存储桶上传一次数据文件。开发人员希望每个文件上传后立即处理，并已配置一个包含上传目标桶信息的 AWS Lambda 函数处理这些文件。如何配置，使每次上传后立即调用该函数？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。S3 ObjectCreated 通知可直接触发 Lambda；不必把普通上传事件改为 EventBridge。

知识点／记忆点：事件驱动触发和函数配置是两件事；函数知道桶名，不代表桶已获授权并配置为在对象创建时调用函数。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：仅声明异步调用方式没有建立桶事件到函数的触发关系。

B：EventBridge 也能实现，但需启用 S3 事件发送并配置规则，选项描述不完整且非直接触发方案。

D：层提供共享依赖代码，不能订阅对象上传事件。

options.text: Add an asynchronous invocation to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.
Add an Amazon EventBridge event to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.
Add a trigger to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.
Add a layer to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.

question_text_original: A developer is working on an application that processes operating data from IoT devices. Each IoT device uploads a data file once every hour to an Amazon S3 bucket. The developer wants to immediately process each data file when the data file is uploaded to Amazon S3. The developer will use an AWS Lambda function to process the data files from Amazon S3. The Lambda function is configured with the S3 bucket information where the files are uploaded. The developer wants to configure the Lambda function to immediately invoke after each data file is uploaded. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS CloudFormation 设置基础设施。如果模板中资源的预置过程发生错误，必须保留已成功预置的资源。开发人员必须通过 AWS CLI 预置和更新堆栈。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：B。CloudFormation create-stack 的 --disable-rollback 在创建失败时保留资源供排错。

知识点／记忆点：终止保护防删除堆栈，禁用回滚保留失败现场；参数与标签只在有对应实现时才改变行为。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：终止保护不控制创建或更新失败时是否回滚资源。

C：PreserveResources 不是 CloudFormation 识别的内置控制参数。

D：自定义标签不会自动改变回滚行为。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stack-failure-options.html

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/cloudformation/update-stack.html

options.text: Add an --enable-termination-protection command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.
Add a --disable-rollback command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.
Add a --parameters ParameterKey=PreserveResources,ParameterValue=True command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.
Add a --tags Key=PreserveResources,Value=True command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.

question_text_original: A developer is setting up infrastructure by using AWS CloudFormation. If an error occurs when the resources described in the Cloud Formation template are provisioned, successfully provisioned resources must be preserved. The developer must provision and update the CloudFormation stack by using the AWS CLI. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建一个连接 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库的无服务器应用，由数百个 AWS Lambda 函数组成。每次 Lambda 扩容都会建立新的数据库连接，增加数据库资源消耗。开发人员需要减少连接数量，同时不能影响 Lambda 函数的可扩展性。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：C。RDS Proxy 复用数据库连接，适合大量 Lambda 并发访问 Aurora。

知识点／记忆点：函数扩容数与数据库连接数应解耦；连接池可以复用后端连接，而限制并发只是限制请求处理能力。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：预置并发减少冷启动，不负责复用数据库连接。

B：集群缓存管理改善故障转移后的缓存预热，不提供连接池端点。

D：预留并发硬性限制函数扩展，违反不影响可扩展性的要求。

options.text: Configure provisioned concurrency for each Lambda function by setting the ProvisionedConcurrentExecutions parameter to 10.
Enable cluster cache management for Aurora PostgreSQL. Change the connection string of each Lambda function to point to cluster cache management.
Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a connection pool to manage the database connections. Change the connection string of each Lambda function to reference the proxy.
Configure reserved concurrency for each Lambda function by setting the ReservedConcurrentExecutions parameter to 10.

question_text_original: A developer is building a serverless application that connects to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. The serverless application consists of hundreds of AWS Lambda functions. During every Lambda function scale out, a new database connection is made that increases database resource consumption. The developer needs to decrease the number of connections made to the database. The solution must not impact the scalability of the Lambda functions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员准备开始开发新版应用。旧版已部署在生产环境中，新版开发期间仍需要为当前版本部署修复和更新。新版代码存储在 AWS CodeCommit 中。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：A。并行维护旧版与开发新版应使用独立分支；还需明确从生产提交点切出维护分支。

知识点／记忆点：分支是可继续提交的工作线，标签是特定提交的标记；维护线应从真实生产提交切出，修复再合回后续版本。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：标签不能替代持续接收修复和新功能的开发分支。

C：只有生产维护分支与写入限制，没有完整建立新版并行开发流程。

D：新建仓库割裂共同历史，标签也不能代替新版开发分支。

options.text: From the main branch, create a feature branch for production bug fixes. Create a second feature branch from the main branch for development of the new version.
Create a Git tag of the code that is currently deployed in production. Create a Git tag for the development of the new version. Push the two tags to the CodeCommit repository.
From the main branch, create a branch of the code that is currently deployed in production. Apply an IAM policy that ensures no other users can push or merge to the branch.
Create a new CodeCommit repository for development of the new version of the application. Create a Git tag for the development of the new version.

question_text_original: A developer is preparing to begin development of a new version of an application. The previous version of the application is deployed in a production environment. The developer needs to deploy fixes and updates to the current version during the development of the new version of the application. The code for the new version of the application is stored in AWS CodeCommit. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个包含自定义名称 IAM 资源的 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈。部署时收到 InsufficientCapabilities 错误。应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：D。CloudFormation 创建自定义名称 IAM 资源需 CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM，不是普通管理员权限。

知识点／记忆点：IAM capability 是部署者对创建权限资源的显式确认，不是给部署角色增加权限；自定义名字需要更具体的确认项。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：AUTO_EXPAND 针对宏展开，不确认创建具名 IAM 资源。

B：管理员权限不能替代 CloudFormation 要求的显式 capability 确认。

C：普通 IAM 确认不足以覆盖带自定义名称的 IAM 资源。

options.text: Specify the CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND capability in the CloudFormation stack.
Use an administrators role to deploy IAM resources with CloudFormation.
Specify the CAPABILITY_IAM capability in the CloudFormation stack.
Specify the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability in the CloudFormation stack.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS CloudFormation stack. The stack contains IAM resources with custom names. When the developer tries to deploy the stack, they receive an InsuficientCapabilities error. What should the developer do to resolve this issue?

question_text: 一家公司通过 Amazon API Gateway 向客户提供一组 API，并已启用缓存。客户测试 API 时需要能够使各 API 的缓存失效。开发人员应如何提供这一能力？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：B。API Gateway 缓存失效需调用方具备 execute-api:InvalidateCache 并发送 Cache-Control: max-age=0。

知识点／记忆点：缓存刷新由调用权限和请求指令共同控制；刷新缓存不是删除 API，也不是普通查询参数。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：不存在供客户端直接调用的独立 InvalidateCache API 操作。

C：SDK 中不能用虚构的 InvalidateCache 操作替代请求标头机制。

D：INVALIDATE_CACHE 不是该功能认可的查询参数。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html

options.text: Ask the customers to use AWS credentials to call the InvalidateCache API operation.

Attach an InvalidateCache policy to the IAM execution role that the customers use to invoke the API. Ask the customers to send a request that contains the Cache-Control:max-age=0 HTTP header when they make an API call.
Ask the customers to use the AWS SDK API Gateway class to invoke the InvalidateCache API operation.
Attach an InvalidateCache policy to the IAM execution role that the customers use to invoke the API. Ask the customers to add the INVALIDATE_CACHE query string parameter when they make an API call.

question_text_original: A company uses Amazon API Gateway to expose a set of APIs to customers. The APIs have caching enabled in API Gateway. Customers need a way to invalidate the cache for each API when they test the API. What should a developer do to give customers the ability to invalidate the API cache?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个生成并导出文件的 AWS Lambda 函数。运行期间需要 100 MB 的临时存储空间，函数结束后不再需要这些文件。如何最高效地处理临时文件？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：C。Lambda 有临时 /tmp 存储；100 MB 临时文件无需另建 EBS 或 EFS。

知识点／记忆点：只服务于单次执行的中间文件用本地临时空间；执行环境可能复用，因此主动清理可以避免后续调用读取残留。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Lambda 不能像 EC2 一样直接挂载任意 EBS 卷。

B：EFS 增加共享文件系统和网络配置，本题不需要持久共享。

D：上传 S3 增加网络 I/O，生命周期删除也不是即时清理。

options.text: Store the files in Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.
Copy the files to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.
Store the files in the /tmp directory and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.
Copy the files to an Amazon S3 bucket with a lifecycle policy to delete the files.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that will generate and export a file. The function requires 100 MB of temporary storage for temporary files while running. These files will not be needed after the function is complete. How can the developer MOST efficiently handle the temporary files?

question_text: 一家公司以 Amazon DynamoDB 作为订单管理系统的数据存储。前端将订单写入表，表将变更事件发送到 DynamoDB 流，AWS Lambda 函数根据流数据记录和处理新订单。运维检查发现，传入订单的订单数量有时被设置为 0。开发人员需要创建仪表板，显示每天有多少名不重复的客户受到此问题影响。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。Lambda 写入 CloudWatch Logs 前要给 execution role 日志权限，才能查看异常细节。

知识点／记忆点：业务日志先带上客户标识和订单数量，再按天筛选异常并去重计数；订单条数不能当成受影响客户数。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：CloudTrail API 审计不等于包含完整业务订单字段的应用日志。

C：EventBridge 规则负责事件匹配，不提供按天去重聚合或以仪表板为通知目标。

D：流的默认指标不含客户业务维度，告警也不是日志去重查询引擎。

options.text: Grant the Lambda function’s execution role permissions to upload logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Implement a CloudWatch Logs Insights query that selects the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 and groups the results in 1-day periods. Add the CloudWatch Logs Insights query to a CloudWatch dashboard.

Use Amazon Athena to query AWS CloudTrail API logs for API calls. Implement an Athena query that selects the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 and groups the results in 1-day periods. Add the Athena query to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard.

Configure the Lambda function to send events to Amazon EventBridge. Create an EventBridge rule that groups the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 in 1-day periods. Add a CloudWatch dashboard as the target of the rule.

Turn on custom Amazon CloudWatch metrics for the DynamoDB stream of the DynamoDB table. Create a CloudWatch alarm that groups the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 in 1-day periods. Add the CloudWatch alarm to a CloudWatch dashboard.

question_text_original: A company uses Amazon DynamoDB as a data store for its order management system. The company frontend application stores orders in a DynamoDB table. The DynamoDB table is configured to send change events to a DynamoDB stream. The company uses an AWS Lambda function to log and process the incoming orders based on data from the DynamoDB stream. An operational review reveals that the order quantity of incoming orders is sometimes set to 0. A developer needs to create a dashboard that will show how many unique customers this problem affects each day. What should the developer do to implement the dashboard?

question_text: 开发人员需要排查开发环境中的 AWS Lambda 函数。该函数在 VPC 模式下运行，连接现有 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 数据库实例。数据库部署在私有子网，通过 1433 端口接受连接。测试中，函数连接数据库时报错。应采取哪些诊断步骤？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：AC；修正答案：AE。Lambda 访问私有 RDS 需检查安全组出入站与 ENI 权限；同 VPC 私网访问不需 NAT。

知识点／记忆点：私有数据库连通性分网络路径和身份授权排查；连接由函数发起，所以检查函数出站、数据库入站，而不是反过来。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：将连接发起方向颠倒，不能允许函数主动连接数据库。

C：同 VPC 私网访问无需 NAT，也无需将数据库公开。

D：描述和修改 RDS 资源的管理权限不授予 SQL 网络连接能力。

options.text: Check that the function’s security group has outbound access on port 1433 to the DB instance’s security group. Check that the DB instance’s security group has inbound access on port 1433 from the function’s security group.

Check that the function’s security group has inbound access on port 1433 from the DB instance’s security group. Check that the DB instance’s security group has outbound access on port 1433 to the function’s security group.
Check that the VPC is set up for a NAT gateway. Check that the DB instance has the public access option turned on.
Check that the function’s execution role permissions include rds:DescribeDBInstances, rds:ModifyDBInstance. and rds:DescribeDBSecurityGroups for the DB instance.
Check that the function’s execution role permissions include ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces, and ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface.

question_text_original: A developer needs to troubleshoot an AWS Lambda function in a development environment. The Lambda function is configured in VPC mode and needs to connect to an existing Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance. The DB instance is deployed in a private subnet and accepts connections by using port 1433. When the developer tests the function, the function reports an error when it tries to connect to the database. Which combination of steps should the developer take to diagnose this issue? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员需要通过 AWS CLI 启动新的 Amazon EC2 实例。应使用哪个 AWS CLI 命令？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。aws ec2 run-instances 创建 EC2；start-instances 只启动已存在实例。

知识点／记忆点：区分资源生命周期动词：创建新实例与启动已有已停止实例是不同 API，不能靠名称中的 start 推断创建。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：bundle-instance 用于旧式实例存储映像打包，不启动新实例。

B：start-instances 只启动已存在且停止的实例。

C：confirm-product-instance 验证实例产品代码，不创建计算资源。

options.text: aws ec2 bundle-instance
aws ec2 start-instances
aws ec2 confirm-product-instance
aws ec2 run-instances

question_text_original: A developer needs to launch a new Amazon EC2 instance by using the AWS CLI. Which AWS CLI command should the developer use to meet this requirement?

question_text: 开发人员需要以代码管理 AWS 基础设施，并能够部署多个相同副本、分阶段实施变更，以及回退到旧版本。哪种方法能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。CloudFormation 管基础设施声明式部署，CodeCommit 管模板版本。

知识点／记忆点：可重复环境来自声明式模板，可追溯回退来自版本历史；指标、标签与账单是观察信息，不是资源期望状态。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：成本报表不能定义或版本化基础设施，OpsWorks 也非本题通用模板方案。

B：监控和标签不具备完整的基础设施部署与版本回退能力。

C：Elastic Beanstalk 聚焦应用环境，并非管理任意基础设施副本的通用声明式工具。

options.text: Use cost allocation reports and AWS OpsWorks to deploy and manage the infrastructure.
Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics and alerts along with resource tagging to deploy and manage the infrastructure.
Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk and AWS CodeCommit to deploy and manage the infrastructure.
Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS CodeCommit to deploy and manage the infrastructure.

question_text_original: A developer needs to manage AWS infrastructure as code and must be able to deploy multiple identical copies of the infrastructure, stage changes, and revert to previous versions. Which approach addresses these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在开发一个访问 Amazon DynamoDB 的 AWS Lambda 函数。函数需要获取项目并更新部分属性；如果项目不存在，则创建项目。函数已能获得主键。应为函数申请哪些 IAM 权限来实现此功能？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：D。GetItem、UpdateItem 满足读改；若实现还会 PutItem 才需要该权限，最小权限应按实际 API 调整。

适用前提与时效：原参考 D 多授予 PutItem；题干没有规定必须调用它，D 并非唯一可行或严格最小权限答案，保留原答案同时标出歧义。

知识点／记忆点：DynamoDB UpdateItem 既能改属性，也能在项目不存在时创建项目；IAM 最小权限应按实际调用的 API 列表授予。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：缺少 UpdateItem，且 DeleteItem 与题目读改需求无关。

B：若实现只调用 GetItem 和 UpdateItem，此选项具备所需能力，不能简单判为功能错误；DescribeTable 是否需要取决于代码。

C：GetRecords 读取流记录，UpdateTable 修改表配置，都不是按主键读改项目的 API。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateItem.html

options.text: dynamodb:DeleleItem dynamodb:GetItem dynamodb:PutItem
dynamodb:UpdateItem dynamodb:GetItem dynamodb:DescribeTable
dynamodb:GetRecords dynamodb:PutItem dynamodb:UpdateTable
dynamodb:UpdateItem dynamodb:GetItem dynamodb:PutItem

question_text_original: A developer is working on an AWS Lambda function that accesses Amazon DynamoDB. The Lambda function must retrieve an item and update some of its attributes, or create the item if it does not exist. The Lambda function has access to the primary key. Which IAM permissions should the developer request for the Lambda function to achieve this functionality?

question_text: 开发人员构建了一个交易市场应用，将价格数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中，并在前面使用 Amazon ElastiCache 缓存。商品价格经常变化，卖家开始抱怨更新价格后，商品列表中的价格并未实际改变。什么原因可能导致此问题？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。数据库价格更新后必须更新或失效缓存，否则读到旧价格。

知识点／记忆点：数据库写成功与缓存刷新成功是两个事件；缓存一致性需要更新或失效策略，TTL 只能限制陈旧时间而不能保证立即一致。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：正确实现写穿策略会同时更新缓存，不是产生持续旧价格的原因。

C：读取容量不足通常表现为限流或延迟，不会主动使缓存保留旧价格。

D：写容量不足会导致写入限流，不能单凭它解释已更新数据库却显示缓存旧值。

options.text: The cache is not being invalidated when the price of the item is changed.
The price of the item is being retrieved using a write-through ElastiCache cluster.
The DynamoDB table was provisioned with insufficient read capacity.
The DynamoDB table was provisioned with insufficient write capacity.

question_text_original: A developer has built a market application that stores pricing data in Amazon DynamoDB with Amazon ElastiCache in front. The prices of items in the market change frequently. Sellers have begun complaining that, after they update the price of an item, the price does not actually change in the product listing. What could be causing this issue?

question_text: 公司要求所有运行在 Amazon EC2 上的应用通过 IAM 角色访问 AWS 服务。开发人员正在修改一个使用 AWS SDK for Python（boto）访问 DynamoDB 表的应用，它原先依赖存储在环境变量中的 IAM 用户访问密钥。开发人员给实例附加了与该用户权限相同的角色，随后删除该 IAM 用户。应用重启后，日志开始出现 AWS AccessDeniedException。但开发人员使用自己的账户，能够在服务器上通过 AWS CLI 执行 DynamoDB API 命令。异常最可能的原因是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。AWS SDK 凭证链可能优先取环境变量；移除旧凭证后才能改用 instance profile。

知识点／记忆点：SDK 按凭证提供程序优先级寻找身份；给实例附加角色不会自动覆盖更高优先级的环境变量凭证。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：短暂传播延迟不能解释应用持续用已删除用户凭证而另一身份正常。

C：AWS SDK 支持实例角色临时凭证，不必改为静态密钥。

D：安全组不用于阻止实例元数据服务的链路本地地址访问。

options.text: IAM policies might take a few minutes to propagate to resources.
Disabled environment variable credentials are still being used by the application.
The AWS SDK does not support credentials obtained using an instance role.
The instance’s security group does not allow access to http://169.254.169.254.

question_text_original: A company requires that all applications running on Amazon EC2 use IAM roles to gain access to AWS services. A developer is modifying an application that currently relies on IAM user access keys stored in environment variables to access Amazon DynamoDB tables using boto, the AWS SDK for Python. The developer associated a role with the same permissions as the IAM user to the EC2 instance, then deleted the IAM user. When the application was restarted, the AWS AccessDeniedException messages started appearing in the application logs. The developer was able to use their personal account on the server to run DynamoDB API commands using the AWS CLI. What is the MOST likely cause of the exception?

question_text: 一家公司的现有应用硬编码了数据库凭证。为满足灾难恢复策略，应用以主动—被动故障转移配置部署在两个 AWS 区域。开发人员需要将凭证存储到代码之外，且方案必须符合灾难恢复策略。哪种方案最安全？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。Secrets Manager 跨 Region 复制支持保留加密凭证和自动轮换。

知识点／记忆点：灾备不只复制业务数据，也要让备用区域具备独立可取用的凭证；应用应读取本区域副本，避免故障时依赖主区域。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：题述的 Parameter Store 原生参数跨区域复制开关不是该服务提供的功能。

C：S3 复制文件不提供专用 secret 的版本与轮换管理，需自建更多安全流程。

D：单个 EFS 文件系统不是两个区域共享的同一挂载端点。

options.text: Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager in the primary Region. Enable secret replication to the secondary Region. Update the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) based on the Region.

Store credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store in the primary Region. Enable parameter replication to the secondary Region. Update the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) based on the Region.

Store credentials in a config file. Upload the config file to an S3 bucket in the primary Region. Enable Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to an S3 bucket in the secondary region. Update the application to access the config file from the S3 bucket, based on the Region.
