Store credentials in a config file. Upload the config file to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Update the application to use the Amazon EFS file system Regional endpoints to access the config file in the primary and secondary Regions.

question_text_original: A company has an existing application that has hardcoded database credentials. A developer needs to modify the existing application. The application is deployed in two AWS Regions with an active-passive failover configuration to meet company’s disaster recovery strategy. The developer needs a solution to store the credentials outside the code. The solution must comply with the company’s disaster recovery strategy. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

question_text: 开发人员调用 Amazon CloudWatch API 时，间歇性收到 HTTP 400: ThrottlingException 错误；调用失败时无法获取数据。首先应采用哪项最佳实践来解决问题？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。ThrottlingException 是限流，使用 exponential backoff 加抖动重试。

知识点／记忆点：限流是服务要求降低请求速率的反馈；退避加随机抖动避免所有客户端同时重试，重试次数仍应有上限。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：申请提高配额不能替代客户端正确处理短暂限流，通常不是第一步。

B：换成 CLI 仍访问同一受限 API，不会绕过配额。

C：删除业务所需调用会丢失功能，不能作为一般限流处理。

options.text: Contact AWS Support for a limit increase.
Use the AWS CLI to get the metrics.
Analyze the applications and remove the API call.
Retry the call with exponential backoff.

question_text_original: A developer is receiving HTTP 400: ThrottlingException errors intermittently when calling the Amazon CloudWatch API. When a call fails, no data is retrieved. What best practice should first be applied to address this issue?

question_text: 一个应用在处理过程中需要使用客户端 IP 地址。迁移到 AWS 并置于 Application Load Balancer（ALB）后方后，所有客户端 IP 看起来都相同。应用必须继续支持横向扩展。最具成本效益的解决方案是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。ALB 把原始客户端 IP 放在 X-Forwarded-For；应用应读取并校验可信代理链。

知识点／记忆点：反向代理终止客户端连接后，下游看到的是代理地址；真实来源通过转发链传递，应用只应信任受控代理添加的部分。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：移除负载均衡会削弱横向扩展与高可用能力。

B：换为 Classic Load Balancer 仍需处理代理转发地址，不能消除问题。

D：客户端自报地址可伪造，还需修改客户端，不能作为可信来源。

options.text: Remove the application from the ALB. Delete the ALB and change Amazon Route 53 to direct traffic to the instance running the application.
Remove the application from the ALCreate a Classic Load Balancer in its place. Direct traffic to the application using the HTTP protocol.
Alter the application code to inspect the X-Forwarded-For header. Ensure that the code can work properly if a list of IP addresses is passed in the header.
Alter the application code to inspect a custom header. Alter the client code to pass the IP address in the custom header.

question_text_original: An application needs to use the IP address of the client in its processing. The application has been moved into AWS and has been placed behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). However, all the client IP addresses now appear to be the same. The application must maintain the ability to scale horizontally. Based on this scenario, what is the MOST cost-effective solution to this problem?

question_text: 开发人员正在设计一个无服务器应用，让客户选择音乐会场地的座位。客户将购票请求发送给 Amazon API Gateway API，由 AWS Lambda 函数确认订单并生成订单 ID。另有两个并行运行的 Lambda 函数负责库存管理和支付处理，并将订单写入 Amazon DynamoDB 表。如果同一座位意外售出多次，最先收到的订单必须获得该座位，且只能处理该订单的付款；但如果第一笔订单的付款被拒绝，则第二笔订单必须获得座位并处理其付款。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。SNS FIFO 可扇出到多个 SQS FIFO 订阅者并保持消息组内顺序。

适用前提与时效：A 提供有序扇出基础，但仍需同座位 MessageGroupId、条件占座和支付失败后的补偿逻辑；仅搭建 FIFO 队列不足以满足全部业务事务要求。

知识点／记忆点：消息组内有序不等于跨服务事务；座位竞争还需要条件写入、幂等支付和失败补偿，支付与库存两条队列不会自动达成一致。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：只顺序调用两次函数未定义持久队列、并发座位竞争和支付失败补偿。

C：标准 SNS 不能保证同一用户事件严格有序及去重。

D：两个消费者竞争同一队列会分走消息，不能保证库存和支付都收到每笔订单。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/fifo-topic-message-ordering.html

options.text: Send the order ID to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic that fans out to one Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue for inventory management and another SQS FIFO queue for payment processing.
Change the Lambda function that generates the order ID to initiate the Lambda function for inventory management. Then initiate the Lambda function for payment processing.
Send the order ID to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the Lambda functions for inventory management and payment processing to the topic.
Deliver the order ID to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda functions for inventory management and payment processing to poll the queue.

question_text_original: A developer is designing a serverless application that customers use to select seats for a concert venue. Customers send the ticket requests to an Amazon API Gateway API with an AWS Lambda function that acknowledges the order and generates an order ID. The application includes two additional Lambda functions: one for inventory management and one for payment processing. These two Lambda functions run in parallel and write the order to an Amazon Dynamo DB table. The application must provide seats to customers according to the following requirements. If a seat is accidently sold more than once, the first order that the application received must get the seat. In these cases, the application must process the payment for only the first order. However, if the first order is rejected during payment processing, the second order must get the seat. In these cases, the application must process the payment for the second order. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一个应用每小时通过 AWS X-Ray 生成大量跟踪数据。开发人员希望使用筛选表达式，根据用户指定的自定义属性限制返回结果。应如何在 X-Ray 中筛选？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。X-Ray annotations 可索引和按表达式过滤；metadata 不可索引。

知识点／记忆点：可检索属性与诊断详情应分开：索引字段支持筛选，非索引字段适合保存大量上下文；采样决定采不采，筛选决定查哪些。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：metadata 不建立用于筛选表达式的索引。

C：任意新增字段不自动成为 X-Ray 支持的可索引注解。

D：采样影响未来记录量，不能按自定义属性查询已有跟踪。

options.text: Add custom attributes as annotations in the segment document.
Add custom attributes as metadata in the segment document.
Add custom attributes as new segment fields in the segment document.
Create new sampling rules that are based on custom attributes.

question_text_original: An application uses AWS X-Ray to generate a large amount of trace data on an hourly basis. A developer wants to use filter expressions to limit the returned results through user-specified custom attributes. How should the developer use filter expressions to filter the results in X-Ray?

question_text: 一个 Web 应用使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 处理点击流数据，数据可能在最长 12 小时后才被消费。开发人员如何对数据流中的数据实现静态加密？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Kinesis Data Streams server-side encryption 保护静态数据；TLS 只保护传输。

知识点／记忆点：TLS 保护数据移动过程，静态加密保护服务保存的记录；保留时间长短不改变这两层加密的职责。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：SSL/TLS 只保护传输，不能为已保存的流记录提供静态加密。

B：消费者库处理读取与协调，不启用服务端静态加密。

C：流记录存入后无法通过 Lambda 就地重新加密它们。

options.text: Enable SSL connections to Kinesis.
Use Amazon Kinesis Consumer Library.
Encrypt the data once it is at rest with a Lambda function.
Enable server-side encryption in Kinesis Data Streams.

question_text_original: A web application is using Amazon Kinesis Data Streams for clickstream data that may not be consumed for up to 12 hours. How can the developer implement encryption at rest for data within the Kinesis Data Streams?

question_text: 一个应用实时处理通过 API 接收的数百万个事件。哪项服务能够让多个消费者并行处理数据，同时最具成本效益？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Kinesis Data Streams 支持多独立 consumer 重放同一实时事件流。

适用前提与时效：成本与吞吐、消费者数量、保留时长有关，不能断言任何 SNS/SQS 配置都比 Kinesis 贵；按题目大规模实时多消费者需求选 D。

知识点／记忆点：日志型流让各消费者维护独立读取位置，同一记录可被多次读取和重放；队列通常在成功消费后删除消息。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：可实现扇出，但需为每个消费者维护队列，未提供共享流的保留重放模型。

B：每个消费者各建 FIFO 队列增加重复投递与队列管理，题干也没有严格顺序需求。

C：Firehose 侧重缓冲转换并投递目的地，不是多消费者独立实时读取的通用流。

options.text: Amazon SNS with fanout to an SQS queue for each application
Amazon SNS with fanout to an SQS FIFO (first-in, first-out) queue for each application
Amazon Kinesis Firehose
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

question_text_original: An application is real-time processing millions of events that are received through an API. What service could be used to allow multiple consumers to process the data concurrently and MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 给定下图所示的 AWS CloudFormation 模板，从另一个 CloudFormation 模板引用新建 Amazon S3 存储桶的最高效方式是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudFormation 跨栈引用需在 Outputs 导出 Export，再用 Fn::ImportValue 引用。

知识点／记忆点：跨栈引用是发布者导出、使用者导入的契约；输出值并不默认公开给其他堆栈，导出名必须在账户区域范围内唯一。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Exported 和 ImportResource 不是所述跨栈引用的合法模板语法。

C：自定义资源需额外代码和权限，内置导出导入已经能完成。

D：包含模板片段不等于引用已创建资源，且不存在所述 Fn::Include 内置函数。

options.text: Add an Export declaration to the Outputs section of the original template and use ImportValue in other templates.
Add Exported: true to the Content.Bucket in the original template and use ImportResource in other templates.
Create a custom AWS CloudFormation resource that gets the bucket name from the ContentBucket resource of the first stack.
Use Fn::Include to include the existing template in other templates and use the ContentBucket resource directly.

question_text_original: Given the following AWS CloudFormation template: What is the MOST efficient way to reference the new Amazon S3 bucket from another AWS CloudFormation template?

question_text: 开发人员构建了一个向 Amazon DynamoDB 表插入数据的应用。表使用预置容量，应用部署在突发性能型 nano Amazon EC2 实例上。应用日志显示因 ProvisionedThroughputExceededException 而失败。开发人员应采取哪些措施？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：CE。DynamoDB 限流可先指数退避；改 on-demand 可适应不可预测突发，但仍受配额影响。

知识点／记忆点：判断限流先定位被限制的服务和读写方向；更快的客户端不能增加服务端容量，反而可能加剧请求拥堵。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：EC2 变大不会提高 DynamoDB 表的写容量。

B：插入项目消耗写容量，增加读取容量不解决写限流。

D：缩短重试间隔会继续加压，容易形成重试风暴。

options.text: Move the application to a larger EC2 instance.
Increase the number of read capacity units (RCUs) that are provisioned for the DynamoDB table.
Reduce the frequency of requests to DynamoDB by implementing exponential backoff.
Increase the frequency of requests to DynamoDB by decreasing the retry delay.
Change the capacity mode of the DynamoDB table from provisioned to on-demand.

question_text_original: A developer has built an application that inserts data into an Amazon DynamoDB table. The table is configured to use provisioned capacity. The application is deployed on a burstable nano Amazon EC2 instance. The application logs show that the application has been failing because of a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error. Which actions should the developer take to resolve this issue? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司为外部用户举办研讨会，希望向这些用户共享参考文档 7 天。文档保存在公司拥有的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。最安全的共享方式是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：A。S3 presigned URL 能限时共享；单个 URL 最长期限取决于签名凭证，SDK/IAM 用户签名可到 7 天。

知识点／记忆点：预签名 URL 是持有者凭证，权限继承签名者且寿命不超过签名凭证；URL 写了七天不代表临时凭证也能存活七天。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：迁移到另一文档系统增加管理，且题述未设置七天访问到期。

C：IAM 用户访问密钥没有自动七天到期的临时凭证语义，还暴露了长期凭证。

D：角色 ARN 只是标识符，没有信任和代入授权不能据此下载对象。

options.text: Use S3 presigned URLs to share the documents with the external users. Set an expiration time of 7 days.
Move the documents to an Amazon WorkDocs folder. Share the links of the WorkDocs folder with the external users.
Create temporary IAM users that have read-only access to the S3 bucket. Share the access keys with the external users. Expire the credentials after 7 days.
Create a role that has read-only access to the S3 bucket. Share the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of this role with the external users.

question_text_original: A company is hosting a workshop for external users and wants to share the reference documents with the external users for 7 days. The company stores the reference documents in an Amazon S3 bucket that the company owns. What is the MOST secure way to share the documents with the external users?

question_text: 开发人员计划使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 提供 REST API，需要分别管理开发、测试和生产三个环境。如何在尽量减少待管理资源数量的同时部署应用？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。API Gateway stage 与 Lambda alias 可把 dev/test/prod 指向不同函数版本。

知识点／记忆点：API 阶段负责发布入口，函数别名负责绑定代码版本；两层版本映射使环境可分别演进而无需复制整套资源。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：为每个环境复制网关和函数会增加待管理资源。

B：用区域代替环境隔离会重复基础设施并引入跨区域管理。

D：仅靠客户端参数区分环境缺少独立版本入口，也容易误访问生产资源。

options.text: Create a separate API Gateway and separate Lambda function for each environment in the same Region.
Assign a Region for each environment and deploy API Gateway and Lambda to each Region.
Create one API Gateway with multiple stages with one Lambda function with multiple aliases.
Create one API Gateway and one Lambda function, and use a REST parameter to identify the environment.

question_text_original: A developer is planning to use an Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to provide a REST API. The developer will have three distinct environments to manage: development, test, and production. How should the application be deployed while minimizing the number of resources to manage?

question_text: 开发人员通过 CLI 命令将 AWS Lambda 函数注册为 Application Load Balancer（ALB）的目标，但客户端通过 ALB 发送请求时，函数并未被调用。原因是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。ALB 调用 Lambda target 需 Lambda resource-based policy 授权 elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com。

知识点／记忆点：把函数登记为目标与允许服务调用它是两步；资源策略应限制调用服务及来源负载均衡目标组。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：ALB 支持 Lambda 目标类型。

B：CLI 和 API 也能注册 Lambda 目标，并非控制台专属。

D：跨可用区负载均衡不是函数调用授权的开关。

options.text: A Lambda function cannot be registered as a target for an ALB.
A Lambda function can be registered with an ALB using AWS Management Console only.
The permissions to invoke the Lambda function are missing.
Cross-zone is not enabled on the ALB.

question_text_original: A developer registered an AWS Lambda function as a target for an Application Load Balancer (ALB) using a CLI command. However, the Lambda function is not being invoked when the client sends requests through the ALB. Why is the Lambda function not being invoked?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个连接 Amazon RDS for MySQL 实例的 AWS Lambda 函数，需要存储数据库凭证。凭证必须加密，数据库密码必须自动轮换。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。Secrets Manager 存数据库凭证并支持 RDS 托管轮换。

知识点／记忆点：加密存储不等于自动轮换；轮换需要协调 secret 的版本与数据库中真实密码，不能只替换客户端字符串。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：环境变量不会自动更新数据库密码，也没有此处所称的自动轮换开关。

C：SecureString 提供加密，但 Parameter Store 不直接提供数据库凭证托管轮换。

D：X-Amz-Security-Token 是临时 AWS 凭证的会话令牌字段，不是数据库凭证仓库。

options.text: Store the database credentials as environment variables for the Lambda function. Set the environment variables to rotate automatically.
Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Set up managed rotation on the database credentials.
Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as secure string parameters. Set up managed rotation on the parameters.
Store the database credentials in the X-Amz-Security-Token parameter. Set up managed rotation on the parameter.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that will connect to an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance. The developer wants to store the database credentials. The database credentials need to be encrypted and the database password needs to be automatically rotated. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员希望降低部署现有 AWS Lambda 函数新版本时的风险。为了测试，需要在旧版本和新版本之间分配流量。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。Lambda alias weighted routing 可把少量流量发往新发布版本以降低上线风险。

知识点／记忆点：灰度发布需要稳定调用入口与不可变版本；在入口上设置权重能限制新版本的爆炸半径。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：DNS 记录不能直接指向同一 Lambda 函数的内部版本。

C：ALB 的同一 Lambda 目标组不能按题述直接对两个函数版本分流，额外目标组方案也更复杂。

D：层是依赖包，不是函数版本，也不提供调用流量分配。

options.text: Configure a weighted routing policy in Amazon Route 53. Associate the versions of the Lambda function with the weighted routing policy.
Create a function alias. Configure the alias to split the traffic between the two versions of the Lambda function.
Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that uses the Lambda function as a target. Configure the ALB to split the traffic between the two versions of the Lambda function.
Create the new version of the Lambda function as a Lambda layer on the existing version. Configure the function to split the traffic between the two layers.

question_text_original: A developer wants to reduce risk when deploying a new version of an existing AWS Lambda function. To test the Lambda function, the developer needs to split the traffic between the existing version and the new version of the Lambda function. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员创建了一个较大的 AWS Lambda 函数，部署时发生 InvalidParameterValueException，提示解压后的函数大小超过支持上限。可以采取哪些措施解决？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：CE。超出 Lambda 部署包限制可拆分函数或提取共享依赖到 layer；layer 也受解压后总大小限制。

适用前提与时效：原参考 CE 存在缺陷：E 不能单独解决题干明确的“解压后超限”；只有拆分或实际移除运行依赖等措施才能减少该总量。

知识点／记忆点：压缩后上传大小与解压后运行包总大小是不同限制；把依赖移到层只改变打包方式，不会从函数的总解压大小中扣除。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：不可调整的部署包大小限制不能通过申请配额提升来解决。

B：更换压缩算法不能减少解压后的代码和依赖总大小。

D：二次压缩仍不改变最终解压数据量，还使包结构不符合预期。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html

options.text: Submit a quota increase request to AWS Support to increase the function to the required size.
Use a compression algorithm that is more efficient than ZIP.
Break up the function into multiple smaller functions.
Zip the .zip file twice to compress the file more.
Move common libraries, function dependencies, and custom runtimes into Lambda layers.

question_text_original: A developer has created a large AWS Lambda function. Deployment of the function is failing because of an InvalidParameterValueException error. The error message indicates that the unzipped size of the function exceeds the maximum supported value. Which actions can the developer take to resolve this error? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员正在集成环境中排查应用。Amazon SQS 队列接收消息，AWS Lambda 函数随后处理和转换消息，并调用第三方 API。应用使用量增加后，第三方 API 经常返回 HTTP 429 Too Many Requests，导致大量消息无法成功处理。应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：D。SQS event source maximum concurrency 可限制 Lambda 并发，避免压垮第三方 API。

知识点／记忆点：队列吸收突发，并发限制保护下游；最大并发不是每秒请求限额，还需结合每次调用的批量和 API 请求次数估算。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：增加批量可能让每次函数调用发出更多下游请求，不能可靠限制速率。

B：预置并发是预热容量，不是并发上限。

C：SQS 事件源映射不是 Lambda 异步调用队列，异步重试参数不控制该消费路径。

options.text: Increase the SQS event source’s batch size setting.
Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function based on the third-party API’s documented rate limits.
Increase the retry attempts and maximum event age in the Lambda function’s asynchronous configuration.
Configure maximum concurrency on the SQS event source based on the third-party service’s documented rate limits.

question_text_original: A developer is troubleshooting an application in an integration environment. In the application, an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue consumes messages and then an AWS Lambda function processes the messages. The Lambda function transforms the messages and makes an API call to a third-party service. There has been an increase in application usage. The third-party API frequently returns an HTTP 429 Too Many Requests error message. The error message prevents a significant number of messages from being processed successfully. How can the developer resolve this issue?

question_text: 一家公司将三层应用部署在 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）中，使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。应用的数据库读取多于写入。高峰期性能下降时，CloudWatch 中数据库实例的 ReadLatency 指标会突然增大。开发人员应如何修改应用以提高性能？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。ElastiCache 缓存热查询结果，减少后端数据库重复读取。

知识点／记忆点：先找瓶颈所在层；读延迟高且重复读取多时，缓存命中可以绕过数据库，扩容应用层却可能进一步增加数据库压力。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：增加 ECS 实例不减少数据库读取，可能使竞争更严重。

C：RCU 是 DynamoDB 的容量单位，不是 RDS 实例的扩容参数。

D：增加任务内存不会直接修复数据库的读取延迟。

options.text: Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache query results.
Scale the ECS cluster to contain more ECS instances.
Add read capacity units (RCUs) to the DB instance.
Modify the ECS task definition to increase the task memory.

question_text_original: A company has a three-tier application that is deployed in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The application is using an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The application performs more database reads than writes. During times of peak usage, the application’s performance degrades. When this performance degradation occurs, the DB instance’s ReadLatency metric in Amazon CloudWatch increases suddenly. How should a developer modify the application to improve performance?

question_text: 一家公司的在线 Web 应用包含产品目录，目录存放在名为 DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET 的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。应用必须通过 IAM 策略获得列出桶内对象和下载对象的权限。哪项策略以最小访问权限满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。图中 A 的 s3:ListBucket 作用于 bucket ARN，s3:GetObject 作用于 object ARN，恰好满足列桶与下载的最小权限。

知识点／记忆点：IAM 的 Action 和 Resource 必须类型匹配：列出内容操作作用于桶，读正文作用于对象；最小权限还要求排除写入和删除。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：图中对对象授予 s3:*，包含不需要的写入、删除等权限。

C：图中额外授予 PutObject 和 DeleteObject，超过列出及下载所需权限。

D：图中明确 Deny GetObject，会阻止所要求的下载。

options.text: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D

question_text_original: A company has an online web application that includes a product catalog. The catalog is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket that is named DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET. The application must be able to list the objects in the S3 bucket and must be able to download objects through an IAM policy. Which policy allows MINIMUM access to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在编写应用，在 AWS 之外加密文件，然后上传到 Amazon S3。加密必须采用对称方式，并在应用内部完成。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。AWS Encryption SDK 可配合 KMS data key 在客户端加密文件后上传 S3。

知识点／记忆点：大文件采用信封加密：本地数据密钥加密正文，KMS 保护数据密钥；消息认证码用来验证完整性，并不能隐藏明文。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：HMAC 密钥用于生成和验证消息认证码，不执行文件加密。

C：数据密钥对属于非对称方案，不符合对称加密要求。

D：常规 AWS CLI 的 KMS Encrypt 不是任意大小文件的本地加密库，且不满足在应用内完成文件加密。

options.text: Create a data key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files.
Create a Hash-Based Message Authentication Code (HMAC) key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files.
Create a data key pair in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS CLI to encrypt the files.
Create a data key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS CLI to encrypt the files.

question_text_original: A developer is writing an application to encrypt files outside of AWS before uploading the files to an Amazon S3 bucket. The encryption must be symmetric and must be performed inside the application. How can the developer implement the encryption in the application to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在维护一个部署于 Amazon EC2 实例的应用，需要将文件安全传输到 Amazon S3 存储桶。最安全的做法是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。EC2 instance profile 提供临时角色凭证；IAM role 不会创建长期 access key。

知识点／记忆点：工作负载身份宜绑定运行环境，由 SDK 获取短期凭证；授权精确到需要的 API 和桶，避免把长期密钥搬进环境变量。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：环境变量仍保存长期 IAM 用户密钥，需要自行轮换且有泄露风险。

B：IAM 角色不能像 IAM 用户一样创建长期访问密钥。

D：EC2 实例 ID 不是可直接写入桶策略的 IAM 主体。

options.text: Create an IAM user. Create an access key for the IAM user. Store the access key in the application’s environment variables.
Create an IAM role. Create an access key for the IAM role. Store the access key in the application’s environment variables.
Create an IAM role. Configure the IAM role to access the specific Amazon S3 API calls the application requires. Associate the IAM role with the EC2 instance.
Configure an S3 bucket policy for the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket policy to allow access for the EC2 instance ID.

question_text_original: A developer is working on an application that is deployed on an Amazon EC2 instance. The developer needs a solution that will securely transfer files from the application to an Amazon S3 bucket. What should the developer do to meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

question_text: 开发人员创建了一个 Web API，通过具有 HTTPS 侦听器的面向互联网 Application Load Balancer（ALB）接收请求。开发人员已配置 Amazon Cognito 用户池，希望确保每个 API 请求都经过 Cognito 身份验证。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。ALB listener authentication action 可接入 OIDC 或 Cognito 校验请求。

知识点／记忆点：检查请求头存在不等于验证身份；认证必须检查令牌来源、有效性和会话状态，再决定是否转发给后端。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：任意人都能填写 Authorization 标头，存在性检查不能验证令牌。

C：增加 API Gateway 不必要，且若 ALB 仍可直接公网访问则可绕过网关认证。

D：认证 Lambda 目标不是先认证再转发原业务目标的内置监听器认证链。

options.text: Add a listener rule to the listener to return a fixed response if the Authorization header is missing. Set the fixed response to 401 Unauthorized.
Create an authentication action for the listener rules of the ALSet the rule action type to authenticate-cognito. Set the OnUnauthenticatedRequest field to “deny.”

Create an Amazon API Gateway API. Configure all API methods to be forwarded to the ALB endpoint. Create an authorizer of the COGNITO_USER_POOLS type. Configure every API method to use that authorizer.
Create a new target group that includes an AWS Lambda function target that validates the Authorization header by using Amazon Cognito. Associate the target group with the listener.

question_text_original: A developer created a web API that receives requests by using an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) with an HTTPS listener. The developer configures an Amazon Cognito user pool and wants to ensure that every request to the API is authenticated through Amazon Cognito. What should the developer do to meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司最近部署了 AWS Lambda 函数。开发人员发现 Amazon CloudWatch 中的函数限流指标上升。哪些方案能够以最高的运维效率减少限流？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：CE。先查看函数 reserved concurrency 是否不足；账户并发上限不足则申请 quota increase。

知识点／记忆点：函数预留并发与账户区域并发是不同层的上限；先确认哪个上限命中，再扩容对应层，读配置权限不会改变额度。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：迁移到 Kubernetes 远超解决并发限流所需运维工作。

B：延长事件年龄只是让事件等更久，不能增加可执行并发。

D：GetFunctionConcurrency 只允许读取配置，不提升并发容量。

options.text: Migrate the function to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS).
Increase the maximum age of events in Lambda.
Increase the function’s reserved concurrency.
Add the lambda:GetFunctionConcurrency action to the execution role.
Request a service quota change for increased concurrency.

question_text_original: A company recently deployed an AWS Lambda function. A developer notices an increase in the function throttle metrics in Amazon CloudWatch. What are the MOST operationally efficient solutions to reduce the function throttling? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司使用集成 AWS Lambda 的 Amazon API Gateway 创建 REST 服务。为进行测试，需要运行服务的不同版本。最佳做法是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。API Gateway stage 隔离 API 版本，并用 stage variable 指向对应 Lambda alias。

知识点／记忆点：版本测试要隔离发布快照和入口；授权策略回答能否访问，不负责选择运行哪个版本。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：自定义标头需业务代码自行解释，不能替代受管理的 API 阶段。

B：Lambda 授权程序决定允许或拒绝，不是 API 版本路由器。

C：资源策略控制权限，不创建独立发布快照和版本端点。

options.text: Use an X-Version header to denote which version is being called and pass that header to the Lambda function(s).
Create an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to route API clients to the correct API version.
Create an API Gateway resource policy to isolate versions and provide context to the Lambda function(s).
Deploy the API versions as unique stages with unique endpoints and use stage variables to provide further context.

question_text_original: A company is creating a REST service using an Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda integration. The service must run different versions for testing purposes. What would be the BEST way to accomplish this?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS CodePipeline 交付应用。流水线由 AWS CodeCommit 主分支的变更触发，使用 AWS CodeBuild 测试和构建，再通过 AWS CodeDeploy 部署。流水线已正常运行数月且未修改。最近应用源代码变更后，CodeDeploy 未按预期部署更新。可能的原因有哪些？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AB。CodePipeline 可因变更不在监听分支或上游 stage 失败而未执行部署。

知识点／记忆点：流水线是串联状态机：只有监听的源事件发生且上游成功，下游部署才会执行；从未触发与部署失败应分别排查。

其他选项为什么不选：

C：CodePipeline 是托管服务，不存在客户维护的 CodePipeline EC2 集群。

D：题干说明配置数月未变且此前正常，没有证据支持其突然配置错误。

E：此前正常且无权限修改信息，缺少 CodeCommit 权限不是本题优先解释。

options.text: The change was not made in the main branch of the AWS CodeCommit repository.
One of the earlier stages in the pipeline failed and the pipeline has terminated.
One of the Amazon EC2 instances in the company’s AWS CodePipeline cluster is inactive.
The AWS CodePipeline is incorrectly configured and is not invoking AWS CodeDeploy.
AWS CodePipeline does not have permissions to access AWS CodeCommit.

question_text_original: A company is using AWS CodePipeline to deliver one of its applications. The delivery pipeline is triggered by changes to the main branch of an AWS CodeCommit repository and uses AWS CodeBuild to implement the test and build stages of the process and AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the application. The pipeline has been operating successfully for several months and there have been no modifications. Following a recent change to the application’s source code, AWS CodeDeploy has not deployed the updated application as expected. What are the possible causes? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS SAM 构建基于多个 AWS Lambda 函数的无服务器应用。部署后的前 10 分钟，希望将 10% 的流量切换到新版本；如果没有问题，再将全部流量切换过去。应如何修改 AWS SAM 模板？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。SAM DeploymentPreference Canary10Percent10Minutes 配合 AutoPublishAlias 发布函数版本。

知识点／记忆点：Canary 是小比例试运行后一次切全量，Linear 是每隔一段时间再增加固定比例；流量入口是别名，测试钩子必须是测试函数。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：线性策略会每十分钟增加 10%，而不是首个十分钟后切换剩余 90%。

C：PreTraffic/PostTraffic 是测试钩子，不应填入用于路由的别名。

D：既使用了错误的线性节奏，也把别名误用作测试钩子。

options.text: Set the Deployment Preference Type to Canary10Percent10Minutes. Set the AutoPublishAlias property to the Lambda alias.
Set the Deployment Preference Type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Set AutoPublishAlias property to the Lambda alias.
Set the Deployment Preference Type to Canary10Percent10Minutes. Set the PreTraffic and PostTraffic properties to the Lambda alias.
Set the Deployment Preference Type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Set PreTraffic and PostTraffic properties to the Lambda alias.

question_text_original: A developer is building a serverless application by using AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) on multiple AWS Lambda functions. When the application is deployed, the developer wants to shift 10% of the traffic to the new deployment of the application for the first 10 minutes after deployment. If there are no issues, all traffic must switch over to the new version. Which change to the AWS SAM template will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一个 AWS Lambda 函数运行在公司的共享 AWS 账户中，现在还需要对公司的开发账户执行 ec2:DescribeInstances 操作。开发人员必须配置跨账户权限。如何遵循最小权限原则配置？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。跨账户 Lambda 先用执行角色获准 sts:AssumeRole，再信任目标账户角色调用 EC2 API。

适用前提与时效：参考选项 B 的 iam:AssumeRole 是原题笔误，实施时必须改为 sts:AssumeRole；原答案字母按既有审查保留。

知识点／记忆点：跨账户代入需要双边授权：目标账户角色信任调用方，调用方获准 sts:AssumeRole；代入后使用目标角色权限访问目标资源。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：角色建在共享账户而不是资源所在开发账户，不能按题述切换到开发账户身份。

C：角色所在账户错误，且 iam:AssumeRole 不是有效动作名称。

D：只增加 DescribeInstances 不授予代入目标角色所需权限。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_permissions-to-switch.html

options.text: Create an IAM role in the shared account. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship between the development accounts for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role.

Create an IAM role in the development accounts. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship with the shared account for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the iam:AssumeRole permissions.

Create an IAM role in the shared account. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship between the development accounts for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the iam:AssumeRole permissions.

Create an IAM role in the development accounts. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship with the shared account for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role.

question_text_original: An AWS Lambda function is running in a company’s shared AWS account. The function needs to perform an additional ec2:DescribeInstances action that is directed at the company’s development accounts. A developer must configure the required permissions across the accounts. How should the developer configure the permissions to adhere to the principle of least privilege?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建将部署到 AWS 的新应用，已创建 AWS CodeCommit 仓库，并使用 AWS CDK 的 cdk init 命令初始化项目。开发人员需要为 CDK 生成的基础设施即代码（IaC）模板编写单元测试，还必须对应用中的全部构造运行验证工具，以确保关键安全配置已启用。哪组措施需要的开发开销最少？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BE。CDK assertions 可测试合成模板，Aspects 可实施组织规则。

知识点／记忆点：基础设施单元测试检查合成后的资源属性，构造树访问器检查跨构造规则；输入配置本身不是自动验证器。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：自行解析 cdk.out 目录内容重复实现断言能力，开发维护更多。

C：运行时 context 提供配置值，不会自动验证安全属性或阻止合成。

D：字符串搜索容易漏掉动态生成配置，不如结构化访问构造树可靠。

options.text: Use a unit testing framework to write custom unit tests against the cdk.out file that the AWS CDK generates. Run the unit tests in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that is invoked after any commit to the repository.

Use the CDK assertions module to integrate unit tests with the application. Run the unit tests in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that is invoked after any commit to the repository.
Use the CDK runtime context to set key-value pairs that must be present in the cdk.out file that the AWS CDK generates. Fail the stack synthesis if any violations are present.
Write a script that searches the application for specific key configuration strings. Configure the script to produce a report of any security violations.
Use the CDK Aspects class to create custom rules to apply to the CDK application. Fall the stack synthesis if any violations are present.

question_text_original: A developer is building a new application that will be deployed on AWS. The developer has created an AWS CodeCommit repository for the application. The developer has initialized a new project for the application by invoking the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) cdk init command. The developer must write unit tests for the infrastructure as code (IaC) templates that the AWS CDK generates. The developer also must run a validation tool across all constructs in the CDK application to ensure that critical security configurations are activated. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements with the LEAST development overhead? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家在线销售公司正在开发 AWS 无服务器应用。一个 AWS Lambda 函数计算订单成功率，并将结果存入 Amazon DynamoDB 表。开发人员希望每 15 分钟高效地调用一次函数。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。EventBridge schedule/rate expression 可定期触发 Lambda，无需自建定时服务器。

知识点／记忆点：周期性触发应交给托管调度器；工作流 Wait 用于流程内部等待，不能把执行角色当作可调用的业务函数。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：需要 EC2、脚本和额外调度配置，远比托管定时规则复杂。

C：执行角色不是调用目标，且循环状态机不是最简周期调度方式。

D：为一个定时调用维护 EC2 和 cron 增加补丁、可用性及费用负担。

options.text: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has a rate expression that will run the rule every 15 minutes. Add the Lambda function as the target of the EventBridge rule.
Create an AWS Systems Manager document that has a script that will invoke the Lambda function on Amazon EC2. Use a Systems Manager Run Command task to run the shell script every 15 minutes.
Create an AWS Step Functions state machine. Configure the state machine to invoke the Lambda function execution role at a specified interval by using a Wait state. Set the interval to 15 minutes.
Provision a small Amazon EC2 instance. Set up a cron job that invokes the Lambda function every 15 minutes.

question_text_original: An online sales company is developing a serverless application that runs on AWS. The application uses an AWS Lambda function that calculates order success rates and stores the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. A developer wants an efficient way to invoke the Lambda function every 15 minutes. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 一家公司将照片处理应用部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上。每张照片必须在 5 秒内处理完成；如果超过 5 秒，开发团队必须收到通知。开发人员如何以最少的运维开销实现计时和通知？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：A。CloudWatch custom metric + alarm + SNS 可低运维告警；若要求任一照片超时，统计量须使用 Maximum 且留意聚合周期。

知识点／记忆点：“任一请求超时”应看 Maximum，而非平均值；指标告警按聚合周期和状态变化触发，不能当成每张照片的逐条通知流。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：自建消费者判断阈值增加代码和运行管理。

C：平均值会掩盖单张超时，且告警不能按描述直接把 SES 当作原生告警动作。

D：CloudWatch 告警不会直接逐条读取 Kinesis 业务记录并计算处理耗时。

options.text: Create an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time as a metric value. Create a CloudWatch alarm that is based on a static threshold of 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time to the queue. Create an application to consume from the queue and to determine whether any values are more than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

Create an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time as a metric value. Create a CloudWatch alarm that enters ALARM state if the average of values is greater than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by sending an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) message.

Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time to the data stream. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that enters ALARM state if any values are more than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

question_text_original: A company deploys a photo-processing application to an Amazon EC2 instance. The application needs to process each photo in less than 5 seconds. If processing takes longer than 5 seconds, the company’s development team must receive a notification. How can a developer implement the required time measurement and notification with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 管理运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 应用。开发人员需要修改配置，且变更只能部署到新实例。可以使用哪些部署类型？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BD。Elastic Beanstalk immutable 和 blue/green 都能部署独立新实例再切换，降低中断风险。

知识点／记忆点：只改新实例意味着先创建替代容量再切换；分批更新旧实例与创建全新环境是不同部署模型。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：一次性在现有实例上更新，不符合仅新实例要求。

C：滚动部署逐批更新现有实例。

E：额外批次只是先补充容量，后续仍会更新现有实例。

options.text: All at once
Immutable
Rolling
Blue/green
Rolling with additional batch

question_text_original: A company is using AWS Elastic Beanstalk to manage web applications that are running on Amazon EC2 instances. A developer needs to make configuration changes. The developer must deploy the changes to new instances only. Which types of deployment can the developer use to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员需要使用 Amazon DynamoDB 保存客户订单。公司要求所有客户数据在静态存储时，使用公司生成的密钥进行加密。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。DynamoDB server-side encryption 可选择 customer managed KMS key 满足自管密钥要求。

适用前提与时效：若“公司生成”指公司外部产生的密钥材料，还需将材料导入受支持的客户托管 KMS 密钥，而不是仅创建一个默认材料的密钥。

知识点／记忆点：客户控制密钥与 AWS 管理密钥的区别在密钥所有权和策略控制；指定服务端加密密钥应在表配置中完成，不是在每次写入夹带 IAM 动作。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：DynamoDB 不提供将静态加密设置为 None 的选项。

C：kms:Encrypt 是权限动作，不是 DynamoDB SDK 每次写入接受的加密参数。

D：AWS 托管密钥不满足公司自行生成并控制密钥的要求。

options.text: Create the DynamoDB table with encryption set to None. Code the application to use the key to decrypt the data when the application reads from the table. Code the application to use the key to encrypt the data when the application writes to the table.
Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Choose an AWS KMS customer managed key during creation of the DynamoDB table. Provide the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key.

Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Create the DynamoDB table with default encryption. Include the kms:Encrypt parameter with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key when using the DynamoDB software development kit (SDK).
Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Choose an AWS KMS AWS managed key during creation of the DynamoDB table. Provide the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key.

question_text_original: A developer needs to use Amazon DynamoDB to store customer orders. The developer’s company requires all customer data to be encrypted at rest with a key that the company generates. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司通过 AWS CloudFormation 部署应用，使用与 AWS Lambda 集成的 Amazon API Gateway REST API，并用 Amazon DynamoDB 持久化数据。应用包含开发、测试和生产三个阶段，各自使用独立的 DynamoDB 表。变更在开发和测试阶段成功，但提升到生产时出现意外问题。下次发布时，开发人员需要将 20% 的流量导向新的生产阶段 API，其余 80% 保留在现有生产阶段，并尽量减少任何单个客户遇到的错误数量。应采用哪种方法？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。API Gateway canary deployment 将生产 stage 的部分流量导向新版本。

知识点／记忆点：灰度控制的是请求流量比例，而不是代码改动比例；生产灰度应仍使用生产数据边界，不能把真实用户导向测试数据库。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：分五次提交代码无法保证 20% 请求使用新版本，还可能产生不完整功能。

B：导向测试阶段会混用测试数据，DNS 缓存还会使单个客户长期固定在某目标。

C：API Gateway 阶段不是 ALB 可直接注册的目标类型，且测试阶段不应承接生产写入。

options.text: Update 20% of the planned changes to the production stage. Deploy the new production stage. Monitor the results. Repeat this process five times to test all planned changes.

Update the Amazon Route 53 DNS record entry for the production stage API to use a weighted routing policy. Set the weight to a value of 80. Add a second record for the production domain name. Change the second routing policy to a weighted routing policy. Set the weight of the second policy to a value of 20. Change the alias of the second policy to use the testing stage API.

Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the REST API. Change the production API Amazon Route 53 record to point traffic to the ALB. Register the production and testing stages as targets of the ALB with weights of 80% and 20%, respectively.
Configure canary settings for the production stage API. Change the percentage of traffic directed to canary deployment to 20%. Make the planned updates to the production stage. Deploy the changes

question_text_original: A company uses AWS CloudFormation to deploy an application that uses an Amazon API Gateway REST API with AWS Lambda function integration. The application uses Amazon DynamoDB for data persistence. The application has three stages: development, testing, and production. Each stage uses its own DynamoDB table. The company has encountered unexpected issues when promoting changes to the production stage. The changes were successful in the development and testing stages. A developer needs to route 20% of the traffic to the new production stage API with the next production release. The developer needs to route the remaining 80% of the traffic to the existing production stage. The solution must minimize the number of errors that any single customer experiences. Which approach should the developer take to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员创建了一个使用 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 和 Amazon S3 的数据采集应用。用户定期上传数据文件，等待处理仪表板显示验证状态。大型文件的验证过程复杂且耗时，部分用户一次上传数十个大型文件，不得不等待并刷新仪表板以查看验证是否完成。开发人员需要重构应用，在不重新加载整个仪表板的情况下立即更新验证结果。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。API Gateway WebSocket API 可向已连接客户端主动推送异步处理状态。

知识点／记忆点：长任务完成通知应与上传请求解耦；服务端推送需要保存用户与连接的对应关系，并处理连接已断开及重新连接的情况。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：自建 WebSocket 服务器需要维护连接容量、可用性和服务器补丁，运维更多。

C：邮件通知不能直接更新已打开的浏览器仪表板。

D：SNS 移动推送不是任意浏览器页面的实时连接通道，且文件不宜直接存入 DynamoDB。

options.text: Integrate the client with an API Gateway WebSocket API. Save the user-uploaded files with the WebSocket connection ID. Push the validation status to the connection ID when the processing is complete to initiate an update of the user interface.

Launch an Amazon EC2 micro instance, and set up a WebSocket server. Send the user-uploaded file and user detail to the EC2 instance after the user uploads the file. Use the WebSocket server to send updates to the user interface when the uploaded file is processed.

Save the user’s email address along with the user-uploaded file. When the validation process is complete, send an email notification through Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to the user who uploaded the file.

Save the user-uploaded file and user detail to Amazon DynamoDB. Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams with Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) push notifications to send updates to the browser to update the user interface.

question_text_original: A developer has created a data collection application that uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon S3. The application’s users periodically upload data files and wait for the validation status to be refiected on a processing dashboard. The validation process is complex and time-consuming for large files. Some users are uploading dozens of large files and have to wait and refresh the processing dashboard to see if the files have been validated. The developer must refactor the application to immediately update the validation result on the user’s dashboard without reloading the full dashboard. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建使用 Amazon API Gateway 的应用。公司只允许销售部门用户访问。用户通过 Amazon Cognito，使用第三方身份提供商（IdP）的联合凭证登录。开发人员已将名为 Department 的属性映射并传递给自定义 AWS Lambda 授权程序。测试时，开发人员在 IdP 中将部门设为 Engineering，登录被拒绝；随后改为 Sales 再登录，仍被拒绝。日志显示访问令牌中的部门值仍为 Engineering。以下哪项可能导致部门未更新为 Sales？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。Lambda authorizer 结果缓存会复用授权决策；缓存键未纳入部门信息时可能误放行。

适用前提与时效：A 可解释旧拒绝决策被复用，但不能使新令牌的声明变回 Engineering；若日志确实看到令牌内旧值，还应检查重新认证、属性映射与令牌刷新，题干将两类缓存混淆。

知识点／记忆点：排查授权要区分用户属性、已签发令牌声明与缓存的授权决策；修改 IdP 属性不会改写已经签发的令牌。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Cognito 用户池没有题述这种可配置的授权决策缓存开关。

C：授权程序角色标签不会自动改写用户令牌中的 Department 声明。

D：用户池角色标签不是联合用户部门属性的来源。

options.text: Authorization caching is enabled in the custom Lambda authorizer.
Authorization caching is enabled on the Amazon Cognito user pool.
The IAM role for the custom Lambda authorizer does not have a Department tag.
The IAM role for the Amazon Cognito user pool does not have a Department tag.

question_text_original: A company’s developer is creating an application that uses Amazon API Gateway. The company wants to ensure that only users in the Sales department can use the application. The users authenticate to the application by using federated credentials from a third-party identity provider (IdP) through Amazon Cognito. The developer has set up an attribute mapping to map an attribute that is named Department and to pass the attribute to a custom AWS Lambda authorizer. To test the access limitation, the developer sets their department to Engineering in the IdP and attempts to log in to the application. The developer is denied access. The developer then updates their department to Sales in the IdP and attempts to log in. Again, the developer is denied access. The developer checks the logs and discovers that access is being denied because the developer’s access token has a department value of Engineering. Which of the following is a possible reason that the developer’s department is still being reported as Engineering instead of Sales?

question_text: 一家公司已将应用迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。用户界面的自动扩展正常，但向仓库员工发送发货请求的流程出现问题：请求重复、丢失或乱序。公司必须避免重复发货请求，并按请求到达顺序处理。请求大小不超过 250 KB，每个需处理 5 到 10 分钟。开发人员需要重新设计应用，提高请求投递和处理的可靠性。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。SQS 缓冲突发请求，再由 Lambda 弹性消费，避免前端与后台处理耦合。

适用前提与时效：FIFO 的发送去重不等于业务端绝不重复执行；处理成功后须正确确认消息，并用订单标识保证发货幂等。

知识点／记忆点：FIFO 的顺序保证在消息组内；业务去重还需幂等键，可见性超时应覆盖实际处理时间，避免处理中再次投递。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Firehose 是缓冲投递服务，不是可确认消费的有序发货任务队列。

B：标准 SNS 不提供严格顺序和持久消费任务队列语义。

C：标准 SQS 只提供尽力排序和至少一次投递，不能满足严格顺序要求。

options.text: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to process the requests. Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Modify the application to write the requests to the Kinesis data stream.

Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Modify the application to write the requests to the SNS topic.

Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. Set the SQS queue as an event source for the Lambda function. Modify the application to write the requests to the SQS queue.

Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the SQS queue as an event source for the Lambda function. Modify the application to write the requests to the SQS queue.

question_text_original: A company has migrated an application to Amazon EC2 instances. Automatic scaling is working well for the application user interface. However, the process to deliver shipping requests to the company’s warehouse staff is encountering issues. Duplicate shipping requests are arriving, and some requests are lost or arrive out of order. The company must avoid duplicate shipping requests and must process the requests in the order that the requests arrive. Requests are never more than 250 KB in size and take 5-10 minutes to process. A developer needs to rearchitect the application to improve the reliability of the delivery and processing of the requests. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在 AWS Step Functions 中创建包含 AWS Lambda 函数的机器学习（ML）流水线。Amazon SQS 队列向流水线提供模型参数以训练模型，训练好的模型上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。开发人员需要在本地测试流水线，而不实际向 SQS 和 S3 发出服务集成调用。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Step Functions Local mocked integrations 可离线模拟状态机外部服务响应。

知识点／记忆点：测试工作流控制逻辑时可模拟服务响应，验证分支、重试与错误路径；本地运行函数与模拟整个状态机不是同一层测试。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：性能分析器用于观察运行性能，不能离线替代 SQS/S3 集成。

B：仅运行本地状态机不等于已经模拟其外部服务调用。

C：SAM 本地函数测试不能直接覆盖 Step Functions 的服务集成流程。

options.text: Use the Amazon CodeGuru Profiler to analyze the Lambda functions used in the AWS Step Functions pipeline.
Use the AWS Step Functions Local Docker Image to run and locally test the Lambda functions.
Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI to run and locally test the Lambda functions.
Use AWS Step Functions Local with mocked service integrations.

question_text_original: A developer is creating a machine learning (ML) pipeline in AWS Step Functions that contains AWS Lambda functions. The developer has configured an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to deliver ML model parameters to the ML pipeline to train ML models. The developer uploads the trained models are uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket. The developer needs a solution that can locally test the ML pipeline without making service integration calls to Amazon SQS and Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon API Gateway API 运行批处理应用，并设置开发、用户验收测试和生产部署阶段。开发团队需要将各阶段 API 配置为连接第三方服务端点。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。API Gateway stage variables 可为不同 stage 指定不同后端 endpoint。

知识点／记忆点：同一 API 定义可用阶段配置选择不同后端；不要让客户端任意指定后端地址，否则会混淆环境边界。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Lambda 层是版本化代码依赖包，不是 API 阶段端点配置机制。

C：客户端查询参数不宜成为选择可信后端的配置来源。

D：AppConfig 可以存配置，但 API Gateway 不会自动把它当阶段后端地址，需要额外读取逻辑。

options.text: Store the third-party service endpoints in Lambda layers that correspond to the stage.
Store the third-party service endpoints in API Gateway stage variables that correspond to the stage.
Encode the third-party service endpoints as query parameters in the API Gateway request URL.
Store the third-party service endpoint for each environment in AWS AppConfig.

question_text_original: A company runs a batch processing application by using AWS Lambda functions and Amazon API Gateway APIs with deployment stages for development, user acceptance testing, and production. A development team needs to configure the APIs in the deployment stages to connect to third-party service endpoints. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建 AWS 无服务器应用，希望建立加速开发流程，将增量变更部署到 AWS 进行测试，而无需在每次提交代码时完整部署整个应用。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。sam sync 增量同步代码与资源，加快开发测试反馈。

知识点／记忆点：区分开发同步与完整基础设施部署；初始化、合成和引导环境都不是把代码变更同步到运行服务。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：sam init 创建项目骨架，不部署增量变更。

C：cdk synth 生成 CloudFormation 模板，不执行部署。

D：cdk bootstrap 创建部署依赖基础设施，不发布应用代码。

options.text: Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to build the application. Use the sam sync command to deploy the incremental changes.
Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to build the application. Use the sam init command to deploy the incremental changes.
Use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to build the application. Use the cdk synth command to deploy the incremental changes.
Use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to build the application. Use the cdk bootstrap command to deploy the incremental changes.

question_text_original: A developer is building a serverless application that runs on AWS. The developer wants to create an accelerated development workflow that deploys incremental changes to AWS for testing. The developer wants to deploy the incremental changes but does not want to fully deploy the entire application to AWS for every code commit. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建使用 Amazon API Gateway API 和 AWS Lambda 后端的应用。前端团队需要立即访问 API 端点以开发 UI。为准备后端集成，开发人员需要设置返回预定义 HTTP 状态码和 JSON 响应的端点，并已为 API 资源创建方法。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。API Gateway MOCK integration 能在后端尚未实现时返回模拟响应供前端联调。

知识点／记忆点：模拟接口也有请求到响应的映射链；请求模板选择模拟状态，集成响应模板生成返回正文，方法请求不能代替响应配置。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：额外创建返回固定值的 Lambda 增加开发及运行资源。

C：代理要求真实 HTTP 后端，仍要等待另一占位服务完成。

D：把状态码与响应正文放错配置位置，不能按描述生成模拟响应。

options.text: Set the integration type to AWS_PROXY. Provision Lambda functions to return hardcoded JSON data.
Set the integration type to MOCK. Configure the method's integration request and integration response to associate a JSON responses with specific HTTP status codes.
Set the integration type to HTTP_PROXY. Configure API Gateway to pass all requests to an external placeholder API. which the team will build.
Set the integration type to MOCK. Use a method request to define HTTP status codes. Use an integration request to define JSON responses.

question_text_original: A developer is building an application that will use an Amazon API Gateway API with an AWS Lambda backend. The team that will develop the frontend requires immediate access to the API endpoints to build the UI. To prepare the backend application for integration, the developer needs to set up endpoints. The endpoints need to return predefined HTTP status codes and JSON responses for the frontend team. The developer creates a method for an API resource. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在将应用迁移到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS），使用 Amazon Elastic Container Registry（Amazon ECR）和 EKS 集群。为迁移到新后端，开发人员创建了新 AWS 账户，并修改应用配置，使其指向新账户和新后端资源。通过部署流水线测试变更时，Docker 映像构建和部署均成功，但应用仍连接旧后端。检查发现配置仍引用原来的 EKS 集群，而不是新资源。什么原因可以解释此问题？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：C。使用可复用的镜像 tag 时节点缓存可能保留旧镜像；应推新 tag 并更新部署的 image。

适用前提与时效：复用标签是否拉取新映像还取决于 imagePullPolicy 和是否重建 Pod；同一标签不是所有情况下都会缓存旧版本。

知识点／记忆点：可变镜像标签不等于可重复发布；唯一版本标签或摘要让部署配置明确指向新映像，也便于回滚。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：题干已说明新账户创建及流水线测试成功，没有证据支持账户不存在。

B：增加新标签并用于部署通常有助于更新，而非导致继续引用旧映像。

D：推送新标签本身不能解释旧配置，关键还在部署实际引用哪个标签或摘要。

options.text: The developer did not successfully create the new AWS account.
The developer added a new tag to the Docker image.
The developer did not update the Docker image tag to a new version.
The developer pushed the changes to a new Docker image tag.

question_text_original: A developer is migrating an application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The developer migrates the application to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) with an EKS cluster. As part of the application migration to a new backend, the developer creates a new AWS account. The developer makes configuration changes to the application to point the application to the new AWS account and to use new backend resources. The developer successfully tests the changes within the application by deploying the pipeline. The Docker image build and the pipeline deployment are successful, but the application is still connecting to the old backend. The developer finds that the application's configuration is still referencing the original EKS cluster and not referencing the new backend resources. Which reason can explain why the application is not connecting to the new resources?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个读写多个 Amazon S3 存储桶的应用，将部署到 Amazon EC2 实例。开发人员希望从实例安全地发出 API 请求，无需管理应用安全凭证，并遵循最小权限原则。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。EC2 role 配合最小权限 IAM policy 访问指定 S3 buckets，无需明文 access key。

适用前提与时效：B 的 s3:*Object 仍可能包含不必要的删除等动作；真实实现应按代码收紧到 GetObject/PutObject 等具体 API。

知识点／记忆点：实例角色提供自动轮换的临时凭证，策略再将权限限定到具体桶和实际操作；安全身份来源与最小权限缺一不可。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：长期用户密钥需要管理，且 s3:* 远超读写指定桶所需权限。

C：AmazonS3FullAccess 覆盖过多桶及管理动作，不符合最小权限。

D：桶策略不能把普通 EC2 实例对象直接当 IAM 主体，应用仍需有效身份凭证。

options.text: Create an IAM user. Create access keys and secret keys for the user. Associate the user with an IAM policy that allows s3:* permissions.
Associate the EC2 instance with an IAM role that has an IAM policy that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:*Object permissions for specific S3 buckets.
Associate the EC2 instance with an IAM role that has an AmazonS3FullAccess AWS managed policy.
Create a bucket policy on the S3 bucket that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:*Object permissions to the EC2 instance.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an application that reads and writes to multiple Amazon S3 buckets. The application will be deployed to an Amazon EC2 instance. The developer wants to make secure API requests from the EC2 instances without the need to manage the security credentials for the application. The developer needs to apply the principle of least privilege. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在编写一个应用，从第三方系统获取敏感数据并生成 PDF，文件可能超过 1 MB。应用通过 AWS KMS 将数据加密后写入磁盘，并在用户请求下载时解密。获取和格式化功能已完成。开发人员需要使用 GenerateDataKey API 和 AWS KMS 对称客户托管密钥加密 PDF，并确保以后可以解密。哪些方案能够满足这些要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。KMS envelope encryption 只持久化加密 data key；明文 data key 用后清除。

知识点／记忆点：信封加密持久化的是密文数据和被包裹的数据密钥；明文数据密钥只在内存中短暂存在，文件正文由本地对称算法加密。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：密文数据密钥不能直接用来加密正文，而且把明文密钥写盘会削弱安全性。

C：KMS Encrypt 不是用返回的明文数据密钥加密任意大型 PDF 的接口。

D：既保存了明文密钥，又误把密文数据密钥当作 KMS Encrypt 的文件加密参数。

options.text: Write the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the plaintext key from the GenerateDataKey API and a symmetric encryption algorithm to encrypt the file.
Write the plain text key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API and a symmetric encryption algorithm to encrypt the file.
Write the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the plaintext key from the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the file by using the KMS Encrypt API.
Write the plain text key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the file by using the KMS Encrypt API.

question_text_original: A developer is writing an application that will retrieve sensitive data from a third-party system. The application will format the data into a PDF file. The PDF file could be more than 1 MB. The application will encrypt the data to disk by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). The application will decrypt the file when a user requests to download it. The retrieval and formatting portions of the application are complete. The developer needs to use the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the PDF file so that the PDF file can be decrypted later. The developer needs to use an AWS KMS symmetric customer managed key for encryption. Which solutions will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行应用，并连接 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 数据库。开发人员需要安全存储和访问凭证、自动轮换凭证，且不能将其保存在代码中。哪种方案最安全？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。Secrets Manager 可保存 RDS 凭证并执行自动轮换，减少硬编码。

知识点／记忆点：轮换凭证必须同时更新存储的 secret 和数据库实际密码；实例启动时下载一次配置，不能保证后续轮换后仍可连接。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：给 EC2 附加 IAM 角色不等于获得 RDS SQL Server 数据库登录密码。

C：启动时拉取 S3 文件后不会自动刷新，轮换后实例可能继续使用旧凭证。

D：DynamoDB 加自建定时流程需要自行实现 secret 版本、访问审计与轮换协调。

options.text: Create an IAM role that has permissions to access the database. Attach the IAM role to the EC2 instances.
Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function to update the secrets and the database. Retrieve the credentials from Secrets Manager as needed.

Store the credentials in an encrypted text file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instance launch template to download the credentials from Amazon S3 as the instance launches. Create an AWS Lambda function to update the secrets and the database.
Store the credentials in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Events rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to periodically update the secrets and database.

question_text_original: A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances open connections to an Amazon RDS for SQL Server database. A developer needs to store and access the credentials and wants to automatically rotate the credentials. The developer does not want to store the credentials for the database in the code. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

question_text: 一家公司希望更频繁地测试 Web 应用。应用在每个环境中使用独立的 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈，并在开发生命周期各阶段向对应堆栈部署相同模板。开发人员需要在最终预生产环境发生新部署时通知 QA 团队。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。SNS 能通知 QA 团队，部署流程需要在成功后发布消息。

适用前提与时效：A 默认发送堆栈事件，不代表仅在部署成功时发一封邮件；若只需最终成功通知，应再按状态过滤。

知识点／记忆点：部署通知应绑定目标环境的堆栈，而不是修改每个环境共用的业务代码；堆栈事件通知可能包含多个状态，需要明确成功或失败筛选。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：EventBridge 加 Lambda 可以实现，但额外维护通知函数，不如现成堆栈 SNS 通知简单。

C：CloudFormation 堆栈状态不是按描述自动提供的业务指标维度。

D：CloudFormation 不是 Lambda 事件源映射支持的轮询源。

options.text: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the QA team to the Amazon SNS topic. Update the CloudFormation stack options to point to the SNS topic in the pre-production environment.

Create an AWS Lambda function that notifies the QA team. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function on the default event bus. Filter the events on the CloudFormation service and on the CloudFormation stack Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that monitors the metrics from CloudFormation. Filter the metrics on the stack name and the stack status. Configure the CloudWatch alarm to notify the QA team.

Create an AWS Lambda function that notifies the QA team. Configure the event source mapping to receive events from CloudFormation. Specify the filtering values to limit invocations to the desired CloudFormation stack.

question_text_original: A company wants to test its web application more frequently. The company deploys the application by using a separate AWS CloudFormation stack for each environment. The company deploys the same CloudFormation template to each stack as the application progresses through the development lifecycle. A developer needs to build in notifications for the quality assurance (QA) team. The developer wants the notifications to occur for new deployments in the final preproduction environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员管理三个 AWS 账户，每个账户的私有子网中都有 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。开发人员需要一致地定义各数据库用户，确保三个账户中创建相同用户，并能在以后同步更新。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。CloudFormation custom resource 可调用 Lambda 在 RDS 中创建数据库用户。

知识点／记忆点：IaC 管理云资源，不会自动执行数据库内部的建用户语句；自定义资源把创建、更新、删除逻辑接入堆栈生命周期。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudFormation 没有通用的关系数据库内部用户原生资源类型可直接声明。

C：为脚本维护三台 EC2 增加运行和补丁管理，也缺少堆栈更新绑定。

D：单个跨账户函数还需解决多 VPC 连通性及调用生命周期，不能自然确保各部署同步更新。

options.text: Create an AWS CloudFormation template. Declare the users in the template. Attach the users to the database. Deploy the template in each account.
Create an AWS CloudFormation template that contains a custom resource to create the users in the database. Deploy the template in each account.
Write a script that creates the users. Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance in each account to run the script on the databases. Run the script in each account.
Implement an AWS Lambda function that creates the users in the database. Provide the function with the details of all three accounts.

question_text_original: A developer manages three AWS accounts. Each account contains an Amazon RDS DB instance in a private subnet. The developer needs to define users in each database in a consistent way. The developer must ensure that the same users are created and updated later in all three accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational eficiency?

question_text: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建新应用，并通过 Amazon API Gateway 暴露 API。多个开发团队并行开发不同组件。公司希望在尚未集成后端时发布 API，使依赖后端的团队能够在 API 后端开发完成前继续工作。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。API Gateway MOCK integration 可先定义接口和模拟响应，支持并行开发。

知识点／记忆点：先定义接口契约与样例响应，前后端即可并行；模拟集成在网关内返回响应，不需要任何占位后端。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Lambda 可以模拟，但仍需编写和部署一个不必要的后端。

C：EC2 增加服务器维护，且 AWS 集成类型不是连接任意 EC2 HTTP 应用的正确配置。

D：HTTP 代理需要真实端点，Lambda 层也不能直接关联 API 部署充当后端。

options.text: Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to MOCK. Configure the method integration request and integration response to associate a response with an HTTP status code. Create an API Gateway stage and deploy the API.
Create an AWS Lambda function that returns mocked responses and various HTTP status codes. Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to AWS_PROXY. Deploy the API.
Create an EC2 application that returns mocked HTTP responses. Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to AWS. Create an API Gateway stage and deploy the API.

Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value set to HTTP_PROXY. Add mapping templates and deploy the API. Create an AWS Lambda layer that returns various HTTP status codes. Associate the Lambda layer with the API deployment.

question_text_original: A company is building a new application that runs on AWS and uses Amazon API Gateway to expose APIs. Teams of developers are working on separate components of the application in parallel. The company wants to publish an API without an integrated backend so that teams that depend on the application backend can continue the development work before the API backend development is complete. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一个 AWS 应用从 Amazon SQS 队列接收消息并批量处理，再将数据发送到另一个 SQS 队列，供旧应用消费。旧系统处理某些交易数据最长需要 5 分钟。开发人员不能改变旧系统的行为，但需要确保其中不会发生乱序更新。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。SQS FIFO MessageGroupId 保序；visibility timeout 让失败消息稍后重新可见。

知识点／记忆点：延迟消息决定首次何时可见，可见性超时决定消费期间隐藏多久；两者不能互换，FIFO 保序还需按业务实体正确分组。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：标准队列即使批量发送并延迟，也不保证严格顺序。

C：可见性超时不会给标准队列增加 FIFO 排序保证。

D：发送延迟不能防止长任务处理中消息再次可见。

options.text: Use an SQS FIFO queue. Configure the visibility timeout value.
Use an SQS standard queue with a SendMessageBatchRequestEntry data type. Configure the DelaySeconds values.
Use an SQS standard queue with a SendMessageBatchRequestEntry data type. Configure the visibility timeout value.
Use an SQS FIFO queue. Configure the DelaySeconds value.

question_text_original: An application that runs on AWS receives messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and processes the messages in batches. The application sends the data to another SQS queue to be consumed by another legacy application. The legacy system can take up to 5 minutes to process some transaction data. A developer wants to ensure that there are no out-of-order updates in the legacy system. The developer cannot alter the behavior of the legacy system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司正在构建计算密集型应用，运行在一组 Amazon EC2 实例上，并使用初次部署时创建的附加 Amazon EBS 卷存储数据。应用处理敏感信息，所有数据都必须加密，且不能影响应用性能。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。EBS 卷加密保护 EC2 持久化数据，不依赖应用自制密码算法。

知识点／记忆点：存储层透明加密可覆盖持久卷而无需修改业务代码；加密根卷不代表其他卷或临时磁盘也已加密。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：改写到 S3 改变存储接口和 I/O 模型，不是保持现有 EBS 应用的最小改动。

C：自制算法增加安全风险与 CPU 开销，不应取代成熟存储加密。

D：根卷加密不能自动保护另行使用的临时磁盘数据。

options.text: Configure the fleet of EC2 instances to use encrypted EBS volumes to store data.
Configure the application to write all data to an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket.
Configure a custom encryption algorithm for the application that will encrypt and decrypt all data.
Configure an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that has an encrypted root volume and store the data to ephemeral disks.

question_text_original: A company is building a compute-intensive application that will run on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application uses attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes for storing data. The Amazon EBS volumes will be created at time of initial deployment. The application will process sensitive information. All of the data must be encrypted. The solution should not impact the application's performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在修复生产环境 AWS Lambda 函数的缺陷，并已在测试环境验证更新代码。希望先向少部分生产用户逐步推出，再扩大到全部用户；最初只能让 10% 的用户使用新代码。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。发布 Lambda version 后通过 alias 切换生产流量，保留旧版以便回滚。

适用前提与时效：权重分配的是调用比例而非固定用户群；若要求同一用户始终命中同版本，还需稳定分群路由。

知识点／记忆点：Lambda 别名的权重在同一函数的已发布版本之间分配调用，不是在不同函数、层或触发器之间分配。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Lambda 触发器不是管理两个函数版本权重的配置位置。

B：同一别名不能跨两个不同的 Lambda 函数分流。

C：代理集成定义请求转发形式，不提供所述版本权重配置。

options.text: Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda function trigger. Configure the traffic weights in the trigger between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

Create a new Lambda function that uses the updated code. Create a Lambda alias for the production Lambda function. Configure the Lambda alias to send 90% of the traffic to the production Lambda function, and send 10% of the traffic to the test Lambda function.

Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda proxy integration. Configure the Lambda proxy to split traffic between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda function alias. Configure the traffic weights in the Lambda alias between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

question_text_original: A developer is updating the production version of an AWS Lambda function to fix a defect. The developer has tested the updated code in a test environment. The developer wants to slowly roll out the updates to a small subset of production users before rolling out the changes to all users. Only 10% of the users should be initially exposed to the new code in production. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个消费 Amazon SQS 标准队列消息的 AWS Lambda 函数，发现部分消息被处理多次。如何以最具成本效益的方式解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。SQS FIFO 队列可保证消息组内顺序，标准队列不保证严格顺序。

适用前提与时效：A 不能保证 Lambda 绝不重复执行；只能按去重标识减少窗口内的重复发送，且标准队列不能原地转换为 FIFO，需要新建并迁移。

知识点／记忆点：生产端重复发送与消费端重新处理是不同问题；FIFO 去重窗口减少重复入队，但消费失败重试仍要求幂等处理。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：死信队列隔离反复失败的消息，不阻止已接收消息重复处理。

C：并发为 1 只串行化执行，消息仍可能再次投递。

D：改成 Kinesis 也存在消费者重试，迁移成本更高且未解决幂等性。

options.text: Change the Amazon SQS standard queue to an Amazon SQS FIFO queue by using the Amazon SQS message deduplication ID.
Set up a dead-letter queue.
Set the maximum concurrency limit of the AWS Lambda function to 1.
Change the message processing to use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams instead of Amazon SQS.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that consumes messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The developer notices that the Lambda function processes some messages multiple times. How should developer resolve this issue MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 开发人员正在优化一个处理 Amazon API Gateway REST API 请求的 AWS Lambda 函数，希望在生产环境中使用少量流量测试变更，且不能更改 API Gateway URL。应如何部署并测试？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：A。API Gateway production stage canary 可保持 URL 不变；原选项的部署顺序和 $LATEST 描述不严谨，Lambda alias/版本更稳妥。

知识点／记忆点：保持客户端 URL 不变，可以在同一 API 阶段内部切分流量；生产基线应固定已发布版本，避免可变 $LATEST 让对照组随开发变化。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：新建阶段通常形成新阶段 URL，且未配置小比例生产流量分配。

C：Lambda 别名不能指向 $LATEST。

D：直接部署到生产阶段会全量切换，没有小流量验证步骤。

options.text: Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. On the production API Gateway stage, define a canary release and set the percentage of traffic to direct to the canary release. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Publish the API to the canary stage.

Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Deploy a new API Gateway stage.

Define an alias on the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function alias. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. On the production API Gateway stage, define a canary release and set the percentage of traffic to direct to the canary release. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Publish to the canary stage.

Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Deploy the API to the production API Gateway stage.

question_text_original: A developer is optimizing an AWS Lambda function and wants to test the changes in production on a small percentage of all traffic. The Lambda function serves requests to a RE ST API in Amazon API Gateway. The developer needs to deploy their changes and perform a test in production without changing the API Gateway URL. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司发现，连接外部 SaaS 供应商的凭证以明文保存在配置文件中。开发人员需要保护 API 凭证，并强制每季度自动轮换。哪种方案最安全？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Secrets Manager rotation 可定期更换第三方凭证，但第三方系统仍需轮换集成。

知识点／记忆点：轮换加密密钥不等于轮换第三方密码；外部 SaaS 凭证轮换还需要调用供应商接口，并协调新旧凭证生效。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：KMS 密钥轮换不会自动更改被加密文件中的 SaaS 凭证。

B：STS 生成 AWS 临时凭证，不能自动替代任意第三方服务的认证凭证。

D：Parameter Store 不提供题述的第三方凭证自动轮换开关。

options.text: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the configuration file. Decrypt the configuration file when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor. Enable rotation.
Retrieve temporary credentials from AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) every 15 minutes. Use the temporary credentials when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor.
Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager and enable rotation. Configure the API to have Secrets Manager access.
Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and enable rotation. Retrieve the credentials when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor.

question_text_original: A company notices that credentials that the company uses to connect to an external software as a service (SaaS) vendor are stored in a configuration file as plaintext. The developer needs to secure the API credentials and enforce automatic credentials rotation on a quarterly basis. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

question_text: 一家公司的应用托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上，将对象保存到 Amazon S3，并允许用户下载。开发人员为存储桶开启 S3 阻止公有访问后，用户下载时报错。开发人员需要确保只有已登录应用的用户才能访问桶内对象。哪组步骤最安全？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：AE；修正答案：AC。EC2 用 instance profile 获授权，再生成 S3 presigned URL 供临时客户端下载。

知识点／记忆点：公有访问阻止不影响获授权的签名请求；应用先认证用户，再签发限定对象和有效期的下载凭证，避免给浏览器长期密钥。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：把长期 IAM 用户密钥存实例上比实例角色更难安全轮换。

D：GetObject 返回的数据或本地句柄不是浏览器可复用的授权下载链接。

E：仅说委托请求未定义用户认证、签名与对象授权机制，不能确保私有访问。

options.text: Create an EC2 instance profile and role with an appropriate policy. Associate the role with the EC2 instances.
Create an IAM user with an appropriate policy. Store the access key ID and secret access key on the EC2 instances.
Modify the application to use the S3 GeneratePresignedUrl API call.
Modify the application to use the S3 GetObject API call and to return the object handle to the user.
Modify the application to delegate requests to the S3 bucket.

question_text_original: A company has an application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The application stores objects in an Amazon S3 bucket and allows users to download objects from the S3 bucket. A developer turns on S3 Block Public Access for the S3 bucket. After this change, users report errors when they attempt to download objects. The developer needs to implement a solution so that only users who are signed in to the application can access objects in the S3 bucket. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way? (Choose two.)

question_text: Amazon SQS 队列是一个 AWS Lambda 函数的事件源，每条消息对应一个需要转为较低分辨率的视频文件。处理较长视频时函数超时，但超时设置已达到最大值。开发人员如何在不额外修改代码的情况下避免超时？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。增加 Lambda memory 同时增加 CPU 可能缩短转码；若仍超过 15 分钟需改用其他计算服务。

适用前提与时效：不要死记旧解析中的固定 15 分钟上限；运行限制按当前 Lambda 产品与调用方式核对，题目已说明超时配置达到该环境上限。

知识点／记忆点：执行超时与队列可见性超时分别限制计算和消息隐藏；增加内存会增加计算资源，能否提速仍取决于任务的实际瓶颈。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：延长队列隐藏时间不能让已到最大运行时间的函数继续执行。

C：托管 Lambda 不提供直接调整宿主 EC2 实例规格的配置。

D：引入多线程需要修改代码，且不一定解决串行或 I/O 瓶颈。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html

options.text: Increase the memory configuration of the Lambda function.
Increase the visibility timeout on the SQS queue.
Increase the instance size of the host that runs the Lambda function.
Use multi-threading for the conversion.

audit_label: 有条件成立；原答案已修正
question_text_original: An Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue serves as an event source for an AWS Lambda function. In the SQS queue, each item corresponds to a video file that the Lambda function must convert to a smaller resolution. The Lambda function is timing out on longer video files, but the Lambda function's timeout is already configured to its maximum value. What should a developer do to avoid the timeouts without additional code changes?

question_text: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建应用，后端包含 Amazon API Gateway REST API。前端开发人员必须等后端 API 就绪才能继续集成工作。公司需要让前端团队能够继续开发。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。API Gateway MOCK integration 不调用真实后端即可返回开发阶段样例。

知识点／记忆点：模拟后端要解决的是“没有真实服务仍可返回契约响应”，不是简单增加一个 URL 或打开代理转发。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：额外函数能够实现但需开发部署，运维多于网关内置模拟。

C：新建端点本身不会产生响应，仍需配置其集成。

D：代理资源只传递请求，后端未完成时无法提供所需样例响应。

options.text: Configure mock integrations for API Gateway API methods.
Integrate a Lambda function with API Gateway and return a mocked response.
Add new API endpoints to the API Gateway stage and returns a mocked response.
Configure a proxy resource for API Gateway API methods.

question_text_original: A company is building an application on AWS. The application's backend includes an Amazon API Gateway REST API. The company's frontend application developers cannot continue work until the backend API is ready for integration. The company needs a solution that will allow the frontend application developers to continue their work. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

question_text: 一家公司准备将应用迁移到其首个 AWS 环境。迁移前，开发人员正在创建概念验证应用，以验证在 AWS 上构建和部署容器应用的模式。应采取哪些步骤，以最少的运维工作部署该容器化概念验证应用？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：BD；修正答案：BE。容器推送 ECR，运行在 ECS Fargate；比自管 EC2 或迁移到 EKS 更少运维。

知识点／记忆点：容器交付分为映像仓库存储与计算运行两步；首个简单概念验证优先减少宿主机和编排平台管理。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：ZIP 是文件归档，不是包含运行环境的容器映像。

C：EC2 部署需要管理宿主机，不符合最少运维要求。

D：EKS Fargate 仍需维护 Kubernetes 配置和集群对象，简单概念验证比 ECS 更复杂。

options.text: Package the application into a .zip file by using a command line tool. Upload the package to Amazon S3.
Package the application into a container image by using the Docker CLI. Upload the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).
Deploy the application to an Amazon EC2 instance by using AWS CodeDeploy.
Deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on AWS Fargate.
Deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.

question_text_original: A company is preparing to migrate an application to the company's first AWS environment. Before this migration, a developer is creating a proof-of-concept application to validate a model for building and deploying container-based applications on AWS. Which combination of steps should the developer take to deploy the containerized proof-of-concept application with the LEAST operational effort? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员支持的应用访问 Amazon DynamoDB 表，其中 expirationDate 属性采用时间戳格式。应用根据该时间戳查找项目、归档并删除它们。应用即将停用，开发人员需要使用其他方式实现这一功能，并尽量少编写代码。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
