【答案核查：有条件成立；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。DynamoDB TTL 删除可触发 Streams 再由 Lambda 归档；TTL 属性必须是 Unix epoch 秒数且删除为异步。

知识点／记忆点：TTL 删除是异步清理机制，归档应消费包含旧映像的删除流记录；过期时间必须是受支持的 epoch 秒值而非任意日期字符串。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：自行扫描并调用删除 API 重复实现 TTL 的清理职责，代码更多。

C：GetRecords 是读取流的操作，不能按描述直接从 DynamoDB 表取得项目。

D：TTL 不支持把 SQS 死信队列指定为删除目标。

options.text: Enable TTL on the expirationDate attribute in the table. Create a DynamoDB stream. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the deleted items. Create a DynamoDB trigger for the Lambda function.

Create two AWS Lambda functions: one to delete the items and one to process the items. Create a DynamoDB stream. Use the DeleteItem API operation to delete the items based on the expirationDate attribute. Use the GetRecords API operation to get the items from the DynamoDB stream and process them.

Create two AWS Lambda functions: one to delete the items and one to process the items. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the Lambda functions. Use the DeleteItem API operation to delete the items based on the expirationDate attribute. Use the GetRecords API operation to get the items from the DynamoDB table and process them.

Enable TTL on the expirationDate attribute in the table. Specify an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue as the target to delete the items. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the items.

audit_label: 有条件成立；原答案已修正
question_text_original: A developer supports an application that accesses data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. One of the item attributes is expirationDate in the timestamp format. The application uses this attribute to find items, archive them, and remove them from the table based on the timestamp value. The application will be decommissioned soon, and the developer must find another way to implement this functionality. The developer needs a solution that will require the least amount of code to write. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员需要在应用中使用一个自定义机器学习库，当前大小为 15 GB 且持续增长。应用由 AWS Lambda 函数组成，所有函数都必须能访问该库。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。15 GB 库超出 Lambda package/layer 容量，可用挂载 EFS 共享依赖。

知识点／记忆点：共享依赖选型应同时检查部署制品容量、临时磁盘容量与多函数共享需求；网络文件系统使依赖独立于代码发布。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Layer 与函数包共同计入解压容量限制，不能容纳 15 GB 库。

B：下载 15 GB 库超过常规 Lambda 临时存储容量，并显著增加启动时间。

C：Lambda 容器镜像未压缩大小限制为 10 GB，库本身已超限。

options.text: Save the library in Lambda layers. Attach the layers to all Lambda functions.
Save the library in Amazon S3. Download the library from Amazon S3 inside the Lambda function.
Save the library as a Lambda container image. Redeploy the Lambda functions with the new image.
Save the library in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all the Lambda functions.

question_text_original: A developer needs to implement a custom machine learning (ML) library in an application. The size of the library is 15 GB. The size of the library is increasing. The application uses AWS Lambda functions. All the Lambda functions must have access to the library. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在设计无服务器游戏应用，用户通过浏览器注册和登录。应用代表用户向 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 后方的一组 AWS Lambda 函数发出请求。开发人员需要在登录页面实现注册和登录，尽量减少运维开销及用户身份的持续管理。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。Cognito user pool 可联合社交身份提供登录；不应自行保管浏览器用户密码。

适用前提与时效：A 混写用户池与身份池；HTTP API 使用 JWT 授权时未必需要身份池。

知识点／记忆点：用户池负责注册登录及令牌，身份池将身份换成 AWS 临时凭证；认证与资源授权应分层。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：IAM 组不是消费者登录系统，也不能通过给组附加角色完成注册。

C：自行用 RDS 管理账户和授权增加身份系统的维护负担。

D：表的 IAM 策略不会实现密码安全管理、用户登录和令牌签发。

options.text: Create Amazon Cognito user pools for external social identity providers. Configure IAM roles for the identity pools.
Program the sign-in page to create users' IAM groups with the IAM roles attached to the groups.
Create an Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance to store the users and manage the permissions to the backend resources in AWS.
Configure the sign-in page to register and store the users and their passwords in an Amazon DynamoDB table with an attached IAM policy.

question_text_original: A developer is designing a serverless application for a game in which users register and log in through a web browser. The application makes requests on behalf of users to a set of AWS Lambda functions that run behind an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API. The developer needs to implement a solution to register and log in users on the application's sign-in page. The solution must minimize operational overhead and must minimize ongoing management of user identities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司将 Web 应用托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上，实例配置为将日志流式发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。当 5 分钟内应用错误消息数超过设定阈值时，公司需要收到 Amazon SNS 通知。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。CloudWatch Logs metric filter 从日志 ERROR 模式生成指标并设置 alarm。

知识点／记忆点：日志模式需先变成数值指标，再按时间窗口聚合告警；日志转发本身不负责阈值计算。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：SNS 负责投递通知，不负责统计五分钟错误数量。

B：订阅筛选器负责转发日志，不会自行聚合数量并直接触发 SNS 阈值告警。

C：Inspector 评估漏洞，不统计应用错误日志。

options.text: Rewrite the application code to stream application logs to Amazon SNS. Configure an SNS topic to send a notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.
Configure a subscription filter on the CloudWatch Logs log group. Configure the filter to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

Install and configure the Amazon Inspector agent on the EC2 instances to monitor for errors. Configure Amazon Inspector to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

Create a CloudWatch metric filter to match the application error pattern in the log data. Set up a CloudWatch alarm based on the new custom metric. Configure the alarm to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

question_text_original: A company has a web application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are configured to stream logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company needs to receive an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification when the number of application error messages exceeds a defined threshold within a 5-minute period. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一个照片分享应用使用 Amazon S3 保存图片，由第三方公司人工审核不当内容。审核在上传后 1 到 24 小时内完成，结果写入以 S3 对象键为主键的 Amazon DynamoDB 表，并可通过第三方创建的 REST API 查询。开发人员需要自动根据审核结果为所有 S3 对象添加标签。哪种做法的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：B。SQS visibility timeout 最长 12 小时，不能设为 24 小时；Step Functions Wait 可等待 24 小时后取审核结果。

适用前提与时效：24 小时等待依赖题设审核期限，实际仍应处理迟到结果和重复事件。

知识点／记忆点：长时间业务等待应保存为工作流状态，避免占用计算资源；消息可见性超时是处理锁定机制。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：SQS 可见性超时最长 12 小时，不能设为 24 小时。

C：周期查找所有未标记对象需要扫描、分页与重复检查，增加实现负担。

D：EC2 与 cron 需要维护实例和调度任务，运维成本更高。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to run in response to the s3:ObjectCreated event type. Write the S3 key to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue with a visibility timeout of 24 hours. Create and configure a second Lambda function to read items from the queue. Retrieve the results for each item from the DynamoDB table. Tag each S3 object accordingly.

Create an AWS Lambda function to run in response to the s3:ObjectCreated event type. Integrate the function into an AWS Step Functions standard workflow. Define an AWS Step Functions Wait state and set the value to 24 hours. Create and configure a second Lambda function to retrieve the audit results and tag the S3 objects accordingly after the Wait state is over.

Create an AWS Lambda function to load all untagged S3 objects. Retrieve the results for each item from the REST API and tag each S3 object accordingly. Create and configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to run at regular intervals. Set the Lambda function as a target for the EventBridge rule.

Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Deploy a script to the EC2 instance to use the external database results to tag the S3 objects accordingly. Configure a crontab file to run the script at regular intervals.

question_text_original: A photo sharing application uses Amazon S3 to store image files. All user images are manually audited for inappropriate content by a third-party company. The audits are completed 1-24 hours after user upload and the results are written to an Amazon DynamoDB table, which uses the S3 object key as a primary key. The database items can be queried by using a REST API created by the third-party company. An application developer needs to implement an automated process to tag all S3 objects with the results of the content audit. What should the developer do to meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数，将大型图片转换为第三方查看器支持的输出文件。最近增加了改进输出的新模块，但使部署包变大，代码变更部署耗时增加。开发人员如何加快函数部署？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：B。Lambda layer 用于共享函数依赖；S3 仅存放包本身不会自动加载依赖。

知识点／记忆点：把低频变化依赖与高频变化代码分离，可减少每次发布重新打包及上传的内容。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CodeDeploy 控制版本发布，不会自动缩小依赖包。

C：内存影响运行资源，不减少部署包上传体积。

D：S3 存储依赖不代表 Lambda 会自动加载，还需额外下载和加载逻辑。

options.text: Use AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the function code.
Use Lambda layers to package and load dependencies.
Increase the memory size of the function.
Use Amazon S3 to host the function dependencies.

question_text_original: A company has built an AWS Lambda function to convert large image files into output files that can be used in a third-party viewer application. The company recently added a new module to the function to improve the output of the generated files. However, the new module has increased the bundle size and has increased the time that is needed to deploy changes to the function code. How can a developer increase the speed of the Lambda function deployment?

question_text: 开发人员为部门创建静态网站，将静态资源部署到 Amazon S3，并通过 Amazon CloudFront 提供，分配使用源访问控制（OAC）访问存储桶。用户能够访问根 URL 和具体页面，但不指定文件名就无法访问目录；例如 /products/index.html 正常，而 /products/ 报错。开发人员需要支持不带文件名的目录访问，同时不能公开 S3 存储桶。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。OAC 使用 S3 REST origin，CloudFront Function 重写目录路径到 index.html；S3 website endpoint 不支持 OAC。

知识点／记忆点：默认根对象只处理分配根路径；私有 S3 REST 源的子目录首页需要请求路径重写。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：默认根对象不会自动为每个子目录补上 index.html。

B：S3 网站端点不支持 OAC，不能保持题目要求的私有源访问方式。

D：全部 404 改为根首页不能返回各子目录自己的首页，还会掩盖真实缺失资源。

options.text: Update the CloudFront distribution's settings to index.html as the default root object is set.

Update the Amazon S3 bucket settings and enable static website hosting. Specify index.html as the Index document. Update the S3 bucket policy to enable access. Update the CloudFront distribution's origin to use the S3 website endpoint.

Create a CloudFront function that examines the request URL and appends index.html when directories are being accessed. Add the function as a viewer request CloudFront function to the CloudFront distribution's behavior.

Create a custom error response on the CloudFront distribution with the HTTP error code set to the HTTP 404 Not Found response code and the response page path to /index.html. Set the HTTP response code to the HTTP 200 OK response code.

question_text_original: A developer creates a static website for their department. The developer deploys the static assets for the website to an Amazon S3 bucket and serves the assets with Amazon CloudFront. The developer uses origin access control (OAC) on the CloudFront distribution to access the S3 bucket. The developer notices users can access the root URL and specific pages but cannot access directories without specifying a file name. For example, /products/index.html works, but /products/ returns an error. The developer needs to enable accessing directories without specifying a file name without exposing the S3 bucket publicly. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在测试使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 部署的 RESTful 应用。使用无效凭证测试登录时，收到 HTTP 405: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED。开发人员已确认测试向资源发送了正确请求。应用应返回哪种 HTTP 错误？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。API Gateway 缺失或无效认证通常返回 HTTP 401；具体还应看 authorizer 配置。

适用前提与时效：网关实际返回 401 或 403 取决于认证方式和响应配置，本题按登录失败语义判断。

知识点／记忆点：状态码应区分认证失败、资源不存在、服务不可用和协议版本不支持，方便客户端作出正确处理。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：404 表示资源不存在，不表示凭证错误。

C：503 表示服务暂时不可用，不表示身份认证失败。

D：505 表示 HTTP 版本不支持，与凭证无关。

options.text: HTTP 401
HTTP 404
HTTP 503
HTTP 505

question_text_original: A developer is testing a RESTful application that is deployed by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. When the developer tests the user login by using credentials that are not valid, the developer receives an HTTP 405: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED error. The developer has verified that the test is sending the correct request for the resource. Which HTTP error should the application return in response to the request?

question_text: 开发人员必须使用多重身份验证（MFA），访问另一个 AWS 账户中 Amazon S3 存储桶的数据。应将 MFA 信息用于哪个 AWS Security Token Service（AWS STS）API 操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：D。跨账户 AssumeRole 支持 MFA 条件并返回临时凭证。

知识点／记忆点：跨账户授权同时依赖调用方权限和目标角色信任；MFA 条件可约束临时角色会话。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Web 身份联合接受身份提供商令牌，不按题意直接接收 IAM MFA 设备及验证码。

B：GetFederationToken 不承担目标账户角色，也不接收题意中的 MFA 参数。

C：SAML 联合依赖断言，MFA 通常在身份提供商侧完成，不是该参数调用方式。

options.text: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
GetFederationToken
AssumeRoleWithSAML
AssumeRole

question_text_original: A developer must use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access data in an Amazon S3 bucket that is in another AWS account. Which AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) API operation should the developer use with the MFA information to meet this requirement?

question_text: 开发人员在 Amazon EC2 实例上设计了一个应用，会向 Amazon S3 存储桶中的对象发出 API 请求。哪组步骤能确保以最安全的方式发出请求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BC。EC2 role 必须通过 instance profile 绑定到实例，避免长期密钥。

知识点／记忆点：实例配置文件把 EC2 与角色相连，SDK 可自动获取并刷新临时凭证，无需分发长期密钥。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：IAM 用户及组不能为实例提供自动轮换的角色凭证。

D：角色不能分配给 IAM 组供 EC2 承担。

E：环境变量中的用户密钥仍是长期凭证，需要保管和轮换。

options.text: Create an IAM user that has permissions to the S3 bucket. Add the user to an IAM group.
Create an IAM role that has permissions to the S3 bucket.
Add the IAM role to an instance profile. Attach the instance profile to the EC2 instance.
Create an IAM role that has permissions to the S3 bucket. Assign the role to an IAM group.
Store the credentials of the IAM user in the environment variables on the EC2 instance.

question_text_original: A developer designed an application on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application makes API requests to objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which combination of steps will ensure that the application makes the API requests in the MOST secure manner? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一个 AWS Lambda 函数需要 Amazon S3 存储桶的读取权限，以及 Amazon DynamoDB 表的读写权限。正确的 IAM 策略已经存在。授予函数这些权限的最安全方式是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。Lambda execution role 承载访问 S3 和 DynamoDB 的 IAM policy。

知识点／记忆点：执行角色决定函数能调用什么，资源策略决定谁能调用函数，两种授权方向不能混淆。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：访问其他服务的身份策略应附加到执行角色，不直接附加给函数。

C：用户长期密钥增加保管和轮换负担，执行角色已能满足需求。

D：根账户密钥权限过大，加密保存也不符合最小权限。

options.text: Attach the existing IAM policy to the Lambda function.
Create an IAM role for the Lambda function. Attach the existing IAM policy to the role. Attach the role to the Lambda function.
Create an IAM user with programmatic access. Attach the existing IAM policy to the user. Add the user access key ID and secret access key as environment variables in the Lambda function.
Add the AWS account root user access key ID and secret access key as encrypted environment variables in the Lambda function.

question_text_original: An AWS Lambda function requires read access to an Amazon S3 bucket and requires read/write access to an Amazon DynamoDB table. The correct IAM policy already exists. What is the MOST secure way to grant the Lambda function access to the S3 bucket and the DynamoDB table?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS Step Functions 自动编排工作流，将每一步定义为 AWS Lambda 函数任务。状态机在 GetResource 任务中会因 IllegalArgumentException 或 TooManyRequestsException 失败。遇到 IllegalArgumentException 时必须停止；遇到 TooManyRequestsException 时，等待 10 秒后只再重试一次，第二次失败则停止。如何在不增加不必要复杂度的情况下实现该重试逻辑？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：C。Step Functions Retry/Catch 用于重试临时错误；单纯 Delay 不会在失败后自动重试。

知识点／记忆点：Retry 负责次数和间隔，Catch 负责失败后的跳转；只匹配可恢复异常，让其他异常直接失败。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：等待再回跳增加额外状态，而且没有限制只重试一次。

B：重试间隔和最大尝试次数属于 Retry，不是 Catch 参数。

D：复制任务立即跳转缺少十秒等待，并增加重复状态维护。

options.text: Add a Delay task after the GetResource task. Add a catcher to the GetResource task. Configure the catcher with an error type of TooManyRequestsException. Configure the next step to be the Delay task. Configure the Delay task to wait for an interval of 10 seconds. Configure the next step to be the GetResource task.

Add a catcher to the GetResource task. Configure the catcher with an error type of TooManyRequestsException, an interval of 10 seconds, and a maximum attempts value of 1. Configure the next step to be the GetResource task.
Add a retrier to the GetResource task. Configure the retrier with an error type of TooManyRequestsException, an interval of 10 seconds, and a maximum attempts value of 1.

Duplicate the GetResource task. Rename the new GetResource task to TryAgain. Add a catcher to the original GetResource task. Configure the catcher with an error type of TooManyRequestsException. Configure the next step to be TryAgain.

question_text_original: A developer is using AWS Step Functions to automate a workflow. The workflow defines each step as an AWS Lambda function task. The developer notices that runs of the Step Functions state machine fail in the GetResource task with either an IllegalArgumentException error or a TooManyRequestsException error. The developer wants the state machine to stop running when the state machine encounters an IllegalArgumentException error. The state machine needs to retry the GetResource task one additional time after 10 seconds if the state machine encounters a TooManyRequestsException error. If the second attempt fails, the developer wants the state machine to stop running. How can the developer implement the Lambda retry functionality without adding unnecessary complexity to the state machine?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建使用 AWS Lambda 函数的无服务器应用，并通过 AWS CloudFormation 部署。应用向 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 写入日志，模板中已创建所需日志组。开发人员需要修改模板，使应用运行时能够获取日志组名称。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。Lambda 环境变量可传日志组标识；选项给的是 ARN 而题干要 name，代码需提取或改传 Ref 的日志组名称。

适用前提与时效：题干要名称而 D 给 ARN，应传日志组 Ref 或在代码中提取名称。

知识点／记忆点：模板创建资源后要显式注入运行时配置；模板宏和静态映射不会自动变为函数变量。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Include 只插入模板片段，不会自动把资源名注入应用。

B：UserData 是实例启动配置，不是 Lambda 配置入口。

C：Mappings 是模板求值查找表，应用不能直接当运行时参数读取。

options.text: Use the AWS::Include transform in CloudFormation to provide the log group's name to the application.
Pass the log group's name to the application in the user data section of the CloudFormation template.
Use the CloudFormation template's Mappings section to specify the log group's name for the application.
Pass the log group's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as an environment variable to the Lambda function.

audit_label: 有条件成立；原答案已修正
question_text_original: A developer is creating a serverless application that uses an AWS Lambda function. The developer will use AWS CloudFormation to deploy the application. The application will write logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The developer has created a log group in a CloudFormation template for the application to use. The developer needs to modify the CloudFormation template to make the name of the log group available to the application at runtime. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 开发人员通过 AWS CLI 创建 Amazon DynamoDB 表。表必须使用 AWS 自有加密密钥进行服务器端加密。应如何创建？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。DynamoDB 新建表默认启用 server-side encryption；无需手动提供 AWS owned key ARN。

知识点／记忆点：AWS 自有、AWS 托管和客户管理密钥的控制权及可见性不同；默认加密不等于需要自行创建密钥。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：客户管理密钥不符合指定 AWS 自有密钥的要求。

B：AWS 托管密钥不是 AWS 自有密钥，且由 AWS 服务管理创建。

C：客户不能创建 AWS 自有密钥并取得其 ARN 用于配置。

options.text: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.
Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.
Create an AWS owned key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.
Create the DynamoDB table with the default encryption options.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an Amazon DynamoDB table by using the AWS CLI. The DynamoDB table must use server-side encryption with an AWS owned encryption key. How should the developer create the DynamoDB table to meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的应用跨多个 AWS 区域运行，间歇性出现性能问题。开发人员必须使用 AWS X-Ray 实现分布式跟踪，以排查根因。应如何操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。X-Ray trace annotation 可按 Region 过滤服务跟踪；用户自定义 segment 则可能需主动加注解。

适用前提与时效：实际字段取决于服务集成，应检查具体追踪片段中的区域信息。

知识点／记忆点：追踪检索维度需要可索引的 annotation；自定义服务应主动提供区域等维度，不能假定平台能补全所有标签。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：控制台用于查看追踪，不为已采集服务自动补注解。

C：Daemon 主要传输片段，不负责为所有服务生成注解。

D：该项颠倒 AWS 服务区域信息与自定义服务自行提供注解的责任。

options.text: Use the X-Ray console to add annotations for AWS services and user-defined services.
Use Region annotation that X-Ray adds automatically for AWS services. Add Region annotation for user-defined services.
Use the X-Ray daemon to add annotations for AWS services and user-defined services.
Use Region annotation that X-Ray adds automatically for user-defined services. Configure X-Ray to add Region annotation for AWS services.

question_text_original: A company has an application that runs across multiple AWS Regions. The application is experiencing performance issues at irregular intervals. A developer must use AWS X-Ray to implement distributed tracing for the application to troubleshoot the root cause of the performance issues. What should the developer do to meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行应用，其 AWS Lambda 函数以名为 high priority queue 的 Amazon SQS 队列为事件源。开发人员还要将名为 low priority queue 的队列添加为事件源。函数在处理低优先级队列消息前，必须始终先从高优先级队列同时读取最多 10 条消息，并将并发调用限制为 100。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：信息不足】
参考答案：A。batch size、delivery delay、maximum concurrency 均不能保证两条 SQS event source 的严格处理优先级；原题没有完全正确选项。

适用前提与时效：保留 A，但批量大小同样不保证严格优先级或总并发 100，原选项无完整解。

知识点／记忆点：批量、等待窗口和并发限制控制吞吐延迟，不构成跨队列优先级调度；严格优先需要显式协调消费顺序。

选项核查与缺失信息：

B：首次投递延迟不能保证高优先队列始终先被读取。

C：给低优先队列更多并发不能建立优先顺序。

D：不同聚合窗口仍允许两个事件源并发处理。

options.text: Set the event source mapping batch size to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.
Set the delivery delay to 0 seconds for the high priority queue and to 10 seconds for the low priority queue.
Set the event source mapping maximum concurrency to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.
Set the event source mapping batch window to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.

question_text_original: A company runs an application on AWS. The application uses an AWS Lambda function that is configured with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue called high priority queue as the event source. A developer is updating the Lambda function with another SQS queue called low priority queue as the event source. The Lambda function must always read up to 10 simultaneous messages from the high priority queue before processing messages from low priority queue. The Lambda function must be limited to 100 simultaneous invocations. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家数据可视化公司希望加强核心应用的安全性。应用在 AWS 的开发、预发布、预生产和生产环境中运行。公司需要加密所有存储的敏感凭证、自动轮换凭证，并为每个环境保存一个版本。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。Secrets Manager 应按环境隔离 secret，避免不同环境共用同一凭证版本。

知识点／记忆点：版本表达同一秘密的轮换历史，环境表达独立权限边界；不同环境应可独立授权、轮换和回滚。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：共用秘密的不同版本会把环境与轮换版本生命周期混在一起，难以独立隔离。

B：Parameter Store 版本不提供数据库凭证自动轮换，并混淆环境与版本。

C：代码环境变量不提供自动凭证轮换和秘密生命周期管理。

options.text: Configure AWS Secrets Manager versions to store different copies of the same credentials across multiple environments.
Create a new parameter version in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for each environment. Store the environment-specific credentials in the parameter version.
Configure the environment variables in the application code. Use different names for each environment type.
Configure AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret for each environment type. Store the environment-specific credentials in the secret.

question_text_original: A data visualization company wants to strengthen the security of its core applications. The applications are deployed on AWS across its development, staging, pre-production, and production environments. The company needs to encrypt all of its stored sensitive credentials. The sensitive credentials need to be automatically rotated. A version of the sensitive credentials need to be stored for each environment. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

question_text: 开发人员正在调查应用问题：消息发送到 Amazon SQS 队列，AWS Lambda 函数轮询队列并通过 Amazon SES 发送邮件。高流量期间，用户收到重复邮件。哪些原因可能解释这种情况？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AD。SQS standard 至少一次投递可能重复；visibility timeout 不足也会让消息处理期间重新可见。

知识点／记忆点：邮件等外部副作用需要业务幂等键；队列至少一次交付与处理超时都可能让同一消息再次执行。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：标准队列不承诺恰好一次处理，不能因此认定为用户错误。

C：DKIM 影响邮件身份验证，不会让队列消息自动重复消费。

E：退信率衡量投递失败比例，本身不会触发同一业务邮件重复发送。

options.text: Standard SQS queues support at-least-once message delivery.
Standard SQS queues support exactly-once processing, so the duplicate email messages are because of user error.
Amazon SES has the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) authentication incorrectly configured.
The SQS queue's visibility timeout is lower than or the same as the Lambda function's timeout.
The Amazon SES bounce rate metric is too high.

question_text_original: A developer is investigating an issue in part of a company's application. In the application, messages are sent to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The AWS Lambda function polls messages from the SQS queue and sends email messages by using Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES). Users have been receiving duplicate email messages during periods of high traffic. Which reasons could explain the duplicate email messages? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员将公司应用部署到 Amazon EC2 实例，应用每天生成数 GB 数据文件。文件很少访问，但存储的第一年内，用户请求后必须在几分钟内获取。公司必须保存文件 7 年。如何以最具成本效益的方式实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。第一年用 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 满足分钟级读取，随后转 Deep Archive 保留 7 年。

适用前提与时效：Lifecycle 转换不自动确保七年保留，实际还需避免提前过期删除；成本仍与对象大小和访问量有关。

知识点／记忆点：按不同保留阶段分别匹配检索时延与存储成本；低频访问不代表允许小时级恢复。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：第一年 Standard 和后续 Flexible Retrieval 的存储成本通常高于对应的低频即时及深度归档方案。

C：EBS 加快照适合块卷备份，为长期保留对象文件增加卷管理和恢复流程。

D：EFS 提供共享文件访问，题目不需要该能力，长期容量成本通常更高。

options.text: Store the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use the S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the files to the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class after 1 year.
Store the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use the S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the files to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 1 year.
Store the files on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to create snapshots of the EBS volumes and to store those snapshots in Amazon S3.

Store the files on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) mount. Configure EFS lifecycle management to transition the files to the EFS Standard- Infrequent Access (Standard-IA) storage class after 1 year.

question_text_original: A developer is deploying a company's application to Amazon EC2 instances. The application generates gigabytes of data files each day. The files are rarely accessed, but the files must be available to the application's users within minutes of a request during the first year of storage. The company must retain the files for 7 years. How can the developer implement the application to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 公司的开发人员通过 AWS CloudFormation 部署应用，堆栈包含作为应用配置的 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 参数，应用可以修改参数值。开发人员更新堆栈、创建带标签的新资源时，发现参数值被重置，应用最近做出的修改被忽略。开发人员需要更改部署方式，避免重置在堆栈之外修改的参数值。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。CloudFormation stack policy 的显式 Deny 可阻止更新 Parameter Store 资源；DeletionPolicy 只管删除。

适用前提与时效：Stack policy 拒绝更新时可能使包含该资源变更的栈更新失败，并非自动忽略更新；长期宜把可变配置与基础设施生命周期分开。

知识点／记忆点：声明式模板会把资源收敛到模板状态，应用自行修改配置会产生漂移；更新保护与删除保留是两类机制。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Retain 约束删除时的保留行为，不阻止更新参数值。

B：迁移 DynamoDB 需要修改应用读取和写入逻辑，比设置更新保护工作更多。

C：迁移 RDS 还需数据库和应用改造，开发及运维成本更高。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/protect-stack-resources.html

options.text: Modify the CloudFormation stack to set the deletion policy to Retain for the Parameter Store parameters.

Create an Amazon DynamoDB table as a resource in the CloudFormation stack to hold configuration data for the application. Migrate the parameters that the application is modifying from Parameter Store to the DynamoDB table.

Create an Amazon RDS DB instance as a resource in the CloudFormation stack. Create a table in the database for parameter configuration. Migrate the parameters that the application is modifying from Parameter Store to the configuration table.
Modify the CloudFormation stack policy to deny updates on Parameter Store parameters.

question_text_original: A company's developer has deployed an application in AWS by using AWS CloudFormation. The CloudFormation stack includes parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store that the application uses as configuration settings. The application can modify the parameter values. When the developer updated the stack to create additional resources with tags, the developer noted that the parameter values were reset and that the values ignored the latest changes made by the application. The developer needs to change the way the company deploys the CloudFormation stack. The developer also needs to avoid resetting the parameter values outside the stack. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 一家公司的社交媒体应用流量很大，用户帖子及互动持续写入 Amazon RDS 数据库。数据变化频繁，类型可能复杂，读取请求必须保持极低延迟。目前架构难以高效提供这些快速更新的数据。哪种方案能够提高性能？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。ElastiCache for Redis 可缓存高频读取，不能把 CloudFront 直接放在 RDS 前面。

知识点／记忆点：写穿缓存需在数据库写入路径同步维护缓存，读路径才能低延迟获取新值；还应考虑写入失败、失效与一致性。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：DAX 是 DynamoDB 缓存，不能作为 RDS 的透明缓存层。

B：S3 Transfer Acceleration 加速 S3 对象传输，不能配置在 RDS 上。

C：CloudFront 缓存 HTTP 内容，不能直接以 RDS 数据库协议作为源站。

options.text: Use Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in front of the RDS database to provide a caching layer for the high volume of rapidly changing data.
Set up Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on the RDS database to enhance the speed of data transfer from the databases to the application.
Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the RDS database to provide a caching layer for the high volume of rapidly changing data.
Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Update the application code to use a write-through caching strategy and read the data from Redis.

question_text_original: A company has a social media application that receives large amounts of traffic. User posts and interactions are continuously updated in an Amazon RDS database. The data changes frequently, and the data types can be complex. The application must serve read requests with minimal latency. The application's current architecture struggles to deliver these rapid data updates efficiently. The company needs a solution to improve the application's performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员创建了一个 AWS Lambda 函数，执行涉及多个 AWS 服务的一系列操作。函数运行时长高于正常水平。为确定原因，开发人员必须在不修改函数代码的情况下调查服务间流量。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。X-Ray active tracing 呈现 Lambda 跨服务调用耗时，CloudWatch Logs 本身不是分布式追踪。

适用前提与时效：仅开 active tracing 不保证所有出站 SDK 调用都有子分段；若没有现成埋点或支持集成，完整调用链仍需要 instrumentation，因此题目无代码修改的承诺有限。

知识点／记忆点：分布式追踪把一次请求的各阶段延迟关联起来；审计日志、配置历史和普通运行日志承担不同观察职责。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：CloudTrail 记录 API 审计事件，不能完整显示应用跨服务调用链的耗时。

C：Config 记录资源配置变更，不测量函数内各服务调用延迟。

D：默认 Lambda 日志可给出总执行时间，但没有自动关联的完整跨服务调用链。

options.text: Enable AWS X-Ray active tracing in the Lambda function. Review the logs in X-Ray.
Configure AWS CloudTrail. View the trail logs that are associated with the Lambda function.
Review the AWS Config logs in Amazon CloudWatch.
Review the Amazon CloudWatch logs that are associated with the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A developer created an AWS Lambda function that performs a series of operations that involve multiple AWS services. The function's duration time is higher than normal. To determine the cause of the issue, the developer must investigate traffic between the services without changing the function code. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司在本地数据中心运行图片处理服务，由 Kubernetes 集群上的容器化应用组成，所有应用共享同一个 NFS 来存储文件和数据。数据中心的 NFS 容量即将耗尽，需要尽快迁移到 AWS。AWS 上的 Kubernetes 集群必须具有高可用性。哪组措施能够满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：AE；修正答案：BE。EFS 提供共享 NFS 文件系统；EKS 保留 Kubernetes 编排，ECR 存镜像。

适用前提与时效：实际部署还需跨可用区工作节点及 EFS 挂载目标；镜像存 ECR，EFS 应承载共享数据而非作为镜像仓库。

知识点／记忆点：迁移容器时分别匹配编排接口和共享存储语义：Kubernetes 与 NFS 需求不能被普通容器服务或单区块卷替代。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：EBS 是块存储，不能直接等价替换多节点共享 NFS。

C：ECS 不保留 Kubernetes 编排接口，且 EBS 不提供题目所需共享 NFS。

D：EKS 符合编排要求，但普通 EBS 卷不能满足跨可用区的共享文件访问。

options.text: Transfer the information that is in the NFS share to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Upload the container images to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).
Transfer the information that is in the NFS share to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Upload the container images to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).

Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume at the required path for the container images.

Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume at the required path for the container images.

Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume at the required path for the container images.

question_text_original: A company has on-premises data centers that run an image processing service. The service consists of containerized applications that run on Kubernetes clusters. All the applications have access to the same NFS share for files and data storage. The company is running out of NFS capacity in the data centers and needs to migrate to AWS as soon as possible. The Kubernetes clusters must be highly available on AWS. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司的分析应用使用 AWS Lambda 函数异步处理交易数据。开发人员发现异步调用有时失败，希望失败时调用第二个 Lambda 函数处理错误并记录详情。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。异步 Lambda 的 on-failure destination 可把失败调用记录交给另一 Lambda。

知识点／记忆点：异步调用在重试耗尽后可以发送完整调用结果记录到失败目标；触发器定义输入来源，目标定义处理后的去向。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：X-Ray 负责观测，不会因捕获堆栈自动按此配置调用错误处理函数。

C：失败条件属于 destination 配置，不是 Lambda 输入触发器类型。

D：Lambda 没有该描述的实例状态检查告警，普通告警也不携带完整失败调用堆栈。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-retain-records.html

options.text: Configure a Lambda function destination with a failure condition. Specify Lambda function as the destination type. Specify the error-handling Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as the resource.

Enable AWS X-Ray active tracing on the initial Lambda function. Configure X-Ray to capture stack traces of the failed invocations. Invoke the error-handling Lambda function by including the stack traces in the event object.
Configure a Lambda function trigger with a failure condition. Specify Lambda function as the destination type. Specify the error-handling Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as the resource.

Create a status check alarm on the initial Lambda function. Configure the alarm to invoke the error-handling Lambda function when the alarm is initiated. Ensure that the alarm passes the stack trace in the event object.

question_text_original: A company has an analytics application that uses an AWS Lambda function to process transaction data asynchronously. A developer notices that asynchronous invocations of the Lambda function sometimes fail. When failed Lambda function invocations occur, the developer wants to invoke a second Lambda function to handle errors and log details. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司推出了一项仅对特定高级客户群开放的新功能。开发人员需要根据性能和反馈随时启用或关闭，并快速验证和部署这些配置，而不造成中断。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。AppConfig feature flags 可按客户群发布，并验证配置降低发布风险。

知识点／记忆点：功能开关把上线代码与开放功能解耦；配置验证、渐进发布和回滚能降低面向特定用户群的发布风险。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Secrets Manager 面向秘密管理，没有此处所说生命周期规则来控制功能开关。

C：AWS Config 检查资源配置合规性，不提供应用功能开关部署流程。

D：Parameter Store 可存值，但没有选项所述生命周期规则来完成验证、受控发布和开关管理。

options.text: Use AWS AppConfig to manage the feature configuration and to validate and deploy changes. Use feature flags to turn the feature on and off.
Use AWS Secrets Manager to securely manage and validate the feature configurations. Enable lifecycle rules to turn the feature on and off.
Use AWS Config to manage the feature configuration and validation. Set up AWS Config rules to turn the feature on and off based on predefined conditions.
Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store and validate the configuration settings for the feature. Enable lifecycle rules to turn the feature on and off.

question_text_original: A company introduced a new feature that should be accessible to only a specific group of premium customers. A developer needs the ability to turn the feature on and off in response to performance and feedback. The developer needs a solution to validate and deploy these configurations quickly without causing any disruptions. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员必须获得产品负责人批准，才能通过 AWS CodePipeline 将应用代码部署到生产环境。开发人员已配置 Amazon SNS 主题向产品负责人发送通知。获取批准时，运维效率最高的方案是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。CodePipeline 单独前置 manual approval stage 才能保证生产部署前获批；SNS 可发审批通知。

适用前提与时效：C 若明确设置审批动作 runOrder 小于部署动作，也能实现先审批；独立阶段不是技术上唯一可行方案。

知识点／记忆点：审批必须处于部署前的依赖链上；通知只提醒人处理，不能代替暂停流水线的审批动作。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：自建审批状态机重复实现 CodePipeline 已有能力，运维工作更多。

C：仅放在同一阶段不能保证先审批，仍需正确设置 runOrder。

D：只创建通知规则没有增加人工审批动作，不会阻止生产部署。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/approvals-action-add.html

options.text: Add a new stage to CodePipeline before the production deployment. Add a manual approval action to the new stage. Add a new notification rule in the pipeline settings. Specify manual approval as the event that initiates the notification. Specify the SNS topic's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to notify the product owner.

Develop an AWS Step Functions state machine that sends a notification to the product owner and accepts an approval. Add a new stage to CodePipeline before the production deployment. Add the state machine as a Step Functions action to the new stage.
Add a manual approval action to the existing production deployment stage in CodePipeline. Specify the SNS topic's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) while configuring the new manual approval action.

Edit the settings in CodePipeline. Create a new notification rule. Specify manual approval as the event that initiates the notification. Create a new notification target. Specify the SNS topic to notify the product owner. Save the notification rule.

question_text_original: A developer needs approval from a product owner before the developer can deploy code for an application to production. The developer uses AWS CodePipeline to deploy the application. The developer configures an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send notifications to the product owner. Which solution is the MOST operationally efficient way for the developer to receive approval from the product owner?

question_text: 开发人员正在 AWS 上构建处理大量数据的无服务器工作流。AWS Step Functions 状态机调用多个 AWS Lambda 函数，其中一个在高需求期间偶尔超时失败。开发人员必须确保发生超时错误时，工作流自动重试失败的函数调用。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。Step Functions Retry 定义可重试错误、次数与退避间隔。

适用前提与时效：应依据实际错误名称匹配 Lambda 超时，任务超时与函数运行时超时可能产生不同错误。

知识点／记忆点：工作流重试应针对可恢复错误明确配置次数与退避；超时限制决定何时失败，不决定失败后再做什么。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Timeout 控制执行期限，不接受最大重试次数来自动重试任务。

C：Fail 状态结束执行，不负责重试。

D：引入 SNS 改变调用模式且增加组件，不能直接保留原任务的超时重试语义。

options.text: Add a Retry field in the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts and the timeout error type to retry on.
Add a Timeout field in the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts.
Add a Fail state to the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts.

Update the Step Functions state machine to pass the invocation request to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe a Lambda function to the SNS topic. Configure the Lambda function with the maximum number of retry attempts for a timeout error type.

question_text_original: A developer is building a serverless application on AWS for a workflow that processes high volumes of data. In the workflow, an AWS Step Functions state machine invokes several AWS Lambda functions. One of the Lambda functions occasionally fails because of timeout errors during periods of high demand. The developer must ensure that the workflow automatically retries the failed function invocation if a timeout error occurs. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司运行无服务器应用，由 AWS Lambda 函数处理数据并存入 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL。开发人员已为应用创建数据库用户凭证，需要通过 AWS Secrets Manager 管理并定期轮换密码。轮换期间必须保持高可用且无停机。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Secrets Manager alternating users rotation 可交替使用两套数据库凭证以避免轮换停机。

知识点／记忆点：交替用户轮换时保留一套有效凭证服务请求，再更新另一套；应用应读取当前版本并妥善刷新缓存。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：服务托管的主用户轮换不等于为自建应用用户配置交替轮换，单用户策略也可能出现切换窗口。

B：题目是自建数据库应用用户，应使用轮换函数执行交替用户策略，而非假定 RDS 代管此用户。

C：单用户更新密码时旧密码会失效，不如交替用户适合高可用切换。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/tutorials_rotation-alternating.html

options.text: Configure managed rotation with the single user rotation strategy.
Configure managed rotation with the alternating users rotation strategy.
Configure automatic rotation with the single user rotation strategy.
Configure automatic rotation with the alternating users rotation strategy.

question_text_original: A company runs a serverless application on AWS. The application includes an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function processes data and stores the data in an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. A developer created a user credentials in the database for the application. The developer needs to use AWS Secrets Manager to manage the user credentials. The password must to be rotated on a regular basis. The solution needs to ensure that there is high availability and no downtime for the application during secret rotation. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的应用包含托管在 Amazon S3 上的静态网站，以及调用 AWS Lambda 函数的 Amazon API Gateway API。高流量期间，用户反映应用间歇性变慢，但没有请求失败。开发人员需要从所有 Lambda 函数中找出执行缓慢的调用。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。X-Ray trace 与 Insights 可定位跨多个 Lambda 的慢调用；CloudTrail Insights 不测执行时长。

适用前提与时效：保留原参考 C，但 A 实际可行且更直接；X-Ray Insights 偏向故障率异常，题设无失败请求，不能据此否定 A。建议单独复核答案。

知识点／记忆点：定位慢调用可直接利用 REPORT 日志的 duration 按请求排序；错误异常检测与延迟查询并非同一能力。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：不能排除：跨日志组筛选 REPORT 并按 duration 排序可以直接找到慢执行，与题目要求相符。

B：CloudTrail Insights 关注 API 活动异常，不提供函数实际执行耗时排行。

D：为已有可查询日志增加 Glue 抽取和 S3 中转明显复杂，且仪表盘不会自动读取这些输出。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_QuerySyntax-examples.html

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_AnalyzeLogData-discoverable-fields.html

options.text: Perform a query across all the Lambda function log groups by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights. Filter on type of report and sort descending by Lambda function execution duration.
Enable AWS CloudTrail Insights on the account where the Lambda functions are running. After CloudTrail Insights has finished processing, review CloudTrail Insights to find the anomalous functions.

Enable AWS X-Ray for all the Lambda functions. Configure an X-Ray insight on a new group that includes all the Lambda functions. After the X-Ray insight has finished processing, review the X-Ray logs.

Set up AWS Glue to crawl through the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the Lambda functions. Configure an AWS Glue job to transform the logs into a structured format and to output the logs into Amazon S3. Use the Amazon CloudWatch dashboard to visualize the slowest functions based on the duration.

question_text_original: A company runs an application on AWS. The application consists of a static website that is hosted on Amazon S3. The application includes Amazon API Gateway APIs that invoke AWS Lambda functions. During a period of high traffic on the application, application users reported that the application was slow at irregular intervals. There were no failed requests. A developer needs to find the slow executions across all the Lambda functions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司正在构建使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 的无服务器应用，需要部署到开发、测试和生产环境。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。API Gateway stage variables 配 Lambda aliases 可为各环境复用部署配置。

知识点／记忆点：环境差异应通过引用与配置表达，避免复制业务代码；别名提供稳定入口，阶段变量选择环境目标。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：ECS 需要容器化和额外运行平台，偏离现有 API Gateway 与 Lambda 架构。

C：复制代码增加多环境漂移和维护工作。

D：Elastic Beanstalk 需要改造为其应用运行模式，不是现有无服务器架构的最小改动。

options.text: Use API Gateway stage variables and create Lambda aliases to reference environment-specific resources.
Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to deploy the application to the environments.
Duplicate the code for each environment. Deploy the code to a separate API Gateway stage.
Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to deploy the application to the environments.

question_text_original: A company is building a serverless application on AWS. The application uses Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The company wants to deploy the application to its development, test, and production environments. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员通过 AWS CloudFormation 部署 Amazon API Gateway API 和 AWS Step Functions 状态机。模板部署后，状态机必须引用该 API。开发人员需要让状态机引用 API Gateway 端点。哪种方案最具成本效益？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。Step Functions CloudFormation DefinitionSubstitutions 可注入同栈 API endpoint，无需额外 Secret。

知识点／记忆点：部署时已知的同栈资源标识可在模板求值后注入状态机定义，无需另建运行时配置存储。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：StateMachine 资源不支持 Lambda 式环境变量属性供定义读取。

C：非秘密端点无需 Secrets Manager，额外存储和读取增加成本。

D：AppConfig 配置档案不直接等于可引用端点值，并增加不必要的配置分发流程。

options.text: Configure the CloudFormation template to reference the API endpoint in the DefinitionSubstitutions property for the AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine resource.

Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in an environment variable for the AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine resource. Configure the state machine to reference the environment variable.
Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in a standard AWS::SecretsManager::Secret resource. Configure the state machine to reference the resource.
Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in a standard AWS::AppConfig::ConfigurationProfile resource. Configure the state machine to reference the resource.

question_text_original: A developer uses AWS CloudFormation to deploy an Amazon API Gateway API and an AWS Step Functions state machine. The state machine must reference the API Gateway API after the CloudFormation template is deployed. The developer needs a solution that uses the state machine to reference the API Gateway endpoint. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 开发人员正在 AWS 上构建应用，其中一个 AWS Lambda 函数处理 Amazon SQS 队列消息。函数有时失败或超时，开发人员需要查明部分消息无法处理的原因。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。增加 SQS visibility timeout 避免处理未完成就重新投递；CloudWatch Logs 查看 Lambda 异常原因。

知识点／记忆点：诊断消息失败应同时看函数异常和队列重投递窗口；可见性不足会放大重复消费，但不能替代定位根因。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：CloudTrail 不记录函数应用异常堆栈，盲目延长超时也无法说明根因。

C：SQS 事件源应在源队列设置 redrive policy，而非依赖函数异步调用 DLQ 设置。

D：新增数据库和失败写入代码增加维护，而且函数超时后未必能执行该代码。

options.text: Increase the maximum timeout of the Lambda function to 15 minutes. Check the AWS CloudTrail event history for error details.
Increase the visibility timeout of the SQS queue. Check logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for error details.
Create a dead-letter queue. Configure the Lambda function to send the failed messages to the dead-letter queue.
Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Update the Lambda function to send the failed messages to the DynamoDB table.

question_text_original: A developer is building an application on AWS. The application includes an AWS Lambda function that processes messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The Lambda function sometimes fails or times out. The developer needs to figure out why the Lambda function fails to process some messages. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 开发人员需要通过 AWS CloudFormation 将应用部署到三个 AWS 区域。每个区域都使用包含 Application Load Balancer（ALB）的 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 环境。开发人员希望通过 AWS Certificate Manager（ACM）向每个 ALB 部署 SSL 证书。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。ACM 证书为 Regional，多个 Region 的区域端点通常各需对应 Region 的证书。

适用前提与时效：选项中的 import into ALB 应理解为绑定监听器证书；可导出证书也必须先在目标区域导入 ACM 后绑定。

知识点／记忆点：区域负载均衡器使用同区域证书；CloudFront 的特定证书区域规则不能套用到各区域 ALB。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：单一区域证书 ARN 不能直接绑定其他区域 ALB。

B：ACM 没有可直接跨区绑定所有 ALB 的全局证书资源。

D：us-east-1 的特殊要求针对 CloudFront，不适用于所有区域 ALB。

options.text: Create a certificate in ACM in any one of the Regions. Import the certificate into the ALB that is in each Region.
Create a global certificate in ACM. Update the CloudFormation template to deploy the global certificate to each ALB.
Create a certificate in ACM in each Region. Import the certificate into the ALB for each Region.
Create a certificate in ACM in the us-east-1 Region. Update the CloudFormation template to deploy the certificate to each ALB.

question_text_original: A developer needs to deploy an application in three AWS Regions by using AWS CloudFormation. Each Region will use an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment with an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The developer wants to use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to deploy SSL certificates to each ALB. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司要求所有云资源都通过 AWS CloudFormation 模板部署。开发人员需要创建 Amazon SNS 自动通知来帮助执行此规则，已创建主题并订阅安全团队邮箱。如果未通过 CloudFormation 创建 IAM 角色，安全团队必须立即收到通知。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。EventBridge rule 可匹配 CloudTrail API 事件并按条件调用目标。

适用前提与时效：应验证 CloudTrail 中代表 CloudFormation 的身份字段，正确排除服务角色调用；事件投递是近实时而非严格零延迟。

知识点／记忆点：审计事件适合通过事件规则近实时路由；检测谁创建资源时要检查调用身份与服务上下文，而不是定时扫描。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：十五分钟轮询不满足立即通知，并增加 Lambda 扫描逻辑。

B：定时容器任务有最多十五分钟等待，还增加运行资源。

C：EC2 定时脚本延迟通知并需要维护服务器。

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the Lambda function to publish to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to invoke the Lambda function every 15 minutes.

Create an AWS Fargate task in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the Fargate task to publish to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Fargate task every 15 minutes.

Launch an Amazon EC2 instance that includes a script to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the script to publish to the SNS topic. Create a cron job to run the script on tile EC2 instance every 15 minutes.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Specify the SNS topic as the target of the EventBridge rule.

question_text_original: A company needs to deploy all its cloud resources by using AWS CloudFormation templates. A developer must create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) automatic notification to help enforce this rule. The developer creates an SNS topic and subscribes the email address of the company's security team to the SNS topic. The security team must receive a notification immediately if an IAM role is created without the use of CloudFormation. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司正在为部分新服务采用无服务器计算。开发团队需要使用 AWS SAM 创建无服务器基础设施，而且全部基础设施必须通过 AWS CloudFormation 模板部署。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。CloudFormation 的 Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31 启用 SAM 资源转换。

知识点／记忆点：SAM 是对 CloudFormation 的扩展语法，经 Transform 展开成底层资源；资源、参数和映射各有固定职责。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：直接写 Lambda 原生资源可部署函数，但没有使用 SAM 简化语法。

B：Mappings 不能声明可部署的 Serverless 资源。

D：Parameters 不能代替 Transform 或容纳 SAM Globals 的语义。

options.text: Add a Resources section to the CloudFormation templates that contains AWS::Lambda::Function resources.
Add a Mappings section to the CloudFormation templates that contains AWS::Serverless::Function and AWS::Serverless::API.
Add a Transform section to the CloudFormation templates. Use the AWS SAM syntax to define the resources.
Add a Parameters section to the CloudFormation templates that specifies the relevant AWS SAM Globals section.

question_text_original: A company is adopting serverless computing for some of its new services. A development team needs to create a serverless infrastructure by using AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). All infrastructure must be deployed by using AWS CloudFormation templates. What should the development team do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建异步调用 AWS Lambda 函数处理事件的应用，发现函数随机无法处理部分事件。开发人员需要调查并捕获这些处理失败的事件。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：C。Lambda 异步调用失败后可投递到 SQS DLQ；需授予执行角色写队列权限。

知识点／记忆点：异步事件重试耗尽后应保留原始事件供重放，并授予投递权限；函数异步 DLQ 与队列源 DLQ 是不同配置。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：普通 EventBridge 规则不会自动接收函数内部的所有失败事件并写入 DynamoDB。

B：Kinesis 不是 Lambda 异步调用 DLQ 支持的目标类型。

D：Lambda 异步调用 DLQ 不支持 SQS FIFO 队列。

options.text: Add an Amazon EventBridge rule for the Lambda function. Configure the EventBridge rule to react to failed events and to store the events in an Amazon DynamoDB table.
Configure the Lambda function with a dead-letter queue based in Amazon Kinesis. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.
Configure the Lambda function with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.
Configure the Lambda function with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO dead-letter queue. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.

question_text_original: A developer is building an application that invokes AWS Lambda functions asynchronously to process events. The developer notices that a Lambda function fails to process some events at random times. The developer needs to investigate the failed events and capture the events that the Lambda function fails to process. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家电商公司的无服务器应用通过 Amazon API Gateway REST API 调用 AWS Lambda 函数。函数处理数据、写入 Amazon DynamoDB，并调用第三方库存应用 API 处理订单。完成后，函数向客户端返回无响应体的 HTTP 200。高峰期 API 调用超过一定阈值时，第三方库存应用有时处理失败并返回错误。公司需要避免压垮第三方应用。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。API Gateway 先写 SQS 缓冲请求，再用 Lambda reserved concurrency 控制第三方并发。

适用前提与时效：并发数不等于每秒速率；若第三方限制 RPS，还需速率控制，并处理一次调用内并行发出多个请求的情形。

知识点／记忆点：用队列吸收突发流量，再以消费端并发约束下游压力；预置并发减少冷启动，保留并发才形成调用上限。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：DynamoDB 没有该项所说自动变换并直接调用外部 HTTP API 的内置函数。

C：预置并发不是最大并发上限，SNS 推送也没有这里所需的受控消费缓冲。

D：Athena 是查询引擎，查询结果位置不能直接指定数据库表与外部支付类 API 来完成调用。

options.text: Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into DynamoDB. Configure a DynamoDB intrinsic function to perform the transformation. Set up a DynamoDB stream to call the third-party stock application API with each new row. Delete the Lambda function.

Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function with a reserved concurrency equal to the third-party stock application's threshold. Set Lambda function to process the messages from the SQS queue.

Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure the Lambda function with a provisioned concurrency equal to the third-party stock application's threshold. Set the Lambda function to process the messages from the SNS topic.

Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into Amazon Athena. Configure the transformation of the data by using SQL with multiple query result locations set up to point to the DynamoDB table and the third-party stock fulfilment application API. Delete the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A company has built a serverless application for its ecommerce website. The application includes a REST API in Amazon API Gateway that invokes an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function processes data and stores the data in Amazon DynamoDB table. The Lambda function calls a third-party stock application API to process the order. After the ordered is processed, the Lambda function returns an HTTP 200 status code with no body to the client. During peak usage when the API calls exceeds a certain threshold, the third-party stock application sometimes fails to process the data and responds with error messages. The company needs a solution that will not overwhelm the third-party stock application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的应用运行在使用 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon ECS 集群上，位于 Application Load Balancer 后方，并使用 Amazon Aurora 存储数据。目前数据库凭证在应用内部加密和管理。公司希望采用更安全的存储方式，并定期轮换凭证。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。Secrets Manager 保存 ECS 应用凭证并支持 KMS 加密和轮换。

适用前提与时效：D 中 by using keys 不应理解为给容器分发长期访问密钥；使用任务角色，并按注入或运行时读取方式区分执行角色权限。

知识点／记忆点：秘密应由专门服务管理加密及轮换，容器用角色获取临时 AWS 权限；获取新版本与数据库密码轮换要协调。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：RDS 参数组控制数据库引擎配置，不是秘密存储与自动轮换服务。

B：Parameter Store 没有直接开启数据库秘密轮换的同等功能，而且选项授权目标与存储位置不一致。

C：普通 ECS 环境变量不提供秘密轮换流程，仅配置 KMS 权限不会自动实现轮换。

options.text: Migrate the secret credentials to Amazon RDS parameter groups. Encrypt the parameter by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant AWS KMS permissions to access Amazon RDS.

Migrate the credentials to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Encrypt the parameter by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager.

Migrate the credentials to ECS Fargate environment variables. Encrypt the credentials by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager.

Migrate the credentials to AWS Secrets Manager. Encrypt the credentials by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager by using keys.

question_text_original: A company hosts its application on AWS. The application runs on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate. The cluster runs behind an Application Load Balancer. The application stores data in an Amazon Aurora database. A developer encrypts and manages database credentials inside the application. The company wants to use a more secure credential storage method and implement periodic credential rotation. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 一家公司的移动应用包含调用 AWS Lambda 函数的 Amazon API Gateway REST API，函数处理应用数据。公司需要在部署之前，让一部分用户测试含新功能的更新函数，同时不影响其他用户。哪种方案需要的运维工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：信息不足】
参考答案：C。weighted alias、CodeDeploy canary 都是随机抽样流量，不能保证只让指定的一组用户测试；题目缺少定向路由选项。

适用前提与时效：保留 C；若 subset 仅指随机流量样本，A 也可行；若要求特定用户且不影响其他用户，C 同样不足，需定向路由。

知识点／记忆点：按比例金丝雀是随机分配请求，指定用户群测试则需要身份或用户属性路由；两种隔离目标不同。

选项核查与缺失信息：

A：加权别名随机选择请求，不能保证同一指定用户群专属访问新功能。

B：新建 REST API 增加配置，按比例 canary 也不固定用户身份。

D：非代理集成增加映射维护，流量百分比仍不能保证指定用户群隔离。

options.text: Create a new version of each Lambda function with a weighted alias. Configure a weight value for each version of the Lambda function. Update the new weighted alias Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the REST API.

Create a new REST API in API Gateway. Set up a Lambda proxy integration to connect to multiple Lambda functions. Enable canary settings on the deployment stage. Specify a smaller percentage of API traffic to go to the new version of the Lambda function.
Create a new version of each Lambda function. Integrate a predefined canary deployment in AWS CodeDeploy to slowly shift the traffic to the new versions automatically.

Create a new REST API in API Gateway. Set up a Lambda non-proxy integration to connect to multiple Lambda functions. Specify the necessary parameters and properties in API Gateway. Enable canary settings on the deployment stage. Specify a smaller percentage of API traffic to go to the new version of the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A company has a mobile app. The app includes an Amazon API Gateway REST API that invokes AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda functions process data from the app. The company needs to test updated Lambda functions that have new features. The company must conduct these tests with a subset of users before deployment. The tests must not affect other users of the app. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational effort?

question_text: 公司只有一个预生产 AWS 账户，其中部署了一个 AWS CloudFormation AWS SAM 堆栈。开发人员修改了模板中的现有 AWS Lambda 函数，并增加了 Amazon SNS 主题，希望一次性部署这些变更进行验证，同时不能影响其他团队成员在发布流水线中使用的现有预生产应用。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。SAM CLI 可用 sam deploy 部署到指定账户和 stack；变更集预览不等于部署。

适用前提与时效：C 需先具备新账户和部署权限；同账户独立栈在名称与资源隔离充分时也可测试，但原选项未提供。

知识点／记忆点：隔离测试的关键是部署到独立资源边界；调试日志和变更集预览都不会自动隔离运行中的应用。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：debug 只增加诊断输出，部署到原栈仍会影响团队共用环境。

B：变更集属于指定账户和栈，不能直接在另一个账户执行同一变更集。

D：普通 CloudFormation 栈不能靠添加一个 stage 将部分资源直接部署到另一个账户。

options.text: Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and deploy the SAM application to the pre-production AWS account. Specify the debug parameter.
Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and create a change set against the pre-production AWS account. Execute the change set in a new AWS account designated for a development environment.
Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and deploy the SAM application to a new AWS account designated for a development environment.
Update the CloudFormation stack in the pre-production account. Add a separate stage that points to a new AWS account designated for a development environment.

question_text_original: A developer works for a company that only has a single pre-production AWS account with an AWS CloudFormation AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) stack. The developer made changes to an existing AWS Lambda function specified in the AWS SAM template and additional Amazon Simple Notification service (Amazon SNS) topics. The developer wants to do a one-time deploy of the changes to test if the changes are working. The developer does not want to impact the existing pre-production application that is currently being used by other team members as part of the release pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司构建了在线活动平台，为各活动组织测验并按分数生成排行榜。排行榜数据保存在 Amazon DynamoDB，活动结束后保留 30 天，再通过定时任务删除。表配置了固定写入容量。活动较多的月份，删除任务运行时 DynamoDB 写 API 请求会受到限流。开发人员需要长期方案，删除旧排行榜数据并优化写入吞吐量。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。DynamoDB TTL 根据 Unix epoch 秒数属性异步清理过期 leaderboard 数据。

适用前提与时效：TTL 不保证到期立即删除；全局表的副本删除可能产生复制写入费用。

知识点／记忆点：数据过期清理由托管 TTL 异步完成，可避免批量业务删除争用写吞吐；时间戳应使用 epoch 秒。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Streams 输出变更记录，不会自行安排三十天后的删除。

C：Step Functions 调用删除仍消耗表写容量，并增加调度状态。

D：临时提高写容量可缓解限流，但保留周期删除作业和额外容量成本。

options.text: Configure a TTL attribute for the leaderboard data.
Use DynamoDB Streams to schedule and delete the leaderboard data.
Use AWS Step Functions to schedule and delete the leaderboard data.
Set a higher write capacity when the scheduled delete job runs.

question_text_original: A company built an online event platform. For each event, the company organizes quizzes and generates leaderboards that are based on the quiz scores. The company stores the leaderboard data in Amazon DynamoDB and retains the data for 30 days after an event is complete. The company then uses a scheduled job to delete the old leaderboard data. The DynamoDB table is configured with a fixed write capacity. During the months when many events occur, the DynamoDB write API requests are throttled when the scheduled delete job runs. A developer must create a long-term solution that deletes the old leaderboard data and optimizes write throughput. Which solution meets these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数读取 Amazon SQS 标准队列消息，并为每条消息向第三方 API 发出 HTTP 调用。公司希望确保函数对第三方 API 的并发请求不超过两个。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：D。SQS event source maximum concurrency 限制映射可同时运行的 Lambda 数量；batch size 是每次消息数。

适用前提与时效：D 仅在单次函数最多同时发一个 HTTP 请求时保证下游并发不超过二；批内并行需要另行限制。

知识点／记忆点：事件源最大并发限制同时运行的函数数；要把它转换成下游请求上限，还要限制每次调用内部的并行请求数。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：预置并发只预热环境，超过该值仍可能继续扩容。

B：批量大小限制每次取多少消息，不限制同时有多少函数调用。

C：事件过滤按内容筛选消息，不负责设定两条并发请求的配额。

options.text: Configure a provisioned concurrency of two on the Lambda function.
Configure a batch size of two on the Amazon SQS event source mapping for the Lambda function.
Configure Lambda event filtering to process two messages from Amazon SQS at every invocations.
Configure a maximum concurrency of two on the Amazon SQS event source mapping for the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A company uses an AWS Lambda function that reads messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The Lambda function makes an HTTP call to a third-party API for each message. The company wants to ensure that the Lambda function does not overwhelm the third-party API with more than two concurrent requests. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon API Gateway 开发应用 API。开发人员需要测试并生成 API 响应，其他团队必须立即开始测试该 API。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。API Gateway MOCK integration 可快速返回固定测试响应。

知识点／记忆点：后端未就绪时可先用稳定响应模拟接口契约，区分业务模拟响应与网关错误响应。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：请求校验器检查输入格式，不生成用于联调的业务响应。

C：Gateway response 定制网关产生的错误等响应，不是正常方法的模拟后端。

D：Authorizer 用于访问控制，不应承担业务响应模拟。

options.text: Set up a mock integration request in API Gateway. Configure the method's integration request and integration response to associate a response with a given status code.
Set up the request validators in the API's OpenAPI definition file. Import the OpenAPI definitions into API Gateway to test the API.
Set up a gateway response for the API in API Gateway. Configure response headers with hardcoded HTTP status codes and responses.
Set up a request parameter-based Lambda authorizer to control access to the API. Configure the Lambda function with the necessary mapping template.

question_text_original: A company is using Amazon API Gateway to develop an API for its application on AWS. A developer needs to test and generate API responses. Other teams are required to test the API immediately. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司即将发布新功能，用户可通过申请表请求提前体验。公司预计表单开放后请求激增。每个请求作为项目保存到 Amazon DynamoDB，包含用户名、提交日期、验证状态（UNVALIDATED、VALID 或 NOT VALID），以及用户对流程的 1 到 5 分评分。每位用户只能提交一次。开发人员应选择哪个属性作为分区键，使记录在分区间均匀分布？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：A。username 高基数且每用户仅一条，适合作 DynamoDB partition key；状态和评分基数太低。

知识点／记忆点：分区键需要足够高的基数并让热点写入分散；键值唯一并不等于访问一定均衡，还应结合业务分布。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：申请集中发布时提交日期容易相同，使写入集中在少数键值。

C：仅三个状态且新申请都为 UNVALIDATED，会形成明显热点。

D：评分只有五个取值，无法充分分散大规模集中写入。

options.text: Username
Submission date
Validation status
Rating of the process on a scale of 1 to 5

question_text_original: A company is releasing a new feature. Users can request early access to the new feature by using an application form. The company expects a surge of requests when the application form becomes available. Each request will be stored as an item in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Each item will contain the user's username, the submission date, and a validation status of UNVALIDATED. VALID, or NOT VALID. Each item also will contain the user's rating of the process on a scale of 1 to 5. Each user can submit one request. For the DynamoDB table, the developer must choose a partition key that will give the workload well-distributed records across partitions. Which DynamoDB attribute will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个仅包含静态资源的公开企业网站，托管在 Amazon S3，并通过 Amazon CloudFront 分配向用户提供。用户不得直接从 S3 存储桶访问内容，所有内容必须经 CloudFront 提供。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：A。CloudFront OAC 可私有访问 S3 origin，并配合 bucket policy 限制来源 distribution。

适用前提与时效：A 的写权限对只读静态站点不必要，应只授予 GetObject 并限定 SourceArn，保持阻止公共访问。

知识点／记忆点：私有 S3 源通过 CloudFront 签名访问，并用桶策略限制分配身份；公开访问控制与源读取授权需要同时满足。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：只给写权限不能读取静态对象，也缺少正确的 OAC 读取授权。

C：网站端点依赖公共可读内容，不能满足只允许 CloudFront 私有访问源的要求。

D：aws:RequestTag 不是任意 HTTP 自定义头，不能按描述用于源访问认证。

options.text: Create a new origin access control (OAC) in CloudFront. Configure the CloudFront distribution's origin to use the new OAC. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow CloudFront OAC with read and write access to access Amazon S3 as the origin.

Update the S3 bucket settings. Enable the block all public access setting in Amazon S3. Configure the CloudFront distribution's with Amazon S3 as the origin. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow CloudFront write access.
Update the S3 bucket's static website settings. Enable static website hosting and specifying index and error documents. Update the CloudFront origin to use the S3 bucket's website endpoint.

Update the CloudFront distribution's origin to send a custom header. Update the S3 bucket policy with a condition by using the aws:RequestTag/tag-key key. Configure the tag-key as the custom header name, and the value being matched is the header's value.

question_text_original: A developer is creating a publicly accessible enterprise website consisting of only static assets. The developer is hosting the website in Amazon S3 and serving the website to users through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The users of this application must not be able to access the application content directly from an S3 bucket. All content must be served through the Amazon CloudFront distribution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员构建了一个调用外部 API 获取数据、处理后写入 Amazon S3 的应用，并制作了包含全部依赖的容器映像。应用在本地可运行，仅需少量 CPU 和内存。开发人员已创建 Amazon ECS 集群，需要在其中每小时运行一次应用。哪种方案的基础设施管理开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。ECS Fargate task 无需管理 EC2 节点；再用 EventBridge Scheduler 按小时运行。

适用前提与时效：C 只解决运行平台，还需 EventBridge Scheduler 等按小时调用 RunTask。

知识点／记忆点：短时定时容器作业适合按任务启动的托管计算，避免维护常驻宿主机；计算定义和调度是两项配置。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：管理 EC2 容量仍需维护实例容量与系统，开销高于 Fargate。

B：固定 EC2 实例增加服务器维护和闲置成本。

D：Managed node groups 属于 EKS，不是 ECS 的功能。

options.text: Add a capacity provider to manage instances.
Add an Amazon EC2 instance that runs the application.
Define a task definition with an AWS Fargate launch type.
Create an Amazon ECS cluster and add the managed node groups feature to run the application.

question_text_original: A developer built an application that calls an external API to obtain data, processes the data, and saves the result to Amazon S3. The developer built a container image with all of the necessary dependencies to run the application as a container. The application runs locally and requires minimal CPU and RAM resources. The developer has created an Amazon ECS cluster. The developer needs to run the application hourly in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of infrastructure management overhead?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行网站，每天发布投票，次日公布结果。用户回答保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表，结果公布后不再需要保留。开发人员需要自动删除旧回答，已添加 expiration_date 属性并计划以此实现自动化。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：D。DynamoDB TTL 自动删除过期项，但不是精确即时删除；过期时间须为 Unix epoch 秒。

适用前提与时效：expiration_date 必须是 Number 类型 epoch 秒；过期后仍可能短暂存在，读取时可过滤。

知识点／记忆点：无严格删除时刻要求的过期记录可用托管 TTL 清理，避免自行实现扫描、分页、重试和调度。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：定时 Lambda 需要编写删除扫描逻辑，开发工作高于启用 TTL。

B：容器删除任务引入镜像与任务维护，且重复实现已有清理能力。

C：Glue ETL 作业过于复杂，不适合仅为表记录到期清理新增。

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Lambda function daily.

Create an AWS Fargate task in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Fargate task daily.
Create an AWS Glue job to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an AWS Glue trigger schedule to run the job daily.
Enable TTL on the DynamoDB table and specify the expiration_date attribute. Expire old user responses by using DynamoDB TTL.

question_text_original: A company runs its website on AWS. The company posts daily polls on its website and publishes the poll results next day. The website stores user responses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. After the poll results are published, the company does not need to keep the user responses. A developer needs to implement a solution that will automatically remove old user responses from the DynamoDB table. The developer adds a new expiration_date attribute to the DynamoDB table. The developer plans to use the expiration_date attribute for the automation. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员正在使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 AWS Lambda 创建简单的概念验证演示。模板将部署一个现有函数，其部署包和依赖存储在 Amazon S3 中。开发人员已在模板中定义 AWS::Lambda::Function 资源，需要将 S3 存储桶加入模板。如何以最少的开发工作实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。CloudFormation Lambda Code 指向已有包的 S3Bucket 和 S3Key；ZipFile 不用于已有 S3 包。

知识点／记忆点：部署包位置与内联源码是不同输入形式；引用已有 S3 制品时必须同时标识桶和对象键。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：将源码搬入模板增加工作，而且 Code 属性不是直接接收任意内联文本。

B：ZipFile 是受支持运行时的内联源码，不是复用现有 S3 依赖包的最省事方式。

C：把 S3 对象键写入 ZipFile 会被当作源码内容，不会下载对象。

options.text: Add the function code in the CloudFormation template inline as the code property.
Add the function code in the CloudFormation template as the ZipFile property.
Find the S3 key for the Lambda function. Add the S3 key as the ZipFile property in the CloudFormation template.
Add the relevant key and bucket to the S3Bucket and S3Key properties in the CloudFormation template.

question_text_original: A developer is creating a simple proof-of-concept demo by using AWS CloudFormation and AWS Lambda functions. The demo will use a CloudFormation template to deploy an existing Lambda function. The Lambda function uses deployment packages and dependencies stored in Amazon S3. The developer defined an AWS::Lambda::Function resource in a CloudFormation template. The developer needs to add the S3 bucket to the CloudFormation template. What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员使用 Python 和多项 AWS 服务构建微服务应用，必须使用 AWS X-Ray，并在控制台的服务地图中查看服务依赖。测试时发现部分服务未显示在地图中。如何确保全部服务都出现在 X-Ray 服务地图上？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立；原答案已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：B。旧题用 X-Ray SDK 埋点仍可理解，但 SDK/daemon 已进入维护期，新实现优先 OpenTelemetry。

适用前提与时效：B 按旧题 SDK 埋点方向理解，新项目应评估 OpenTelemetry；还需正确传播上下文及发送追踪数据，不能只安装 SDK。

知识点／记忆点：服务地图依赖各跳传播追踪上下文并生成片段；提高采样率不能补出从未埋点的服务。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：采样率只影响已有追踪的采样数量，不能让缺少埋点的服务自动出现。

C：CloudWatch Logs 聚合不会自动生成 X-Ray 调用关系片段。

D：没有增加服务地图超时就能补齐未采集服务的机制。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-daemon-timeline.html

options.text: Modify the X-Ray Python agent configuration in each service to increase the sampling rate.
Instrument the application by using the X-Ray SDK for Python. Install the X-Ray SDK for all the services that the application uses.
Enable X-Ray data aggregation in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for all the services that the application uses.
Increase the X-Ray service map timeout value in the X-Ray console.

audit_label: 有条件成立；原答案已修正
question_text_original: A developer is building a microservices-based application by using Python on AWS and several AWS services. The developer must use AWS X-Ray. The developer views the service map by using the console to view the service dependencies. During testing, the developer notices that some services are missing from the service map. What can the developer do to ensure that all services appear in the X-Ray service map?

question_text: 开发人员正在 AWS 上构建容器化应用，通过 API 密钥与第三方服务通信。开发人员需要安全地存储密钥，并将其传递给容器应用。哪些方案能够满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：AC；修正答案：AE。Parameter Store SecureString 与 Secrets Manager SecretString 都能加密保存 API key 并授予容器角色读取。

知识点／记忆点：编码不是加密，制品和模板也不是秘密存储；秘密应在运行时以最小权限获取，避免永久固化到镜像。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Base64 可直接解码，模板与环境配置中的值仍会暴露秘密。

C：普通模板参数和明文容器环境变量没有建立专门秘密存储及访问控制流程。

D：镜像中的密钥可被镜像读取者提取，轮换还需要重建镜像。

options.text: Store the API keys as a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Grant the application access to retrieve the value from Parameter Store.
Store the API keys in AWS CloudFormation templates by using base64 encoding. Pass the API keys to the application through container definition environment variables.
Add a new AWS CloudFormation parameter to the CloudFormation template. Pass the API keys to the application by using the container definition environment variables.
Embed the API keys in the application. Build the container image on-premises. Upload the container image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).
Store the API keys as a SecretString parameter in AWS Secrets Manager. Grant the application access to retrieve the value from Secrets Manager.

question_text_original: A developer is building a containerized application on AWS. The application communicates with a third-party service by using API keys. The developer needs a secure way to store the API keys and pass the API keys to the containerized application. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司的应用将数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表。部分查询执行很慢，涉及的属性既不是分区键也不是排序键。预计表内数据量会大幅增长。开发人员必须提高查询性能。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：B。DynamoDB GSI 以查询属性作 partition key，可避免随数据增长的大范围 Scan。

适用前提与时效：GSI 需评估键分布、投影与额外写成本，并接受其最终一致性读取。

知识点／记忆点：数据量增长时应按访问模式设计索引，减少被读取的数据量；增加扫描并行或容量不改变扫描成本随表规模增长的事实。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：增大单页和重试不能把非键筛选变成高效定向查询。

C：并行扫描仍要读取大量无关数据，只是增加并行和吞吐消耗。

D：扩容可缓解吞吐不足，却不解决非键查询导致的大范围读取。

options.text: Increase the page size for each request by setting the Limit parameter to be higher than the default value. Configure the application to retry any request that exceeds the provisioned throughput.
Create a global secondary index (GSI). Set query attribute to be the partition key of the index.
Perform a parallel scan operation by issuing individual scan requests. In the parameters, specify the segment for the scan requests and the total number of segments for the parallel scan.
Turn on read capacity auto scaling for the DynamoDB table. Increase the maximum read capacity units (RCUs).

question_text_original: A company runs an application on AWS. The application stores data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Some queries are taking a long time to run. These slow queries involve an attribute that is not the table's partition key or sort key. The amount of data that the application stores in the DynamoDB table is expected to increase significantly.
