A developer must increase the performance of the queries. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的支付应用运行在 Application Load Balancer 后方的 Amazon EC2 实例上，实例由跨多个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组管理。应用启动时需要获取应用密钥并导出为环境变量。密钥必须静态加密且每月轮换。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Secrets Manager + customer managed KMS key 保护支付应用敏感信息并可轮换。

适用前提与时效：启动脚本导出的环境变量不会自动同步轮换结果，运行中的应用应刷新凭证或滚动重启。

知识点／记忆点：静态加密保护存储，自动轮换改变业务秘密，两者不是同一操作；启动读取的进程还需要在秘密变化后刷新。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：S3 Object Lambda 不会按月自动轮换真实业务凭证，需额外自建轮换流程。

B：String 不是加密的 SecureString，且自行写 Lambda 轮换增加开发工作。

C：Base64 不是加密，写自定义脚本也增加秘密管理负担。

options.text: Save the secrets in a text file and store the text file in Amazon S3. Provision a customer managed key. Use the key for secret encryption in Amazon S3. Read the contents of the text file and read the export as environment variables. Configure S3 Object Lambda to rotate the text file every month.

Save the secrets as strings in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and use the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Configure an Amazon EC2 user data script to retrieve the secrets during the startup and export as environment variables. Configure an AWS Lambda function to rotate the secrets in Parameter Store every month.

Save the secrets as base64 encoded environment variables in the application properties. Retrieve the secrets during the application startup. Reference the secrets in the application code. Write a script to rotate the secrets saved as environment variables.

Store the secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Provision a new customer master key. Use the key to encrypt the secrets. Enable automatic rotation. Configure an Amazon EC2 user data script to programmatically retrieve the secrets during the startup and export as environment variables.

question_text_original: A company runs a payment application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balance. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The application needs to retrieve application secrets during the application startup and export the secrets as environment variables. These secrets must be encrypted at rest and need to be rotated every month. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 调用 AWS Lambda 函数。PROD 和 DEV 环境各有函数版本及指向对应版本的别名。目前 API Gateway 只有一个指向 PROD 别名的阶段。公司希望 PROD 和 DEV 版本能够同时、分别被访问。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：A；修正答案：D。API Gateway stage variable 可为 PROD/DEV 指向不同 Lambda alias。

知识点／记忆点：阶段配置可让同一 API 定义选择不同的稳定函数别名，实现环境隔离而无需复制业务集成。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Authorizer 负责认证授权，不能替代业务 Lambda 集成的环境选择。

B：Gateway response 修改网关响应，不决定调用哪个函数版本。

C：API Gateway 使用 stage variables，不存在选项所述 Lambda 式环境变量机制。

options.text: Enable a Lambda authorizer for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway. Republish PROD and create a new stage for DEV. Create API Gateway stage variables for the PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda authorizer to the DEV Lambda authorizer.
Set up a gateway response in API Gateway for the Lambda function alias. Republish PROD and create a new stage for DEV. Create gateway responses in API Gateway for PROD and DEV Lambda aliases.

Use an environment variable for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway. Republish PROD and create a new stage for development. Create API gateway environment variables for PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda function alias to the DEV Lambda function alias.

Use an API Gateway stage variable to configure the Lambda function alias. Republish PROD and create a new stage for development. Create API Gateway stage variables for PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda function alias and to the DEV Lambda function alias.

question_text_original: A company is using Amazon API Gateway to invoke a new AWS Lambda function. The company has Lambda function versions in its PROD and DEV environments. In each environment, there is a Lambda function alias pointing to the corresponding Lambda function version. API Gateway has one stage that is configured to point at the PROD alias. The company wants to configure API Gateway to enable the PROD and DEV Lambda function versions to be simultaneously and distinctly available. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在维护一个与多个第三方支付处理 API 通信的电商平台。这些第三方服务不提供测试环境。开发人员需要验证平台的 API 集成代码，但不能实际调用第三方支付 API。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：C；修正答案：D。API Gateway MOCK integration 可返回第三方 API 样例，不实际调用支付服务。

知识点／记忆点：集成测试可对第三方响应建立模拟服务，覆盖正常和异常契约而不产生真实外部副作用。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Gateway response 不是正常业务方法的模拟集成响应机制。

B：AppSync 不能按 API Gateway 的 Mock 集成类型配置该 REST 模拟方案。

C：Route 53 Resolver 入站端点处理 DNS 查询，不能把 Lambda ARN 当作 HTTP 模拟目标。

options.text: Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a gateway response configured for status code 200. Add response templates that contain sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

Set up an AWS AppSync GraphQL API with a data source configured for each third-party API. Specify an integration type of Mock. Configure integration responses by using sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

Create an AWS Lambda function for each third-party API. Embed responses captured from the real third-party API. Configure Amazon Route 53 Resolver with an inbound endpoint for each Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API for each third-party API. Specify an integration request type of Mock. Configure integration responses by using sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

question_text_original: A developer is working on an ecommerce platform that communicates with several third-party payment processing APIs. The third-party payment services do not provide a test environment. The developer needs to validate the ecommerce platform's integration with the third-party payment processing APIs. The developer must test the API integration code without invoking the third-party payment processing APIs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员将大量对象存储在同一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中，需要针对高请求速率进行优化。应如何存储对象？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：C。多个 S3 key prefixes 可提高可扩展性；现行 S3 已自动扩展，不必特意随机化 prefix。

适用前提与时效：S3 会自动扩展，不需要机械随机化键前缀；突增流量仍应渐增并重试暂时的 Slow Down 响应。

知识点／记忆点：S3 请求吞吐可随多个对象键前缀并行扩展；对象标签、存储类别和键命名的扩展维度不同。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Intelligent-Tiering 优化存储费用，不是提高请求吞吐的前缀分布方案。

B：把对象全部放根路径没有利用多个前缀并行扩展。

D：名为 prefix 的对象标签不会改变对象键前缀和请求分布。

options.text: Store the objects by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
Store the objects at the root of the S3 bucket.
Store the objects by using object key names distributed across multiple prefixes.
Store each object with an object tag named "prefix" that contains a unique value.

question_text_original: A developer is storing many objects in a single Amazon S3 bucket. The developer needs to optimize the S3 bucket for high request rates. How should the developer store the objects to meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司将新应用部署到 AWS，并将应用日志流式发送至 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。当任何日志行出现“ERROR”时，开发团队必须收到邮件通知。开发人员已创建 Amazon SNS 主题并让团队订阅。接下来应如何操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudWatch Logs metric filter 将 ERROR 日志转指标，alarm 可发 SNS 告警。

适用前提与时效：现行 CloudWatch 也支持按计划执行 Logs Insights 查询的 log alarms，并非只能先转指标；B 未描述该配置。若要求每条 ERROR 通知，持续 ALARM 状态不会逐条通知。

知识点／记忆点：本题使用日志模式转指标、指标告警发 SNS 的路径；指标告警通常只在状态变化时通知，不代表逐条发送错误日志。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：该项把 Logs Insights 查询直接称为指标来建指标告警，未提供查询型 log alarm 的具体配置。

C：CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器没有直接 SNS 目的地这一配置。

D：该项混合指标告警的维度与日志匹配模式，未定义有效指标或完整查询型日志告警。

options.text: Select the appropriate log group. Create a CloudWatch metric filter with "ERROR" as the search term. Create an alarm on this metric that notifies the SNS topic when the metric is 1 or higher.

In CloudWatch Logs Insights, select the appropriate log group. Create a metric query to search for the term "ERROR" in the logs. Create an alarm on this metric that notifies the SNS topic when the metric is 1 or higher.
Select the appropriate log group. Create an SNS subscription filter with "ERROR" as the filter pattern. Select the SNS topic as the destination.
Create a CloudWatch alarm that includes "ERROR" as a filter pattern, a log group dimension that defines the appropriate log group, and a destination that notifies the SNS topic.

question_text_original: A company deploys a new application to AWS. The company is streaming application logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company's development team must receive notification by email when the word "ERROR" appears in any log lines. A developer sets up an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and subscribes the development team to the topic. What should the developer do next to meet the requirements?

question_text: 一家公司使用 Amazon SQS 解耦微服务架构，队列中部分消息包含敏感信息。开发人员必须对所有静态数据加密。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。SQS server-side encryption 保护队列内静态消息；另可用 TLS 保护传输。

适用前提与时效：SQS 服务端加密保护消息正文，不加密队列名称、消息属性等全部元数据；敏感内容应放正文或自行保护。

知识点／记忆点：静态加密与传输加密保护不同阶段；启用 TLS 不能替代队列中保存消息的加密。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：SecureTransport 约束 HTTPS 请求，只保护传输过程。

C：TLS 证书用于传输安全，不能使队列内消息静态加密。

D：自定义消息属性没有启用加密的服务语义。

options.text: Enable server-side encryption for the SQS queue by using an SQS managed encryption key (SSE-SQS).
Use the aws:SecureTransport condition in the queue policy to ensure that only HTTPS (TLS) is used for all requests to the SQS queue.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to generate an SSL/TLS certificate. Reference the certificate when messages are sent to the queue.
Set a message attribute in the SQS SendMessage request for messages that are sent to the queue. Set the Name to ENCRYPT. Set the Value to TRUE.

question_text_original: A company uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to decouple its microservices architecture. Some messages in an SQS queue contain sensitive information. A developer must implement a solution that encrypts all the data at rest. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司最近部署了新的无服务器用户门户，用户反映部分功能缓慢。初步分析定位到一个 Amazon API Gateway 端点，该端点集成 AWS Lambda 函数，而函数还会与其他 API 和 AWS 服务交互。开发人员如何按运维最佳实践找出响应时间增加的来源？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：B。X-Ray SDK 可记录服务调用链但已进入维护期；新应用宜考虑 OpenTelemetry。

适用前提与时效：B 的埋点思路有效；新实现应评估 OpenTelemetry，并结合尾延迟而非只看平均值。

知识点／记忆点：逐跳追踪与上下文传播能把端到端慢请求拆成具体依赖耗时；整体函数指标只能指出症状。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：手工时间日志可以分析，但需要自建关联和聚合逻辑，维护成本高于标准追踪。

C：Duration 和 Throttles 只能反映函数整体表现，不能定位具体外部依赖。

D：外部合成监控可发现门户变慢，但没有函数内部埋点时无法完整区分各依赖耗时。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-daemon-timeline.html

options.text: Update the Lambda function by adding logging statements with high-precision timestamps before and after each external request. Deploy the updated Lambda function. After accumulating enough usage data, examine the Amazon CloudWatch logs for the Lambda function to determine the likely sources for the increased response time.

Instrument the Lambda function with the AWS X-Ray SDK. Add HTTP and HTTPS interceptors and SDK client handlers. Deploy the updated Lambda function. Turn on X-Ray tracing. After accumulating enough usage data, use the X-Ray service map to examine the average response times to determine the likely sources.

Review the Lambda function's Amazon CloudWatch metrics by using the metrics explorer. Apply anomaly detection to the Duration metric and the Throttles metric. Review the anomalies to determine the likely sources.

Use Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics to create a new canary. Turn on AWS X-Ray tracing on the canary. Configure the canary to scan the user portal. After accumulating enough usage data, use the CloudWatch Synthetics canary dashboard to view the metrics from the canary.

question_text_original: A company recently deployed a new serverless user portal. Users have reported that part of the portal is slow. The initial analysis found a single Amazon API Gateway endpoint that is responsible for the performance issues. The endpoint integrates with an AWS Lambda function. However, the Lambda function interacts with other APIs and AWS services. How can a developer find the source of the increased response time by using operational best practices?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS Lambda 和 Amazon EventBridge 构建事件驱动应用。函数需要向 EventBridge 事件总线推送事件，通过 SDK 执行 PutEvents 操作，代码中未指定凭证。部署后函数失败，日志出现 AccessDeniedException。应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Lambda 向 EventBridge PutEvents 需要 execution role 的 events:PutEvents 许可。

知识点／记忆点：SDK 未显式传凭证时会使用运行环境的角色凭证；访问被拒应先检查实际调用主体及目标资源授权。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：VPC 对等连接解决网络互通，不解决 PutEvents 的 IAM 拒绝。

B：修改开发者个人凭证不会改变部署后函数使用的执行角色。

D：函数资源策略控制谁能调用函数，不授予函数向事件总线写入的权限。

options.text: Configure a VPC peering connection between the Lambda function and EventBridge.
Modify their AWS credentials to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.
Modify the Lambda function execution role to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.
Add a resource-based policy to the Lambda function to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.

question_text_original: A developer is building an event-driven application by using AWS Lambda and Amazon EventBridge. The Lambda function needs to push events to an EventBridge event bus. The developer uses an SDK to run the PutEvents EventBridge action and specifies no credentials in the code. After deploying the Lambda function, the developer notices that the function is failing and there are AccessDeniedException errors in the logs. How should the developer resolve this issue?

question_text: 一家公司的 AWS Lambda 函数处理 IoT 设备消息，公司希望监控函数是否满足服务等级协议（SLA）。开发人员必须近实时计算应用吞吐量，依据给定时间段内函数接收和处理的消息数量。函数初始化及后处理步骤不能计入吞吐量测量。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。业务吞吐量需由 Lambda 代码发布 CloudWatch custom metric，调用次数不等于处理量。

知识点／记忆点：业务吞吐应按消息处理数和实际业务时间定义，不能用函数调用次数代替批内消息数或把初始化算入业务耗时。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：并发执行数表示同时运行的函数数量，不代表消息处理速率。

B：定时处理日志增加延迟与额外任务，不如在业务边界直接发布指标。

D：调用次数与总耗时包含非业务阶段，且一次调用可能处理多条消息。

options.text: Use the Lambda function's ConcurrentExecutions metric in Amazon CloudWatch to measure the throughput.
Modify the application to log the calculated throughput to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke a separate Lambda function to process the logs on a schedule.
Modify the application to publish custom Amazon CloudWatch metrics when the Lambda function receives and processes each message. Use the metrics to calculate the throughput.
Use the Lambda function's Invocations metric and Duration metric to calculate the throughput in Amazon CloudWatch.

question_text_original: A company's application has an AWS Lambda function that processes messages from IoT devices. The company wants to monitor the Lambda function to ensure that the Lambda function is meeting its required service level agreement (SLA). A developer must implement a solution to determine the application's throughput in near real time. The throughput must be based on the number of messages that the Lambda function receives and processes in a given time period. The Lambda function performs initialization and post-processing steps that must not factor into the throughput measurement. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS CodePipeline 为 Java 应用提供 CI/CD，需要更新流水线以支持新增的应用依赖 .jar 文件。每当该文件有新版本时，流水线必须启动构建。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。CodeArtifact 存 Maven/JAR 依赖，供 CodeBuild 管道拉取。

知识点／记忆点：依赖包仓库管理包版本，事件规则把新版本发布连接到流水线触发；容器镜像源与 Maven 依赖不是同一制品。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：SNS 通知不能直接作为 CodePipeline 启动动作，仍需额外触发桥接逻辑。

B：ECR 源动作面向容器镜像，不直接把普通 JAR 依赖当作镜像版本。

C：ECR 不是此处的 Maven 包管理方案，SNS 也不能直接启动流水线。

options.text: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the dependency .jar file. Publish the dependency .jar file to the S3 bucket. Use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.
Create an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) private repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an ECR source action to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.

Create an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) private repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.
Create an AWS CodeArtifact repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.

question_text_original: A developer is using an AWS CodePipeline pipeline to provide continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) support for a Java application. The developer needs to update the pipeline to support the introduction of a new application dependency .jar file. The pipeline must start a build when a new version of the .jar file becomes available. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家拥有多个分支机构的公司运行分析和报告应用。各分支每天在预定时间向共享 Amazon S3 存储桶上传销售报告。公司已开发 AWS Lambda 函数，一次分析全部分支报告并将结果存入数据库。每天需要在指定时间启动一次分析。哪种方案最具成本效益？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。EventBridge schedule 可每日定时触发 Lambda 汇总报告。

适用前提与时效：应为迟到或缺失报告增加业务检查，固定时间触发本身不保证数据齐全。

知识点／记忆点：固定时间执行一次聚合任务应使用调度事件；对象到达事件代表单文件变化，不代表当天所有文件都已齐全。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：每次上传触发会运行多次，且早到文件到达时其他分支数据可能未齐。

B：状态机本身不是每日 cron 调度器，为单一调用增加编排没有必要。

C：函数持续空转等待既受执行时限约束，又产生无用计算费用。

options.text: Configure an S3 event notification to invoke the Lambda function when a branch office uploads a sales report.
Create an AWS Step Functions state machine that invokes the Lambda function once each day at the predefined time.
Configure the Lambda function to run continuously and to begin analysis only at the predefined time each day.
Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule that invokes the Lambda function once each day at the predefined time.

question_text_original: A company with multiple branch locations has an analytics and reporting application. Each branch office pushes a sales report to a shared Amazon S3 bucket at a predefined time each day. The company has developed an AWS Lambda function that analyzes the reports from all branch offices in a single pass. The Lambda function stores the results in a database. The company needs to start the analysis once each day at a specific time. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 开发人员的应用异步调用 AWS Lambda 函数，希望保存导致调用失败的消息，以便以后重试。如何以最少的运维开销实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：C。异步 Lambda DLQ 保留失败事件；不要把同一 DLQ 直接接回原函数形成即时重试循环，应受控重放。

适用前提与时效：C 前半部分合理，但直接把同一 DLQ 接回原函数可能造成循环，且 SQS 事件包装与原事件不同；应修复原因后受控重放。

知识点／记忆点：失败事件应进入可控重放流程，避免永久故障导致无限循环；保留事件与自动立即重试是不同目标。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：日志未必包含可重放的完整原始事件，而且导出与重放需要额外代码。

B：EventBridge 不会自动获得 Lambda 内部所有异步失败事件供 SNS 重发。

D：引入 EventBridge 到 SQS 的入口链不能自动捕获已有异步调用丢弃事件。

options.text: Set up Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups to filter and store the messages in an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the messages in Lambda. Run the Lambda function again.
Configure Amazon EventBridge to send the messages to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to initiate the Lambda function again.
Implement a dead-letter queue for discarded messages. Set the dead-letter queue as an event source for the Lambda function.
Send Amazon EventBridge events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function to pull messages from the SQS queue. Run the Lambda function again.

question_text_original: A developer has an application that asynchronously invokes an AWS Lambda function. The developer wants to store messages that resulted in failed invocations of the Lambda function so that the application can retry the call later. What should the developer do to accomplish this goal with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板部署 AWS 资源，需要更新其中一个堆栈。公司如何预先了解变更会对正在运行的资源产生什么影响？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudFormation change set 显示待更新资源和替换影响，可在执行前检查。

适用前提与时效：Change set 不保证执行必成功，仍可能遇到权限、配额或运行时依赖问题。

知识点／记忆点：部署前比较声明状态的变化，可以识别新增、删除和可能替换的资源；保护规则不等于变更预览。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Stack policy 约束可更新的资源，不列出本次变更的实际影响。

C：Metadata 是模板附加信息，不计算资源差异。

D：Resources 描述期望状态，单独查看不能直接得到相对现有栈的变更计划。

options.text: Investigate the change sets.
Investigate the stack policies.
Investigate the Metadata section.
Investigate the Resources section.

question_text_original: A company is using AWS CloudFormation templates to deploy AWS resources. The company needs to update one of its AWS CloudFormation stacks. What can the company do to find out how the changes will impact the resources that are running?

question_text: 一家公司将全部个人身份信息（PII）存储在账户 A 中名为 PII 的 Amazon DynamoDB 表。开发人员正在开发运行于账户 B 的 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用，该应用需要访问此表。账户 A 的管理员创建了具有表访问权限的 AccessPII IAM 角色，并在信任策略中指定账户 B 为可代入该角色的主体。账户 B 的开发人员应采取哪些步骤使应用访问该表？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AD。跨账户访问先允许源 EC2 role 执行 AssumeRole，再在应用使用 STS 临时凭证。

适用前提与时效：DynamoDB 也有资源策略的跨账户方案，但题目已给定角色信任路径，应按此完成。

知识点／记忆点：跨账户承担角色需目标信任与源身份允许同时成立，随后用目标角色会话访问资源，而不是沿用源角色凭证。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：仅给源角色表权限不足以完成题设基于 AccessPII 角色的跨账户授权流程。

C：EC2 源角色凭证不等于目标 AccessPII 角色凭证，还需要承担角色。

E：GetSessionToken 不会切换成目标账户的 AccessPII 角色身份。

options.text: Allow the EC2 IAM role the permission to assume the AccessPII role.
Allow the EC2 IAM role the permission to access the PII table.
Include the AWS API in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials from the EC2 IAM role to access the PII table.
Include the AssumeRole API operation in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials to access the PII table.
Include the GetSessionToken API operation in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials to access the PII table.

question_text_original: A company stores all personally identifiable information (PII) in an Amazon DynamoDB table named PII in Account A. Developers are working on an application that is running on Amazon EC2 instances in Account B. The application in Account B requires access to the PII table. An administrator in Account A creates an IAM role named AccessPII that has permission to access the PII table. The administrator also creates a trust policy that specifies Account B as a principal that can assume the role. Which combination of steps should the developers take in Account B to allow their application to access the PII table? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一个游戏网站允许用户相互交易游戏道具。平台要求在同一事务中更新并持久化双方用户记录；任何更新失败，都必须回滚事务。哪些 AWS 方案能够提供该事务能力？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：CD。DynamoDB TransactWriteItems 或 Aurora SQL transaction 保证交易双方状态原子一致。

适用前提与时效：Athena 对特定表格式有事务性写入能力，但不等于关系数据库式任意多语句业务事务。

知识点／记忆点：交易的原子性要求多个写入共同提交或回滚；强一致读取只保证读到的版本，不保证多个更新同生共灭。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：ConsistentRead 控制读取一致性，不把两次写操作组合成原子事务。

B：Memcached 不提供题目所需的持久多记录事务能力。

E：Athena 面向分析查询，不能按该通用事务块方案实现游戏业务双用户交易。

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB with operations made with the ConsistentRead parameter set to true
Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with operations made within a transaction block
Amazon DynamoDB with reads and writes made by using Transact* operations
Amazon Aurora MySQL with operations made within a transaction block
Amazon Athena with operations made within a transaction block

question_text_original: A gaming website gives users the ability to trade game items with each other on the platform. The platform requires both users' records to be updated and persisted in one transaction. If any update fails, the transaction must roll back. Which AWS solutions can provide the transactional capability that is required for this feature? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员通过 AWS CloudFormation 在 AWS 云中部署应用，需要连接现有 Amazon RDS 数据库。数据库主机名以明文值保存于 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store。开发人员需要将主机名加入模板，以便创建堆栈时初始化应用。应如何引用包含主机名的参数？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudFormation ssm dynamic reference 可读取普通 Parameter Store 参数；密文需 ssm-secure。

知识点／记忆点：动态引用在栈操作时解析外部配置；Ref 引用模板内标识，ImportValue 引用其他栈导出，三者来源不同。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：普通 Ref 不会仅凭外部 Parameter Store 参数名读取其值，除非另行声明相应 SSM 参数类型。

C：ImportValue 读取 CloudFormation 导出，不直接读取 Parameter Store。

D：ssm-secure 用于 SecureString，本题明确是明文参数。

options.text: Use the ssm dynamic reference.
Use the Ref intrinsic function.
Use the Fn::ImportValue intrinsic function.
Use the ssm-secure dynamic reference.

question_text_original: A developer is deploying an application in the AWS Cloud by using AWS CloudFormation. The application will connect to an existing Amazon RDS database. The hostname of the RDS database is stored in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a plaintext value. The developer needs to incorporate the database hostname into the CloudFormation template to initialize the application when the stack is created. How should the developer reference the parameter that contains the database hostname?

question_text: 一家公司通过 AWS Lambda 函数调用第三方服务。该服务限制每分钟请求次数，超限时返回限流错误。开发人员需要配置函数以避免这些错误。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：信息不足】
参考答案：A。题干限制每分钟请求数，但 reserved concurrency 只限制同时运行数；选项都不能精确执行每分钟限流。

适用前提与时效：保留 A，但 reserved concurrency 不能精确执行每分钟限流；需令牌桶、节流队列或协调器，并处理 429 退避。

知识点／记忆点：并发是同时进行的请求数，速率是时间窗口内完成或发出的请求数；相同并发在不同耗时下产生不同请求速率。

选项核查与缺失信息：

B：减内存可能拖慢执行，却不是可预测、准确的每分钟限流机制。

C：预置并发只预热环境，不设置最大调用数或每分钟配额。

D：增加超时只允许执行更久，不限制一分钟发出的请求数。

options.text: Set the reserved concurrency on the Lambda function to match the number of concurrent requests that the third-party service allows.
Decrease the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
Set the provisioned concurrency on the Lambda function to match the number of concurrent requests that the third-party service allows.
Increase the timeout value that is specified on the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A company uses an AWS Lambda function to call a third-party service. The third-party service has a limit of requests each minute. If the number of requests exceeds the limit, the third-party service returns rate-limiting errors. A developer needs to configure the Lambda function to avoid receiving rate limiting errors from the third-party service. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS Copilot 构建新的容器应用，开发期间通过 Copilot CLI 部署，并已将代码提交到新的 AWS CodeCommit 仓库。发布生产前必须建立自动部署流程。哪种做法的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。AWS Copilot CLI 可以定义并部署 pipeline，自动构建容器服务。

适用前提与时效：按题目所用 Copilot/CodeCommit 环境判断；实际新项目应确认工具维护状态与可用源提供商。

知识点／记忆点：已有部署工具能生成流水线时，应优先复用其应用和环境模型，避免同时维护另一套发布定义。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：自行编写调用 Copilot 的 buildspec 重复实现内置 pipeline 能力，维护更多。

B：SAM 针对无服务器应用，给现有 Copilot 容器部署再引入它增加工具链复杂度。

D：手写流水线模板并作为附加资源部署需要额外维护，不如内置 pipeline 工作流。

options.text: Create a buildspec file that invokes the AWS Copilot CLI commands to build and deploy the application. Use the AWS Copilot CLI to create an AWS CodePipeline that uses the CodeCommit repository in the source stage and AWS CodeBuild in the build stage.

Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI to bootstrap and initialize an AWS CodePipeline configuration. Use the CodeCommit repository as the source. Invoke the AWS Copilot CLI to build and deploy the application.
Use the AWS Copilot CLI to define the AWS Copilot pipeline and to deploy the AWS CodePipeline. Select CodeCommit as the source for the AWS CodePipeline.
Define an AWS CloudFormation template for an AWS CodePipeline with CodeCommit as the source. Configure the template as an AWS Copilot CLI add-on. Use the AWS Copilot CLI to deploy the application.

question_text_original: A developer is building a new containerized application by using AWS Copilot. The developer uses the AWS Copilot command line interface (CLI) to deploy the application during development. The developer committed the application code to a new AWS CodeCommit repository. The developer must create an automated deployment process before releasing the new application to production. What should the developer do to meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

question_text: 开发人员正在为宠物商店创建管理客户奖励积分的应用，使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储数据。在实际性能分析前，需要优化查询性能并限制分区过载。应选择哪个选项作为分区键？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。随机 UUID 作为 DynamoDB partition key 有高基数，避免同名与热点。

适用前提与时效：随机 UUID 有助于分散但不会自动满足查询模式，应用仍需保存该标识并按实际查询设计索引。

知识点／记忆点：分区键应具备高基数和合理访问分散度；业务显示名常重复或变化，不宜直接承担稳定标识职责。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：客户姓名可能重复且分布不均，也可能发生更名。

C：注册日期在活动期间集中，容易造成热点键值。

D：宠物名字重复率高，不能可靠地区分客户并分散负载。

options.text: A randomly generated universally unique identifier (UUID)
The customer's full name
The date when the customer signed up for the rewards program
The name of the customer's pet

question_text_original: A developer is creating a new application for a pet store. The application will manage customer rewards points. The developer will use Amazon DynamoDB to store the data for the application. The developer needs to optimize query performance and limit partition overload before actual performance analysis. Which option should the developer use for a partition key to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员通过 AWS IAM Identity Center（AWS Single Sign-On）在本地工作站使用 AWS CLI 和 AWS SDK。最初配置 SSO 时 API 调用正常，现在却收到 Access Denied 错误，而且未修改此前正常使用的配置文件或脚本。最可能的原因是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。IAM Identity Center 临时会话过期时需重新登录以刷新 CLI/SDK 凭证。

适用前提与时效：过期常表现为凭证或令牌过期错误；仅凭 AccessDenied 不能断定，仍需核对错误码及权限变更。

知识点／记忆点：联合登录凭证有生命周期，代码未改也可能因会话失效无法访问；先确认身份、有效期和实际错误类型。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：本地二进制执行权限改变通常导致程序无法启动，而不是服务端 API AccessDenied。

B：权限集不足可以造成拒绝，但题设先前相同操作成功，未说明权限被调整。

D：选错账户也可导致拒绝，但题目无切换账户迹象，较不支持这一判断。

options.text: The access permissions to the developer's AWS CLI binary file have changed.
The permission set that is assumed by IAM Identity Center does not have the necessary permissions to complete the API call.
The credentials from the IAM Identity Center federated role have expired.
The developer is attempting to make API calls to the incorrect AWS account.

question_text_original: A developer uses AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to interact with the AWS CLI and AWS SDKs on a local workstation. API calls to AWS services were working when the SSO access was first configured. However, the developer is now receiving Access Denied errors. The developer has not changed any configuration files or scripts that were previously working on the workstation. What is the MOST likely cause of the developer's access issue?

question_text: 一家公司正在构建无服务器应用，通过 API 密钥向第三方应用进行身份验证。公司希望将外部 API 密钥存入 AWS Lambda 配置，并完全控制用于加密它的 AWS KMS 密钥，且只允许获授权的实体查看。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：B。Lambda 环境变量可用 KMS 加密；API key 长期保存更推荐 Secrets Manager。

适用前提与时效：应限制查看配置及 KMS 解密权限；静态加密不阻止函数运行时读到明文，长期秘密还可考虑专门秘密服务。

知识点／记忆点：客户管理密钥允许自己控制密钥策略与生命周期；秘密存储位置和谁能解密需要分别授权。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：String 参数不提供 SecureString 加密，默认 AWS 托管密钥也不满足完全控制。

C：秘密不应固化在代码库，AWS 托管密钥也不提供完整客户控制。

D：AWS 托管密钥不满足题目对密钥完全控制的要求，且不属于函数配置。

options.text: Store the API key in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a string parameter. Use the default AWS KMS key that AWS provides to encrypt the API key.
Store the API key in AWS Lambda environment variables. Create an AWS KMS customer managed key to encrypt the API key.
Store the API key in the code repository. Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the code repository.
Store the API key as an Amazon DynamoDB table record. Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the API key.

question_text_original: A company is building a serverless application. The application uses an API key to authenticate with a third-party application. The company wants to store the external API key as a part of an AWS Lambda configuration. The company needs to have full control over the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys that will encrypt the API key and should be visible only to authorized entities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在编写应用，分析一组位于公有 Application Load Balancer（ALB）后方的 Amazon EC2 实例流量。每台实例上的 HTTP 服务器都将请求写入日志。开发人员希望捕获客户端公有 IP，但日志中只看到 ALB 的 IP。必须如何修改才能记录客户端公有 IP？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。HTTP X-Forwarded-For 表示代理链中的客户端 IP，需信任接入代理后再解析。

适用前提与时效：X-Forwarded-For 可能包含客户端伪造的前置值，应按可信代理链和 ALB 处理模式解析。

知识点／记忆点：反向代理终止客户端连接后，后端网络对端变成代理；原始客户端信息需从可信代理维护的转发头提取。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Host 表示请求目标主机名，不是客户端 IP。

B：日志代理仅采集已有日志，不会自动恢复没有记录的客户端地址。

C：X-Ray daemon 传送追踪信息，不会替 HTTP 日志补入真实来源 IP。

options.text: Add a Host header to the HTTP server log configuration file.
Install the Amazon CloudWatch Logs agent on each EC2 instance. Configure the agent to write to the log file.
Install the AWS X-Ray daemon on each EC2 instance. Configure the daemon to write to the log file.
Add an X-Forwarded-For header to the HTTP server log configuration file.

question_text_original: A developer is writing an application to analyze the traffic to a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances run behind a public Application Load Balancer (ALB). An HTTP server runs on each of the EC2 instances, logging all requests to a log file. The developer wants to capture the client public IP addresses. The developer analyzes the log files and notices only the IP address of the ALB. What must the developer do to capture the client public IP addresses in the log file?

question_text: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Lambda 函数开发无服务器应用，其中一个函数需要访问 VPC 私有子网中的 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。公司已创建具有所需数据库访问权限的角色，并附加给函数。开发人员还需要采取哪些操作，才能让函数访问数据库？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。Lambda 接入 RDS 私网需配置相同 VPC 的子网及允许数据库端口的安全组。

知识点／记忆点：身份权限与网络可达性缺一不可；私有数据库连接还需子网路由、安全组和数据库层认证共同允许。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：函数没有可直接用于该规则的固定公网地址，公开数据库也无必要。

B：Direct Connect 用于本地到 AWS 的专线，不用于 Lambda 与同 VPC 数据库通信。

C：CloudFront 面向 HTTP 内容分发，不代理 RDS 数据库协议。

options.text: Assign a public IP address to the DB instance. Modify the security group of the DB instance to allow inbound traffic from the IP address of the Lambda function.
Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the Lambda function and the DB instance.
Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution to create a secure connection between the Lambda function and the DB instance.
Configure the Lambda function to connect to the private subnets in the VPC. Add security group rules to allow traffic to the DB instance from the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A company is developing a serverless application by using AWS Lambda functions. One of the Lambda functions needs to access an Amazon RDS DB instance. The DB instance is in a private subnet inside a VPC. The company creates a role that includes the necessary permissions to access the DB instance. The company then assigns the role to the Lambda function. A developer must take additional action to give the Lambda function access to the DB instance. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员需要临时访问另一个 AWS 账户中的资源。最安全的方式是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。STS AssumeRole 获取访问第二账户的临时权限，避免交换长期 access key。

知识点／记忆点：临时跨账户授权应通过有范围和期限的角色会话完成，避免复制长期身份凭证。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：用户池主要签发登录令牌，不直接发放跨账户 AWS 角色凭证。

B：邮件传长期访问密钥增加泄露风险，且不符合临时访问目标。

D：SSH 公钥不能代替 AWS API 的跨账户 STS 授权。

options.text: Use the Amazon Cognito user pools to get short-lived credentials for the second account.
Create a dedicated IAM access key for the second account, and send it by mail.
Create a cross-account access role, and use sts:AssumeRole API to get short-lived credentials.
Establish trust, and add an SSH key for the second account to the IAM user.

question_text_original: A developer needs temporary access to resources in a second account. What is the MOST secure way to achieve this?

question_text: 一家公司希望将本地服务器上的应用迁移到 AWS。第一步是修改一个非关键应用，并迁移到单台 Amazon EC2 实例，应用将在 Amazon S3 中存储信息。为遵循安全最佳实践，应采用哪种方式让应用与 S3 交互？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。EC2 instance profile 绑定仅具 S3 必要权限的 role，遵循最小权限。

知识点／记忆点：计算资源通过角色获得自动轮换的临时凭证，再把权限限定到必要 API 和资源；非关键应用也应遵守最小权限。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：管理员角色远超读写指定 S3 资源所需权限。

B：管理员长期密钥同时带来过度授权和硬编码泄露风险。

D：虽限制 S3 权限，但硬编码长期密钥仍比实例角色更难保管与轮换。

options.text: Create an IAM role that has administrative access to AWS. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.

Create an IAM user. Attach the AdministratorAccess policy. Copy the generated access key and secret key. Within the application code, use the access key and secret key along with the AWS SDK to communicate with Amazon S3.
Create an IAM role that has the necessary access to Amazon S3. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.

Create an IAM user. Attach a policy that provides the necessary access to Amazon S3. Copy the generated access key and secret key. Within the application code, use the access key and secret key along with the AWS SDK to communicate with Amazon S3.

question_text_original: A company wants to migrate applications from its on-premises servers to AWS. As a first step, the company is modifying and migrating a non-critical application to a single Amazon EC2 instance. The application will store information in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to follow security best practices when deploying the application on AWS. Which approach should the company take to allow the application to interact with Amazon S3?

question_text: 一家公司有一个包含敏感数据的内部网站，希望使其可从公网访问，但必须确保只有通过公司 OpenID Connect（OIDC）身份提供商验证的员工能够访问。开发人员必须在不修改网站的情况下实施身份验证。哪组步骤能够满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BC。公有 ALB 配 HTTPS listener 和合适证书可公开提供加密 Web 入口。

适用前提与时效：后端应限制只能由 ALB 访问，防止绕过认证入口直接访问网站。

知识点／记忆点：在负载均衡器完成身份验证可让原网站无需改代码；认证动作必须位于转发前，并用 HTTPS 保护登录及会话。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：NLB 工作于传输层，不提供 ALB 的 OIDC 用户认证动作。

D：ALB 的用户认证动作要求 HTTPS 监听器，不能按此放在 HTTP 80 上。

E：ALB 没有该描述的默认 Lambda 认证动作；Lambda 目标转发不等于原生 OIDC 身份验证。

options.text: Create a public Network Load Balancer.
Create a public Application Load Balancer.
Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTPS port 443. Add a default authenticate action providing the OIDC IdP configuration.
Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTP port 80. Add a default authenticate action providing the OIDC IdP configuration.
Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTPS port 443. Add a default AWS Lambda action providing an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to a Lambda authentication function.

question_text_original: A company has an internal website that contains sensitive data. The company wants to make the website public. The company must ensure that only employees who authenticate through the company's OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider (IdP) can access the website. A developer needs to implement authentication without editing the website. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员正在开发一个需要选择性启用特定功能的 Web 应用。在功能准备好公开之前，必须对终端用户隐藏。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。AppConfig feature flag 支持逐步启用与配置校验。

适用前提与时效：隐藏 UI 不是安全授权，未开放功能的服务端路径也应检查开关及访问权限。

知识点／记忆点：功能开关将代码部署与功能开放分开，应用读取开关决定是否展示或执行功能；开关不是数据同步的副作用。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Feature flag 配置档案属于 AppConfig，不是 AppSync 的对应功能。

B：DynamoDB Streams 记录项目变更，不会自动控制应用功能可见性。

D：DataStore 同步数据，不提供题意中的专门功能开关管理。

options.text: Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppSync. Store the feature flag values in the configuration profile. Activate and deactivate feature flags as needed.
Store prerelease data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams in the table. Toggle between hidden and visible states by using DynamoDB Streams.
Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppConfig. Store the feature flag values in the configuration profile. Activate and deactivate feature flags as needed.
Store prerelease data in AWS Amplify DataStore. Toggle between hidden and visible states by using Amplify DataStore cloud synchronization.

question_text_original: A developer is working on a web application that requires selective activation of specific features. The developer wants to keep the features hidden from end users until the features are ready for public access. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员编写了一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，其中引用公司网络团队另一个模板创建的子网。首次尝试启动堆栈时失败。哪些模板编码错误可能导致失败？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BD。跨 CloudFormation stack 的子网引用需源栈 Outputs Export 与目标栈 Fn::ImportValue。

适用前提与时效：导入导出通常要求同账户同区域，且已被导入的导出值不能随意删除或修改。

知识点／记忆点：跨栈引用建立在导出名称契约上；源栈导出值、消费栈导入值，普通本地引用无法跨越栈边界。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Ref 通常引用本模板中的资源或参数，不能直接引用另一栈的子网逻辑 ID。

C：Mappings 是静态查找表，不是跨栈导入资源的必需位置。

E：跨栈 Export 位于 Outputs，不在 Mappings 中声明。

options.text: The developer's template does not use the Ref intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.
The developer's template does not use the ImportValue intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.
The Mappings section of the developer's template does not refer to the subnets.
The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Outputs section.
The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Mappings section.

question_text_original: A developer at a company writes an AWS CloudFormation template. The template refers to subnets that were created by a separate AWS CloudFormation template that the company's network team wrote. When the developer attempts to launch the stack for the first time, the launch fails. Which template coding mistakes could have caused this failure? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员的应用运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，读取 Amazon S3 存储桶时失败。开发人员发现关联 IAM 角色缺少 S3 读取权限，需要授予应用该权限。哪种方案对应用的干扰最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。修改 EC2 现有关联角色的 IAM policy 会逐步生效，不必重建实例。

知识点／记忆点：角色身份与授权策略分离，调整策略无需重建使用该角色的计算资源；权限传播可能有短暂延迟。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：终止并重建实例会造成不必要的应用中断。

C：休眠重启不是让 IAM 策略生效的必要步骤。

D：桶策略可以承担部分授权，但重启实例无必要，也不是修正现有角色权限的最少干扰路径。

options.text: Add the permission to the role. Terminate the existing EC2 instance. Launch a new EC2 instance.
Add the permission to the role so that the change will take effect automatically.
Add the permission to the role. Hibernate and restart the existing EC2 instance.
Add the permission to the S3 bucket. Restart the EC2 instance.

question_text_original: A developer is running an application on an Amazon EC2 instance. When the application tries to read an Amazon S3 bucket, the application fails. The developer notices that the associated IAM role is missing the S3 read permission. The developer needs to give the application the ability to read the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST application disruption?

question_text: 开发人员正在编写一个 Web 应用，部署在面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer（ALB）后方的 Amazon EC2 实例上。必须在 ALB 前增加 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并确保 VPC 外部的客户数据在传输中加密。应使用哪些 CloudFront 配置？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BE。CloudFront origin protocol Match Viewer 与 viewer HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect 合用保护传输。

适用前提与时效：Match Viewer 与重定向组合可使被接受请求 HTTPS 回源；若严格禁止首次明文请求，应使用 HTTPS Only，并确保源站证书有效。

知识点／记忆点：CDN 形成客户端到边缘和边缘到源站两段连接，必须分别约束协议才能避免回源退回明文。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：签名 URL 控制访问授权，不强制两段网络连接加密。

C：字段级加密仅保护特定字段，不能代替所有传输连接使用 HTTPS。

D：压缩减少传输体积，不提供加密。

options.text: Restrict viewer access by using signed URLs.
Set the Origin Protocol Policy setting to Match Viewer.
Enable field-level encryption.
Enable automatic object compression.
Set the Viewer Protocol Policy setting to Redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

question_text_original: A developer is writing a web application that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances behind an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB). The developer must add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB. The developer also must ensure that customer data from outside the VPC is encrypted in transit. Which combination of CloudFront configuration settings should the developer use to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员正在实现一个在对象上传至 Amazon S3 时触发的 AWS Lambda 函数，希望发布到生产 AWS 账户前，在本地开发机器上测试。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。sam local start-lambda 可提供本地 Lambda endpoint，用样例 S3 event 测试。

适用前提与时效：sam local invoke 可独立运行，不必先 start-lambda；后者用于向 SDK/CLI 提供本地 Lambda API 端点。

知识点／记忆点：本地函数测试需要模拟事件与本地执行环境；云端触发通知不会自动路由到开发机。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：上传真实 S3 对象只触发已配置的云端目标，不会自动调用本地函数。

B：aws lambda invoke 默认调用云端端点，未指定本地端点不能完成本地测试。

D：控制台测试调用的是 AWS 上的函数，不是开发机函数。

options.text: Upload an object to Amazon S3 by using the aws s3api put-object CLI command. Wait for the local Lambda invocation from the S3 event.
Create a sample JSON text file for a put object S3 event. Invoke the Lambda function locally. Use the aws lambda invoke CLI command with the JSON file and Lambda function name as arguments.

Use the sam local start-lambda CLI command to start Lambda. Use the sam local generate-event s3 put CLI command to create the Lambda test JSON file. Use the sam local invoke CLI command with the JSON file as the argument to invoke the Lambda function.
Create a JSON string for the put object S3 event. In the AWS Management Console, use the JSON string to create a test event for the local Lambda function. Perform the test.

question_text_original: A developer is implementing an AWS Lambda function that will be invoked when an object is uploaded to Amazon S3. The developer wants to test the Lambda function in a local development machine before publishing the function to a production AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 开发人员正在向两个月前创建的 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组发布关键日志。根据安全政策，必须使用 AWS KMS 密钥加密今后写入的日志数据。哪种方案需要的工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。CloudWatch Logs 现有 log group 关联 KMS key 使用 associate-kms-key。

适用前提与时效：还需允许 CloudWatch Logs 服务使用该对称 KMS 密钥；关联不会回溯重加密历史日志。

知识点／记忆点：对已有日志组关联密钥影响后续摄取数据，不能靠重新创建同名资源实现更新；解密旧数据还需保留旧密钥可用性。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：客户端自行加密需要修改写日志代码并处理解密，开发工作更高。

B：KMS 控制台管理密钥，不提供此处现有日志组的直接关联操作。

C：create-log-group 用于创建新组，不能修改已存在同名组的密钥关联。

options.text: Use the AWS Encryption SDK for encryption and decryption of the data before writing to the log group.
Use the AWS KMS console to associate the KMS key with the log group.
Use the AWS CLI aws logs create-log-group command, and specify the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
Use the AWS CLI aws logs associate-kms-key command, and specify the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

question_text_original: A developer is publishing critical log data to a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The log group was created 2 months ago. The developer must encrypt the log data by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key so that future data can be encrypted to comply with the company's security policy. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST effort?

question_text: 开发人员正在维护一个应用，用名为 Orders 的 Amazon DynamoDB 表保存客户订单。表以 OrderID 为分区键，没有排序键，包含超过 100,000 条记录。开发人员需要增加功能，获取所有 OrderSource 属性值为 MobileApp 的订单。哪种方案能最高效地改善用户体验？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。DynamoDB GSI 可用 OrderSource 作为 partition key 支持按来源查询。

适用前提与时效：来源值少时索引可能出现热点，实际应评估写入分布并分页返回大结果集。

知识点／记忆点：DynamoDB Query 必须提供目标表或索引的分区键等值条件；只把筛选字段设为排序键不能省略分区键。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Scan 后过滤仍读取全表大量数据，而且 QueryFilter 不是 Scan 的适当参数。

B：LSI 必须沿用原表分区键，不能改为 OrderSource，也不能事后添加。

C：仅以 OrderSource 为排序键无法凭 MobileApp 发起无分区键的 Query。

options.text: Perform a Scan operation on the Orders table. Provide a QueryFilter condition to filter to only the items where the OrderSource attribute is equal to the MobileApp value.
Create a local secondary index (LSI) with OrderSource as the partition key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.
Create a global secondary index (GSI) with OrderSource as the sort key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.
Create a global secondary index (GSI) with OrderSource as the partition key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.

question_text_original: A developer is working on an app for a company that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table named Orders to store customer orders. The table uses OrderID as the partition key and there is no sort key. The table contains more than 100,000 records. The developer needs to add a functionality that will retrieve all Orders records that contain an OrderSource attribute with the MobileApp value. Which solution will improve the user experience in the MOST efficient way?

question_text: 一家公司的应用使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理数据。开发人员必须对存储在应用中的所有敏感配置（例如 API 密钥）实施传输加密，并已创建 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥。接下来应如何操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：D。Lambda 环境变量启用 client-side encryption helpers 可加强传输保护；Secrets Manager 另适合集中管密钥。

适用前提与时效：题干仅说传输加密时并非 D 唯一可行：Secrets Manager 默认 HTTPS 读取也可满足，需区分客户端加密这一预期意图，不能说 B 天生不安全。

知识点／记忆点：客户端加密可让配置在到达存储服务前已是密文；服务端静态加密与 TLS 传输加密是不同保护层。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：String 参数不使用 KMS 静态加密，环境变量也不会自动执行 GetParameter API。

B：Secrets Manager 通过 HTTPS 读取本可安全传输，但新增函数和 layer 不是题目暗示的环境变量 encryption helpers 配置。

C：S3 的 KMS 加密只描述静态保护，未明确传输协议及客户端解密方案。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html

options.text: Create parameters of the String type in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. For each parameter, specify the KMS key ID to encrypt the parameter in transit. Reference the GetParameter API call in the Lambda environment variables.

Create secrets in AWS Secrets Manager by using the customer managed KMS key. Create a new Lambda function and set up a Lambda layer. Configure the Lambda layer to retrieve the values from Secrets Manager.

Create objects in Amazon S3 for each sensitive data field. Specify the customer managed KMS key to encrypt the object. Configure the Lambda function to retrieve the objects from Amazon S3 during data processing.

Create encrypted Lambda environment variables. Specify the customer managed KMS key to encrypt the variables. Enable encryption helpers for encryption in transit. Grant permission to the Lambda function's execution role to access the KMS key.

question_text_original: A company has an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to process data. A developer must implement encryption in transit for all sensitive configuration data, such as API keys, that is stored in the application. The developer creates an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. What should the developer do next to meet the encryption requirement?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建电商应用。发生销售事件时，应用需要并发调用三个第三方系统记录交易。开发人员为每个系统分别编写了独立的 AWS Lambda 函数，包含复杂集成逻辑。无论其他函数成功还是失败，每个函数都必须执行。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。SNS topic fanout 可同时向多个订阅者分发促销事件。

适用前提与时效：独立投递仍需为每个订阅者配置重试、失败保留和幂等；SNS 不等于所有第三方调用必定成功。

知识点／记忆点：广播扇出让每个独立订阅者获得事件副本，各自处理失败；竞争消费则把消息分给其中一个消费者。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：三个函数竞争同一个 SQS 队列通常各取不同消息，不保证每个事件交给全部三者。

C：ALB 将请求路由到一个目标，不向全部目标广播。

D：迁移复杂代码进状态机增加改造，且选项没有配置独立并行分支与失败隔离。

options.text: Publish the sale event from the application to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the three Lambda functions to poll the queue.
Publish the sale event from the application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the three Lambda functions to be triggered by the SNS topic.
Publish the sale event from the application to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Add the three Lambda functions as ALB targets.
Publish the sale event from the application to an AWS Step Functions state machine. Move the logic from the three Lambda functions into the Step Functions state machine.

question_text_original: A developer is building an ecommerce application. When there is a sale event, the application needs to concurrently call three third-party systems to record the sale. The developer wrote three AWS Lambda functions. There is one Lambda function for each third-party system, which contains complex integration logic. These Lambda functions are all independent. The developer needs to design the application so each Lambda function will run regardless of others' success or failure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在编写将数据保存在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中的应用，希望使用分区键和一个不同的排序键值查询表，并获取包含全部最新写入操作的数据。应如何编写查询？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。LSI 可强一致读取并使用不同 sort key；GSI 只支持最终一致读取。

知识点／记忆点：设计索引时同时检查分区键是否变化、索引能否后建以及读取一致性；LSI 必须建表时定义，GSI 的读取不能请求强一致。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：最终一致读取可能暂时看不到刚完成的写入，不满足最新数据要求。

C：GSI 的最终一致读取无法保证包含所有近期写入。

D：GSI 不支持强一致读取，请求该模式会失败。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SecondaryIndexes.html

options.text: Add a local secondary index (LSI) during table creation. Query the LSI by using eventually consistent reads.
Add a local secondary index (LSI) during table creation. Query the LSI by using strongly consistent reads.
Add a global secondary index (GSI) during table creation. Query the GSI by using eventually consistent reads.
Add a global secondary index (GSI) during table creation. Query the GSI by using strongly consistent reads.

question_text_original: A developer is writing an application, which stores data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer wants to query the DynamoDB table by using the partition key and a different sort key value. The developer needs the latest data with all recent write operations. How should the developer write the DynamoDB query?

question_text: 开发人员维护的应用将客户订单写入 Amazon DynamoDB 表，以 customer_id 为分区键、order_id 为排序键，并包含 order_date 属性。新的访问模式要求按 order_date 和 order_id 访问数据，开发人员需要新建 AWS Lambda 函数支持此模式。如何以最高的运维效率实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。DynamoDB GSI 可后建，并为新查询提供新的 partition/sort key。

知识点／记忆点：先按访问模式确定键，再选择索引；对整表 Scan 后在应用中过滤，读取成本会随整表大小增长，而非只随匹配结果增长。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：LSI 不能改用 order_date 作分区键，也不能在现有表上新增。

B：扫描全表再组合结果增加读取和应用处理开销，不是运维最省的方案。

D：Streams 是限期保留的变更记录，不是可按业务键查询的长期数据索引。

options.text: Add a new local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table that specifies order_date as the partition key and order_id as the sort key. Write the new Lambda function to query the new LSI index.
Write the new Lambda function to scan the DynamoDB table. In the Lambda function, write a method to retrieve and combine results by order_date and order_id.
Add a new global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table that specifies order_date as the partition key and order_id as the sort key. Write the new Lambda function to query the new GSI index.
Enable DynamoDB Streams on the table. Choose the new and old images information to write to the DynamoDB stream. Write the new Lambda function to query the DynamoDB stream

question_text_original: A developer manages an application that writes customer orders to an Amazon DynamoDB table. The orders use customer_id as the partition key, order_id as the sort key, and order_date as an attribute. A new access pattern requires accessing data by order_date and order_id. The developer needs to implement a new AWS Lambda function to support the new access pattern. How should the developer support the new access pattern in the MOST operationally efficient way?

question_text: 开发人员正在为学校创建使用 Amazon DynamoDB 的 Web 应用。ExamScores 表含 student_id、subject_name 和 top_score，以 student_id 为分区键、subject_name 为排序键。应用需要显示每门学科最高分学生的 student_id。开发人员需要加快这些查询。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。GSI 以 subject_name 为 partition key 才能跨原表分区查询同科目分数。

知识点／记忆点：组内排名需要把分组字段放分区键、排序指标放排序键；查询时倒序并限制结果数，就能高效取最高分。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：LSI 必须沿用原表 student_id 分区键，不能改成科目。

B：LSI 不能改分区键，而且以分数分区无法高效取得某科目的最高分。

D：按 student_id 排序不能直接得到分数最高的学生，需要额外读取和排序。

options.text: Create a local secondary index (LSI) with subject_name as the partition key and top_score as the sort key.
Create a local secondary index (LSI) with top_score as the partition key and student_id as the sort key.
Create a global secondary index (GSI) with subject_name as the partition key and top_score as the sort key.
Create a global secondary index (GSI) with subject_name as the partition key and student_id as the sort key.

question_text_original: A developer is creating a web application for a school that stores data in Amazon DynamoDB. The ExamScores table has the following attributes: student_id, subject_name, and top_score. Each item in the ExamScores table is identified with student_id as the partition key and subject_name as the sort key. The web application needs to display the student _id for the top scores for each school subject. The developer needs to increase the speed of the queries to retrieve the student_id for the top scorer for each school subject. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员编写了一个应用，通过 AWS Lambda 函数按客户请求异步生成短视频，最长需要 10 分钟。视频生成后，会将下载 URL 推送到客户浏览器。客户必须能在生成后的至少 3 小时内访问视频。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。异步生成视频可存 S3，再发限时 presigned URL 供用户下载。

适用前提与时效：要保证至少 3 小时可访问，除 URL 到期时间外，还需保证签名凭证在这段时间内有效，或提供可重新签发链接的入口。

知识点／记忆点：异步计算结果应放在独立于计算实例的持久存储；下载链接的有效期同时受签名期限和签名凭证剩余寿命限制。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：临时目录随执行环境回收，函数 URL 也不会自动公开其中的文件。

B：EFS 不提供与 S3 对象相同的浏览器预签名下载接口，需要另建服务。

D：CloudFront 是内容分发层而非上传视频的持久源站，仍需配置对象存储等源站。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html

options.text: Store the video in the /tmp folder within the Lambda execution environment. Push a Lambda function URL to the customer.
Store the video in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system attached to the function. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.
Store the video in Amazon S3. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.
Store the video in an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.

question_text_original: A developer wrote an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to asynchronously generate short videos based on requests from customers. This video generation can take up to 10 minutes. After the video is generated, a URL to download the video is pushed to the customer's web browser. The customer should be able to access these videos for at least 3 hours after generation. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个由 Amazon SNS 主题消息触发的 AWS Lambda 函数。消息表示 CRM 系统的客户数据更新。该函数只应处理电子邮件地址变更，其他更新由主题的其他订阅者处理。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。SNS subscription filter policy 可在调用 Lambda 前按消息属性过滤。

知识点／记忆点：过滤配置属于具体订阅，互不影响其他订阅者；把无关事件挡在投递之前，可以避免额外函数调用和重复广播。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：SNS 直接调用 Lambda 不使用支持 FilterCriteria 的事件源映射，应在 SNS 订阅侧过滤。

C：过滤策略应配置在 SNS 订阅而非 SQS 队列上，额外队列也增加配置。

D：其他订阅已独立收到消息，重新发布会重复投递，甚至触发循环调用。

options.text: Use Lambda event filtering to allow only messages that are related to email address changes to invoke the Lambda function.
Use an SNS filter policy on the Lambda function subscription to allow only messages that are related to email address changes to invoke the Lambda function.

Subscribe an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to the SNS topic. Configure the SQS queue with a filter policy to allow only messages that are related to email address changes. Connect the SQS queue to the Lambda function.

Configure the Lambda code to check the received message. If the message is not related to an email address change, configure the Lambda function to publish the message back to the SNS topic for the other subscribers to process.

question_text_original: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that is invoked by messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The messages represent customer data updates from a customer relationship management (CRM) system The developer wants the Lambda function to process only the messages that pertain to email address changes. Additional subscribers to the SNS topic will process any other messages. Which solution will meet these requirements in the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员正在设计一个保存客户端会话的容错环境。如何确保 Amazon EC2 实例故障时不会丢失任何会话？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。DynamoDB 存共享会话，应用实例重启也不会丢会话状态。

知识点／记忆点：会话路由和会话持久化是两回事；让任意健康实例都能读取共享状态，才能在实例故障后继续处理同一会话。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：粘性会话只把请求尽量送往同一实例，不能恢复故障实例内存中的状态。

B：消息队列适合消费任务，不适合按会话 ID 反复读取和更新当前会话。

D：连接排空用于平稳结束在途请求，不能备份已故障实例上的会话。

options.text: Use sticky sessions with an Elastic Load Balancer target group.
Use Amazon SQS to save session data.
Use Amazon DynamoDB to perform scalable session handling.
Use Elastic Load Balancer connection draining to stop sending requests to failing instances.

question_text_original: A developer is designing a fault-tolerant environment where client sessions will be saved. How can the developer ensure that no sessions are lost if an Amazon EC2 instance fails?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建 AWS CloudFormation 模板，通过 AWS CodeDeploy 管理应用在 Amazon ECS 中的部署。希望自动先向一部分用户发布新版本，再向所有用户开放。应如何管理部署？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。ECS 蓝绿部署可借助 CloudFormation Transform 与 CodeDeploy；需核对模板支持情况。

知识点／记忆点：蓝绿描述新旧环境并存，金丝雀描述流量逐步转移；自动分流还需部署控制器和明确的流量路由配置。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：测试后切 DNS 不能直接表达题目要求的 CodeDeploy 自动按比例渐进发布。

C：普通堆栈更新本身不等于配置了渐进流量切换。

D：CloudFormation 的 BlueGreen hook 不支持放在嵌套堆栈中。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/blue-green-considerations.html

options.text: Modify the CloudFormation template to include a Transform section and the AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen hook.
Deploy the new version in a new CloudFormation stack. After testing is complete, update the application's DNS records for the new stack.
Run CloudFormation stack updates on the application stack to deploy new application versions when they are available.
Create a nested stack for the new version. Include a Transform section and the AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen hook.

question_text_original: A developer is creating AWS CloudFormation templates to manage an application's deployment in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) through AWS CodeDeploy. The developer wants to automatically deploy new versions of the application to a percentage of users before the new version becomes available for all users. How should the developer manage the deployment of the new version?

question_text: 开发人员编写了使用微服务的分布式应用，运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。由于消息量很大，无法将各微服务的日志输出对应到具体事务。开发人员需要分析消息流来调试应用。应采取哪些步骤？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：AD。旧 X-Ray daemon + SDK 能采集自定义 trace，但两者已进入维护期；新项目宜用 OpenTelemetry。

知识点／记忆点：分布式追踪依靠跨服务传播的 trace ID 关联同一事务，采集器负责转发片段；仅有时间相近的日志或指标不能可靠重建调用链。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：不存在题述的全球 daemon TCP 2000 入口，本地 daemon 接收的是 UDP 追踪数据。

C：开启服务不会把普通 CloudWatch 日志自动转换为完整的追踪片段。

E：指标流输出聚合指标，不能关联每个请求跨微服务的调用顺序。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-daemon-timeline.html

options.text: Download the AWS X-Ray daemon. Install the daemon on an EC2 instance. Ensure that the EC2 instance allows UDP traffic on port 2000.
Configure an interface VPC endpoint to allow traffic to reach the global AWS X-Ray daemon on TCP port 2000.
Enable AWS X-Ray. Configure Amazon CloudWatch to push logs to X-Ray.
Add the AWS X-Ray software development kit (SDK) to the microservices. Use X-Ray to trace requests that each microservice makes.
Set up Amazon CloudWatch metric streams to collect streaming data from the microservices.

question_text_original: A developer has written a distributed application that uses microservices. The microservices are running on Amazon EC2 instances. Because of message volume, the developer is unable to match log output from each microservice to a specific transaction. The developer needs to analyze the message flow to debug the application. Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司正在开发新的无服务器应用。开发人员需要以最少的编码工作自动部署 AWS Lambda 函数及其依赖基础设施，同时应用必须可靠。哪种方法的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。SAM 模板和 sam deploy 可自动打包部署 Lambda 应用及依赖资源。

知识点／记忆点：可重复部署需要把代码和依赖资源一起声明并纳入流水线；只自动上传函数包，仍会留下基础设施配置和版本一致性工作。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：手动上传不满足自动化，且脚本还要自行管理依赖资源。

C：逐个 CLI 部署函数仍需额外脚本编排基础设施，维护量高于声明式模板。

D：Lambda 容器镜像应存放于 ECR，CodeArtifact 是软件包制品仓库。

options.text: Build the application by using shell scripts to create .zip files for each Lambda function. Manually upload the .zip files to the AWS Management Console.
Build the application by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). Use a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline and the SAM CLI to deploy the Lambda functions.

Build the application by using shell scripts to create .zip files for each Lambda function. Upload the .zip files. Deploy the .zip files as Lambda functions by using the AWS CLI in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.

Build a container for each Lambda function. Store the container images in AWS CodeArtifact. Deploy the containers as Lambda functions by using the AWS CLI in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.

question_text_original: A company is working on a new serverless application. A developer needs to find an automated way to deploy AWS Lambda functions and the dependent infrastructure with minimum coding effort. The application also needs to be reliable. Which method will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 开发人员需要修改架构以满足新功能要求。应用数据保存在 Amazon DynamoDB，现于每晚批量处理分析。系统分析人员不希望等到第二天，希望近实时查看处理后的数据。哪种架构模式能够在数据到达时立即处理？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。事件驱动架构对状态变化进行异步反应，解耦生产者和处理者。

知识点／记忆点：从定时批处理转向低延迟处理，关键是把数据变化作为处理触发器；消费端仍应处理重试、重复事件和积压。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：客户端与服务器的角色划分并不决定数据变化后是否立即处理。

C：扇出描述把一条事件交给多个消费者，可用于事件驱动系统，但不是消除批处理等待的根本触发机制。

D：按计划执行仍依赖时间窗口，不能在每次数据到达时自然触发处理。

options.text: Event driven
Client-server driven
Fan-out driven
Schedule driven

question_text_original: A developer needs to modify an application architecture to meet new functional requirements. Application data is stored in Amazon DynamoDB and processed for analysis in a nightly batch. The system analysts do not want to wait until the next day to view the processed data and have asked to have it available in near-real time. Which application architecture pattern would enable the data to be processed as it is received?

question_text: 一家公司的应用托管在 us-west-1 区域，希望在 us-east-1 增加冗余。应用密钥存储在 us-west-1 的 AWS Secrets Manager 中，开发人员需要将其复制到 us-east-1。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。Secrets Manager replica secret 能跨 Region 同步密文供容灾使用。

知识点／记忆点：跨区域复制服务数据不等于复用源区域密钥；副本必须使用目标区域可用的密钥，主秘密更新后由服务传播至副本。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：应从主秘密配置副本，且副本加密不能使用位于源区域的 KMS 密钥。

C：Secrets Manager 没有题述的仅在轮换时执行的复制规则配置方式。

D：不存在题述的秘密生命周期到 S3 复制流程，导出到 S3 也不等于区域秘密副本。

options.text: Configure secret replication for each secret. Add us-east-1 as a replication Region. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-east-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.

Create a new secret in us-east-1 for each secret. Configure secret replication in us-east-1. Set the source to be the corresponding secret in us-west-1. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-west-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.

Create a replication rule for each secret. Set us-east-1 as the destination Region. Configure the rule to run during secret rotation. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-east-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.
Create a Secrets Manager lifecycle rule to replicate each secret to a new Amazon S3 bucket in us-west-1. Configure an S3 replication rule to replicate the secrets to us-east-1.

question_text_original: A company hosts its application in the us-west-1 Region. The company wants to add redundancy in the us-east-1 Region. The application secrets are stored in AWS Secrets Manager in us-west-1. A developer needs to replicate the secrets to us-east-1. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行电商应用，数据保存在 Amazon Aurora 中。开发人员正在添加缓存层，要求应用始终使用每个数据项的最新值。应采用哪种缓存策略？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。write-through 在写入时同步更新缓存，降低后续读取陈旧概率。

适用前提与时效：write-through 是这些选项中最合适的策略，但严格的始终最新还需要处理并发、写失败和绕过缓存的数据库更新，策略名称本身并非一致性保证。

知识点／记忆点：缓存新鲜度取决于所有写路径能否同步更新或失效缓存；TTL 只能限制陈旧持续时间，不能证明读取值始终最新。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：TTL 到期前仍可能返回旧值，因此不能保证每次读取最新。

C：懒加载只在未命中时查询数据库，命中的旧缓存不会自动刷新。

D：读穿透同样主要处理未命中，数据库更新时若不刷新缓存仍会读到旧值。

options.text: Implement a TTL strategy for every item that is saved in the cache.
Implement a write-through strategy for every item that is created and updated.
Implement a lazy loading strategy for every item that is loaded.
Implement a read-through strategy for every item that is loaded.

question_text_original: A company runs an ecommerce application on AWS. The application stores data in an Amazon Aurora database. A developer is adding a caching layer to the application. The caching strategy must ensure that the application always uses the most recent value for each data item. Which caching strategy will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的无服务器应用使用以 AWS Lambda 代理集成为后端的 Amazon API Gateway。公司正在开发多个后端 API，需要一个着陆页提供 API 导航概览。开发人员已创建 /LandingPage 资源及使用模拟集成的 GET 方法。接下来应如何操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。API Gateway MOCK 的 integration request 返回 statusCode，integration response 以 text/html 输出页面。

知识点／记忆点：MOCK 集成把请求模板当成模拟后端结果，再由响应模板生成客户端正文；浏览器如何解释正文还取决于正确的响应 Content-Type。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：把响应标成 application/json 无法正确表达 HTML 页面，且请求与响应模板职责混淆。

B：HTML 应由响应模板输出，请求模板应提供模拟返回的 statusCode。

D：把 HTML 放请求模板并用 JSON 响应类型，既混淆处理阶段也不符合页面输出要求。

options.text: Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of text/html and statusCode of 200. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of application/json. In the integration response mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs.

Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of application/json. In the integration request mapping template, include the LandingPage HMTL code that references the APIs. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of text/html and statusCode of 200.

Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of application/json and statusCode of 200. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of text/html. In the integration response mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs.

Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of text/html. In the integration request mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of application/json and statusCode of 200.

question_text_original: A company has a serverless application that uses Amazon API Gateway backed by AWS Lambda proxy integration. The company is developing several backend APIs. The company needs a landing page to provide an overview of navigation to the APIs. A developer creates a new/LandingPage resource and a new GET method that uses mock integration. What should the developer do next to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员创建了用 Java 编写的 AWS Lambda 函数，测试时行为不符合预期，希望通过跟踪功能排查。应使用哪项 AWS 服务？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。X-Ray 可定位分布式调用延迟；对于 Java Lambda 冷启动还需看 init 指标。

适用前提与时效：不能据此记成 CloudWatch 无法查看 trace；当前可观测性功能整合了追踪展示，本题选择直接提供追踪能力的 X-Ray。

知识点／记忆点：排障时先区分日志、指标、追踪和审计：追踪关注一次请求走过哪些组件、各段耗时及错误位置，审计关注谁调用了管理 API。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Trusted Advisor 提供资源配置建议，不能逐次追踪 Java 函数内部调用。

B：CloudWatch 与 X-Ray 有集成，但泛称 CloudWatch 并未配置题目所需的请求追踪。

D：CloudTrail 记录 API 活动，不能代替函数运行中的调用链诊断。

options.text: AWS Trusted Advisor
Amazon CloudWatch
AWS X-Ray
AWS CloudTrail

question_text_original: A developer creates an AWS Lambda function that is written in Java. During testing, the Lambda function does not work how the developer expected. The developer wants to use tracing capabilities to troubleshoot the problem. Which AWS service should the developer use to accomplish this goal?

question_text: 一家公司正在开发通过 Amazon API Gateway REST API 访问的应用。API 的部分资源只能由注册用户访问，所用令牌必须自动到期并定期刷新。开发人员应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Cognito user pool authorizer 验证已注册用户 token，不必给每用户建 IAM user。

适用前提与时效：Lambda 授权器配合完整的自建令牌服务也可实现需求；C 是现成托管方案，不应把 B 理解为技术上永远不可行。

知识点／记忆点：用户池签发表示用户身份的 JWT，身份池提供调用 AWS 的临时凭证；令牌到期后通过刷新流程取得新令牌，而不是延长旧令牌。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：身份池的临时 AWS 凭证不是 Cognito 用户池授权器验证的 JWT。

B：自建令牌库可以实现认证，但题述没有实现到期和刷新机制，还引入自行维护的工作。

D：为每个终端用户创建 IAM 用户不会直接得到自动过期、可刷新的用户登录令牌。

options.text: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool, configure the Amazon Cognito Authorizer in API Gateway, and use the temporary credentials generated by the identity pool.
Create and maintain a database record for each user with a corresponding token and use an AWS Lambda authorizer in API Gateway.
Create an Amazon Cognito user pool, configure the Cognito Authorizer in API Gateway, and use the identity or access token.
Create an IAM user for each API user, attach an invoke permissions policy to the API, and use an IAM authorizer in API Gateway.

question_text_original: A company is developing an application that will be accessed through the Amazon API Gateway REST API. Registered users should be the only ones who can access certain resources of this API. The token being used should expire automatically and needs to be refreshed periodically. How can a developer meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS 为客户开发应用，通过 Amazon API Gateway API 调用 AWS Lambda 函数，函数处理数据并写入 Amazon DynamoDB 表。公司必须监控整个应用，以识别可能影响客户的架构瓶颈。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。X-Ray service map 展示 API Gateway、Lambda、DynamoDB 调用链和耗时。

知识点／记忆点：整体瓶颈需要比较同一请求各段耗时，单个组件错误计数只能说明局部现象；正常但缓慢的下游调用也可能影响体验。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：日志查询可辅助排障，但自行建立跨组件关联需要更多开发工作。

C：只监控 API 限流错误，无法定位 Lambda 和数据库调用中的全部性能瓶颈。

D：只检查 DynamoDB 吞吐异常会遗漏 API、函数及其他类型的延迟。

options.text: Instrument the application with AWS X-Ray. Inspect the service map to identify errors and issues.
Configure Lambda exceptions and additional logging to Amazon CloudWatch. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to query the logs.
Configure API Gateway to log responses to Amazon CloudWatch. Create a metric filter for the TooManyRequestsException error message.
Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics for the DynamoDB tables to identify all the ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error messages.

question_text_original: A company used AWS to develop an application for customers. The application includes an Amazon API Gateway API that invokes AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda functions process data and store the data in Amazon DynamoDB tables. The company must monitor the entire application to identify potential bottlenecks in the architecture that can negatively affect customers. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 一家公司推出在线门户，宣传将在 6 个月后发布的新产品，并邀请用户填写邮箱以接收产品消息。公司需要一个将邮箱存入 Amazon DynamoDB 的 REST API。开发人员已创建存储邮箱的 AWS Lambda 函数，将通过 AWS SAM 部署，并必须提供 HTTP 访问。哪些方案所需额外配置最少？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AE。Lambda function URL 与 API Gateway 都能以 HTTP 公开函数；生产需限制访问和滥用。

知识点／记忆点：函数 HTTP 入口和四层流量转发不是同一能力；简单单函数入口可用函数 URL，复杂路由与 API 管理需求则适合 API Gateway。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Gateway Load Balancer 面向网络虚拟设备流量，不是 Lambda 的 HTTP 调用入口。

C：Network Load Balancer 不能直接将 Lambda 函数作为目标。

D：Global Accelerator 不直接接受 Lambda 函数作为端点，仍需额外受支持入口。

options.text: Expose the Lambda function by using function URLs.
Expose the Lambda function by using a Gateway Load Balancer.
Expose the Lambda function by using a Network Load Balancer.
Expose the Lambda function by using AWS Global Accelerator.
Expose the Lambda function by using Amazon API Gateway.

question_text_original: A company launched an online portal to announce a new product that the company will release in 6 months. The portal requests that users enter an email address to receive communications about the product. The company needs to create a REST API that will store the email addresses in Amazon DynamoDB. A developer has created an AWS Lambda function that can store the email addresses. The developer will deploy the Lambda function by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). The developer must provide access to the Lambda function over HTTP. Which solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST additional configuration? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司的站点展示每日简报。用户访问时，AWS Lambda 函数处理浏览器请求，从公司本地数据库获取英文简报，再调用 Amazon Translate 的 TranslateText API 翻译并展示。网站日益受欢迎后，响应变慢，数据库过载。公司不能更改数据库，需要提高 Lambda 函数响应速度。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：B。Lambda /tmp 可复用暖实例内的翻译结果，但各执行环境不共享；跨实例持久缓存需 S3/ElastiCache。

知识点／记忆点：可复用计算结果的缓存键应包含内容版本和目标语言；临时本地缓存只优化命中的暖实例，必须允许缓存丢失并能重新生成。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：异步调用改变返回语义，不会减少数据库查询和翻译工作，也不能直接返回当前页面。

C：TranslateText 没有题述的一键响应缓存开关，需要应用自行缓存。

D：并行处理可能增加对已经过载数据库的压力，不能消除重复读取。

options.text: Change to asynchronous Lambda function invocation.
Cache the translated newsletters in the Lambda/tmp directory.
Enable TranslateText API caching.
Change the Lambda function to use parallel processing.

question_text_original: A company has a website that displays a daily newsletter. When a user visits the website, an AWS Lambda function processes the browser's request and queries the company's on-premises database to obtain the current newsletter. The newsletters are stored in English. The Lambda function uses the Amazon Translate TranslateText API operation to translate the newsletters, and the translation is displayed to the user. Due to an increase in popularity, the website's response time has slowed. The database is overloaded. The company cannot change the database and needs a solution that improves the response time of the Lambda function. Which solution meets these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在监控运行于 Amazon EC2 实例的应用，已配置数据粒度为 1 秒的自定义 Amazon CloudWatch 指标。发生问题时，希望在 30 秒内通过 Amazon SNS 收到通知。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。高分辨率 CloudWatch alarm 可设置 10/20/30 秒周期监测高分辨率指标。

适用前提与时效：短周期告警可满足题目目标，但端到端送达还受指标发布、评估及 SNS 投递延迟影响，不能视作严格的 30 秒送达保证。

知识点／记忆点：高分辨率采样和快速告警是两个配置：发布细粒度数据后，还需设置短评估周期、阈值及通知动作。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：仪表板用于展示数据，仅创建它不会触发 SNS 通知。

C：查询日志不等于为已有高分辨率自定义指标配置秒级告警。

D：改用默认指标可能降低采样频率，也不会自动配置告警通知。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Alarms.html

options.text: Configure a high-resolution CloudWatch alarm.
Set up a custom CloudWatch dashboard.
Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights.
Change to a default CloudWatch metric.

question_text_original: A developer is monitoring an application that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The developer has configured a custom Amazon CloudWatch metric with data granularity of 1 second. If any issues occur, the developer wants to be notified within 30 seconds by Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). What should the developer do to meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司的 Web 应用包含 Amazon API Gateway REST API。开发人员创建了初次部署的 AWS CloudFormation 模板，并通过 AWS CodePipeline CI/CD 成功部署，全部资源和方法都可经阶段端点访问。模板包含 AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi、AWS::ApiGateway::Resource、AWS::ApiGateway::Method、AWS::ApiGateway::Stage 和 AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment。后来开发人员增加带有更多方法的新资源并重新部署，CloudFormation 显示成功且堆栈为 UPDATE_COMPLETE，但所有新方法都返回 404（Not Found）。应如何使新方法可用？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：C。更新 API Gateway 方法后需创建新 deployment 才会在 stage 生效；CodeBuild 调 CLI 可行但模板管理 Deployment 更清晰。

适用前提与时效：CLI create-deployment 还需指定目标 stage 或随后更新 Stage 的 deploymentId；仅生成未被引用的部署快照并不会切换线上接口。

知识点／记忆点：REST API 的资源定义和已发布快照分离；Stage 指向一个 deployment，修改方法后需生成新快照并使 Stage 指向它。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：关闭回滚不创建新 API 快照，无法让新增方法对外可用。

B：堆栈失败处理设置与 Stage 使用哪个部署版本无关。

D：CloudFront 失效操作只清缓存，不能发布 API Gateway 的新方法。

options.text: Specify the disable-rollback option during the update-stack operation.
Unset the CloudFormation stack failure options.
Add an AWS CodeBuild stage to CodePipeline to run the aws apigateway create-deployment AWS CLI command.
Add an action to CodePipeline to run the aws cloudfront create-invalidation AWS CLI command.

question_text_original: A company has a web application that contains an Amazon API Gateway REST API. A developer has created an AWS CloudFormation template for the initial deployment of the application. The developer has deployed the application successfully as part of an AWS CodePipeline continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) process. All resources and methods are available through the deployed stage endpoint. The CloudFormation template contains the following resource types: • AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi • AWS::ApiGateway::Resource • AWS::ApiGateway::Method • AWS::ApiGateway::Stage • AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment The developer adds a new resource to the REST API with additional methods and redeploys the template. CloudFormation reports that the deployment is successful and that the stack is in the UPDATE_COMPLETE state. However, calls to all new methods are returning 404 (Not Found) errors. What should the developer do to make the new methods available?

question_text: 开发人员更新了 Amazon API Gateway API 使用的 AWS Lambda 函数，该 API 是 Web 应用后端。生产部署前需要测试更新，且不能影响任何生产用户。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。独立 test stage 与 stage variables 可试用新版 Lambda 而不改变生产流量。

知识点／记忆点：验证新代码与逐步放量是不同阶段：完全不影响生产用户时，需要独立测试入口；阶段变量可让相同 API 定义绑定不同后端。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：金丝雀部署会让部分现有用户访问新版本，不满足零生产用户影响。

B：改成私有 API 会改变生产访问条件，也没有隔离测试版本。

D：复制整套基础设施可以隔离，但比增加测试阶段具有更高运维开销。

options.text: Create a canary release deployment for the existing API stage. Deploy the API to the existing stage. Test the updated Lambda function by using the existing URL.
Update the API Gateway API endpoint type to private. Deploy the changes to the existing API stage. Test the API by using the existing URL.
