Create a new test API stage in API Gateway. Add stage variables to deploy the updated Lambda function to only the test stage. Test the updated Lambda function by using the new stage URL.
Create a new AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy a copy of the entire production API and Lambda function. Use the stack's API URL to test the updated Lambda function.

question_text_original: A developer updates an AWS Lambda function that an Amazon API Gateway API uses. The API is the backend for a web application. The developer needs to test the updated Lambda function before deploying the Lambda function to production. The testing must not affect any production users of the web application. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

question_text: 开发人员希望在新部署引发错误时，能够回退到 AWS Lambda 函数的旧版本。如何以最小的用户影响实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。Lambda alias 指向发布版本，出错时改回先前版本即可回滚。

适用前提与时效：原库保留 A；B 同样支持快速回滚，并可能更符合最小影响，题目不能据此唯一排除 B。

知识点／记忆点：版本固定代码快照，别名固定调用入口；回滚应移动入口指向，而不是让每个调用方逐一更新版本 ARN。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：这也是有效的加权别名金丝雀方案，且可减小新版本暴露范围，不能断言技术上错误。

C：直接修改调用方的版本 ARN 会让回滚依赖客户端配置发布。

D：Lambda 别名指向函数版本，不能再指向另一个别名组成路由链。

options.text: Change the application to use an alias that points to the current version. Deploy the new version of the code. Update the alias to use the newly deployed version. If too many errors are encountered, point the alias back to the previous version.

Change the application to use an alias that points to the current version. Deploy the new version of the code. Update the alias to direct 10% of users to the newly deployed version. If too many errors are encountered, send 100% of traffic to the previous version.

Do not make any changes to the application. Deploy the new version of the code. If too many errors are encountered, point the application back to the previous version using the version number in the Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

Create three aliases: new, existing, and router. Point the existing alias to the current version. Have the router alias direct 100% of users to the existing alias. Update the application to use the router alias. Deploy the new version of the code. Point the new alias to this version. Update the router alias to direct 10% of users to the new alias. If too many errors are encountered, send 100% of traffic to the existing alias.

question_text_original: A developer wants the ability to roll back to a previous version of an AWS Lambda function in the event of errors caused by a new deployment. How can the developer achieve this with MINIMAL impact on users?

question_text: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 及其原生 API 密钥验证维护 REST 服务。新上线的注册页面通过 CreateApiKey 创建密钥并发送给用户，但新用户使用密钥调用 API 时收到 403 Forbidden，老用户则不受影响。需要如何更新代码，才能让新用户访问 API？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。API Gateway API key 需绑定 usage plan，createUsagePlanKey 完成关联。

知识点／记忆点：API key 的创建与可用范围授权分开：密钥需关联包含目标 API 阶段的使用计划；API key 也不是用户身份验证的替代品。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：新密钥关联使用计划无需重新部署 API。

B：原生 API key 校验与 authorizer 的身份验证不是同一个配置。

C：导入密钥只创建密钥，不能替代密钥与使用计划的关联。

options.text: The createDeployment method must be called so the API can be redeployed to include the newly created API key.
The updateAuthorizer method must be called to update the API's authorizer to include the newly created API key.
The importApiKeys method must be called to import all newly created API keys into the current stage of the API.
The createUsagePlanKey method must be called to associate the newly created API key with the correct usage plan.

question_text_original: A company maintains a REST service using Amazon API Gateway and the API Gateway native API key validation. The company recently launched a new registration page, which allows users to sign up for the service. The registration page creates a new API key using CreateApiKey and sends the new key to the user. When the user attempts to call the API using this key, the user receives a 403 Forbidden error. Existing users are unaffected and can still call the API. What code updates will grant these new users access to the API?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板部署和管理基础设施，其中创建了 Amazon VPC 安全组和 Amazon EC2 安全组。经理发现部分工程师为测试修改了几个 EC2 实例的安全组。开发人员需要确定发生了哪些修改。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。CloudFormation drift detection 比对实际资源与模板的差异。

知识点／记忆点：漂移检测比较实际配置与模板期望状态；变更集则预览下一次模板更新，两者的时间方向不同。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Conditions 控制模板资源是否创建，不检测人工改动。

C：执行变更集会更新资源，不是查看现有资源与模板的偏差。

D：Detective 用于安全调查，不提供 CloudFormation 模板属性漂移对比。

options.text: Add a Conditions section statement in the source YAML file of the template. Run the CloudFormation stack.
Perform a drift detection operation on the CloudFormation stack.
Execute a change set for the CloudFormation stack.
Use Amazon Detective to detect the modifications.

question_text_original: A company uses an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy and manage its AWS infrastructure. The CloudFormation template creates Amazon VPC security groups and Amazon EC2 security groups. A manager finds out that some engineers modified the security groups of a few EC2 instances for testing purposes. A developer needs to determine what modifications occurred. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 一个 Amazon EC2 实例附加的 IAM 角色明确拒绝全部 Amazon S3 API 操作。但实例的凭证文件指定了一组具有完整管理员权限的 IAM 访问密钥和秘密访问密钥。实例同时存在多种 IAM 访问方式，以下哪项说法正确？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：D；修正答案：C。默认 SDK 凭证链若读到本机 shared credentials 的管理员密钥，就不会用 EC2 role；role 的显式拒绝不自动套用到另一身份。

适用前提与时效：C 以 SDK 使用共享凭证文件、且无其他组织或资源层显式拒绝为前提，并非能访问任意第三方私有桶。

知识点／记忆点：先确定请求实际使用的身份，再评估策略；凭证链选中的身份不会自动继承机器上其他身份的拒绝策略。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：题目给的是管理员凭证，没有仅允许列桶的限定。

B：IAM 权限并不存在一次只能列一个桶内容的此类规则。

D：实例角色的拒绝不适用于被凭证链选中的另一个 IAM 用户身份。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/file-format.html

options.text: The EC2 instance will only be able to list the S3 buckets.
The EC2 instance will only be able to list the contents of one S3 bucket at a time.
The EC2 instance will be able to perform all actions on any S3 bucket.
The EC2 instance will not be able to perform any S3 action on any S3 bucket.

question_text_original: An IAM role is attached to an Amazon EC2 instance that explicitly denies access to all Amazon S3 API actions. The EC2 instance credentials file specifies the IAM access key and secret access key, which allow full administrative access. Given that multiple modes of IAM access are present for this EC2 instance, which of the following is correct?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数，将文件从 Amazon S3 存储桶传输到公司的 SFTP 服务器。函数通过用户名和密码连接 SFTP，这些凭证存储在 Lambda 环境变量中。开发人员需要实现加密的用户名和密码凭证。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：B。Parameter Store 必须用 SecureString 类型才加密凭证；普通 String 迁移不满足安全要求。

适用前提与时效：B 必须选择 SecureString 并配置读取与解密权限；Lambda 环境变量本身也默认静态加密。

知识点／记忆点：配置存储的类型决定是否加密：SecureString 才是机密参数；KMS 保存的是加密密钥，不是用户名密码的通用数据库。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：IAM 数据库认证针对受支持数据库，不能直接替代普通 SFTP 用户密码。

C：KMS 不提供将任意凭证作为可检索参数保存的功能。

D：加密 S3 文件可以实现保密，但需要自行处理读取和解密，题干未规定低开销时不能视为绝对不可行。

options.text: Remove the user credentials from the Lambda environment. Implement IAM database authentication.
Move the user credentials from Lambda environment variables to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.
Move the user credentials from Lambda environment variables to AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
Move the user credentials from the Lambda environment to an encrypted .txt file. Store the file in an S3 bucket.

question_text_original: A company uses an AWS Lambda function to transfer files from an Amazon S3 bucket to the company's SFTP server. The Lambda function connects to the SFTP server by using credentials such as username and password. The company uses Lambda environment variables to store these credentials. A developer needs to implement encrypted username and password credentials. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个运行于 Amazon EC2 实例的批处理应用，需要读取 Amazon S3 存储桶。如何遵循安全最佳实践授予读取权限？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。EC2 通过 instance profile role 获取 S3 必要权限，避免持久化 access key。

知识点／记忆点：工作负载用角色获取自动轮换的临时凭证；实例配置文件是 EC2 承载角色的容器，不是用户或组的容器。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：IAM 组不能附加到实例配置文件。

C：IAM 用户不能附加到实例配置文件。

D：Web 身份联合需要外部身份令牌流程，EC2 本身已有实例角色机制。

options.text: Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a role. Attach the role to the EC2 instance profile.
Add the permissions inline to an IAM group. Attach the group to the EC2 instance profile.
Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a user. Attach the user to the EC2 instance profile.
Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Use IAM web identity federation to access the S3 bucket with the policy.

question_text_original: A developer is creating a new batch application that will run on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application requires read access to an Amazon S3 bucket. The developer needs to follow security best practices to grant S3 read access to the application. Which solution meets these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司的应用每天从合作伙伴接收批量订单，使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理。如果某个批次不包含订单，函数必须尽快向 Amazon SNS 主题发布消息。哪组步骤所需实现工作最少？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AC。自定义指标记录每日订单处理量，CloudWatch alarm 可按阈值通知异常。

知识点／记忆点：零业务量应显式上报数值 0；没有指标数据不等于零，告警的缺失数据处理也必须单独设置。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：题目没有 Kinesis 数据源，新增消费者和数据流会增加实现工作。

D：每天轮询最多延迟一天，不符合尽快通知。

E：仅将订单写入 Kinesis 既不判断空批次也不发送通知。

options.text: Update the existing Lambda function's code to send an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric for the number of orders in a batch for each partner.
Create a new Lambda function as an Amazon Kinesis data stream consumer. Configure the new Lambda function to track orders and to publish to the SNS topic when a batch contains no orders.
Set up an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that will send a notification to the SNS topic when the value of the custom metric is 0.
Schedule a new Lambda function to analyze Amazon CloudWatch metrics every 24 hours to identify batches that contain no orders. Configure the Lambda function to publish to the SNS topic.
Modify the existing Lambda function to log orders to an Amazon Kinesis data stream.

question_text_original: A company has an application that receives batches of orders from partners every day. The application uses an AWS Lambda function to process the batches. If a batch contains no orders, the Lambda function must publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as soon as possible. Which combination of steps will meet this requirement with the LEAST implementation effort? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员的应用使用配置了本地二级索引（LSI）的 Amazon DynamoDB 表。测试时，表指标报告 ProvisionedThroughputExceededException，但测试套件的请求数没有超过预置容量限制。此问题的原因是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原错误答案：B；修正答案：A。LSI 与基表共用读写吞吐量，分区键倾斜可造成 hot partition；LSI 没有独立 capacity。

知识点／记忆点：总容量有余量不代表每个分区都有余量；倾斜访问会形成热分区，LSI 与主表共享吞吐容量。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：LSI 没有独立的预置吞吐容量。

C：缺少退避会放大重试压力，但不是总容量未用满时出现局部限流的根本解释。

D：权限不足产生访问拒绝，而不是吞吐量超限异常。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/LSI.html

options.text: The data in the table's partition key column is not evenly distributed.
The LSI's capacity is different from the table's capacity.
The application is not implementing exponential backoff retry logic while interacting with the DynamoDB API.
The application has the IAM permission to query the DynamoDB table but not to query the LSI.

question_text_original: A developer has an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table with a configured local secondary index (LSI). During application testing, the DynamoDB table metrics report a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error message. The number of requests made by the test suite did not exceed the table's provisioned capacity limits. What is the cause of this issue?

question_text: 开发人员管理一个通过 Amazon CloudFront 分发内容的网站，静态资源保存在 Amazon S3 中。部署变更后，桶内可以看到新资源，但 CloudFront 提供的网页未反映变更。应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。S3 内容更新后 CloudFront 可能仍缓存旧对象；invalidate 或版本化文件名可刷新。

知识点／记忆点：源站对象更新不会主动刷新边缘缓存；部署应协调资源版本名、TTL 或失效操作，区分源站新旧与缓存新旧。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Object Lock 防止删除或修改受保护版本，不负责 CDN 缓存更新。

B：删除源站旧对象不能清除边缘已缓存副本。

D：没有更换源站的需要，修改分配源配置也不是针对内容更新的缓存失效操作。

options.text: Configure S3 Object Lock to update to the latest version of the files every time an S3 object is updated.
Configure the S3 bucket to clear all old objects from the bucket before new artifacts are uploaded.
Set CloudFront to invalidate the cache after the artifacts have been deployed to Amazon S3.
Set CloudFront to modify the distribution origin after the artifacts have been deployed to Amazon S3.

question_text_original: A developer manages a website that distributes its content by using Amazon CloudFront. The website's static artifacts are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The developer deploys some changes and can see the new artifacts in the S3 bucket. However, the changes do not appear on the webpage that the CloudFront distribution delivers. How should the developer resolve this issue?

question_text: 一家公司的开发团队使用 AWS CodeCommit 进行版本控制，在多个 AWS 账户中拥有仓库。团队正在扩展，成员分布在不同地点。公司必须确保开发人员安全访问这些仓库。哪种方案的运维效率最高？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。IAM Identity Center permission sets 可集中授予开发者 CodeCommit 访问权限。

知识点／记忆点：多账户人员权限适合集中身份和权限集；应按组分配短期访问，避免共享长期访问密钥。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：逐人逐账户维护角色使入离职和权限变更成本上升。

C：共享访问密钥无法可靠区分操作者，并扩大泄露影响范围。

D：SSH 公钥只解决 Git 认证方式，不能集中管理跨账户人员授权。

options.text: Configure IAM roles for each developer and grant access individually.
Configure permission sets in AWS IAM Identity Center to grant access to the accounts.
Share AWS access keys with the development team for direct repository access.
Use public SSH keys for authentication to the CodeCommit repositories.

question_text_original: A company has a development team that uses AWS CodeCommit for version control. The development team has CodeCommit repositories in multiple AWS accounts. The team is expanding to include developers who work in various locations. The company must ensure that the developers have secure access to the repositories. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

question_text: 开发人员在 AWS CloudFormation 部署中收到错误：DELETE_FAILED（以下资源删除失败：[ASGInstanceRole12345678]）。应采取哪项操作解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：信息不足】
参考答案：C。DELETE_FAILED 时改模板加 Retain 通常无法直接救已有失败栈；应排错权限或用 delete-stack RetainResources，但选项未列。

适用前提与时效：原库 C 仅表达保留资源方向；已有 DELETE_FAILED 应使用 RetainResources 或 FORCE_DELETE_STACK 等受支持操作，改模板加 Retain 不一定能执行。

知识点／记忆点：删除失败先查堆栈事件中的具体依赖或权限；保留失败资源后删除堆栈，与强行删除资源本身不是一回事。

选项核查与缺失信息：

A：资源名不能证明 Auto Scaling 服务故障，应先查看删除失败原因。

B：DependsOn 管理依赖顺序，不能泛化修复既有 DELETE_FAILED 或权限错误。

D：现行强制删除使用 deletion-mode，role-arn 指定的是执行角色而非任意待删除资源角色。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/troubleshooting.html

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/cfn-console-delete-stack.html

options.text: Contact AWS Support to report an issue with the Auto Scaling Groups (ASG) service.
Add a DependsOn attribute to the ASGInstanceRole12345678 resource in the CloudFormation template. Then delete the stack.
Modify the CloudFormation template to retain the ASGInstanceRole12345678 resource. Then manually delete the resource after deployment.
Add a force parameter when calling CloudFormation with the role-arn of ASGInstanceRole12345678.

question_text_original: A developer received the following error message during an AWS CloudFormation deployment: DELETE_FAILED (The following resource(s) failed to delete: [ASGInstanceRole12345678].) Which action should the developer take to resolve this error?

question_text: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例在 Amazon ECS 上运行关键应用，需要迁移到 AWS Fargate 上的 ECS。开发人员正在配置 Fargate 和 ECS 容量提供程序。哪种方案能使迁移期间停机最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。ECS cluster 需用 PutClusterCapacityProviders 关联已有 capacity provider。

适用前提与时效：A 的关联 API 和按需基础容量方向较合理，但“Provider 2 for failover”不准确，完整迁移还需服务更新和部署控制。

知识点／记忆点：容量策略的 base 是最低任务数，weight 是剩余任务分配比例；二者不是主备优先级，Spot 容量不足不会自动切换为按需容量。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：FARGATE/FARGATE_SPOT 是预定义容量提供程序，应关联而不是通过 CreateCapacityProvider 创建。

C：将关键基础容量放在 Spot 会引入中断风险，而且其所谓备用切换并非容量策略保证。

D：既混淆创建与关联 API，又将基础任务置于可中断 Spot 容量。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-capacity-providers.html

options.text: Use the PutClusterCapacityProviders API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 2 for failover.

Use the CreateCapacityProvider API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 2 for failover.

Use the PutClusterCapacityProviders API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE as Provider 2 for failover.

Use the CreateCapacityProvider API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE as Provider 2 for failover.

question_text_original: A company runs a critical application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) by using Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to migrate the application to Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate. A developer is configuring Fargate and the ECS capacity providers to make the change. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST downtime during migration?

question_text: 一家公司的 Web 应用托管在 AWS，位于 Amazon CloudFront 分配后方。开发人员需要仪表板，尽可能频繁地监控该分配的错误率和异常。应采取哪些步骤？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BC。CloudFront real-time logs 经 Kinesis Data Streams 可送 OpenSearch 做实时分析。

知识点／记忆点：实时日志面向低延迟观测，标准访问日志面向延后分析；业务访问日志与审计控制面 API 调用的 CloudTrail 不是同一数据。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：标准日志落 S3 后再查询的时效性不如实时流。

D：CloudFront 实时日志直接目标是 Kinesis Data Streams，不能按此描述直接发到 Firehose。

E：CloudTrail 不是接收任意日志并建立此类业务仪表板的目标。

options.text: Stream the CloudFront distribution logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Detect anomalies and error rates by using Amazon Athena.
Enable real-time logs on the CloudFront distribution. Create a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.
Set up Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to send the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service by using an AWS Lambda function. Make a dashboard in OpenSearch Dashboards.
Stream the CloudFront distribution logs to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.
Set up Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to send the logs to AWS CloudTrail. Create CloudTrail metrics, alarms, and dashboards.

question_text_original: A company has a web application that is hosted on AWS. The application is behind an Amazon CloudFront distribution. A developer needs a dashboard to monitor error rates and anomalies of the CloudFront distribution as frequently as possible. Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员创建的 Amazon DynamoDB 表以 OrderID 为分区键、NumberOfItemsPurchased 为排序键，两者类型均为 Number。查询结果按 NumberOfItemsPurchased 升序排列，但开发人员需要降序结果。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。DynamoDB Query 设置 ScanIndexForward=false 可按 sort key 降序读。

知识点／记忆点：Query 的排序由排序键决定，正反方向由查询参数决定；修改字段名或过滤条件不会改变排序方向。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：重复建立同一排序键的 LSI 不会自动变成降序，也无法给现有表任意追加 LSI。

B：字段名称不决定数值排序方向。

D：KeyConditionExpression 是键条件表达式，不接受用于倒序的布尔开关。

options.text: Create a local secondary index (LSI) on the NumberOfItemsPurchased sort key.
Change the sort key from NumberOfItemsPurchased to NumberOfItemsPurchasedDescending.
In the Query operation, set the ScanIndexForward parameter to false.
In the Query operation, set the KeyConditionExpression parameter to false.

question_text_original: A developer creates an Amazon DynamoDB table. The table has OrderID as the partition key and NumberOfItemsPurchased as the sort key. The data type of the partition key and the sort key is Number. When the developer queries the table, the results are sorted by NumberOfItemsPurchased in ascending order. The developer needs the query results to be sorted by NumberOfItemsPurchased in descending order. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 开发人员需要通过代码模板自动将应用部署到 Amazon EC2 实例。模板必须支持重复部署、安装和更新应用资源，创建相同环境，并回退到旧版本。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：C。CloudFormation 定义资源部署模板；若题干要求应用版本部署，还须配合 CodeDeploy/用户数据等交付步骤。

知识点／记忆点：基础设施模板描述期望资源，启动脚本安装软件；应将模板和软件版本一起纳入版本控制，才能可重复创建环境。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Amplify 面向托管应用工作流，不是本题通用 EC2 基础设施模板方案。

B：AppSpec 和部署组属于 CodeDeploy，选项把它们错误归给 CodeBuild。

D：AppSync 的 GraphQL schema 和 resolver 不负责部署 EC2 或基础设施版本回滚。

options.text: Use AWS Amplify for automatic deployment templates. Use a traffic-splitting deployment to copy any deployments. Modify any resources created by Amplify, if necessary.

Use AWS CodeBuild for automatic deployment. Upload the required AppSpec file template. Save the appspec.yml file in the root directory folder of the revision. Specify the deployment group that includes the EC2 instances for the deployment.

Use AWS CloudFormation to create an infrastructure template in JSON format to deploy the EC2 instances. Use CloudFormation helper scripts to install the necessary software and to start the application. Call the scripts directly from the template.

Use AWS AppSync to deploy the application. Upload the template as a GraphQL schema. Specify the EC2 instances for deployment of the application. Use resolvers as a version control mechanism and to make any updates to the deployments.

question_text_original: A developer needs to use a code template to create an automated deployment of an application onto Amazon EC2 instances. The template must be configured to repeat deployment, installation, and updates of resources for the application. The template must be able to create identical environments and roll back to previous versions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员的 CI/CD 流水线使用 AWS CodeArtifact 和 AWS CodeBuild。构建制品大小为 0.5 GB 到 1.5 GB，构建频繁且每次从 CodeArtifact 获取大量依赖。依赖传输耗时导致构建缓慢。开发人员需要减少每次获取的依赖数量以提高性能。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。CodeBuild 本地缓存需在 buildspec cache.paths 指向实际依赖缓存目录，不是仓库名称。

适用前提与时效：C 的本地缓存依赖构建主机复用，并非每次保证命中；A 的表述若正确配置本地 paths 也不能绝对排除。

知识点／记忆点：缓存必须指向构建工具真正写入依赖的文件路径；仓库名称是远端标识，不能替代本地缓存目录。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：S3 缓存也是有效机制；若 paths 指本地依赖目录则可行，只是仍有远端缓存传输成本。

B：填写 CodeArtifact 仓库名称不会缓存本地下载的依赖文件。

D：CodeArtifact 是包仓库，不是此方案中构建配置文件的正常直接来源，且仓库名不是缓存路径。

options.text: Specify an Amazon S3 cache in CodeBuild. Add the S3 cache folder path to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
Specify a local cache in CodeBuild. Add the CodeArtifact repository name to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
Specify a local cache in CodeBuild. Add the cache folder path to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
Retrieve the buildspec.yaml file directly from CodeArtifact. Add the CodeArtifact repository name to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.

question_text_original: A developer has a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that uses AWS CodeArtifact and AWS CodeBuild. The build artifacts are between 0.5 GB and 1.5 GB in size. The builds happen frequently and retrieve many dependencies from CodeArtifact each time. The builds have been slow because of the time it takes to transfer dependencies. The developer needs to improve build performance by reducing the number of dependencies that are retrieved for each build. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家大型在线企业使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表存储销售数据，并已启用 DynamoDB Streams。每笔销售的 TransactionStatus 属性只能为 failed、pending 或 completed。当状态为失败且 Price 超过指定阈值时，公司需要收到通知。开发人员应采用哪种方案，以最少的开发工作实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。DynamoDB Streams 配 Lambda event source mapping 可按批处理表变更并写下游。

适用前提与时效：现有答案 A 存在实质争议：DynamoDB 事件过滤不支持 numeric 运算，Price 大于阈值需要在代码中判断；建议将本题交回复核，勿硬背 A。

知识点／记忆点：事件源过滤适合支持的字段匹配，但要核对源数据类型；DynamoDB 流将数字放在 N 字符串中，不能直接使用 Lambda 数值范围过滤。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：B 在函数中比较 Price 能实现真实的数值阈值，因此不能判为技术错误，反而避开 A 的过滤能力限制。

C：SNS 不能作为 DynamoDB Streams 的 Lambda 事件源映射消费者。

D：CloudWatch 告警读取指标，不直接逐条读取流中的销售字段。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-ddb-filtering.html

options.text: Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an AWS Lambda function. Use Lambda event filtering to trigger the Lambda function only if sales fail when the price is above the specified threshold. Configure the Lambda function to publish the data to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function handler code to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if sales fail when price is above the specified threshold.

Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use event filtering to publish to the SNS topic if sales fail when the price is above the specified threshold.

Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor the DynamoDB Streams sales data. Configure the alarm to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if sales fail due when price is above the specified threshold.

question_text_original: A company that has large online business uses an Amazon DynamoDB table to store sales data. The company enabled Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table. The transaction status of each sale is stored in a TransactionStatus attribute in the table. The value of the TransactionStatus attribute must be either failed, pending, or completed. The company wants to be notified of failed sales where the Price attribute is above a specific threshold. A developer needs to set up notification for the failed sales. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 一个 AWS Lambda 函数被异步调用来处理事件，但偶尔处理失败。开发人员需要收集并分析失败事件以修复问题。如何以最少的开发工作实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。异步 Lambda 失败事件可送 SQS DLQ 留存以供排查重放。

知识点／记忆点：异步调用由 Lambda 管理重试；重试耗尽后要保存事件本身才能重放，普通日志不一定保留完整可恢复负载。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：函数日志默认去 CloudWatch Logs，CloudTrail 不是业务日志错误筛选位置。

B：增加 Step Functions 并改写调用流程，比配置现成失败事件出口复杂。

D：Lambda 异步调用死信队列不支持 SNS FIFO 主题作为此目标。

options.text: Add logging statements for all events in the Lambda function. Filter AWS CloudTrail logs for errors.
Configure the Lambda function to start an AWS Step Functions workflow with retries for failed events.
Add a dead-letter queue to send messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue.
Add a dead-letter queue to send messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic.

question_text_original: An AWS Lambda function is invoked asynchronously to process events. Occasionally, the Lambda function falls to process events. A developer needs to collect and analyze these failed events to fix the issue. What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 一家公司的应用使用 Amazon S3 存储对象。开发人员需要配置传输加密，并对所有包含个人数据的对象，使用可按需轮换的 AWS KMS 密钥进行静态加密。哪组步骤能够满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：CD。客户端加密保护对象传输内容，S3 bucket policy 可用 aws:SecureTransport 拒绝非 TLS 访问。

知识点／记忆点：传输加密与对象静态加密是独立控制；拒绝非 TLS 请求应写显式 Deny，客户端加密则由应用在上传前执行。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：权限边界是身份权限上限，不是桶策略强制 HTTPS 的条件机制。

B：桶策略只能允许或拒绝请求，不能替应用执行客户端加密。

E：Block Public Access 控制公开访问，不要求连接使用 HTTPS。

options.text: Write an S3 bucket policy to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS by using permissions boundary.
Configure an S3 bucket policy to enable client-side encryption for the objects containing personal data by using an AWS KMS customer managed key.
Configure the application to encrypt the objects by using an AWS KMS customer managed key before uploading the objects containing personal data to Amazon S3.
Write an S3 bucket policy to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS by using the aws:SecureTransport condition.
Configure S3 Block Public Access settings for the S3 bucket to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS.

question_text_original: A company has an application that uses an Amazon S3 bucket for object storage. A developer needs to configure in-transit encryption for the S3 bucket. All the S3 objects containing personal data needs to be encrypted at rest with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys, which can be rotated on demand. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司有一个处理图片的桌面单体应用，开发人员正在用 Python 将其转换为 AWS Lambda 函数。桌面应用每 5 分钟处理 Amazon S3 存储桶中的最新图片，并在 1 分钟内完成。AWS 测试中，函数确实每 5 分钟运行一次，但处理任务超过 2 分钟。开发人员需要提高 Lambda 性能。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Lambda memory 增加通常也提高可用 CPU，有助缩短图像处理时长。

知识点／记忆点：单次执行速度、并发吞吐和调度频率要分开：CPU 密集任务需要更多计算资源，不是更多同时执行次数。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：普通 Lambda 配置不能选择 EC2 计算优化实例类型。

B：升级运行时可能有收益，但无法保证解决资源不足导致的图像处理耗时。

D：预留并发控制并发额度，不提高单次函数的 CPU 配额。

options.text: Update the instance type of the Lambda function to a compute optimized instance with at least eight virtual CPU (vCPU).
Update the configuration of the Lambda function to use the latest Python runtime.
Increase the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
Configure a reserved concurrency on the Lambda function.

question_text_original: A company has a monolithic desktop-based application that processes images. A developer is converting the application into an AWS Lambda function by using Python. Currently, the desktop application runs every 5 minutes to process the latest image from an Amazon S3 bucket. The desktop application completes the image processing task within 1 minute. During testing on AWS, the developer notices that the Lambda function runs at the specified 5-minute interval. However, the Lambda function takes more than 2 minutes to complete the image processing task. The developer needs a solution that will improve the Lambda function's performance. Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司通过 AWS CloudFormation 模板管理面向公众应用的开发、预生产和生产基础设施。为应对客户需求增长，开发人员必须将 Amazon RDS 数据库实例升级为更大类型。在预生产环境部署此堆栈更新后，发现状态变为 UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED。哪个选项是原因？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：B。CloudFormation 更新回滚失败可能因外部修改资源，也可能因权限/配额等；仅凭状态无法唯一判定根因。

知识点／记忆点：UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED 表示连恢复旧状态也失败，不只是更新失败；应沿堆栈事件找到回滚阶段的失败资源和原因。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：无效规格可导致更新失败，但不能单凭这一点解释为什么回滚也失败。

C：模板语法错误通常在验证阶段被拒绝，不能直接推导出回滚失败。

D：权限不足也可能使更新或回滚失败，必须结合事件，不能从状态唯一排除。

options.text: The new instance type specified in the CloudFormation template is invalid
The database was deleted or modified manually outside of the CloudFormation stack
There is a syntax error in the CloudFormation template
The developer has insufficient IAM permissions to provision an instance of the specified type

question_text_original: A company uses AWS CloudFormation templates to manage infrastructure for a public-facing application in its development, pre-production, and production environments. The company needs to scale for increasing customer demand. A developer must upgrade the Amazon RDS DB instance type to a larger instance. The developer deploys an update to the CloudFormation stack with the instance size change in the pre-production environment. The developer notices that the stack is in an UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED slate in CloudFormation. Which option is the cause of this issue?

question_text: 开发人员需要在 Amazon S3 存储桶中保存公司应用文件。每个对象可以有多个版本，但必须在对象创建一年后永久删除。开发人员已创建启用版本控制的存储桶。接下来应如何满足数据保留要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：A。版本化桶需要同时处理当前版本过期与非当前版本删除；非当前版本的计时从变为非当前版本开始，并非原始创建时间，因此 A 是最接近的选项，不能保证创建满一年立即永久删除所有版本。

知识点／记忆点：版本化桶里删除当前对象通常产生删除标记，旧版本仍占空间；非当前版本生命周期从成为非当前版本开始计时。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：对象创建时尚未满一年，触发一次的检查不会自动在一年后再次执行。

C：删除事件发生后才检查，不能主动为尚未删除的到期对象安排清理。

D：仅删除过期删除标记和非当前版本，不能使仍为当前版本的对象到期。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_NoncurrentVersionExpiration.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 339

options.text: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 bucket. Configure the rule to expire current versions of objects and permanently delete noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.

Create an event notification for all object creation events in the S3 bucket. Configure the event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to check the object creation date and to delete the object if the object is older than 1 year.

Create an event notification for all object removal events in the S3 bucket. Configure the event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to check the object creation date and to delete the object if the object is older than 1 year.
Create an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 bucket. Configure the rule to delete expired object delete markers and permanently delete noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.

question_text_original:
A developer needs to store files in an Amazon S3 bucket for a company's application. Each S3 object can have multiple versions. The objects must be permanently removed 1 year after object creation.

The developer creates an S3 bucket that has versioning enabled.

What should the developer do next to meet the data retention requirements?

question_text: 一家公司使用 AWS X-Ray 监控无服务器应用。各组件请求速率不同：重要的用户交互和交易量较低，而健康检查、轮询和连接维护等后台任务产生大量只读请求。目前所有请求统一使用默认采样规则，只记录每秒第一个请求及部分额外请求，无法有效按服务或请求类型审查。开发人员必须按服务或请求属性配置跟踪规则，记录用户交互和交易，避免将精力浪费在次要后台任务上。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。对低频关键交易全量追踪，对高频后台只读请求降低采样率；禁用采样在本题语境中指记录全部请求，而不是停止追踪。

知识点／记忆点：采样预算优先留给低频高价值交易；“不采样而全量追踪”是全收集，并非关闭追踪，应与“关闭追踪”区分。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：高频后台全量记录、关键交易降采样，优先级正好相反。

B：高频只读请求仍提高采样率，会浪费追踪预算。

D：后台请求全量记录仍产生大量低价值数据。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 340

options.text: Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests. Sample at a lower rate for all requests that handle user interactions or transactions.
Disable sampling and trace all requests for requests that handle user interactions or transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a higher rate.
Disable sampling and trace all requests for requests that handle user interactions or transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a lower rate.
Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests. Sample at a higher rate for all requests that handle user interactions or transactions.

question_text_original:
A company uses AWS X-Ray to monitor a serverless application. The components of the application have different request rates. The user interactions and transactions are important to trace, but they are low in volume. The background processes such as application health checks, polling, and connection maintenance generate high volumes of read-only requests.

Currently, the default X-Ray sampling rules are universal for all requests. Only the first request per second and some additional requests are recorded. This setup is not helping the company review the requests based on service or request type.

A developer must configure rules to trace requests based on service or request properties. The developer must trace the user interactions and transactions without wasting effort recording minor background tasks.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员在应用中使用 AWS Lambda 函数编辑用户上传的照片，现在需要更新并测试代码。测试时必须将用户流量分配给原版本和新版本。哪组步骤能够满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AD。先发布两个不可变函数版本，再用同一加权别名分配流量；CodeBuild 本身不提供 Lambda 流量切换。

知识点／记忆点：加权别名在两个已发布版本之间分流；URL 是调用入口而不是函数版本，构建工具也不等于流量路由器。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：CodeBuild 负责构建测试，本身不提供 Lambda 渐进流量切换。

C：创建两个 URL 不会自动按比例分流，还会改变调用入口。

E：别名指向函数版本，不能指向函数 URL。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 341

options.text: Publish a version of the original Lambda function. Make the necessary changes to the Lambda code. Publish a new version of the Lambda function.

Use AWS CodeBuild to detect updates to the Lambda function. Configure CodeBuild to incrementally shift traffic from the original version of the Lambda function to the new version of the Lambda function.
Update the original version of the Lambda function to add a function URL. Make the necessary changes to the Lambda code. Publish another function URL for the updated Lambda code.

Create an alias that points to the original version of the Lambda function. Configure the alias to be a weighted alias that also includes the new version of the Lambda function. Divide traffic between the two versions.
Create an alias that points to the original function URL. Configure the alias to be a weighted alias that also includes the additional function URL. Divide traffic between the two function URLs.

question_text_original:
A developer uses an AWS Lambda function in an application to edit users' uploaded photos. The developer needs to update the Lambda function code and needs to test the updates.

For testing, the developer must divide the user traffic between the original version of the Lambda function and the new version of the Lambda function.

Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司曾有一个名为 mysql-db 的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例，在过去 90 天内被删除。开发人员需要查出哪个 IAM 用户或角色删除了它。哪种方案能够提供此信息？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudTrail 事件历史保留最近 90 天管理事件，可按 DeleteDBInstance 和资源筛选，并从 userIdentity 查操作者。

知识点／记忆点：调查“谁修改了资源”看审计事件的身份、动作与时间；数据库运行日志和分布式追踪回答的是应用执行问题。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：数据库日志记录引擎活动，不是删除实例管理操作的身份审计来源。

C：X-Ray 的调用链和 ErrorRootCauses 不记录谁执行 DeleteDBInstance。

D：Systems Manager Inventory 不提供题目所述 RDS 删除者清单。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/view-cloudtrail-events-console.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 342

options.text: Retrieve the AWS CloudTrail events for the resource mysql-db where the event name is DeleteDBInstance. Inspect each event.
Retrieve the Amazon CloudWatch log events from the most recent log stream within the rds/mysql-db log group. Inspect the log events.
Retrieve the AWS X-Ray trace summaries. Filter by services with the name mysql-db. Inspect the ErrorRootCauses values within each summary.
Retrieve the AWS Systems Manager deletions inventory. Filter the inventory by deletions that have a TypeName value of RDS. Inspect the deletion details.

question_text_original:
A company had an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance that was named mysql-db. The DB instance was deleted within the past 90 days.

A developer needs to find which IAM user or role deleted the DB instance in the AWS environment.

Which solution will provide this information?

question_text: 一家公司的电商 Web 应用原使用本地 MySQL 数据库存储数据，现已迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL。开发人员需要配置应用访问数据库，且不能使用长期凭证。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。RDS MySQL 的 IAM 数据库认证使用短期令牌，避免在应用中保存长期数据库密码；还需配置数据库用户和 rds-db:connect 权限。

知识点／记忆点：将长期密码换成短期数据库登录令牌，才是不使用长期凭证；仅把密码搬到安全存储不会改变它的生命周期。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Secrets Manager 可以安全保存和轮换密码，但此选项仍使用数据库密码。

C：环境变量只是传递配置，既不生成临时令牌也不消除长期凭证。

D：SecureString 提供加密存储，仍保存长期用户名密码。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 343

options.text: Enable IAM database authentication on the RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions. Assign the role to the application.
Store the MySQL credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions to retrieve the secrets. Assign the role to the application.
Configure the MySQL credentials as environment variables that are available at runtime for the application.

Store the MySQL credentials as SecureString parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions to retrieve the parameters. Assign the role to the application.

question_text_original:
A company has an ecommerce web application that uses an on-premises MySQL database as a data store. The company migrates the on-premises MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL.

A developer needs to configure the application's access to the RDS for MySQL database. The developer's solution must not use long term credentials.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建一个将过期项目从 Amazon DynamoDB 转移到 Amazon S3 的应用。表已设置在指定 TTL 后自动删除项目。应用必须处理 DynamoDB 项目，再将过期项目存入 S3；处理和存储全过程需要 5 分钟。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。TTL 删除可通过 DynamoDB Streams 驱动 Lambda；使用包含旧镜像的流记录取得已删除内容并归档 S3，五分钟处理在 Lambda 时限内。

知识点／记忆点：删除后的项目不能再从表中读取，归档必须使用流里的旧镜像；TTL 是异步删除机制，不保证到期瞬间触发。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：DAX 是读取缓存，不是 TTL 删除调度器或归档执行器。

C：自管 EC2/ECS 集群增加主机、扩展和轮询维护工作。

D：仅创建 EventBridge 规则没有提供逐条 TTL 删除事件的来源与被删内容。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 344

options.text: Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to query for expired items based on the TTL. Save the results to Amazon S3.
Configure DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.

Deploy a custom application on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on Amazon EC2 instances. Program the custom application to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.

question_text_original:
A developer is creating an application that must transfer expired items from Amazon DynamoDB to Amazon S3. The developer sets up the DynamoDB table to automatically delete items after a specific TTL. The application must process the items in DynamoDB and then must store the expired items in Amazon S3. The entire process, including item processing and storage in Amazon S3, will take 5 minutes.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 开发人员的应用使用 Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API，希望通过 API Gateway Lambda 授权程序控制访问，并增加凭证缓存，减少每次请求重复使用密钥和授权令牌。应采取哪些步骤？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：原答案错误，已修正】
原参考答案：AC；核查答案：BC。WebSocket API 使用 REQUEST 类型 Lambda authorizer，且只在连接路由鉴权；可通过 context 传递身份信息。TOKEN 类型不适用于 WebSocket，不能照搬 REST API 的缓存语义。

知识点／记忆点：WebSocket 只在建立连接时运行 Lambda 授权；后续消息可使用连接身份上下文，但不应照搬 REST TOKEN authorizer 的缓存假设。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：WebSocket Lambda authorizer 采用 REQUEST 类型，不支持 TOKEN 类型。

D：API key 不是用户身份授权上下文，引用它不能替代正确的授权上下文传递。

E：VPC 端点策略不是 WebSocket 应用身份认证与令牌复用机制。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-lambda-auth.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 345

options.text: Use a token-based Lambda authorizer.
Use a request parameter-based Lambda authorizer.
Configure an integration request mapping template to reference the context map from the APIGateway Lambda authorizer.
Configure an integration request mapping template to reference the identity API key value from the API Gateway Lambda authorizer.
Use VPC endpoint policies for the WebSocket APIs.

question_text_original:
A developer has an application that uses WebSocket APIs in Amazon API Gateway. The developer wants to use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to control access to the application.

The developer needs to add credential caching and reduce repeated usage of secret keys and authorization tokens on every request.

Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员使用 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 和 Amazon Route 53 构建无服务器应用。测试中发现错误，但无法立即定位根因，因此需要搜索全部应用日志。如何以最少的运维开销实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。把 API Gateway 和 Lambda 应用日志集中到 CloudWatch Logs，再用 Logs Insights 跨日志组查询；CloudTrail 记录的是 API 审计而非完整应用运行日志。

知识点／记忆点：先让实际运行日志集中可查询，再跨日志组关联错误；可用性探测告诉你故障是否发生，日志才提供具体失败上下文。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：PutMetricData 写指标而不是日志，Athena 也不直接查询 CloudWatch Logs。

B：CloudTrail 管理审计不会取代 Lambda 与 API Gateway 的应用运行日志。

C：额外搭建流式投递、存储与搜索集群增加运维，且并非所有服务能按描述直接投递。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 347

options.text: Set up API Gateway health checks to monitor the application's availability. Use the Amazon CloudWatch PutMetricData API operation to publish the logs to CloudWatch. Search and query the logs by using Amazon Athena.

Set up Route 53 health checks to monitor the application's availability. Turn on AWS CloudTrail logs for all the AWS services that the application uses. Send the logs to a specified Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the log files directly from Amazon S3.

question_text_original:
A developer builds a serverless application on AWS by using Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda functions, and Amazon Route 53. During testing, the developer notices errors but cannot immediately locate the root cause.

To identify the errors, the developer needs to search all the application's logs.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_text: 开发人员需要在生产发布前冻结 AWS CodeCommit 仓库的变更。QA 团队测试发布版本时，开发人员仍需开发新功能。QA 测试及所有缺陷修复必须与主分支隔离，发布后再将全部修复合入主分支。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。从发布提交创建 release 分支，隔离修复和主分支新功能，发布后把修复合回主分支；tag 不是可持续提交修复的分支。

知识点／记忆点：分支是可继续提交的开发线，标签是某个提交的标记；发布修复要合回主线，避免下次发布重新引入已修复缺陷。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：将标签移动到包含新功能的主分支，会把未验收功能一起带入发布。

C：重放主分支会改写提交历史，对共享主线比合并发布修复风险更高，并非最直接方案。

D：标签不是可接收新提交的分支，不能把修复提交直接应用到标签。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 348

options.text: Create a release branch from the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Apply fixes to the release branch. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Merge the release branch into the main branch after the release.

Create a Git tag on the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Apply fixes to the main branch. Update the Git tag for the release to be on the latest commit on the main branch.

Create a release branch from the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Apply fixes to the release branch. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Rebase the main branch onto the release branch after the release.

Create a Git tag on the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Apply the Git commits for fixes to the Git tag for the release.

question_text_original:
A developer needs to freeze changes to an AWS CodeCommit repository before a production release. The developer will work on new features while a quality assurance (QA) team tests the release.

The QA testing and all bug fixes must take place in isolation from the main branch. After the release, the developer must integrate all bug fixes into the main branch.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在为新应用设置 AWS CodePipeline，每次构建都必须生成测试报告。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CodeBuild 执行测试，并在 buildspec 的 reports 中声明报告文件与格式；CodeDeploy 和 CodeArtifact 不是测试报告服务。

知识点／记忆点：运行测试与发布测试报告是两步：测试工具先生成报告文件，再通过 buildspec 的 reports 描述格式和路径供服务收集。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：CodeDeploy/AppSpec 管部署生命周期，不提供 CodeBuild 的测试报告收集配置。

C：仅安装 SSM Agent 不会执行测试或生成测试报告。

D：CodeArtifact 管理软件包，不提供这里的测试报告模板执行流程。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 349

Create an AWS CodeDeploy deployment that runs tests. Configure the AppSpec file with the test report information.
Run the builds on an Amazon EC2 instance that has AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) installed and activated.
Create a repository in AWS CodeArtifact. Select the test report template.

question_text_original:
A developer is setting up AWS CodePipeline for a new application. During each build, the developer must generate a test report.

Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 开发人员用多个 AWS Lambda 函数构建应用。函数运行时必须访问动态配置，该配置以 6 KB JSON 文档保存在 AWS AppConfig。配置更新不能要求重新部署应用。如何以最少的开发工作让函数访问这些动态配置？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。AppConfig Agent Lambda extension 通过 localhost 提供缓存配置，并按轮询周期更新，无需重新部署函数。

知识点／记忆点：动态配置需在运行时独立获取，缓存降低远端请求但必须可刷新；将配置打进发布包会重新耦合配置变更与代码发布。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：6 KB 超过常规 Lambda 环境变量总大小限制，且环境变量不是 AppConfig 的动态更新渠道。

C：X-Ray SDK 用于追踪，不是 AppConfig 配置检索 SDK。

D：部署包中的文件只有重新部署才能更新，不满足动态配置需求。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/appconfig-integration-lambda-extensions-how-it-works.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 350

options.text: Migrate the document from AWS AppConfig to a Lambda environment variable. Read the document at the runtime.
Configure the AWS AppConfig Agent Lambda extension. Access the dynamic configuration data by calling the extension on a local host.
Use the AWS X-Ray SDK to call the AWS AppConfig APIs. Retrieve the configuration file at runtime.
Migrate the configuration file to a Lambda deployment package. Read the file from the file system at runtime.

question_text_original:
A developer built an application by using multiple AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda functions must access dynamic configuration data at runtime. The data is maintained as a 6 KB JSON document in AWS AppConfig. The configuration data needs to be updated without requiring the redeployment of the application.

The developer needs a solution that will give the Lambda functions access to the dynamic configuration data.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员的 AWS Lambda 函数需要访问公司内部数据科学库及参考数据。库和数据分别由不同团队管理，各团队必须能够独立更新并上传新数据。函数已连接公司中央 VPC。哪种方案可以提供所需访问？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。Lambda 可挂载同 VPC 的 EFS 共享文件系统，使多个团队独立更新库和参考数据；还需配置访问点、网络和执行角色权限。

知识点／记忆点：跨函数共享且需独立更新的数据适合网络文件系统；每个执行环境的临时目录不是共享持久存储。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Lambda 不支持像 EC2 那样直接附加 EBS Multi-Attach 卷。

B：/tmp 属于单个执行环境，不能让不同函数和团队共同维护持久数据。

D：Lambda 原生文件系统挂载集成针对 EFS，不是 Windows SMB 文件共享。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-filesystem-efs.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 351

options.text: Attach an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume to the Lambda functions by using EBS Multi-Attach in the central VPC. question_text_original:
A developer has AWS Lambda functions that need to access a company's internal data science libraries and reference data. Separate teams manage the libraries and the data. The teams must be able to update and upload new data independently. The Lambda functions are connected to the company's central VPC.

Which solution will provide the Lambda functions with access to the libraries and data?

question_text: 一家公司的 AWS Lambda 函数消费 Amazon SQS 队列消息，该队列配置了死信队列。由于应用缺陷，部分消息处理失败。开发人员已修复缺陷，希望重新处理失败消息。应如何操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。SQS 的 StartMessageMoveTask 启动死信队列重驱动；PurgeQueue 会删除消息，ChangeMessageVisibility 不会搬移消息。

知识点／记忆点：死信重驱动是重新投递，清空队列是永久删除；可见性超时只影响同一队列内消息何时能再次被接收。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：SendMessageBatch 只发送给定内容，不会自动从死信队列读取、移动并管理删除。

B：修改可见性不会把消息从一个队列移到另一个队列。

D：PurgeQueue 删除消息，不会将其返回原队列。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_StartMessageMoveTask.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 352

options.text: Use the SendMessageBatch API to send messages from the dead-letter queue to the original SQS queue.
Use the ChangeMessageVisibility API to configure messages in the dead-letter queue to be visible in the original SQS queue.
Use the StartMessageMoveTask API to move messages from the dead-letter queue to the original SQS queue.
Use the PurgeQueue API to remove messages from the dead-letter queue and return the messages to the original SQS queue.

question_text_original:
A company has an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to consume messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The SQS queue is configured with a dead-letter queue. Due to a defect in the application, AWS Lambda failed to process some messages. A developer fixed the bug and wants to process the failed messages again.

How should the developer resolve this issue?

question_text: 开发人员正在开发将部署到 AWS 的应用，需要在本地测试和调试代码。代码已打包并保存在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。如何以最少的配置在本地测试和调试？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：D。CodeDeploy 本地部署功能可验证应用包和部署脚本；命令形式依操作系统而异，且不是通用源码调试器。D 对应本题意图，需先安装和配置 agent。

知识点／记忆点：本地验证部署包与云端流水线测试不同；部署代理能复现安装生命周期，但并不代替应用源码调试器。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：需注册本地实例并建立应用和部署组，比本地部署命令配置更多。

B：CodeArtifact 上游仓库用于包解析，不会本地执行应用测试。

C：这是云端构建测试流水线，不是在本地机器调试。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployments-local.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 353

For the repository type, specify that the application is stored in Amazon S3. Start the deployment to test on the local machine.

A developer is working on an application that will be deployed on AWS. The developer needs to test and debug the code locally. The code is packaged and stored in an Amazon S3 bucket.

question_text: 开发人员正在 Amazon ECS 上创建应用，需要配置最大并发连接数和每秒最大事务数。这些上限未来可能变化，因此需要能够按需自动部署参数变更且不造成停机的方案。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。AppConfig Agent 可在 ECS 获取配置，配合预定义 Canary10Percent20Minutes 策略渐进发布；应用需从 agent 读取动态配置。

知识点／记忆点：运行参数变化应走配置发布，代码变化才需要重建应用；逐步下发配置还需客户端轮询或代理缓存刷新才能生效。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：ECS CodeDeploy 使用蓝绿部署，且重部署代码不是动态参数发布的低开销方式。

B：ECSCanary10Percent15Minutes 不是 ECS 的 launch type，不能按该方式设置。

D：CloudWatch 告警不通过每五分钟检查函数代码更新来自动识别配置发布，且引入自定义编排。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/appconfig-creating-deployment-strategy-predefined.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 354

options.text: Make the configuration changes for the application. Use AWS CodeDeploy to create a deployment configuration. Specify an in-place deployment to deploy the changes.

Bootstrap the application to use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) and make the configuration changes. Specify the ECSCanary10Percent15Minutes launch type in the properties section of the ECS resource. Deploy the application by using the AWS CDK to implement the changes.

Install the AWS AppConfig agent on Amazon ECS. Configure an IAM role with access to AWS AppConfig. Make the deployment changes by using AWS AppConfig. Specify Canary10Percent20Minutes as the deployment strategy.

question_text_original:
A developer is creating an application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The developer needs to configure the application parameters. The developer must configure limits for the application's maximum number of simultaneous connections and maximum number of transactions per second.

The maximum number of connections and transactions can change in the future. The developer needs a solution that can automatically deploy these changes to the application, as needed, without causing downtime.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS Serverless Application Model（AWS SAM）构建了运行于 AWS Lambda 的应用。成功部署应用的正确步骤顺序是什么？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。SAM 先构建，再将部署制品打包上传 S3，最后通过 CloudFormation 部署；现代 sam deploy 可自动完成打包上传。

知识点／记忆点：构建产生可部署制品，打包把本地路径转成云端可访问地址，部署才创建或更新资源；这三个逻辑阶段不能颠倒。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：EBS 不是 SAM 部署制品的标准共享上传位置，也无需在 EC2 构建。

C：尚未打包并上传制品就部署，模板可能仍引用不可访问的本地文件。

D：CodeCommit 是源代码仓库，不是 SAM 部署资源的目标服务。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 355

question_text: 开发人员需要将新应用代码部署到 AWS Lambda 函数。应用运行其业务逻辑所需的依赖文件大小为 500 MB。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。500 MB 依赖超出 ZIP 部署解压后的 250 MB 限额；容器镜像上传 ECR 后创建镜像型 Lambda，镜像上限更大。

适用前提与时效：本题按既有 ZIP/容器镜像 Lambda 模型判断；具体包大小配额应以所选计算模型和当前官方配额为准。

知识点／记忆点：部署限制要区分压缩上传大小、解压大小和镜像大小；改用 S3 上传不会改变函数包本身的解压限制。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：压缩能减小上传体积，但不能绕过 ZIP 运行包的解压限制。

B：S3 只改变上传入口，不能解决此依赖造成的 ZIP 解压大小问题。

C：镜像型 Lambda 从 ECR 获取镜像，不直接运行 S3 中的镜像对象。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 356

Package the application code and dependencies into a container image. Upload the image to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the Lambda function to run the code in the image.
Package the application code and dependencies into a container image. Push the image to an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Deploy the image to the Lambda function.

question_text_original:
A developer needs to deploy the code for a new application on an AWS Lambda function. The application needs a dependency file that is 500 MB to run the business logic.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

question_text: 一家公司正在开发可公开访问的单页应用，浏览器客户端调用后端服务提供用户界面。应用依赖一个通过 HTTP API 暴露的第三方 Web 服务，客户端必须在 HTTP 请求标头中提供 API 密钥，但公司的密钥不能向 Web 应用用户暴露。哪种方案最具成本效益？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。公网 REST API 的 HTTP 集成可在后端请求映射中加入第三方 API key，避免向浏览器暴露密钥，也无需额外 Lambda。

知识点／记忆点：浏览器能查看发送的请求，任何放到客户端的共享密钥都不能保密；将密钥注入放在服务端代理边界。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：私有 REST API 不能直接供公网单页应用用户普遍访问。

B：除私有 API 的可达性问题外，还增加不必要的 Lambda 代理。

D：Lambda 可以安全代调，但简单 HTTP 转发用直接集成少一层执行成本。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 358

The application depends on a third-party web service exposed as an HTTP API. The web client must provide an API key to the third-party web service by using the HTTP header as part of the HTTP request. The company's API key must not be exposed to the users of the web application.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS CDK 将应用堆栈部署到新测试环境。应用包含多个作为资产部署的 AWS Lambda 函数，均使用 CDK Lambda 构造库定义。开发人员已通过 cdk deploy 成功部署到第一个账户的 alpha 环境。首次部署到第二个账户的 beta 环境时，虽未显著修改 CDK 代码，却收到 NoSuchBucket 错误。重新部署前应运行哪个命令？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。新账户或区域首次使用 CDK 部署资产前需 bootstrap，创建包括资产 S3 桶在内的部署资源。

知识点／记忆点：CDK 部署资产需要账户与区域级的引导资源；代码相同并不意味着新环境已具备资产桶和部署角色。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：synth 只生成 CloudFormation 模板，不创建缺失的引导桶。

C：init 初始化本地项目，不初始化目标账户部署基础设施。

D：destroy 删除资源，不能建立缺失的部署桶。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 359

cdk bootstrap
cdk init

question_text_original:

The application contains the code for several AWS Lambda functions that will be deployed as assets. Each Lambda function is defined by using the AWS CDK Lambda construct library.

The developer has already successfully deployed the application stacks to the alpha environment in the first account by using the AWS CDK CLI's cdk deploy command. The developer is preparing to deploy to the beta environment in a second account for the first time. The developer makes no significant changes to the CDK code between deployments, but the initial deployment in the second account is unsuccessful and returns a NoSuchBucket error.

Which command should the developer run before redeployment to resolve this error?

question_text: 开发人员使用 AWS SAM 自动部署新应用，其中包含一个 AWS Lambda 函数和一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。函数只需读取桶内对象。应如何配置 AWS SAM，授予所需读取权限？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。SAM 的 S3ReadPolicy 策略模板可为函数生成读取指定桶所需权限；应限制 BucketName，避免不必要的写权限。

知识点／记忆点：函数执行角色决定代码能访问哪些下游资源；授权程序控制谁能调用 API，不能替代函数自身的 S3 读取权限。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：Lambda authorizer 负责 API 请求身份验证，不授予业务函数读桶权限。

B：桶策略属于 S3 资源，不能作为桶策略直接附到 Lambda 函数。

C：SQS 没有“只用于对象读取的主题”，也不能提供 S3 权限。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 360

options.text: Reference a second Lambda authorizer function.
Add a custom S3 bucket policy to the Lambda function.
Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) topic for only S3 object reads. Reference the topic in the template.
Add the S3ReadPolicy template to the Lambda function's execution role.

question_text_original:
A developer is automating a new application deployment with AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). The new application has one AWS Lambda function and one Amazon S3 bucket. The Lambda function must access the S3 bucket to only read objects.

How should the developer configure AWS SAM to grant the necessary read privilege to the S3 bucket?

question_text: 开发团队希望每当源代码变化时立即构建并部署应用。可以使用哪些方式触发部署？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AC。CodePipeline 支持 S3 和 CodeCommit 源并通过变更事件触发；固定十五分钟轮询不满足立即触发。

知识点／记忆点：即时 CI/CD 依赖代码变更事件；可持久访问的源仓库或对象制品与临时计算磁盘的角色不同。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：EBS 文件变化不是 CodePipeline 原生源事件机制。

D：十五分钟定时运行有等待时间，不满足变更立即触发。

E：实例临时盘可能丢失，并需要自建触发逻辑，不是可靠原生源集成。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 361

options.text: Store the source code in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS CodePipeline to start whenever a file in the bucket changes.
Store the source code in an encrypted Amazon EBS volume. Configure AWS CodePipeline to start whenever a file in the volume changes.
Store the source code in an AWS CodeCommit repository. Configure AWS CodePipeline to start whenever a change is committed to the repository.
Store the source code in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS CodePipeline to start every 15 minutes.
Store the source code in an Amazon EC2 instance’s ephemeral storage. Configure the instance to start AWS CodePipeline whenever there are changes to the source code.

question_text_original:
A development team wants to immediately build and deploy an application whenever there is a change to the source code.

Which approaches could be used to trigger the deployment? (Choose two.)

question_text: 开发人员正在构建集成 Amazon API Gateway 与 AWS Lambda 函数的应用。调用 API 时收到错误：Wed Nov 08 01:13:00 UTC 2017 : Method completed with status: 502。开发人员应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：C。Lambda 代理集成返回格式错误会造成 502，修正响应格式是所给选项中的方向；仅有 502 状态码不能唯一证明根因，还需检查执行日志。

知识点／记忆点：代理集成有规定的响应契约，业务成功不代表网关能解析返回值；502 应先定位网关与后端交界处的日志。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：API Gateway 端点本来采用 HTTPS，协议切换不能修复代理响应格式。

B：请求负载错误通常需按请求验证和函数日志定位，不能由此 502 推定。

D：身份验证问题通常表现为 401/403，不是此处最合理的 502 解释。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 362

options.text: Change the HTTP endpoint of the API to an HTTPS endpoint.
Change the format of the payload sent to the API Gateway.
Change the format of the Lambda function response to the API call.
Change the authorization header in the API call to access the Lambda function.

question_text_original:
A developer is building an application integrating an Amazon API Gateway with an AWS Lambda function. When calling the API, the developer receives the following error:

Wed Nov 08 01:13:00 UTC 2017 : Method completed with status: 502

What should the developer do to resolve the error?

question_text: 开发人员正在为运行于 Amazon EC2 实例的应用构建多个微服务，需要监控服务间请求的端到端视图，并调试各微服务问题。应如何实现？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：C。X-Ray 分布式追踪用于查看微服务调用链；题目使用的旧 X-Ray SDK 已进入维护阶段，新埋点应考虑 OpenTelemetry。

知识点／记忆点：分布式追踪用共同 trace 上下文把跨服务调用关联成链；日志集中化不自动产生父子调用关系。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：聚合日志指标可辅助排障，但未必能直接还原每次请求跨服务的端到端路径。

B：CloudTrail 记录 AWS API 审计，不聚合业务微服务运行指标与调用链。

D：AWS Health 反映 AWS 服务与账户相关事件，不追踪自建微服务请求。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-daemon-timeline.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 363

options.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch to aggregate the microservices' logs and metrics, and build the monitoring dashboard.
Use AWS CloudTrail to aggregate the microservices' logs and metrics, and build the monitoring dashboard.
Use the AWS X-Ray SDK to add instrumentation in all the microservices, and monitor using the X-Ray service map.
Use AWS Health to monitor the health of all the microservices.

question_text_original:
A developer is building various microservices for an application that will run on Amazon EC2 instances. The developer needs to monitor the end-to-end view of the requests between the microservices and debug any issues in the various microservices.

What should the developer do to accomplish these tasks?

question_text: 开发人员正在构建一个微服务，通过 AWS Lambda 处理 Amazon SQS 标准队列消息。函数调用外部 API 丰富消息数据，再将数据加载到 Amazon Redshift。队列必须处理最高每秒 1,000 条消息。初始测试中，函数反复向 Redshift 表插入重复数据，影响分析；所有重复消息的提交时间彼此相隔不超过 1 分钟。开发人员应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：A。FIFO 去重可抑制五分钟内相同去重标识的重复发送；仍需配置足够吞吐并使写入端幂等，不能仅靠 FIFO 保证业务操作绝不重复。

知识点／记忆点：队列去重抑制重复发送，消费端幂等防止同一业务被重复执行；二者处理的是不同阶段，FIFO 不等于下游写入绝对只发生一次。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：降低并发不识别重复业务消息，也无法阻止故障后的重投。

C：/tmp 只在一个执行环境内可用，不能作为所有并发消费者共享的可靠去重账本。

D：标准队列不能仅靠 message group ID 开启 FIFO 去重语义。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 364

options.text: Create an SQS FIFO queue. Enable message deduplication on the SQS FIFO queue.
Reduce the maximum Lambda concurrency that the SQS queue can invoke.
Use Lambda's temporary storage to keep track of processed message identifiers
Configure a message group ID for every sent message. Enable message deduplication on the SQS standard queue.

question_text_original:
A developer is building a microservice that uses AWS Lambda to process messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The Lambda function calls external APIs to enrich the SQS message data before loading the data into an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. The SQS queue must handle a maximum of 1,000 messages per second.

During initial testing, the Lambda function repeatedly inserted duplicate data into the Amazon Redshift table. The duplicate data led to a problem with data analysis. All duplicate messages were submitted to the queue within 1 minute of each other.

How should the developer resolve this issue?

question_text: 一家公司的延迟敏感应用通过 Amazon API Gateway API 调用 AWS Lambda 函数。开发人员需要减少默认扩展机制相关的冷启动时间。应如何配置？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。预置并发提前初始化执行环境，应配置到已发布版本或别名；reserved concurrency 仅限制和保留并发额度。

知识点／记忆点：预置并发预热执行环境，预留并发划分调用额度；账户限额提高可扩展上限，但不会预先执行初始化。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：增加内存可加快初始化，预留并发却不会提前创建温热环境。

C：预留并发不消除首次执行环境初始化。

D：提高账户并发配额不能解决新环境的冷启动延迟。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 365

options.text: Publish a new version of the Lambda function. Configure provisioned concurrency. Set the provisioned concurrency limit to meet the company requirements.
Increase the Lambda function's memory to the maximum amount. Increase the Lambda function's reserved concurrency limit.
Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function to a number that matches the current production load.
Use Service Quotas to request an increase in the Lambda function's concurrency limit for the AWS account where the function is deployed.

question_text_original:
A company has an application that uses an Amazon API Gateway API to invoke an AWS Lambda function. The application is latency sensitive.

A developer needs to configure the Lambda function to reduce the cold start time that is associated with default scaling.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员将应用部署在账户 A 的 Amazon EC2 实例上，应用需要读取账户 B 中现有的 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。应采取哪些措施授予访问权限？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：BC。采用跨账户角色方案时，在 B 创建读取角色并信任 A，A 的执行角色还需 sts:AssumeRole 权限；C 把双方都称为信任策略不严谨。Kinesis 也支持资源策略方案。

适用前提与时效：原库采用 BC 角色方案，C 表述不严谨；若采用支持的资源策略，AE 也需按完整双侧授权复核。

知识点／记忆点：跨账户角色方案需要两侧配合：目标角色信任来源身份，来源身份有 AssumeRole 权限；信任策略与读流权限分别控制不同动作。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：仅修改来源角色的读取权限，没有目标侧授权或 AssumeRole 链路，不足以跨账户访问。

D：信任策略授权代入角色，不直接授予 Kinesis 数据读取操作。

E：现行 Kinesis 支持资源策略，配合 A 可形成另一种访问方案，因此不能说 E 技术上错误。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 366

options.text: Update the instance profile role in Account A with stream read permissions.
Create an IAM role with stream read permissions in Account B.
Add a trust policy to the instance profile role and IAM role in Account B to allow the instance profile role to assume the IAM role.
Add a trust policy to the instance profile role and IAM role in Account B to allow reads from the stream.
Add a resource-based policy in Account B to allow read access from the instance profile role.

question_text_original:
A developer is deploying an application on Amazon EC2 instances that run in Account A. The application needs to read data from an existing Amazon Kinesis data stream in Account B.

Which actions should the developer take to provide the application with access to the stream? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家电商初创企业正在筹备年度促销。随着应用流量增长，开发团队希望在 Amazon EC2 实例 CPU 使用率超过 80% 时收到通知。哪种方案能够满足要求？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。EC2 的 CPUUtilization 是 CloudWatch 指标，用阈值告警关联 SNS；CloudTrail 不提供该性能指标。

知识点／记忆点：性能阈值用指标告警，操作追责用审计日志；通知主题只是投递通道，不负责检测 CPU 是否超标。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：CloudTrail 不提供 CPU 利用率指标告警。

C：describe-instance-information 不返回此 CPU 实时指标，十五分钟轮询也增加检测延迟。

D：CloudTrail 日志没有供此方案查询的 CPUUtilization 指标。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 367

options.text: Create a custom Amazon CloudWatch alarm that sends a notification to an Amazon SNS topic when the CPU utilization exceeds 80%.
Create a custom AWS CloudTrail alarm that sends a notification to an Amazon SNS topic when the CPU utilization exceeds 80%.
Create a cron job on the EC2 instance that invokes the --describe-instance-information command on the host instance every 15 minutes and sends the results to an Amazon SNS topic.
Create an AWS Lambda function that queries the AWS CloudTrail logs for the CPUUtilization metric every 15 minutes and sends a notification to an Amazon SNS topic when the CPU utilization exceeds 80%.

question_text_original:
An ecommerce startup is preparing for an annual sales event. As the traffic to the company's application increases, the development team wants to be notified when the Amazon EC2 instance's CPU utilization exceeds 80%.

Which solution will meet this requirement?

question_text: 一家公司的应用部署在 AWS Elastic Beanstalk，生成用户专属 PDF 并保存到 Amazon S3，再通过 Amazon SES 将 PDF 邮寄给订阅者。用户在生成 90 天后不再访问这些文件。存储桶未启用版本控制，包含大量过时 PDF。开发人员必须删除超过 90 天的文件以减少数量。哪种方案需要的开发工作最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。非版本化桶可用生命周期 Expiration 在指定天数后清理对象，无需每天扫描桶；实际删除是异步执行。

知识点／记忆点：按对象年龄清理应优先用存储生命周期；非版本化删除与版本化删除标记的效果不同，生命周期执行也不是秒级定时器。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：每日自行扫描和删除会增加应用代码、分页及失败重试维护。

B：Lambda 定时扫描仍需要自行实现全桶遍历和删除。

D：分区前缀加自定义清理没有必要，已有对象年龄可直接用于生命周期规则。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 369

options.text: Update the application code. In the code, add a rule to scan all the objects in the S3 bucket every day and to delete objects after 90 days.
Create an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to scan all the objects in the S3 bucket every day and to delete objects after 90 days.
Create an S3 Lifecycle rule for the S3 bucket to expire objects after 90 days.
Partition the S3 objects with a // key prefix. Create an AWS Lambda function to remove objects that have prefixes that have reached the expiration date.

question_text_original:
A company has an application that is deployed on AWS Elastic Beanstalk. The application generates user-specific PDFs and stores the PDFs in an Amazon S3 bucket. The application then uses Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to send the PDFs by email to subscribers.

Users no longer access the PDFs 90 days after the PDFs are generated. The S3 bucket is not versioned and contains many obsolete PDFs.

A developer must reduce the number of files in the S3 bucket by removing PDFs that are older than 90 days.

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

question_text: 开发人员正在排查应用，其中多个 AWS Lambda 函数调用 Amazon API Gateway API。API 的方法请求使用 Amazon Cognito 授权程序进行身份验证。所有函数都在 Authorization 标头中传入用户 ID，但全部 GET 请求都收到 403。应如何解决？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。Cognito authorizer 需要有效 JWT，而非用户 ID 或 API key；令牌类型需与方法配置的授权范围匹配。

知识点／记忆点：用户 ID 是标识符，签名令牌才是可验证的身份凭据；授权服务器检查签名、有效期和所需 scope，而非相信任意用户编号。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：API key 用于使用计划和用量控制，不是 Cognito 用户 JWT。

C：资源策略放行不能弥补缺少有效 Cognito 令牌。

D：OPTIONS 预检处理浏览器跨域，不会为 GET 请求产生身份令牌。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 370

options.text: Modify the client GET request to include a valid API key in the Authorization header.
Modify the client GET request to include a valid token in the Authorization header.
Update the resource policy for the API Gateway API to allow the execute-api:Invoke action.
Modify the client to send an OPTIONS preflight request before the GET request.

question_text_original:
A developer is troubleshooting an application. The application includes several AWS Lambda functions that invoke an Amazon API Gateway API. The API Gateway's method request is set up to use an Amazon Cognito authorizer for authentication.

All the Lambda functions pass the user ID as part of the Authorization header to the API Gateway API. The API Gateway API returns a 403 status code for all GET requests.

How should the developer resolve this issue?

question_text: 一家公司通过 Amazon S3 接收文档，用户从 Web 界面上传后，AWS Lambda 函数被调用处理文件，但函数间歇性超时。如果函数使用默认设置，发生超时异常时，S3 事件会怎样处理？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。S3 异步调用 Lambda 出现超时等函数错误时，默认再重试两次；未配置失败目的地或死信队列时最终丢弃。

知识点／记忆点：异步失败与同步返回错误的重试责任不同；默认重试次数有限，未显式配置失败目的地就没有永久事件存档。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：不会自动创建 SNS 邮件通知，需要配置目的地与订阅。

B：不存在自动为每个函数建立的默认死信队列。

C：函数错误不会无限重试直到成功。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-error-handling.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 371

options.text: Notification of a failed S3 event is sent as an email through Amazon SNS.
The S3 event is sent to the default Dead Letter Queue.
The S3 event is processed until it is successful.
The S3 event is discarded after the event is retried twice.

question_text_original:
A company processes incoming documents from an Amazon S3 bucket. Users upload documents to an S3 bucket using a web user interface. Upon receiving files in S3, an AWS Lambda function is invoked to process the files, but the Lambda function times out intermittently.

If the Lambda function is configured with the default settings, what will happen to the S3 event when there is a timeout exception?

question_text: 开发人员通过 Amazon S3 事件通知调用 AWS Lambda 处理上传图片，在同一 AWS 账户中设置了开发和生产 S3 存储桶及对应函数。开发人员发现开发桶上传错误地调用了生产函数，必须防止开发数据影响生产函数。应如何操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：D。调用权限由 Lambda 资源策略控制；分账户并限制来源账户可阻断开发桶调用生产函数，执行角色只影响函数运行后的资源访问。

知识点／记忆点：允许谁调用函数由资源策略控制，函数调用后能读取什么由执行角色控制；环境隔离应同时考虑事件入口和数据权限。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：只限制函数读桶并不能阻止开发事件启动生产函数。

B：S3 桶策略不是给 Lambda 授予被调用权限的资源策略位置。

C：分账户加读取限制仍未直接限制生产函数接收何种来源调用。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 372

options.text: Update the execution role for the production Lambda function. Add a policy that allows the execution role to read from only the production S3 bucket.
Update the S3 bucket policy for the production S3 bucket to invoke the production Lambda function. Update the S3 bucket policy for the development S3 bucket to invoke the development Lambda function.

Separate the development environment and the production environment into their own AWS accounts. Update the execution role for each Lambda function. Add a policy that allows the execution role to read from only the S3 bucket that is in the same account.

Separate the development environment and the production environment into their own AWS accounts. Add a resource policy to the Lambda functions to allow only S3 bucket events in the same account to invoke the functions.

question_text_original:
A developer uses Amazon S3 Event Notifications to invoke AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda functions process images after the images are uploaded to S3 buckets. The developer has set up a development S3 bucket, a production S3 bucket, a development Lambda function, and a production Lambda function in the same AWS account.

The developer notices that uploads to the development S3 bucket wrongly invoke the production Lambda function. The developer must prevent development data from affecting the production Lambda function.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

question_text: 开发人员正在编写运行于 Auto Scaling 组内 Amazon EC2 实例的应用，希望将会话状态外置。可以使用哪些 AWS 服务或资源？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AC。DynamoDB 和 ElastiCache 可外置会话状态，使 EC2 Web 层保持无状态；负载均衡粘性会话不是外置存储。

知识点／记忆点：横向扩展的 Web 层不能把唯一会话副本放在实例内存；会话存储需要低延迟、按用户键读写且跨实例共享。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：Cognito 管身份和令牌，不是通用可变业务会话数据仓库。

D：负载均衡和粘性会话不保存实例失效后可恢复的会话数据。

E：SQS 用于消息传递，不提供按会话键随机读取最新状态的存储接口。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 373

question_text: 一家公司的无服务器应用通过 Amazon API Gateway API 调用 AWS Lambda 函数。开发人员修复了函数缺陷，准备部署到生产环境。为测试变更，需要将 10% 的生产实时流量发送到更新版本。哪组步骤能够满足要求？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：AC。发布新版本并在别名中配置百分之十路由权重，调用方须使用该别名。

知识点／记忆点：灰度比例应在调用路径真正使用的路由入口配置；仅发布新版本不会产生流量，调用方必须引用对应别名。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：阶段之间没有此处描述的通用加权路由配置，应区分阶段内金丝雀与 Lambda 别名路由。

D：NLB 不能按此方式将请求直接分配给 Lambda 版本。

E：DNS 权重针对记录目标，不直接控制同一函数不同版本的调用权重。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 374

question_text: 开发人员正在为一家跨国公司创建视频搜索应用，视频文件平均大小为 2.5 TB。存储系统必须在前 90 天提供即时访问，90 天之后允许加载耗时超过 10 分钟。哪种方案最具成本效益？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：有条件成立】
参考答案：D。Glacier Instant Retrieval 提供即时读取，后续可转 Flexible Retrieval；D 在给定选项中可行，但最省钱取决于读取频率和取回量，题目未充分量化。

知识点／记忆点：归档类名称中的 Instant 与 Flexible 表示取回模型不同；存储单价之外，还应把取回费用、最短存储期和访问频率一起算入成本。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：文件系统实时访问可行，但在本题大对象归档需求下承担较高文件存储成本。

B：Deep Archive 在前九十天不能即时获取对象。

C：EBS 是需附加计算实例的块存储，没有此处直接自动转入 S3 归档的原生生命周期。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 375

A developer is creating a video search application for a global company. The video files have an average size of 2.5 TB. The video storage system must provide instant access to the video files for the first 90 days. After the first 90 days, the video files can take more than 10 minutes to load.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question_text: 一家公司的虚拟现实游戏使用由 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB 构成的无服务器后端。最近全球新用户突然增长，同时用户数据获取出现延迟。公司可使用哪项 AWS 服务或功能，将数据库响应时间降低到微秒级？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：B。DAX 为 DynamoDB 缓存读取提供微秒级延迟；强一致性读会转发到基础表，不能一概承诺微秒返回。

知识点／记忆点：微秒级缓存读取与数据库扩容是两类优化；缓存命中绕过后端读取，而强一致性读取仍需要访问基础表。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：ElastiCache 可自行缓存数据，但需要应用自己管理缓存键和失效，不是 DynamoDB 原生透明加速路径。

C：自动扩容缓解吞吐不足，不把正常数据库读取变成微秒级缓存访问。

D：CloudFront 缓存 HTTP 内容，不直接加速 DynamoDB 数据 API。

官方依据：

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/evaluate-dax-suitability.html
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 376

Which AWS service or feature can the company use to reduce the database response time to microseconds?

question_text: 开发人员正在创建持续跟踪账户内 Amazon S3 存储桶的方案，已创建定时运行的 AWS Lambda 函数，列出所有桶并保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表。函数使用 AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole 托管策略运行时出现权限错误。需要哪些权限才能解决？（选择两项。）
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：BC。AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole 只提供基础日志权限，函数仍需 S3 列桶和 DynamoDB 写入权限。

知识点／记忆点：执行角色要逐个覆盖实际调用的下游 API；基础日志策略只让函数写日志，不隐含访问业务存储的权限。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：题目只涉及同一账户资源，不要求跨账户角色。

D：函数按计划运行，并非由 S3 调用，且该权限不允许函数列桶。

E：允许 DynamoDB 调用函数不能让函数向表写入。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 377

The function will list the account's S3 buckets and will store the list in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer receives a permissions error when the developer runs the function with the AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole AWS managed policy.

Which combination of permissions should the developer use to resolve this error? (Choose two.)

question_text: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行学习管理系统（LMS），应用部署在 Application Load Balancer 后方的 Amazon EC2 实例上，域名由 Amazon Route 53 管理。目前只部署在单一区域，但公司希望改善全球用户的性能。哪种方案的运维开销最少？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：A。CloudFront 使用 ALB 为源站，在边缘缓存并加速分发；Route 53 alias 把域名指向分发，无需多区域重部署。

知识点／记忆点：全球访问慢未必是源站算力不足；边缘分发缩短用户路径并缓存可缓存响应，比复制多区域应用更轻量。

其他选项为什么不选：

B：单一区域增加实例不缩短跨洲网络距离，粘性会话也不解决该问题。

C：要求用户连 VPN 增加接入负担，不是全球内容加速方案。

D：多区域部署可改善体验，但需维护数据和部署一致性，运维开销高于边缘分发。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 379

question_text: 开发人员在 Amazon S3 托管静态网站，通过 Amazon CloudFront 分配及指向该分配 URL 的自定义域名访问。CI/CD 流水线在 AWS CodeCommit 变更时自动运行，先执行源阶段，再由 AWS CodeBuild 按 buildspec.yml 构建代码并将静态文件部署到 S3。流水线成功，桶中和 S3 网站 URL 均可看到最新文件，但通过 CloudFront 域名访问时没有更新。应在 buildspec.yml 中配置什么操作？
explanation_en:
【答案核查：已确认正确】
参考答案：C。S3 已更新而 CloudFront 仍旧通常是边缘缓存；在部署后创建 invalidation，或采用版本化文件名。

知识点／记忆点：验证发布要分别看源站与 CDN：源站新而 CDN 旧是缓存一致性问题，不是构建失败；失效应在上传新文件后执行。

其他选项为什么不选：

A：题目已确认新文件位于 S3，再同步不能清除边缘旧副本。

B：删除并重新上传源站文件仍不保证边缘缓存立即失效。

D：CORS 决定跨域访问许可，不决定缓存返回哪个版本。
source: ExamTopics 本地缓存 DVA-C02 / Topic 1 / Question 380
